dpeshi/ /mi che'i byung ba brjod pa/rke (4tsho deb gsam pa/ ༷1/ 4 ri/ ga tsho/no/ ba ri //sa ༄ 41 533 // ni poka/ 83 4 6 du //rte tshespute900stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis kyis brtsams/bkra shis che ring gis rtsom sgrig rgyus ston gnang /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /1995

009718'i/6726sdusaX/pyalaXrdo123lo6410750byakum pa ṭar nang bcag mkhan zu ba/bkris don grab/'jigs med che ring /rig chosi ring rgyab sha'i mjes rtsal jas 'god/sa 6 6ba'irmi ༵༵'i/khro/༷༷ /7༷༵༵ snyiX /༷/(wa0(3265

dkar chags bcad bdun pa/le tshan so gnyis pa/ shar lho'i rgyal khab khag la lta skor du bskyod pa/ 5le tshan so gsum pa/ rang gzhung dang tha'i wan dbar gyi 'brel ba/ 39le tshan so bzhi pa/ 'brug tu gnas chags bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la dka' tshogs 'phrad pa'i skor/ 59le tshan so lnga pa/ glo smon thang gi drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi don rkyen/ 83sa bcad brgyad pa/le tshan so drug pa/ 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog gi sku tshab dang po bod ljongs yongs su blta skor du bskyod pa'i skor/ 135le tshan so bdun pa/ rang re'i rgyal sa lha sa dang / sa gnas gnad yod khag bcas la blta skor 'tshams 'drir bskyod pa'i 'char snang / 181le tshan so brgyad pa/ 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs zab mo ltar rang gzhung gi sku tshab snga rjes gnyis pe cing du 'brel mol ched brdzong mdzad pa'i skor/ na19

le tshan so dgu pa/ phyi lo 1984 lor bod gzhung gi sku tshab mi gsum pe cing du gros mol thengs gnyis par bskyod pa/ na51le tshan bzhi cu pa/ phran zer gyi ming thog nas pe cing du 'brel gtug tu bskyod pa/ 259le tshan zhe gcig pa/ btsan byol du 'byor khongs de snga rang dbang rang btsan skabs kyi bod gzhung dmag snar khag gi 'go dmag yongs nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chenapor brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul zhus pa/ 303sku dpar khag cig bzhugs/

sa bcad bdun pa/le tshan so gnyis pa/shar lho'i rgyal khab khag la lta skor du bskyod pa/da༅༅/ /phyi lo 1955 zla nya nang 7gong sa mchog nas kho bor dgongs bzhes bla med kyis re zhig shar phyogs rgyal khab khag la skyo gseng dang sbrags lta bskor tu bskyod na zhes bka' bzang spyi bor phebs te rgya gar nas hong kong du bskyod de rla gnyis ring de khul lhod sdod kyis de sngon gyi ngo shes grogs po sku zhabs kra'u cing khrin gyis deng skabs rgya nag skam sa chen po'i chab srid dang / dpal 'byor rim 'gyur thog lo shas rjes rgya nag la dmangs gtso'i las 'gul chen po zhig nges par yong gi red ces ma 'ongs dbye zhib lta bus yang yang gsungs pa dang / de bzhin khong gis/ma 'ongs par rgya nag la mnyam sbrel rgyal khab zhig btsugs nas bod de krung hwa mnyam sbrel rgyal khab de'i khongs kyi rgyal phran zhig chags kyi red ces gsungs pa ltar/ de'i skor khong gis de sngon rtsom yig cig kyang bris gnang mdzad 'dugahong kong nas nyi hong dang / lho ko ri ya/ tha'i wan bcas su rtog zhib lta bskor du bskyod de nyi hong rgyal sa khreg khyer la a ri'i ma rtsa can rog kha phe lar (200601121121 205bsku'i/100) cherdogs pa'i ming thog nas rgyal khab 'ga' shas la 5

bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung / skad yig bcas nyams zhib kyi ched du bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' shas dang / eng lan/ 'jar man/ a ri/ ho lan/ nyi hong / ose ṭi ri ya/ pha ran si bcas rgyal khab khag gi mtho slob dang / dpe mdzod khang bcas kyi bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang yod rigs la mthun rkyen gyi rogs ram byas te gdan zhu byas pa ltar skabs der nyi hong rgyal sa'i e shi ya'i dpe mdzod khang du rnying ma'i mkhas btsun bzang po rin po che dang / ngor thar rtse mkhan po bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lcags sprag lcam chung che ring sgrol ma rnam gsum de khul du phyag las gnang gi yod pa ltar kho bo khong rnams dang lhan du rla ba gsum tsam bsdad de dpe mdzod khang der snga rabs bod dang rgya nag dbar 'brel ba ji byung skor bod rgya'i rgyal rabs chos 'byung yig rnying khag la nyams zhib gang thub byas pa dang / de bzhinanyi hong gi rgyal rabs dang / bod nyi gnyis dbar 'brel ba ji byung skor yang nyams zhib byas pa yin/ de bzhin nyi hong gi grong khyer 'ga' shas la lta skor du bskyod cing /de sngon bod du ngo shes grogs po nyi hong pa rla ba bzang po'am khe mu ra yis ngo sprod byas pa ltar chab srid tshogs pa 'ga' shas kyis mgron 'bod byas par bskyod de de rnams la bod kyi 'das ma 'ongs da lta bcas kyi skor rang gis gang shes ngo sprod gtam bshad zhus pa dang / nyi hong na gzhon khag gcig gis bod kyi snga rabs lo rgyus dang / bod mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs/ yul srol goms gshis/ yul gyi chags stangs bcas kyi skor la yang do snang gis dre ba sna tshogs byas par dres lan gang thub brgyab/ sku zhabs rla ba bzang po'i ngo shes chab srid pa/ nyi tong gzhung gi mtho rim mi sna/ tshogs pa khag gi 'gan khur ba/ chos byed mi sna/ mtho slob dge rgan/ las rigs gzhan gyi mi sna khag bcas rim bzhin mjal 'phrad zhu skabs de 6

rnams mang che bas rgya dmar gyis bod la dpung 'jug btsan 'dzul byas par blo pham dang / bod mi rnams la gdung sems mnyam skyed yod ces gsungs pa las bod don thog rgyab skyor byed pa'i bsam tshul dang / bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la dpal 'byor dang / slob gso bcas kyi rogs ram 'di byed kyi bsam tshul shod mkhan ha cang nyung nyung yin pa dang / srid don pa 'ga' shas kyis phangs sems yod mdog gi rnam 'gyur bstan te rgya dmar gyis bod la dbang sgyur byas nas bzung bod mi rigs dang/ bod kyi rig gzhung / chos bcas rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha chen po yod pa ma zad/ slad bod don skor rgyal spyi'i thog rim bzhin yal 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha yod lugs thag bcad nas shod mkhan yang byung / bsam tshul de lta bu thos skabs rang nyid kyang yid mug dang sems pham brjod las 'das pa zhig byung /gong zhus ltar/ de khul sdod ring de sngon bod nyi gnyis dbar dang thog 'brel ba ji byung skor 'brel yod mi sna 'ga' shas la dri ba zhus pa dang / dpe mdzod khang de'i nang ngos nas nyams zhib byas pa dang / de rjes dpe mdzod bkra shis che ring gis kyang dpyad rtsom spel ba gnyis nas mdor bsdus shig zhor 'phros su 'god rgyur/de yang dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go tsam la bod nyi'i dbar 'brel ba byed 'go btsugs 'dug phyi lo 1899 lo'i zu 8 pa'i nang nyi hong gi mi/ na ri ta ya su ti ru dang / btsun pa te ra mo to en ga (121mas0 07tham) btsun pa hi ro shi no mi (mtsha0bya so 007) bcas bod sde dar rtse mdo dang / 'ba' sa khul bcas su slebs myong yod pa las/ skabs der de rnams kyis lha sar 'gro rtsis byas kyang bod gzhung nas phyi rgyal mi rigs su 'dra zhig kyang bod kyi rgyal sar mi gtong ba'i skabs 'khel gshis khong tsho lha sar slebs thub mi 'dug de rjes 1901 lo'i rla 37

nang nyi hong gi btsun pa ka ba sgu ci e ke (26457770051) bod ming shes rab rgya mtsho zhes pa de lha sar slebs/ khong ni nyi tong gi mi bod kyi rgyal sar slebs pa snga shos de yin/ de rjes na ri ta ya su te ru yis rgya rigs yin khul gyis rgya mi cang lan g.yos zer bar ming brdzus byas nas lo de'i rla 12 pa'i nang lha sar 'byor/1901 lo pe cing g.yung two dgon gyi mkhan po a kya hu thog thu dang / se ra'i mkhan po 'od zer rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi ngo shes nyi hong btsun pa ti ra mu to nas khong gnyis sar bod kyi nang chos dang / skad yig phran bu slob sbyong byas te khong rnam gnyis rla shas ring nyi hong rgyal khab tu gzigs skor gnang bar gdan zhu byas/ 1905lo'i rla 5 pa'i nang gong gsal mkhan po rnam gnyis kyis rogs ram gnang ba'i 'og te ra mu to mtsho sngon brgyud lha sar 'byor/ de rjes kho pas lha sa nas bkris lhun po dang / 'bras spongs/ rgya gar bcas brgyud nyi hong du phyir log byas/ phyi lo 1905 rla 11 par te ra mu to sku 'bum dgon du 'byor nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i gser zhal mjal te kho pas bod nyi rgyal khab gnyis 'brel gtugs dgos lugs dang / lhag par rgyal khab phan tshun gyi nang chos dang / rig gzhung slob gnyer spel res kyi 'brel ba dgos gal shin tu chen po yod lugs/ 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum mchog nyi hong du khyug tsam zhabs sor 'khod thub pa byung na dge mtshan yod lugs bcas kyi bsam tshul zhus 'dugaphyi lo 1908 lo'i zla 9 pa'i nang 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum chen po mchog pe cing du zhabs sor 'khod pa'i skabs der/ 7gong sa mchog nas te ra mu to la bod ming blo bzang thub bstan bzod pa zhes bstsal/1908 lo'i zu 5 pa'i nang / 7gong sa mchog rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar zhabs 8

sor 'khod skabs nyi hong gi ni shi hon kun ci lha khang (ga156150ba8lo/01219/0)gi mkhan po ko dzu o ta ni (50751(7lo1) nyi hong gong ma zhes pa'i gcung po/ sun yus o ta ni (500550 'ab1) 7gong sa mchog gi mjal kha zhu bar ched brdzong byas pa ltar mjal kha bstsal/ de ni nyi hong rgyal rgyud kyi sku nye zhig yin lugs zer/khong gis bod nyi gnyis nang chos kyi 'brel ba yag po yong thabs su rgyal khab phan tshun slob gnyer spel res bya rgyu'i bsam tshul zhus pa dang / 7gong sa mchog la nyi tong nang chos kyi dpe cha pod gsum dang / nyi hong snga rabs su dar ba'i shin to zhes pa thog mar gsar gtod byed mkhan ston pa shig ran gyis brtsams pa'i san dzi a san zhes pa'i dpe cha zhig kyang phul ba red/ 7gong sa mchog nas kyang 'phags pa shes rab kyi phal rol du phyin pa'i mdo sogs mdo lugs kyi phyag dpe mang po bskur gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ rjes su bod rgyal khab nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che cha tshang zhig gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa ltar/ 1915 lo rgya gar brgyud chu thog nas btang ba gnang / 7gong sa mchog pe cing du bzhugs ring nyi hong gzhung gi gzhung tshab gon su gis ha ya shi (6003060575451) gzhungatshab khang khongs kyi dmag dpon ma sa no ri phu khya shi ma 04mthab0075646yom/ yang mjal 'phrad du bcar te bod nyi rgyal khab gnyis 4kyi 'brel ba byed phyogs skor bka' mol mang tsam byung ba dang / lhag par du dmag dpon des bod rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs 'phel rgyas su gtong ched bod mi na gzhon la drag po'i las lugs slob sbyong dang / sbyong brdar nges par dgos gal bcas kyi skor bsam tshul zhus/ dmag dpon ma sa no ni phu phu shi ma de chung dus nas bod don skor do snang chen po yod mkhan zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod du 'gro 'dod chen po byung zhes zhus 'dug de min 9

dmag dpon ya sa ma su phu ku shi ma (ji 0000131 1355tham35 6565361mo'i/zhes pa de yang mjal 'phrad du bcar te nyi hong gi gsar thon 'phrul mda' 'ga' shas kyang 'bul lam zhus 'dugaphyi lo 1910 lo'i dpyod ka 7rgyal dbang skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rdor gling du bzhugs skabs/ nyi hong ni shi hon kun ji'i lha khang gi mkhan po ki dzu'i o ta nas a'o ki pan jo (240550 407) zhes pa de rdor gling du ched bcar zhus te 7gong sa mchog la lo de sngon phan tshun gnyis kyis chos dang rig gzhung gi slob gnyer spel res zhu rgyu'i skor bskyar du snyan seng zhus pa ltar 7gong sa mchog gis bod nyi rgyal khab gnyis phan tshun 'brel lam byung na dgongs kyang / bod kyi khyim mches ru su dang / dbyin ji/ rgya nag bcas nas rnyog rtsod yong gzhir dgongs te ri zhig ne shi hon kun ji lha khang sger gyi ming thog nas bod kyi bla ma gdan 'dren chog rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / 1911 zu 4 tsam nang 7gong sa mchog nas sku bcar mkhan che ser smad tsha ba khri sprul ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin dang /phyag rogs dge 'dun pa gnyis bcas o'o ke pun jo lhan du sog por brdzus te ka ta nas sing ga pur brgyud nyi hong du phebs/ khong rnam gnyis nyi tong du lo gcig tsam bzhugs ring / nyi tong gi btsun pa ta ta to kun dang / a'i ke bun kyo gnyis nas tsha sprul rin po che'i skya 'khor la nyi hong gi skad yig bslab pa dang / phar khong gnyis la bod kyi skad yig bslabs/ zhor du tsha sprul rin po ches nyi hong gi rgyal rabs la do snang chen po gnang / rdor gling nas 7gong sa mchog gis tsha sprul rin po che la gsang tar gnang nas 1912 zla 1 nang rgya gar la phyir log gnang / skabs der tsha sprul rin po che'i lhan du nyi hong gi btsun pa ta ta to kon dang / a'o ke bun kyo bcas 10

rgya gar du 'byor nas bka' sbug khul du 7gong sa mchog gi mjal khar bcar nas ta ta to kun dang / a'o ke gnyis bod du slob gnyer la 'gro chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang ste 7gong sa mchog gis a'o ke la bod ming thub bstan bkris dang / ta ta to ko la bod ming thub bstan rgyal mtshan zhes pa bstsal/phyi lo 1912 zla 9 ches 9 nyin a'o ke bka' sbug nas bod la thon/lha sar 'byor nas dang thog lo gcig tsam 'bras spungs su chos kyi slob gnyer la bzhugs pa dang / de rjes lha sa yab gzhis phun khang nang lo gcig dang phyed tsam bzhugs ring / bod kyi nang chos kyis gtsos sum rtag dang / yig gzugs/ rgyal rabs/ goms gshis bcas slob sbyong dang / rten gnas mjal ba/ bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan nyams zhib bcas gnang / lha sa nas rdog thon gyis bkris lhun por paṇa chen rin po che mjal nas nyi hong du phyir log byas/ nyi hong du 'byor nas bod kyi sum rtags skor deb gcig dang / de rjes bod kyi rig gzhung la gsar du nyams zhib ces pa'i deb cig kyang brtsams/ 1951 lo thog kyo mtho rim slob grwa'i bod skad dge rgan byas/phyi lo 1913 lo'i dbyar dus/ yā su ci ro ya ci ma (1355)110 121177)zhes pa des rgya gar brgyud lha sar 'byor nas lo gnyis tsam ring tshong las rtsag rtsig byas nas bsdad/ phyi lo 1914 lo bod gzhung dmag spyi tsha rong gis bskul ba bzhin bod dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam la nyi tong gi drag po'i dmag sbyong dge rgan byas/sngon spos ltar skabs der las zhor nor gling pho brang gi lho nub ngos 7rgyal ba'i sku srung dmag sgar gsar bskrun gyis bkod dbyibs de nyi hong gi lugs ltar ar las 'go 'doms bskos/ gong 'khod le tshan zhig gi nang kho pa'i lo rgyus 'khod pa bzhin ga

7gong sa mchog gis khong la bod kyi drag po'i dpon rigs kyi go gnas bstsal/1920 lo bod rigs kyi chung ma dang bu gcig bcas nyi hong du phyir log byas/ ta ta to kon zhes pa de a'u ge'i rjes su 1913 lo'i zla 10 nang rgya gar nas lha sar 'byor te se ra har gdong khan tshan du chos zhugs kyis lo ngo 11 la nye ba chos kyi slob gnyer byas/ 1933 lor bod nas rgya gar brgyud nyi hong du phyir log skabs khong gis rta khal brgyad cu brgal ba'i sde dge par ma bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig dang /bstan 'gyur cha tshang gsum/ de min phyag dpe sna mang bcas gdan zhus kyis nyi tong tho ho ku mtho slob dpe mdzod khang du gdan zhu byas 'dug kho bo nyi hong du sdod ring khong e shi ya'i dpe mdzod khang nang gi bod kyi nang chos dang / rig gzhung skad yig bcas nyams zhib kyi 'gan khur pa yin stabs khong dang mjal 'phrad yang yang zhus te khong gis de sngon bod nyi gnyis kyi 'brel ba ji byung dang / khong lha sar bzhugs ring gi lo rgyus/ 7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen pos khong dang nyi hong mi rigs rnams la gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang lugs bcas kyi skor gleng mol mang po byung zhing /khong gis skya phreng 13 chen po'i mdzad rnam lta bu'i deb chung zhig kyang brtsams 'dug1914 lo dbyar dus ka ba ku ci e ke lha sar slar yang slebs nas phyag dpe sna mang 'tshol bsgrubs kyis 1915 lo bod kyi lo gsar rjes lha sa nas phyag dpe rnams gdan zhus kyis rgya gar brgyud phyir log gong gsal de rnams kyi bod nas gdan zhu byas pa'i phyag dpe rnams deng sang e shi ya'i dpe mdzod khang nang bzhugs yod par brten bar lam rgya gar nas gdan 'dren zhus pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bod dpe rnams la dkar chag 'god bzhin 'duganyi hong gi rgyal rabs lo rgyus dang / skad yig bcas kyi skor rob tsam brjod na/ga2

nyi hong mi rigs kyi yong khungs ni sa phyogs lho byang gnyis nas yong lugs zer yang mtha' gcig tu yong yul de yin zhes pa da bar dpyad zhib gtsang ma zhig thub med/nyi tong mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis nyi tong mi rigs khag gcig bod nas yong ba yin zhes pa'i skor deb ther dang / rtsom bris 'ga' shas yod/ ya mtshan pa zhig la nyi hong skad kyi bya tshig nang du bod kyi bya tshig mang po yod pa ma zad/ nyi hong gi grangs ka gcig nas bcu bar sgra 'bod stangs ha lam bod dang gcig pa yin/dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs nyi hong dang rgya nag dbar 'brel ba chen po byung nas nyi tong gi yi ge dang rgya yig gi go don gcig mtshungs yin na yang sgra de nyi hong skad kyi sgra de 'bod pa dang / bya tshig 'ga' shas thog rgya skad kyi sgra 'bod kyi 'dugadamag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su nub phyogs kyi tshan rig dang / 'phrul chas bcas kyi ming tshig gi sgra de rang 'jags 'bod cing lhag par du nyi hong gi mi tshos phyi nas yong ba'i rig gzhung dang dngos po rnams las sla por bsdu len byed thub pa dang / khong tshor phan thogs pa'i lta ba gsar pa dang / bya ba gsar pa'i rigs zur 'bud mi byed par dus yun thung ngu'i nang de dag nyi hong rang nyid kyi skad yig dang lta spyod du bsgyur gyi 'dug dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs nyi hong la pham nyes chen po byung ba'i rkyen ngan de grogs su shar nas sems shugs che bskyed kyis dus yun thung ngu'i nang nyi tong gi bzo las 'dzam gling thog deng rabs can du gyur pa ma zad/ dpal 'byor thad a ri rgyal khab kyi rjes su 'gran thub pa'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur pa red/nyi hong mi rigs kyi khyad chos de gus zhabs ldan zhing kun spyod legs pa/gzhon skyes rnams kyis rgan rabs rnams la gus zhabs chen po zhu ba/ gzhung sger gyi las byed tshang mas gong rim la brtsi gus ldan pa/ gong rim nas las 'gan gang ga3

sprad rnams legs sgrub dang / dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byed mkhan mi rigs zhig yin pa dang / mi rigs de rig gzhung dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas shing / las la brtson pa yin stabs phyi rol gyi mi chos nyi hong gi mi mang che ba rig gnas shes yon gyi gnas tshad mthon po yin par cha 'jog bsngags brjod byed yul zhig tu gyur/ nyi hong gi mi rigs de ngo shes phan tshun dbar zhi 'jam mthun gshibs dang ldan pa zhig yin pa dang / mnyam las kyi sgrig khrims la brtsi 'jog byed pa/ sger don 'bad brtson byed pa ltar gzhung don la yang gcig mtshungs kyi 'bad brtson byed pas mtshon rgyal gces lhag bsam gyi gnas tshad mtho ba/ las don thog le lo med par rgyun bsring lhod med kyis 'phral sgrub byed pa/ dus tshod chud zos su mi gtong ba'i goms gshis bzang ba/ las ka gang byas rung / las don ma grub sngon bsam blo nan tan btang nas lag len bstar ba las/ lam seng hol rgyugs kyis thag gcod mi byed pa bcas yin 'duganyi hong gi rgyal rabs skor rob tsam gleng na/ dus rabs bdun par nyi hong gi rgyal sras shrī tho khu tha e shis nyi hong rgyal khab kyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i ring chab srid lam lugs kyi gsar bcos mang gzhi gsar gtod byed mkhan mi sna thog ma de yin pa dang / lhag par du khong gis/ nyi hong gi rgyal khab kyi chab srid lam lugs dang /tshan rig gi bsam tshul gtan 'bebs kyis rgyal khab kyi rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan pa 'ding ched du mi chos don tshan 17 yang gsar gtod byas 'dugadus skabs de'i mjug tsam bod kyi chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos phyi lo 534 lo'i sngon du lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi spyod gtsang ma bcu drug khrims lugs kyi rnam gzhag bcas gsar gtod gnang ba dang / bod yongs rdzogs rgyal 4

srid gcig gyur gyi 'og tu sdud par mdzad pa de dang lo dus phal cher gcig mtshungs lta bu byung 'dug pa ni ya mtshan zhig tu mngon/kho bo nyi hong du sdod ring e shi ya'i dpe mdzod khang du nyams zhib byed mkhan lho ko ri ya'i dung ko mtho rim slob gru'i slob phrug gcig ngo 'phrad byung ste kho pas kho bo lho ko ri yar khyug tsam 'tshams 'drir yong 'dod yod na khong tsho dung ko mtho rim slob grwas mgron 'bod zhu gi yin zhes zer ba ltar khas len zhus nas nyi hong nas lho ko riya'i rgyal sa si hol ('ab51) gnam thog tu bskyod nas de khul nyin bdun sdod ring dung ko mtho slob kyi dge rgan che mo mkhas dbang ca'o ming ci (2101 07 5krol tha01/0)yis sne len gzab rgyas gnang / khong lo shas sngon rgya gar du gnas mjal yong skabs wa ra na sir 7gong sa skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog mjal kha'i skal bzang thob ste bod kyi gnas tshul la thugs snang chen po byung / slad khong gis mtho slob der bod kyi nang chos kyi slob dge zhig gdan 'dren zhu thub na snyam pa bsam blo 'khor gyi 'dug ces dang / da cha khyed rang dung ko mtho slob la phebs pa de dga' po zhe drag byung zhes gsungs byung / de skabs 'dzam gling nang du dung ko mtho slob lta bu'i nang chos slob gnyer byed pa'i ming grags de ltar rgyal khab gzhan la yod tshod mi 'dug pa dang / mtho slob der slob phrug khyon bsdoms sum stong lhag tsam yod/ slob tshan gtso bo nang chos kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang / dngos khams tshan rig dpal 'byor rig pa/ chab srid rig pa/ lo rgyus rig pa/ sgra rig pa/de bzhin rgya gar gyi sam skyi ta dang / pa li/ tshong gnyer bcas slob tshan 'dzoms po yod zer/ mtho slob de'i nang dpe mdzod khang chen po zhig yod pa'i nang ko ri ya'i nang chos kyi bka' 'gyur dang / gsung rab/ de min rgya gar rgyal rabs kyi yig rnying 5

pa li dang / sam skyi ta/ rgya yig thog gi gsung rab bcas sne kha ha cang 'dzoms po 'dug khong tshos brjod gsal dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs ko ri ya'i gra btsun wan tshog dang / bod ming chos skyabs zhes pa gnyis nas rgya nag thang rgyal sa khrang an (shi.an) shi min lha khang du bod yig thog yod pa'i 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rgya yig tu phab sgyur byas yod pa red/ dus skabs der ko ri ya rang nyid la yi ge med gshis rgya yig bed spyod byed pa'i skabs yin/ko ri ya rang nyid kyi yi ge gsar gtod byas nas lo 400 tsam las song med stabs snga rabs kyi lo rgyus dang nang chos bcas rgya yig thog 'khod 'dug de skabs snga rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / chos kyi slob sbyong byed skabs nges par du rgya yig slob sbyong byed dgos pa red/ 'on kyang ko ri ya'i yig rnying nang gi tshig don gting zab mang che ba da dung rgya yig bed spyod byed bzhin pa yin 'dug par/ der brten ko ri ya'i slob grwa gzhi rim nas mtho slob bar rgya yig nger par slob dgos pa red zer/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs ko ri ya'i grwa btsun zhig bod kyi sa skya'i bla ma 'phags pa'i sku mdun du dge slong bsgrubs pa'i chos ming du bkris 'phags pa zhes kyang bstsal/ de'i rjes tsam la bod kyi grwa btsun mang pos ko ri ya'i yul gru khag la bod lugs thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi nang chos spel mkhan ji snyed byung zhing / dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i skabs sog po yon gong ma ye ti pa la khrir bzhugs skabs sog pos ko ri ya'i rgyal po krang shon wang (05lo8 757 7706) bya ba dus yun lo gsum lhag tsam ring bod du rgyang 'bud btang ste sa skyar bzhugs pa dang / de rjes 1338 lo yon gong ma the mu 'jam ya tu'u khri bzhugs skabs ko ri ya'i rgyal po kun shon wang 1340 lo rang gi rgyal khab tu phyir phebs chog pa'i bka' 'khrol ltar ko 6

ri yar phyir phebs byung yod lugs bcas ko ri ya'i rgyal rabs deb ther dang / rgya nag yon gyi rgyal rabs su 'khod yod lugs zer/ gong gsal lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ shar nub le dbar stong phrag brgal ba dang ri chu grangs med kyis rgyang thag chod pa'i yul de gnyis dus rabs bdun pa nas bzung 'brel ba byung ba dang / dus rabs bcu gsum par sog pos rgya nag la dbang sgyur skabs ko ri ya dang / bod kyi 'brel ba de sngar las lhag pa zhig byung bar mngon/ko ri ya'i mi rigs de las la brtson zhing dpa' rtsal ldan pa zhig yin 'dugargyal khab de'i lo rgyus ha cang yun ring gnas pa ma zad/ rig gnas kyi chu tshod mthon po yod zer/ 'on kyang 'das pa'i lo rgyus nang dka' ngal che ba'i dus rabs mang po zhig brgyud dgos byung 'dug dus yun ring po'i nang rgyal khab de'i nub byang dang / shar lho'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol bcas nas btsan 'dzul gyi 'jigs skul mang po byung yod pa dang / de mtshungs rgya nag nas kyang btsan 'dzul dus rim du ma byung bar grags/ kho bo de khul sdod ring dung ko mtho slob dang / ko ri ya'i mtho slob gnyis kyi mgron 'bod ltar bskyod de bod kyi snga rabs dang / deng rabs kyi lo rgyus rob tsam gtam bshad byas/ ko ri ya'i rgyal yongs su slob gso ha cang dar khyab chen po yod par mngon/ mi rigs de nyi hong gi mi la zhe 'khon chen po yod mkhan zhig yin pa ni de sngon lo brgya phrag gcig gi ring nyi hong gi btsan 'og bsdad pa'i rkyen gyis yin 'dugakho bo rgya gar du phyir log rjes ko ri ya'i rgyal khab tu 'tshams 'dre zhus pa'i skor 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus te 7gong sa mchog gis dung ko mtho slob la 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma cha tshang zhig bstsal song / de'i lo rjes ma/7

1957 zla 10 nang 7gong sa mchog nyi hong du 'tshams 'drer chibs bsgyur gnangaskabs ko ri ya'i dung ko mtho slob kyi dge rgan chen mo ca'o ming ci yis nyi hong du bcar te 7gong sa chen po mchog ko ri yar khyug tsam zhabs sor 'khod re'i gsol ba btab kyang dus tshod thugs khom ma byung ba'i dbang gis kho bo dang chos don drung che rgya mtsho che ring gnyis gtong gnang mdzad de snga lo mtho slob der 7rgyal ba'i gsung rab bka' 'gyur bstsal ba'i mdzad sgor bcar/ skabs der si hol grong khyer spyi khyab cing zhon yus nas phran la si hol grong khyer gyi lde mig zhig gnang ba'i mdzad sgor bcar te khong lhan du bod don skor gsal bshad zhib gleng byung /nyi hong du sdod ring ngo shes grogs po zhig gis mgron 'bod byas pa ltar bskyod skabs go min tang gi nyi hong rgyal khab tu bca' bzhugs sku tshab ngo ma wi ta'o min ngo 'phrad byung ste khong gis tha'i wan du 'tshams 'drer phebs thub na dga' bsu zhu gi yin ces gsungs te sku sger drung che brgyud tha'i wan du bskyod na 'thus min gyi zhu yig phul ba'i bka' lan du/ rang sger gyi ming thog nas bskyod na 'grigs 'thus phebs pa ltar/ phyi lo 1955 zla 10 ches 15 nyin thog kyo nas tha'i per bskyod/ kho bo tha'i pe'i gnam gru thang du 'byor skabs de sngon rgya nag nan cing du ngo shes 'ga' shas dang / bar lam rgya gar nas de khul khrid pa'i li thang ja ma tshang bsam 'phel sogs bod mi 'ga' shas bcas bsu bar 'byor 'dugaskabs der bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab pa dmag dpon ko ci cha'o yang 'dug gong du smros don ltar de sngon kho bo rgya nag la sdod skabs ngo shes yin zhing /bar lam lo shas ring dus kyi 'gyur ba chen po byung rjes rgya mtsho'i mtha' gling phran der khong slar yang ngo 'phrad byung skabs phan tshun grogs po rnying pa'i 'du shes kyi brtse 8

ba zab mo byung / nyin shas rjes srid 'dzin cang gi mjal 'phrad yin zhes lan gsal 'byor te de nyin bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab ko ci yis sne shan byas nas srid 'dzin cang ke shag sar bcar bar dang thog khong gis/ tā la'i bla mar sku khams bzang po'i 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu dang / rgya gar la tu la'i bla ma dang / khong gis rjes 'brangs khyed rnam pa'i 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs la sems 'khur chen po yod/tā la'i bla ma dang khyed rang tsho gung jag gi btsan dbang 'og nas rgya gar du bde phebs byung ba des nga tsho dga' tshor dang ha cang blo bde po byung / de ni grub 'bras chen po zhig red/ phyi lo 1959 zla 3 ches 10 nyin lha sar bod mi dmangs rnams kyis gung khran jag tshogs la 'dzam gling yongs su g.yo 'gul 'thebs pa'i ngo rgol gyi las 'gul spel ba'i snying stobs der nga'i gzhung dang mi dmangs rnams kyis dga' gus yi rang zhu bzhin yod/ slad bod phyi nang du gnas pa'i bod rigs spyan zu rnams kyi gung rgol gyi las 'gul mtha' dag la rgyab bskyor zhu rgyu dang / lhag par bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i chab srid rang thag rang gcod kyi gnas stangs skor gsal bsgrags shig byas yod/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tshos thun mong thog nas krung gung jag tshogs rnams rtsa med btang ste bod rigs spun rla rnams kyi 'dod mos ltar rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang longs su spyod rgyur nga'i gzhung gis rgyab bskyor bya rgyur 'gyur ba med/ de skor snga lo tu la'i bla ma'i sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub 'di khul phebs skabs gsal po zhus yod/ khyed rgya gar du phyir phebs rjes tu la'i bla mar zhu rogs gnang / nga'i gzhung gis bod rigs spun che rnams la rogs ram gang thub zhu rgyu'i gra sgrig yod ces gsung byung / kho bos bar lam sger dgongs zhus nas shar phyogs rgyal khab khag tu lta bskor la yong lugs rnams zhus/ kho bo tha'i 9

wan du rla ba gcig tsam sdod ring de khul grong khyer yas mas khag la spro 'cham du bskyod/ tha'i wan ni thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa'i gling phran zhig yin zhing /gnam gshis ni dus bzhi dpyod dus dang mtshungs pa'i tsha grang snyom po zhig 'dugatha'i wan du snga rabs lo brgya phrag gi sngon du ho lan rgyal khab kyis dbang sgyur gang 'tsham byas shing / skabs der tha'i wan gyi ming la phor mo sa zhes zer/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs rgya nag ming rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon kren khreng gung dpung dmag rnams rgya nag skam sa nas bros te gling phran der yod pa'i ho lan gyi dmag dang 'thab 'khrug gis ho lan pa'i dmag rnams mthar sgrod byas te khong gis gling phran de'i rgyal po byas/ de rjes man ju'i rgyal po khang shi'i skabs man jus dbang sgyur byas nas bzung rgya nag gi mnga' khongs zhing chen gyi gas shig tu gyur/phyi lo 1895 lor nyi hong dang / man ju gnyis kyis ko ri yar dmag 'khrug gis man ju'i dmag pham ste lo der rgyal khab gnyis kyis zhi mthun dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig nang tha'i wan gling phran de nyi hong rgyal khab la rtsis sprod bya dgos byung / phyi lo 1945 lo nyi hong gi dmag pham nyes byung rjes tha'i wan de rgya nag go min tang gzhung la phyir sprod byas/ phyi lo 1949 lo rgya nag skam sa chen po yongs rdzogs dmar pos dbang sgyur byas stabs cang ke shis gtsos pa'i go min tang gi dpon rigs rnams tha'i wan gling phran du bros te bdag 'dzin gyis chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ rig gnas/ slob gso sogs gang thad nas legs bcos byas pa dang / lhag par du go min tang gis mi dmangs rnams kyi khrod du/ sa zhing 'debs mkhan la sa zhing sprod pa'i bcos sgyur gyi srid byus lag len bstar bar brten las don thog grub 'bras chen po byung bar grags/ de bzhin tha'i wan 20

gling phran gyi byang shar dang / nub byang du yod pa'i gling phran chung khag tu skam sa chen po'i tshur rgol gyi 'jigs snang 'gog thabs su sa 'og brag rdo bskos nas de'i nang dmag sgar khag bzos te 'gog srung byas yod/ lhag par du a me ri ku'i mtsho dmag gru gzings ang bdun pa de tha'i lhan srung skyob tu bzhag yod pa bcas kyi rgyu rkyen la brten nas tha'i wan gling phran da phan rang dbang bde 'jags su gnas thub par brten spyi tshogs zhi bde bag phebs kyi ngang nas dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro bzhin 'duganyin zhig go min tang gi bde srung spyi khyab sku zhabs ye shang kre dang ngo 'phrad gyis phan tshun bsam tshul gleng mol byung / kho pas slad skam sa chen por yod pa'i jag tshogs rnams rtsa gtor rjes bod rigs spun rla rnams nas rang mos kyi thog rang thag rang gcod kyi dbang cha lag len bstar skabs grogs rogs blos thub kyi rgyab rten zhig nges par dgos kyi red/ de ni krung ha min go'i gzhung dang / mi dmangs yin pa ma gtogs rgyal khab gzhan su zhig gis kyang bod la lhag bsam rnam dag gi rogs ram byed kyi ma red ces zer/kho bos kho pa'i gleng mol de'i nang dga' bsu byed 'os par dga' bsu dang /rgol lan sprod 'os par rgol lan sprad de bar lam rgya gar du yod pa'i khyed rang tsho'i las byed tshos nga cho'i bod mi 'ga' shas mgo bskor bslu brid kyis 'di khul khrid nas rgyal spyi'i nang go min tang gis bod la gung rgol gyi rgyab bskyor rogs ram yod lugs kyi dril bsgrags kyi ched du bed spyod byas yod pa dang / de bzhin rgya gar bka' rdor khul du gtan sdod bod mi 'ga' la rogs ram yin tshul gyis dngul phran bu sprad pa de lag gnyis kyis len skabs par brgyab pa/ bod mi 'ga' shas go 2

min tang gi tang mi'i nang du zhugs bcug pa'i mdzad sgo'i thog dam bca' 'jog skabs lag g.yas yar brkyangs pa'i par brgyab pa bcas mang dag byas pa'i skor skyon brjod byas pa des kho pas ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i ngang nas khyed kyi bsam tshul bshad pa de rgya lo don grub kyi bsam tshul dang gcig pa red/ khyed tshos nga tsho'i las byed par skyon brjod byas par gzhigs na nga tsho'i las byed tshos las ka yag po byed kyi yod par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod ces bshad ma thag kho bos sku nabs ye khyed rang gis las byed la de 'dra yid ches gnang gi yod na nga gnyis skad cha bshad dgos don med pa mthong gi 'dug ces brjod pa dang sbrags yar langs nas phyir thon byed dgos byung / skabs der tha'i wan du yod pa'i bod mi rnams rim bzhin thug 'phrad byung ste de rnams la/ 7gong sa mchog dang / rang gzhung gi srid byus 'dzin stangs skor 'grel bshad byas par khong tsho de khul du slebs par 'gyod sems chen po skyes thog 7gong sa chen po mchog gi dbu khrid 'og rang gzhung gi chab srid rtsa don la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu dang / bstan srid kyi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam gang thub zhu gi yin zhes zer byung /tha'i wan nas slar yang hong kong brgyud a ri nub phyogs se a khrel du bskyod de de khul sngon phebs sa skya phun tshogs pho brang gi gdung sras dang / khong gi skya 'khor sras sros/ bka' blon zur pa zur khang dbang chen dge legs bcas zhal mjal te nyin shas ring de khul du khong rnams dang lhan du lhod sdod byas/ de nas sku'i gcen po stag 'cher rin po che bzhugs yul en ḍi ya nar bcar te rla gcig tsam bsdad nas ni'u yog tu bskyod de rang gzhung don gcod bka' blon sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa mchog gi sar bsdad/22

skabs der a ri'i gzhung gis rogs ram gnang nas de khul slob sbyong byed mkhan rang re'i slob phrug lnga thug 'phrad byung / de'i khongs su skal bzang dbyangs skyid yang 'dug khong ni de sngon sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma de nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs dbyin drung gi zhabs 'degs hur brtson zhus yod cing / dam pa de nyid la snyun gzhi ma byung gong khong la shes yon gang drag slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs yong thub pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang nas ka tar sman bcos su phebs khar khong mtho slob tu slob sbyong du gtong rgyu'i bka' mngags gnang / de rjes 7gong sa mchog nas gong gsal slob phrug rnams dang mnyam du a rir slob sbyong du gtong gnang mdzad/kho bo a rir rla gsum bsdad rjes yo rob nas bu mo mkha' 'gro dang mnyam du rgya gar la phyir log byas/ skabs der bu bstan 'dzin ngag dbang eng lan nas slob sbyong thon te rgya gar du sngon 'byor gyis rang gzhung ldi li shes rig las khungs su las 'khur zhu bzhin yod/kho bo bzhugs sgar du phyir log rjes re zhig 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i gam bcar zhabs zhu rtsag rtsig zhu skabs sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog gis kho bo ldi li 'khul rang re'i drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs khag gnyis la 'brel gtugs kyi las 'khur byed par yong dgos bka' phebs bzhin phyi lo 1973 lo bar las 'khur zhus/dus skabs der bal yul glo khul du chags pa'i drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go 'doms 'ba' pa ye shes dang / gsham 'og brgya shog khag gi brgya dpon rnams phan tshun phran bu'i ma mthun pa byung ste rgya gar nas sgrig 'dzugs de'i 'go byed rnams mthun thabs su rgya rdo tshang dbang 'dus la 'ba' pa ye shes kyi las rogs su bsko brdzong gnang /23

de rjes 1959 lo dpyid dus kho bo dang sku zhabs lha mo che ring gnyis glo khul drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go dmag rnams la 'tshams 'drer bskyod de 7gong sa chen po'i dbu khrid 'og rang gzhung gi srid byus 'dzin stangs dang / 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul 'pho 'gyur/ bar lam ma'o tse tung gis rgya nag dang bod sa khul yongs su rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i kla klo'i las 'gul lag len bstar te bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum du dmyal ba mi yul du myong ba lta bu'i sdug sbyong tshad las 'das pa btang skor dang / lhag par de khul yod pa'i 'go dmag rnams kyis bstan pa chab srid thog rang don rgyab skyur gyis lus sems gnyis ngal gyi dka' spyad snying stobs la bsngags brjod dang 'go dmag tshang mas 'o chu 'dres pa lta bu'i mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis sa gnas de gar mu mthud bsdad de sngar bzhin dgra bor rdung rdog drag po gtong gal bcas kyi bsam tshul gang shes bshad/zla gcig tsam ring de khul 'go 'doms spyi khyab khang dang / brgya shog sde khag bcas kyi sar rim bzhin lta bskor 'tshams 'drir bskyod/ khong tsho gnad che'i lung khug dang / dbyar dus kyang me zhu ba'i gangs ri 'khyags rom gyi khrod du gnas yod pa ma zad/ bza' bca' sogs kyis dgos mkho skyel 'dren shin tu dka' ba'i rkyen gyis mthun rkyen ha cang zhan po byung yod kyang / bstan pa chab srid kyi don du dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis bod nang nges med rgol rdung gi 'jab dmag ji snyed brgyab ste rgya dmag la dka' ngal chen po bzo thub pa byung zhing / khong tshos 'jigs zhum spu tsam med par blo rtsa brtan po'i sgo nas phyi lo 1974 lo bar lo bco lnga tsam ring sa mtho ri brag gi khrod du ri dwags lta bur gnas te sri zhu zhabs 'degs mthar skyel zhus yod pa red/24

sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma sku gshegs rjes rang nyid kyi bsam par che lhag rnams dam pa'i chos su gzhol bsam pa'i nges 'byung gi blo sna zhig byung yang / dus tshod rim pas song ba dang che sngon gyi bag chags sam/ las dbang lta bus nges 'byung gi blo sna nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yal nas 'di snang 'khor ba phun tshogs la zhen te skal bzang g.yang skyed lags dang 'jig rten mthun 'jug gis ring min mngal sgrum zhing / de nas kho bo glo bo smon thang du thon khar skal bzang g.yang skyed lags la mngal rgya grol te phru gu bu btsas na ming skal bzang phun tshogs dang / bu mo btsas na bkra shis g.yang skyed ces 'dogs zhes mngags/ rjes su bu mo btsas pas ming bkra shis g.yang skyid btags/snga rabs bod kyi goms gshis la phru gu btsas ma thag rgan rabs sam pha ma su rung gis ming 'dogs srol yod/ de rjes dus rabs brgya phrag kha shas sngon tsam nas bla ma dang / chos skyong la phru gu'i ming zhu ba'i srol dar/ kho bo bal yul sa mtshams nas bzhugs sgar rda ram sa lar phyir 'khor rjes skal bzang lags kyang phru gu blta skyong ched re zhig las dgongs zhus te kho bo'i mnyam du ldi lir gnas spos kyis 'tsho ba gsar par rol ba'i 'go tshugs/lo lnga tsam song rjes skal bzang lags la bu mo gnyis pa btsas te de'i ming 7gong sa chen por skyabs 'jug ji zhus bzhin bstan 'dzin dbyangs can stsal/ de nas kho bo bza' tsho gnyis kyi bu btsas tshod 'dzin la gang thub 'bad thog bu mo gnyis la gces skyong gis slob sbyongs dang / gshis spyod gang ci legs pa yong thabs kyi bsam gzhi bkod pa ltar da cha bu mo gnyis 'tshar longs byung ba ma zad/ spyir btang slob sbyong gi shes tshad gang tsam thob yod kyang / da dung rang cag bod mi'i khrod 25

du zhabs 'degs grub thub pa'i skul ma byed bzhin yod/skal bzang g.yang skyid kyi yab kum dbang phyug lags kyi pha rgyud ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i stod tsam la sog po jun sgar gyi dmag dpung bod dbus gtsang khams gsum du lhags skabs khams mi nyag nas dbus gtsang phyogs su gnas spos te rim bzhin jo mo glang ma'i ri rgyud kyi lho ngos su gzhis chags pa'i gas yin zhing / khong tsho bod kyi shar phyogs nas yong bar brten shar pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di thogs yod/phyi lo 1830 lo bod gzhung gis bkod pa'i lcags stag zhib gzhung nang du shel dkar rdzong khongs kyi shar khum bu ba 'don nyis shu skor zhes gsal ba ltar/ de sngon nas shar pa rnams bod gzhung gi mnga' 'og bston med yin/shar pa kurma dbang phyug lags dgung lo chung dus shar khum bu nas bod dbus su phebs te phag ri khul tshong las gnang ba dang / de nas lha sar gnas spos kyis sngar bzhin tshong las mu mthud gnang yod pa red/ khong ni chos sems chen po yod pa ltar sku che smad la chos kyi nyams len legs po gnang thub pa byung song / khong bza' tsho gnyis la bu lnga dang bu mo gsum byung ba'i nang nas skal bzang g.yang skyed lags ni phru gu ang gnyis pa yin/ chung dus nas rgya gar bka' sbug tu dbyin ji'i bu mo slob grwar zhugs te slob sbyong legs po thon pa dang / 1953 lor rda sa bzhugs sgar du 'bod bskong gnang ba ltar da bar bod gzhung gi sri zhu'i las rigs sna tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhus dang zhu bzhin lags so/kho bo ldi li khul lo gsum tsam ring las khur zhus nas sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis dgongs pa zhus te rda sar bcar nas re zhig rgya'i deb rnying thang tru'u gsar 26

rnying nang du 'khod pa'i dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu pa bar bod rgya gnyis dbar zhi drag gnyis thad nas gdong gtugs kyi 'brel ba ji byung gi lo rgyus rnams bod yig tu phab sgyur zhus te/ rgya'i yig tshang nang gsal ba'i bod kyi rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long / zhes pa'i deb ther zhig phyogs sgrig byas/1973 lo rla 9 mjug tu a ri'i grong khyer shi ka ko la rgyal spyi'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs nyams zhib bgro gleng gi tshogs 'du thengs bcu bzhi par mgron 'bod gdan zhu 'byor ba ltar bskyod de bod kyi snga rabs kyi lo rgyus shig rtsom 'bri byas pa tshogs 'du'i thog 'grems spel zhus/de nas phyir log gis lo de'i dgun dus 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar kho bor bod gzhung gi bde srung bka' blon bsko bzhag mdzad pa khur 'gan zhu bya shin tu lci bas rang ngos sgrub nus bral rung / gzhung sa'i bkron la bsam shes kyis re zhig zhabs 'degs gang thub zhu rgyu'i dam bca' phul nas 'bad brtson lhod med zhus//27

le tshan so gsum pa/rang gzhung dang tha'i wan dbar gyi 'brel ba/༄༅༅/ /gong smros ltar phyi lo 1959 lo 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi dbu khrid 'og bod gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs dang / mi dmangs khri phrag 'ga' shas rgya gar du btsan byol du phebs skabs rla 3 ches 20 nyin go min tang gi gtso 'dzin cang ke shag ma 'ongs par bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho gnas dang /chab srid rang dbang thag gcod chog pa'i langs phyogs skor gsal bsgrags byas gsal du/ slad bod kyi chab srid gnas stangs skor rgya nag skam sa chen po slar gso byung rjes bod mi rigs kyi 'dod pa ltar bya rgyu/ kru hwa min go srid gzhung gis de la sgyur bcos gtong gi min zhes gsal yod pa'i thog go min tang gzhung gis tha'i wan du yod pa'i bod mi re zung bod rigs kyi la zhen yod mdog gis rgya gar du gsang myul btang 'byor nas bod mi'i sdod gnas ka rdor khul du bod mi btsan byol khrod du yod pa'i mi sna 'ga' shas la 'brel gtugs mgo skor bslu brid kyis rogs dngul phran bu sprad pa dang / bstan srung dang blangs kyi sgrig 'dzugs su zhugs myong mkhan li thang ja ma bsam 'phel dang nang mi/ de mtshungs mdo stod smad gnyis khongs kyi na gzhon nyung shas shig tha'i wan du 'khrid nas drag po'i slob sbyong sprod rgyu yin lugs dang / li thang ja ma bsam 'phel de sngon bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi 29

dmag spyi gzhon pa yin zer nas go min tang gi dmag dpon gzhon pa hra'o cang zhes pa'i go gnas sprad/ de bzhin go min tang gis bar lam bod du rgya dmar la btsan rgol gyi las 'gul de go min tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin zhes rgyal spyi'i nang ngo so'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / lhag par 59 che 3 ches 10nyin lha sar bod kyi rang dbang slar gso'i las 'gul de yang go min tang gzhung gi thabs byus 'og byung yod lugs 'dzam gling nang dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyi thog nas 'grems spel byas/ de bzhin rgya gar dang / bal yul sa khul khag la gnas pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba'i khrod du go min tang gi so nyul mi snas bod rang btsan thob thabs su tā la'i bla ma nges par du tha'i wan du phebs nas cang tsung thung (cang ke shis ) mjal 'phrad gnang te cang tsung thung dang bka' mol gnang na re ba chen po yod pa dang / de min bod rang btsan khag po yod lugs/ bod rang btsan yong thabs su go min tang gzhung gis rogs ram rgyab skyor byas na ma gtogs de min rgyal khab gzhan su zhig gis rogs ram byed khag po yin lugs/ gal srid bod rang btsan thob pa'i dbang du btang na/ 'bri chu nub brgyud rang btsan thob rgyu las shar rgyud kyi bod rigs sa khul rnams la rang btsan nam yang thob mi thub ces sogs bod mi nang khul bsam blo 'khrug tu 'jug ba'i dkrog gtam rim pa bzos te bod mi 'ga' shas kyis dkrog gtam de tshor yid ches skyes pa yang byung yod/'on kyang rgya che'i bod mi mang tshogs rnams kyis 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi dbu khrid 'og blo brtan 'gyur med kyis thog nas dkrog gtam de rigs la yid ches ma byas par bod mi tshang mas lcags kyi gong bu star mthun sgril dam zab byas stabs gnod skyon gyi nus pa de tsam ma thon par brten/ so nyul de tshos 30

bod mi mtho rim nang khul mi mthun pa'i dkrugs shing dbyen sbyor gang thub kyis lag len bstar 'og bod gzhung bka' zur zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / bka' tshab zur pa g.yu thog bkris don grub gnyis tha'i wan du gdan zhu byas te tha'i wan du bod kyi bka' blon don gcod las khungs zhes pa zhig gsar 'dzugs byas nas khong gnyis thag sgul 'dra gzugs lta bur las khungs de'i gtso 'dzin gyi ming btags nas bed spyod byas pa'i thog khong gnyis kyi mtshan thog nas rgya gar dang /bal yul sogs su yod pa'i bod btsan byol ba rnams nang khul ma mthun pa yong thabs dang / bod mi btsan byol ba'i gzhung rtsa 'thor gtong rtsis kyi ngan sems bcangs/ 'on kyang zur g.yu rnam gnyis kyis/ go min tang gzhung gi srid byus 'dzin stangs rgya dmar dang gnyis su med pa zhig yin pa'i mkhyen rtogs byung bar brten rang nyid lam nor thebs par sngar 'gyod phyis sdom gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa 'khor/phyi lo 1974 lo'i ston dus su phran bza' mi gnyis a ri grong khyer ci ka kor rgyal spyi'i mi rigs kyi 'byung tshul lo rgyus tshogs 'dur bskyod pa'i phyir log lam zhor du sger thog nas tha'i wan du khyug tsam bskyed de bka' zur zur g.yu gnyis kyis gtsos bod mi mchog dman gang mang thug 'phrad kyis khong rnam pa'i dgongs tshul ji yod rtog zhib lta bu byed skabs khong rnams go min tang gi mgo bskor bslu brid kyi 'og de khul du slebs yod pa las/ 7gong sa mchog gi dbu khrid pa'i btsan byol gzhung dang / rgya che'i gzhis byes mi dmangs rnams la rgyab gtod kyi bsam gzhi rtsa ba nas med lugs dang / da bar gyi byed spyod la 'gyod sems chen po yod lugs bcas gsungs pa dang / zur g.yu rnam gnyis kyis da lta'i tha'e wan du btsugs pa'i bka' blon don gcod las khungs de khong gnyis kyi ngos nas bshad bya

na dbang med du byung ba zhig las mos mthun byas med/ khong gnyis kyis rim pas thabs shes byas nas las khungs de ming tsam ma lhag pa byas nas khong gnyis rgya gar ram/ phyi rgyal gzhan zhig tu gnas spo bya rtsis yod pa las de khul gtan du sdod 'dod rtsa ba nas med ces dbu mna' bzhes nas gsungs byung / phran phyir log skabs/ khong gnyis kyis 7gong sa chen po mchog dgongs pa dwangs ched dgongs sel snyan zhu zhig bskur gnang byung ba 'bul lam zhus/der yod mi dmangs gzhan rnams kyang tha'i wan la sdod 'dod med lugs kyi bsam tshul yang ji snyed bshad byung zhing / de nas bzung tha'i wan du yod pa'i rang re'i spyan rla rnams kyis rang gzhung gi pang du phyir log rgyu'i 'du shes slar gso thub pa byung / rjes su 'brug gi gnas tshul byung dus zur g.yu gnyis la bod mi gcig mtshungs kyi sems 'tshab chen po byung nas khong gnyis nas bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab la btang ba'i yi ge'i nang / 1974 lo'i rla 4 ches 15 nyin ka la ka tar go min tang gi bod yig gsar shog thog 'brug rgyal gsar par che bstod bsngabs brjod ji snyed bkod pa'i gnas tshul ring po zhig bris 'dug pa nang gsal/bod mi tshor ched mngags khong khro skyes gzhi'i gnas tshul la nga gnyis kyang blo pham chen po yod/ ces sogs bkod nas ngo rgol gyi gnas bris shig phul 'dug khong gnyis kyis thabs byus ji snyed bton nas bka' blon las khungs de ming tsam ma lhag par tsha 'thor dgos pa bzos/phyi lo 1973 lor nyi tong o sa'i ka (05124) tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin na ga no mchog gis bod gzhung gis tha'i wan gzhung dang 'brel ba gnang na dge mtshan chen po yod lugs dang / da phan phan tshun gnyis kyi rnyog gleng ji snyed byung ba'i skor 32

bton ma dgos pa'i sgo nas 'brel ba gsar gtod cig byas na snyam pa'i slob ston byas pa ltar bod gzhung chos shes bka' blon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan mchog nyi hong o sa'i ka tshogs pas mgron 'bod kyis nyi hong brgyud tha'i wan du phebs te go min tang gzhung gi bod sog las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin dang gnad yod dpon rigs mjal 'phrad thog phan tshun gnyis kyi 'brel ba slar gso byed phyogs skor bka' mol byung yang / phan tshun gnyis gcig gis gcig la yid ches rnyed dka' ba'i ngang gnas/ 'on kyang phan tshun gnyis kyis 'brel gtugs bya rgyu shugs che ru gtong rgyu'i thog phan tshun gyi bsam tshul brje len gnang na phan thogs chen po yong rgyur gnyis phyogs nas mos mthun byung /1974 zla dza pa'i nang zla mjug tu kho bo nyi hong sger khag gcig gi tshogs 'dur bskyod de phyir 'khor lam zhor hong kong la ngo shes grogs po kra'u cin khris thug 'phrad du khyug tsam bskyod/ khong gis bar lam rgya nag skam sa chen pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i rjes su gang ci'i 'pho 'gyur gyi gnas stangs skor dang / bye brag bod phyogs su srid byus 'dzin stangs skor gleng mol ji snyed byung / khong gis krung go gung khran ring lugs kyi srid dbang bsgyur bcos 'gro dang 'gro bzhin pa red ces dang / nye lam khong gis tha'i wan du rgya nag skam sa chen po krung gung srid dbang gi 'pho 'gyur skor gyi nyams zhib bgro gleng tshogs 'du zhig la bskyod pa yin/ zhor du tha'i wan la ngo shes grogs po rnying pa 'ga' shas thug 'phrad byung ba de'i nang go min tang gzhung gi bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab tshu'i khrun yon thug 'phrad byung / tshu'i khrun yon dang nga gnyis pha yul gcig pa yin pa ma zad/ chung dus nas slob grwa gcig pa yin pa dang / de bzhin dmag dpon krang shi'u le'ang gi 'og tu mnyam du 33

las ka byed myong mkhan zhig kyang yin/ khong gis nga gnyis 'brel ba yag po yod pa shes yod tsang khong gis khyed rang tha'i wan du khyug tsam phebs 'dod yod na khong gis dga' bsu zhu gi yin zhes khyed rang la lan sprod rogs zhes zer byung bas khyed phebs 'dod yod na ngas khong tshor lan sprod kyi yin/ nga'i bsam tshul la khyed rang tsho bod mi btsan byol ba tsho yul gzhan du gnas yod stabs 'tsho ba dang gang ci'i dka' ngal yod kyi red/ go min tang gi lag nas dpal 'byor rogs ram blangs na khong tshos rogs ram byed thub kyi red/ 'on kyang go min tang gis bod kyi srid don thog phan thogs de tsam byed kyi ma red/ da bar gyi lo rgyus la gzhigs na/ cang ke shag gcig pu bod don thog do snang chen po yod mkhan gyi mi zhig yin pa dang / da cha khong ni lo na mthon por slobs yod/ khong gi gsham 'og dpon rigs rnams bod don thog de tsam do snang med pa red/ gal srid do snang byas pa yin na'ang klad rnying mkhregs bzung gi srid byus 'dzin gyi red/ slad cang shi ba'i rjes su khong gi bu cang cing gos go min tang gi srid dbang 'dzin gyi red/ khong tha'i wan mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas gtong rgyu las rgya nag skam sa chen por phar rgol gyi las ka lag len bstar mi thub cing / bod don thog la'ang de tsam do snang bya mkhan zhig e yin snyam/ gnas tshul mang po'i thog nas nga tshos dbye zhib byas na go min tang gis khyed rang tsho'i chab srid thog phan thogs de tsam byed mi thub/ khyed rang tshor dpal 'byor dang / bod mi na gzhon rnams kyi slob sbyong lag rtsal sbyong brdar bcas kyi thog nas rogs ram byed thub kyi red/ khe phan de rnams nges par len dgos/ rgyal spyi'i 'pho 'gyur gyi rkyen pas rgya nag gi gnas stangs la 'gyur ba chen po 'gro gi red/lhag par ma'o tse tung shi rjes skam sa chen po da lta nang bzhin gnas khag po red/ de 34

ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul zhig red/ rgya nag skam sa chen por 'pho 'gyur byung ba nang bzhin tha'i wan gyi srid dbang la'ang 'pho 'gyur 'gro rgyu yin pa dang / mthar krung go gung khran tang dang go min tang gnyis slar yang gcig tu zla bsgril yong srid/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir khyod tshos go min tang dang 'brel ba gnang nas khe phan gang thub len rgyu der skyon gang yang ma mthong zhes slob ston gnang byung /phran bzhugs sgar du phyir log rjes rla 11 ches 5 nyin go min tang gis skam sa chen po'i las don spyi khyab khang gi spyi khyab zhus ching lan dang / bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab tshu'i khru'i yon gnyis kyis phran tha'i wan du khyug tsam yong regs zhes gdan zhu'i gnas bris shig 'byor/ de skor 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shagalhan rgyas la dgongs bskor snyan seng gis bka' bgros mthar snga lo chos don bka'ablon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan de khul du phebs pa'i 'brel 04ma mjug skyong lta bur phran tha'i wan du khyug tsam bskyod 'thus bka' phebs pa ltar/ 1175 zla (pa'i nang tong kong brgyud tha'i wan da bskyod gtan 'khe'// tha'i wan da ma thon gong rang gzhung bka' shag nas bka' mngags gnang gas / stsa lo chos/ don bka' blon kun gleng 'od zer rgyal mtshan mcho/chog tha'i wan du phebs/ skaba'i/ go min tang gi 'brel gnad dpon rigs mjal 'phrad kyis bod kyi rtsa don sko ra bgro gleng mang po byung skabs bod zang btsan skor dang bod mi tshos rgyu nga thag zang gcod kyi 'bad rtsol las 'gul byed bzhin pa 'dir go min tang gzhang myos mthun phyogs/ gcig gyur gyi rogs ram/ gnang rgyu las 'gal rkyen rigs/ na / (5nga mi tsha/jo ba'i tre 'dun brjod kyang / go min tang phyogs nas me nag rgya che'i mi/ nga /ngas/ snan/dkyi/ ska / sa chen por gnas tsha/da stabs da lā'i das skabs/ 'di bod snang dbang snang ba zong lang rang35

thag rang gcod kyi gsal bsgrags byed thabs dka' yang / ma 'ongs par skam sa chen po slar gso byung rjes bod don thog bsam don lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong gi red ces bsam tshul brjod pa/ de la 'dod khengs yid ches byed rgyu dka' ba dang /gal srid go min tang gzhung nas rtsa ba'i bod don thog da lta'i srid byus sgyur bcos ma byas na rang re'i gzhung phan tshun gnyis kyi dgongs pa mnyam mthun med pas gung rgol gyi las don mnyam rub yong bar dka'/ go min tang gzhung nas bod don la bskyar du dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu byung na nga tsho gnyis dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis gung rgol 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dam zab zhu rgyu yin lugs dang / gal srid go min tang gis sngar bzhin nga tsho'i bsam tshul la mos mthun ma byas che rtsa ba'i 'brel lam ma chad tsam gyi thog bod mi na gzhon rnams la slob sbyong gi rogs ram dang /dpal 'byor thog gi rogs ram byed rgyur bka' mol gnang na 'thus rgyu zhes bka' mngags gnang don bzhin zla 5 ches 3 nyin tha'i wan la 'byor nas ches 5bar go min tang skam sa chen po'i las don spyi khyab sku zhabs zhus ching lan dang /bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab tshu'i khrun yan rnam gnyis snga rjes thengs gsum mjal 'phrad thog khong gnyis kyis bar lam bod rgya gnyis kyi 'brel lam la don phan de tsam ma byung ba'i skor dang / slar phan tshun gnyis phyogs nas 'bad brtson che bskyed gnang dgos tshul/ nga tsho thun mong thog nas gung rgol gyi las 'gul la shulnga snon gang thub bya rgyu dge mtshan chen po yod lugs bcas kyi bsam tshul bton/phran gyi de sngon sku zhabs rgya lo don grub mchog dang / chos don bka' blon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma'i skya tshab kyi mtshan thog nas 'di khul phebs te 'di gar gnad yod dpon rigs rnams la nga tsho bod mi 36

rnams kyi re 'dun zhib cha zhus yod pa dang / da lam phran 'di khul du slebs nas nga tsho bod mi rnams kyi ma 'ongs pa'i chab srid kyi gnas stangs skor yang bskyar khyed rnam gnyis la zhu gi yin/ de sngon cang tsung thung (cangace hre ) mchog gi yig thog nas gsung 'phrin khyab bsgrags gnang yod kyang / de dag gis nga tsho'i dka' ngal sel thub thabs med/ gang yin zer na nga tsho mi dmangs khri tsho mang po rang srog btang ba'i dgos don gtso bo bod rang btsan gyi don yin/ khyed rnam pas bod mi'i rtsa don der nges par mkhyen rtogs dgos gal 'dug bod mi'i rang btsan gyi don du gnod skyon 'phrad che bod mi tshang mas rang bzhin 'jog thabs med pa zhig yin pas dgongs pa rgya chen po bzhes dgos/ bod mi rnams la thob 'os pa'i rang btsan de go min tang gzhung gis rgyab skyor gnang dgos kyi 'dug de dag byung che nga tsho thun mong gi gung rgol las 'gul thog rang bzhin gyis 'thab phyogs gcig sgril yong rgyu ma zad/ phan thogs chen po'ang yong gi red ces lab pa yin/khong gnyis kyis khyed rang tsho'i re 'dun de de sngon cang tsung thung gis gsal bsgrags gsal po gnang yod/ ma 'ongs par skam sa chen por gnas pa'i jag tshogs rnams rtsa gtor btang rjes bod mi rnams kyi re 'dun rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang 'dod mos ltar byed chog rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang yod/ 'on kyang da lta'i dus skabs 'dir gzhung gis bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod chog pa'i khas len gsal bsgrags bya thabs dka'/ snga lo sku zhabs kunagling 'dir phebs skabs kyang nga tshos khong la gsal bshad gsal po zhus yod/ gang yin zer na/ nga tsho'i rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams skam sa chen por gnas yod stabs nga cho'i gzhung gis bod mis rang thag rang gcod chog pa'i gsal bsgrags byas na gung khran jag tshogs kyis krung 37

go phyi nang gnyis la go min tang gis bod de phyir tshong byed kyi yod lugs drol bsgrags bed spyod byed srid pas phan med gnod gyur yong rgyu red/ ma 'ongs par skam sa chen po slar gso byung rjes go ming tā hu'i (rgyal dmangs tshogs chen ) tshogs pa'i thog rtsa khrims legs bcos kyi gros bsdur byed skabs gzhung gnas nas khyed rang tsho bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod kyi re 'dun bsgrub thub pa'i thabs shes bya rgyu yin/ cang tsung thung gis gsal bsgrags gnang ba der 'gyur ba yong gi ma red/ de dag la khyed tshos yid ches gnang dgos/ sngon du sku zhabs kun bde gling la 'grel bshad zhus pa nang bzhin da res khyed la bskyar du zhus pa yin/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tsho phan tshun lag sbrel thog skam sa chen po dang / bod ljongs su btsan 'dzul byas pa'i jag tshogs de mthar skrod gtong rgyu'i las 'gan de gtso gal chen po red/ nga tsho'i gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis bod nang khul du bod mi spyan rla rnams mtsho ltar zab la me ltar tsha ba'i dka' ngal myong bzhin pa de dag las skyob thabs dang / phyi rgyal du btsan byol bod rigs spyan che rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel thabs dang bod mi nang khul mthun sgril legs po yong rgyu'i re ba yod/ de bzhin phyi mi gzhan brgyud nas nga tsho phan tshun gyi don gnad thog the byus byas na yag po mi 'dug snga lo khyed rang tshos nyi hong o sa'i ka tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin na ga no yis phan tshun 'brel ba byed phyogs skor bka' mol zhus yod pa rtsa ba'i khong nga tsho'i grogs po dang / khong mi bzang po zhig red/ 'on kyang khong phyi mi yin tsang nga tsho nangakhul gyi 'brel ba byed phyogs kyi gros mol skor nga tsho nang khul bka' mol gnang na yag po 'dug ces zer ba'i lan du/sku zhabs na ga no yis dang thog khyed rang tsho dang bka' mol byung nas khyed tshos tso5)

mos mthun byung rjes khong gis nga tshor bsam tshul bton pa zhig red/ nga tshos khong gi bsam tshul ltar phan tshun 'grigs thabs zhus te nga tsho'i chos don bka' blon tha'i wan du phebs nas khyed rnam pa mjal 'phrad kyi nga tsho'i re 'dun gsal po zhus yod/ nye lam ocasa'i ku'i drung che tu'u shi hi ro rgya gar du phebs skabs tha'i wan phyogs nas khong la gsungs gsal/ bod gzhung gi bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / g.yu thog bkris don grub gnyis tu la'i bla ma'i sku tshab byas nas tha'i wan du phebs te tha'i per bka' blon las khungs shig btsugs yod pa dang / de bzhin de sngon sku zhabs phun tshogs bkris tha'i wan du phebs skabs khong yang tā la'i bla ma'i skya tshab yin zhes gsungs pa ltar nga tshos khong la tu la'i bla ma'i sku tshab yin par ngos 'dzin byas yod / de rjes kun bde gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan phebs skabs )kyang tā la'i bla ma'i sku tshab yin zhes gsungs pa ltar nga tshos sne len gzab rgyas zhus yod/ kun bde gling gi bka' mol gnang stangs dang / de sngon phun tshogs bkris kyis bka' mol gnang stangs gcig mtshungs med pa'i thog kun bde gling gis bka' mol mkhregs po gsung gi 'dug nga tsho'i gzhung gis khong gnyis la tu la'i bla ma'i bka' blon yin pa dang / dbang cha 'dra mnyam gcig mtshungs yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod ces khyed rnam pas khong la gsungs byung zhes tu shi hi ros nga tshor gsungs byung / de dag dngos 'brel gyi gnas tshul e yin snyam/ da res nga tsho 'dir 'dzomar/ ji/'e thog batsho /7re mo ka de gas/khu/ po bzo thung/ ri/ gnang ga'/ chen po red/ dngos yod kyi gnas tshul min par phyi mi la ma yin yin tshul gyi bka' mol gsung na yag po mi 'dug de dag gis nga tsho phan tshun 'brel pa yong rgyur 'gal rkyen chen po 'phrad kyi red/ khyed rnam pas mkhyen gsal ltar zur khang dbang chen 39

dge legs dang / g.yu thog bkris don grub gnyis phyi lo 1950 lo nas bod gzhung gi bka' blon gyi las 'khur dgongs pa zhus tshar ba ma zad/ khong gnyis rgya gar nas phyi rgyal du sman bcos su phebs pa'i skor dang / de rjes khyed rang tshos khong gnyis tha'i wan du gdan zhu gnang ba las khong gnyis kyis tu la'i bla ma mchog la 'di khul bskyod 'thus kyi snyan seng zhu rgyu phar bzhag skabs der nga tshos khong gnyis tha'i wan du phebs pa'i gnas tshul de yang shes yod pa ma red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og ga 'dra ze tā la'i bla ma'i sku tshab zhu thub kyi red dam/ khyed rnam pas khong gnyis 'di khul du gdan zhu byas nas bka' blon las khungs shig btsugs su bcug pa red/ de ni rgya gar sa thog tu yod pa'i tu la'i bla mas dbu khrid pa'i gzhung de rtsa gtor gtong rgyu'i srid byus shig yin par nga tsho bod mi rnams nas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ gnas tshul des rkyen pas nga tsho thun mong gi lam phyogs 'brel ba der 'gal rkyen chen po zhig byung yod/don gnad gnyis pa/ phran de sngon tha'i wan du ngo shes rnying par 'tshams 'drir yong ba zhig yin pa las gzhung 'brel thog yong ba ma yin/ phran ma yong gong nas sger gyi ming thog yong gi yin zhes gsal po zhus yod pa ma zad/ 'di khul slobs rjes sku zhabs tshu'i khru'i yon khyod dang grogs po gzhan rnams la gsal por zhus yod/ skabs der phran bod gzhung gi bka' blon yang min/ snga lo sku zhabs na ga no dang khyed rnam pa bka' gros gnang rjes khong gis nga tshor bsam tshul gsungs nas tā la'i bla mas nga tsho'i chos don bka' blon kun bde gling tha'i wan du gtong gnang mdzad skabs khyed rnam pa dang mjal 'phrad kyis bkal mol de byung ba red/ da res phran yang de bzhin yin zhes brjod pa'i lan du/40

da lta skya zhabs phun tshogs bkris nas gsungs pa'i tshig don rnams nga gnyis kyis mi su zhig la yang bshad med/ gal srid bshad yod na gsham 'og las byed pas bshad pa yin gyi red/ der cha 'jog bya rgyu med lugs sogs rgyu mtshan mang po 'grel bshad byas byung /mthar thug phran gyis nga tsho bod mi'i re 'dun thag gcod ma byas bar du rang re'i gzhung gnyis thun mong gis gung rgol 'thab phyogs gcig gyur yong rgyur nga tshor mos mthun zhu dka'/ de bzhin nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba bzang po yong thabs su bod gzhung skya tshab las khungs shig 'dzugs rgyu'i 'dod pa yang yod/ las khungs de dag btsugs rjes 'brel ba bya yul de sngon ltar bod sog las khungs zhes pa de ma yin par phyi 'brel las khungs su 'brel ba bya 'dod yod/ de bzhin nga tsho'i skya tshab las khungs btsugs zin pa'i nyin nas bzung nga tsho phan tshun gyi las don mtha' dag las khungs de brgyud 'brel ba bya rgyu las/ phan tshun gnyis kus lkog nas 'brel ba byed mi chog phan tshun gnyis kyis bod dang rgya nag skam sa chen po'i gsang gnas lag son byung rigs rnams phan tshun brje len dang / mthun 'gyur rogs ram bya rgyu/ bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod kyi las 'gul la go min tang srid gzhung nas rgyab skyor gyi rogs ram gnang rgyu las/ 'gal rkyen mi byung ba'i dgongs bzhes nges par gnang dgos/ zhes brjod par/ khong gnyis kyis da lta'i dus skabs 'dir khyed tshos nga tsho'i gzhung la 'brel pa byed tswa la de bod sog las khungs ma gtogs phyi srid las khungs dang 'brel ba yong shes kyi ma red/ de ni rtsa khrims thog gtan 'bebs zin pa zhig red ces 'grel bshad byed skabs khong gnyis kyis 'dzum mdangs ston bzhin par gdong gshis 'gyur nas nan tan gyis gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis 4ga

shod pa las don gnad gzhan la thag gcod kyi bsam tshul gang yang ma bshad pa'i mur tshogs 'du grol/de'i sang nyin phran gyi de sngon ngo shes grogs po tshu'i hreng phun sar 'tshams 'drer khyug tsam bskyod de gong gsal bka' mol ji byung skor khong la bshad/ khong gis nyin shas rjes phran mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar sku mgron du srid 'dzin cang tsung thung gi drung che chen sha'o yis dang / go min tang skam sa chen po'i las don khang gi gtso 'dzin zhu'i chin lan dang / bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab tshu'i khru'i yan gnyis kyang 'dug drung che chen sha'o yi'i lo rgyus de sngon phran bu shes rtogs yod kyang thug 'phrad thengs dang po yin/ de nyin tsha'o hreng phun gyis khong ngo sprod kyi ched du gsol ston du gdan 'dren zhus pa red/ chan sha'o yi gzugs po chen po min na yang / ha cang 'byon po dang/ snying stobs can gyi mi zhig yin par mngon/ gsol ston skabs/ khong gi rgya gar dang / bal yul/ 'brug yul bcas su gnas pa'i bod mi rnams kyi gnas stangs skor 'dri brtsad byas pa'i lan du/1959 lo bod nas rgya gar sogs phyi rgyal yul khag tu bros byol 'byor skabs bod mi rnams la dka' ngal chen po phrad yod kyang / skabs de'i rgya gar gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis bod dang rgya gar gnyis lo ngo stong phrag ring gi chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba'i 'du shes dang / lhag par mi chos ring lugs kyi thog nas bod mi rnams la byams brtses bskyangs nas sa zhing gnang ba dang / bod mi na gzhon rnams la slob sbyong gi rogs ram 'og gtan 'jags slob grwa khag bdun tsam btsugs pa dang / de bzhin na gzhon dar ma rnams la lag shes sbyong brdar gyi rogs ram byas pa/ bod mi'i sdod sgar khag dang / gzhis chags khag la nyin mo'i 42

slob grwa khag mang po btsugs yod par brten bod mi rnams kyi dkal ngal rim sel gyis 'tsho ba lo re bzhin yag tu 'gro gi yod/ de bzhin phyi rgyal gyi gzhung dang tshogs pa sger khag bcas kyis bod mi na gzhon gyi slob sbyong dang / lag shes kyi sbyong brdar bcas la rogs ram ji snyed byas dang byed bzhin yod/ bod phrug mang po phyi rgyal khag du slob sbyong du len pa ma zad/ bod mi mang po sus dzar lan ḍa dang / ke na ḍa bcas su yod ces brjod lan du/nga tsho'i gzhung gis da bar bod mi spu rla rnams la rogs ram ga re byas yod dam zhes tshu'i khru'i yon la skad cha dris song bar tshu'i khru'i yan gyis/ phran la blta tsam byas nas nga tsho'i skam sa chen po'i skyob gso las khungs kyis dang thog bod mi spyan che rnams rgya gar du 'byor ma thag skyob gso rogs ram bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas yod kyang / hin rdu gzhung gis nga tsho'i skyob gso rogs ram de ma blangs bar phyir slog btang yod/ bod sog las khungs nas da bar bal yul dang rgya gar khul gyi bod mi'i sdod sgar tshogs pa khag 'ga' shas la rogs ram byed bzhin yod ces zhus song /skabs der phran gyis dngos yod gnas tshul phran bu zhig gsal bshad ma byas na 'grigs min la brten phran gyis nga tsho'i phyogs nas bltas na da lta bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab sku zhabs tshu'i khru'i yan gyis gsungs po'i gnas tshul de dngos yod dang 'gal zla chen po yod pa zhig yin par snyam/ da bar rgya gar du yod pa'i khyed rnam pa'i las byed re zung gis 'di ga tha'i wan gyi gong rim la mgo bskor sha stag gtong gi yod pa red/ rogs ram gyi dngul phyed ka lhag tsam rang nyid kyi dngul khug nang du blugs yod pa dang / de 'phros rnams kyang so so'i ngo shes dga' nye bod 43

mi re zung la sprad nas bod mi nang khul 'gal ba bzo gi yod pa red/ nga tsho bod mi spyi 'gre'i sgrig lam du ma zhugs par logs su lung tshan so so'i ming 'khyer te tshogs pa gsar pa btsugs te tu la'i bla mas dbu khrid gnang ba'i bod gzhung de dang kha gtad lta bu'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi yod pa red/ kha sa khas nyin sku zhabs zhu'i chan lan dang / tshu'i khru'i yon rnam gnyis kyis phran la khyed tsho bod mi nang khul mthun sgril yag po yong dgos rgyu'i re 'dun chen po gnang gi yod ces thugs khur chen po'i thog nas gsungs pa der dga' po byung / 'on kyang gong zhus ltar/ rgya gar du yod pa'i khyed tsho'i las byed re zung gi bya spyod de bod mi nang khul du kha bral yong thabs kyi dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing sha stag byas dang byed bzhin yod pa de 'di ga'i 'brel yod gong rim tshos mkhyen gyi med pa 'dra zhes bshadapar/drung che chen sha'o yis/ nga tsho'i gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la brtsi bkur chen po zhu gi yod pa red/ de bzhin bod rigs spyan zla rnams la dka' ngal phrad pa der thugs khur chen po yang yod/ rgya gar khul du nga tsho'i 'brel yod las byed re zung gis bya spyod de lta bu byas yod na ha cang thabs rdugs dang / blo pham gyi rang bzhin zhig red/ nga tshos de'i skor brtsad gcod byed kyi yin/ sku zhabs phun tshogs bkris khyed rang gis da res sba gsang med par dgongs 'char gsal po gnang ba de dga' po byung / rjes su khyed rang tha'i wan du yang yang phebs nas nga tshor dgongs 'char de rigs gsungs rogs gnang / de 'dra byung na nga tshos phan tshun gyi 'brel ba sdig tu 'gro gi red ces dang /yang khong gis/ rgya gar du yod pa'i bod rigs spun rla na gzhon rnams kyis mes rgyal la sha zhen che chung ga 'dra yod dam zhes dres byung ba'i lan du/ phran gyis 44

khyed la gsal po zhus na/ rgya gar dang / phyi rgyal gzhan khag la yod pa'i nga tsho'i bod rigs na gzhon rnams kyis go min tang gzhung gi gnas stangs la do snang de tsam med/ ces brjod skabs khong gis rang bzhin gyis hang sangs pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan byung /skabs der tshu'i khru'i yon gyis rgya gar dang / phyi rgyal khag tu gnas pa'i bod rigs spun rla rnams kyi bu phrug rnams de sngon bod nas yong skabs lo na chung ba dang /da bar rgya gar gyis gtsos pa'i phyi rgyal khag la slob sbyong gis 'tshar longs byung yod par brten mes rgyal la sha zhen gyi 'du shes slob gso de tsam ma byung ba red ces brjod de rno ngar dang ldan pa'i gleng mol rnam 'gyur de phran bu yal ba lta bu byung na yang / mgron brda 'bul mkhan sku zhabs tsha'u hreng phun zhal skyengs po byung song /gsol ston de yang spro snang de tsam med pa'i ngang nas grol dgos byung /de khul du nyin shas sdod ring rang re'i bod mi 'ga' shas kyis phran de khul slobs yod pa shes te thug 'phrad du yong pa de rnams la 7gong sa mchog gis dbu khrid mdzad pa'i rang gzhung gi gnas stangs skor gsal bshad gang thub zhus/ skabs der bka' zur zur khang dbang chen dge legs bzhugs yod pa las/ bka' zur g.yu thog dang khong gi nang mi bcas de'i sngon tsam du ke na ḍar gnas spos gnang grub 'dug de sngon phran tsho ngos mjal skabs khong gis ring min sa cha de nas rgyal khab gzhan du 'gro thabs byed kyi yin zhes nan tan gsungs pa de zhal dan tshig gnas kyi phyag len bstar yod pa de ni tshul ldan 'gyur med kyi mi dam pa zhig yin pa der ngas gus bkur dang yid smon zhu bzhin yod/nyin zhig bka' zur zur khang gi bzhugs gnas su mjal 'phrad du bskyod 45

skabs khong sku khams ha cang zhan po'i thog grogs med gcig pur bzhugs yod pa der ya nga ba'i tshor ba zhig byung / de nyin khong gis phran la/ de sngon 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po mchog 7rgyal ba'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus pa nas 1951 lor rgya dmar ma slebs pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus shig 'bri rtsom byas yod pa de bod yig nas rgya yig tu bsgyur gyi yod ces gsungs byung / rjes su go thos la bka' rtsom de 'thor gyar gyur 'dug pa der blo pham ha cang chen po byung /khong ni mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid cig yin pa ma zad/ bar lam bod kyi chab srid kyi gar stegs thog 'khrab pa'i mi sna gtso bo zhig yin stabs khong gis bris pa'i skabs der lo rgyus rnams gsal zhing phra zhib zhig 'khod yod pa gor ma chagaphran tha'i wan nas phyir log nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar bka' zur zur khang tha'i wan du dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul thos byung / gong smros ltar de sngon khong dgung lo dar ma'i skabs bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang dbu 'phang mngon par mtho ba'i dus skabs der lo rgyus ring po zhig gi nang bod gzhung gi chab srid kyi kha lo bsgyur mkhan sa skyong snyan grags can zhig gnang yod kyang / da cha sku che'i mtha' mar mgon med skyabs med kyis mi yul sa mthar dgongs pa rdzogs pa de ni 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i chos nyid cas/ yin par snyam/nga tsho gros mol byas pa'i nyin mtha' ma der sku zhabs tshu'i khru'i yan gyis phran la/ nga tsho gros sdur byas pa'i skor gong rim la snyan seng zhus nas dka' lan thon rgyur nyin shas 'gor zhes brjod par/ de'i sang nyin cang ke shag gi bu gnyis pa dmag dpon cang khri go mjal 'phrad du bskyod skabs phran gyis khong la da res 'di khul yong don skor zhib gsal zhus par khong gis tu la'i bla ma dang / khyed tsho bod 46

mi rnams kyi re 'dun der nga rang sger gyi ngos nas gdung sems mnyam skyed byed kyi yod/ bod rigs spyan zla rnams la rang thag rang gcod bya rgyu'i dbang cha yod pa red/rang btsan gtsang ma bya rgyur dka' ngal phran bu 'phrad kyi red/ de dag grub par mthun rkyen mang po 'dzoms dgos/ dpe gcig brjod na/ bod kyi sa khams kyi chags tshul de'i mtha' 'khor du rgya gar dang / bal yul/ 'bar ma/ nga tsho'i krung go bcas kyis bskor yod par brten phyi rgyal gzhan khag nas dpal 'byor dang dngos po skyel 'dren bcas kyi 'brel ba thad kur byed dka' ba yong gi red/ gal srid bod kyi sa cha cud zad tsam zhig rgya mtsho'i 'gram du gnas yod na/ gang ci'i thad nas phyi yul gzhan dang 'brel ba bya rgyu'i rang btsan gyi mthun rkyen zhig tshang gi red/ ma 'ongs par nga tshos thun mong thog nas gung khran jag tshogs rnams thal bar brlags rjes nga tsho'i gzhung dang mi dmangs rnams kyis bod rigs spun zla'i 'dod blo khengs pa'i rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang la rogs rgyab nges par zhu gi red ces gsungs pa'i chig don de dag khong gi yab kyis bod don la 'dzin pa'i srid byus kyi rjes su 'brangs pa zhig yin par mngon/ go min tang gi rgan rabs gnad yod dpon rigis gzhan khag gcig gis rnam 'gyur mkhregs po ston gyi yod kyang / khong ni spobs pa gang yang med pa zhi dul gus zhabs dang ldan pa'i shes ldan mi sna 'grogs bde gshib bde zhig red 'dug de'i phyi nyin snga dro bod sog las khungs nas phran la de ring phye dro tshud gsum pa'i thog skam sa chen po'i las khungs su sku zhabs zhu'i ching lan dang / tshu'i khru'i yon rnam gnyis lhan du tshogs 'dur khyug tsam phebs rogs zhes lan 'byor ba ltar dus thog tu bskyod de khong gnyis kyis nyin shas ring nga tsho brel 'tshab chen po byung ste khyed rang 'di khul gzigs bskor du 47

gdan zhu ma thub par dgongs dag zhu gi yod ces dang / nye lam nga tsho phan tshun gyi bsam tshul brje len byung don ltar nga tsho'i phyogs nas khyed rang tsho'i re 'dun la nyams zhib byas pa yin/ nga tsho phan tshun gyi bsam tshul sngar bzhin rgyang ring du gnas 'dug khyed tsho'i re 'dun gtso bo der da lta'i skabs su nga tsho'i phyogs nas khas len zhu thabs med pa de da res nga gnyis kyis khyed rang la gsal po zhu gi yin/dang po/ ma 'ongs par khyed tsho'i re 'dun de'i skor cang tsung thung dam pas gsal bsgra'e gnang ba der krung dbyang gis kha dan rgyab skyor nam yang byed kyi ma red/gnyis pa/ slad phyin bod phyogs nas krung dbyang dang 'brel ba bya phyogs thad sngar bzhin bod sog las khungs ma yin par phyi 'brel las khungs brgyud 'brel ba bya rgyu'i dgongs 'char des nga tshor dka' ngal 'phrad yod/ bod sog las khungs de bod sog spun rla rnams kyi ched du btsugs pa'i krung dbyang gi las khungs mtho shos kyis gras shig yin stabs khyed rang tshos da mus bzhin bod sog las khungs dang 'brel ba gnang na legs gnas/gsum pa/ krung dbyang gis tu la'i bla ma'i gzhung dang 'brel ba bya rgyu las/bod rigs spun rla gzhan su zhig la thad kur 'brel ba mi byed rgyu'i dgongs 'char de skor da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba yag tu ma phyin pa'i ring mes rgyal la sha zhen yod pa'i phyi sdod bod rigs spun rla rnams la da mus bzhin 'brel ba bya rgyu dang / lhag par lo re rla 10 ches 10 nyin rgya khab dbu brnyes pa'i rgyal ston du lo ltar gdan zhu bya gi yod pa de nga tshos lam seng mtshams 'jog bya thabs dka'/ slad nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba legs su phyin pa'i rjes su khyed rang tsho brgyud nas 'brel ba zhu gi yin/48

bzhi pa/ rgya gar khul du yod pa'i nga tsho'i las byed re zung gi bya spyod de tsho'i skor 'brel yod las khungs nas brtsad gcod byas nas phyir 'then bya rgyu yin/ nga tsho'i phyogs kyi re 'dun la nga tsho thun mong thog skam sa chen po'i gung jag mthar sgrod bya rgyu'i 'thab phyogs kyi 'brel ba dam zab 'gro rgyu'i ched krung dbyang nas khyed rang tshor rogs ram gang thub zhu gi yin zhes bcas zer/phran gyis gong gsal don tshan rnams la sngar bzhin lan 'debs rob tsam byas nas de'i sang nyin tha'i wan nas hong kong brgyud rgya gar du phyir log skabs lam bar blo yi 'char tshul du da bar rang gzhung gis go min tang gzhung la 'brel ba gnang na rang re'i rtsa don thog phan thogs yong nges dang / dpal 'byor thog la yang rogs ram thob rgyu'i re ba chen po zhig bcangs myong yang / de res kyi nyams myong la bltas na re ba de gnod 'che'i rang bzhin lta bur gyur rgyur snyam pa'i yid blong blong ba zhig gi ngang bzhugs sgar du phyir log bya dgos byung /rda sar 'byor rjes tha'i wan du go min tang gzhung gi 'brel yod dpon rigs khag dang mjal 'phrad brjod babs ji byung skor gong rim la snyan seng zhus rjes rla 8 ches 5 nyin rang gzhung 'char can rgyun las tshogs 'du'i thog bzhugs sgar las khungs khag gi drung gzhon yan gyi las byed dang / zur skyong sde tshan khag gi 'gan 'dzin bcas lhan tshogs sar bar lam bal yul dang / 'brug yul gnyis nang bod mi'i thog dka' ngal byung ba'i skor dang / rang gzhung dang tha'i wan go min tang gzhung dbar 'brel ba ji byung / slad srid byus 'dzin stangs bcas kyi skor rang gzhung sri zhu ba rnams la mkhyen rtogs yong ched spyi 'thus tshogs gtso 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal gyis bka' shag la re 'dun gnang ba ltar nang srid bka' blon dbang 49

'dus rdo rje mchog nas bal 'brug gnyis nang rang re'i bod mi rnams kyi gnas stangs ji 'gyur dang / bal 'brug rgyal khab de gnyis kyis bod mi'i thog srid byus lag len bstar stangs bcas kyi skor tshogs yongs rnams la gsal bshad gnang ba dang sgrags slad rang gzhung gis bal 'brug gzhung gnyis la da mus bzhin 'brel ba bzang po rgyun mthud gnang thabs kyi srid byus gzhir bzung gnang rgyu yin zhes gsungs pa dang / de mtshams chos don bka' blon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis bar lam rang gzhung gis tha'i wan go min tang gzhung dbar 'brel ba ci gnang skor dang / tha'i wan go min tang gzhung gis srid byus 'dzin stangs rgya dmar dang gnyis su med par brten de snga gzhung 'brel thog 'brel lam de tsam med kyang /bar lam nyi hong o sa'i ka tshogs pas bod gzhung dang go min tang gzhung gnyis mtshams sbyor gyi 'brel ba gnang na dge mtshan yod lugs dgongs 'char zhus pa ltar bod gzhung nas ma lan ma 'gyod ched phan tshun dbar 'grel lam gsar gtod thog bod kyi rtsa don skor go min tang gzhung la bka' bsdur zhu slad gzhung 'brel thog ngo phebs kyis go min tang gzhung gi 'brel yod mi sna khag mjal 'phrad kyis snga rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul ngo ma gzhi bzung gsungs pa ma zad/ bod don thog la 'dzin pa'i srid byus bsgyur bcos yong re'i bsam tshul gleng ba dang / slad phyin nga tsho'i gzhung gnyis 'brel lam gnang phyogs don tshan bcu 'khod pa'i shog blu zhig zur 'don gyis bka' bsdur gnang yang /tha'i wan go min tang gzhung gis rang don khe dbang gtso bzung gis srid byus dam 'dzin byas pa las deng rabs 'dzam gling yongs kyi mi rigs rang dbang dang / mi rigs rang thag rang gcod kyi dngos yod thob thang gi gnas tshul la bsam gzhigs 50

lhug po ma byas pa'i thog bod sog las khungs zer ba dang / skam sa chen po'i las khungs dang 'brel ba byed du 'jug rgyu dang / phyi rgyal khag tu yod pa'i bod mi rnams la phyir sdod rang mi zhes pa'i ming btags te mgo brdung bslu brid kyis bod de rgya khongs yin tshul gyi srid byus sngar bzhin 'dzin gyi yod pa dang / de bzhin bod gzhung 'bangs su zhig gi thad nas khas len med par bka' blon don gcod las khungs zhes pa btsugs te tha'i wan go min tang gzhung gi khe dbang gtso bzung gis bod mi nang khul kha bral gtong ched mi khag gcig bed spyod byed bzhin yod pa bcas gsal bshad gnang ba red/chos don bka' blon nas gsung bshad gnang rjes phran bde srung bka' blon phun tshogs bkris kyis nye lam tha'i wan gzhung gis gdan zhus ltar tha'i wan du snga lo chos don bka' blon kun bde gling mchog gis 'brel ba gnang ba'i mjug skyong ched go min tang gi 'brel yod dpon rigs khag dang mjal 'phrad kyis bka' mol rim pa zhus lugs gong gsal ltar chos don bka' blon gyis gsungs pa bzhin mtha' don go min tang gis 1959 zla 3 ches 25 nyin cang tsung thung nas bod don skor gsal bsgrags gnang ba'i rtsa don la khas len dgos tshul gyi re 'dun bton byung bar rang gzhung nas khas len gnang thabs med lugs sogs phan tshun bka' mol ji byung rnams gsal bshad zhus/ bka' shag nas bar lam bod gzhung dang tha'i wan dbar 'brel lam gyi yong rkyen gnas tshul rnams bka' blon gnyis kyis gsal bshad gnang ba ltar da cha gzhis byes bod mi yongs kyis rtsa don thog lus srog btang dang gtong bzhin pa'i dmigs yul rtsa don dang yongs su 'gal ba'i gnad don de dag la khas len bya thabs med par brten ji srid tha'i 54

lhan go min tang gzhung gi srid byus 'dir 'gyur ba ma byung bar de srid bod gzhung dmangs yongs kyis ngos 'dzin gnang phyogs ga 'dzol ma song ba thugs snang zab bskyed dgos gal che lugs bcas gsal bshad thag gcod gnang ba red/ de nas bzung bod gzhung gis gzhung 'brel thog tha'i wan go min tang gzhung la 'brel ba re zhig mtshams 'jog byas/1981 lo tsam la tha'i wan go min tang gis nyi hong rgyal sa thog kyor bca' sdod gsar 'god pa khren (1 1 0'i ba) dang / rang gzhung don gcod sku zhabs padma rgyal po gnyis ngo shes nas phan tshun 'brel ba byung ste padma rgyal pos rang gzhung la de skor snyan sengabaka' slob zhus par/ gnas skabs ring rtogs zhib lta bur gsang ba'i thog nas 'brel ba byas na 'gal rkyen mi 'dug ces bka' 'khrol ltar de nas bzung gsang ba'i thog nas 'brel ba bya 'go btsugs/7gong sa mchog nyi tong dang / a ri bcas su chibs bsgyur gnang skabs tha'i wan go min tang gzhung gi mi snas mjal bcar zhus pa dang / lhag par nyi hong du chibs bsgyur skabs tha'i wan lan ho pa'o zhes pa'i gsar shog gi spyi khyab wang chi 'u yis thog kyo la 7gong sa chen po mchog gi mjal khar ched bcar gyis 7gong sa mchog nas khong la/ slad phan tshun gnyis phan gyi 'brel ba bya phyogs thad gzhung dang gzhung gnyis 'brel ba ma byung ba'i dus rim la phan tshun gyi mi dmangs dbar 'brel ba bya rgyu de gal chen po red ces bka' gnang ba dang / skabs der wang chi'u yis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog la bod kyi rang thag rang gcod thad nga tsho'i gzhung nas go skabs dang bstun te khas len nam/ gsal bsgrags byed kyi yin zhes zhus yod/ wang chi'u ni tha'i wan lan ho pa'o gsar shog gi gtso 'dzin yin pa ma zad/62
