tha'i wan dang phyi rgyal khag khag la rgya yig gi nyin re'i gsar shog khag lnga tsam bdag gnyer byed mkhan ma rtsa can zhig red/ lhag par du go min tang dbus rgyun las kyi tshogs mi'i gras shig yin 'dug skabs der khong gis lan ho pa'o gsar shog gtso 'dzin gyi ming thog nas nyi hong du 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad zhus kyang /nang don go min tang dbus rgyun las kyi bka' mngags ltar mjal bcar du brdzong ba zhig red/de rjes nyi hong du bca' sdod lan ho pa'o yi gsar 'god pa sku zhabs khren gyi re 'dun ltar rgya gar du 'tshams 'drir yong ste rda ram sa la dang / bod mi sdod sgar khag la lta bskor byas chog pa'i go skabs dang sne len gzab rgyas gnang / skabs der khong gis bod mi rnams kyi dngos yod gnas stangs skor gsal rtogs kyis tha'i wan lan ho pa'o nyin re'i gsar shog thog gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin rtsom bris 'grems spel byas yod stabs nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel bar cung zad phan thogs byung bar brten tha'i wan go min tang gzhung nas 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog de sngon wang chi u la/ gzhung dang gzhung gi 'brel ba ma byung ba'i dus rim la phan tshun me dmangs dbar gyi 'brel ba byed thub na yag po 'dug ces bka' gnang ba ltar tha'i wan go min tang phyogs nas phan tshun gnyis kyi 'brel ba byed bde'i ched mi dmangs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas khungs so so'i tshogs pa re 'dzugs rgyu'i bsam tshul rang gzhung nyi hong don gcod padma rgyal po la bton nas bka' bsdur gnang ste go min tang phyogs nas tha'i wan la lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyu dang / bod phyogs nas ring min rda ram sa lar shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyur gros mol lam tsam bka' gros byung ste bod phyogs nas tshogs pa de ma btsugs gong de sngon go min 53

tang dbus rgyun las tshogs mi wang chi u yis 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad gnang skabs go min tang gzhung gis dus babs dang 'tshams pa'i skabs bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod kyi khas len nam/ gsal bsgrags shig bya rgyur khas len byas yod pa de dag tshogs pa ma btsugs gong gsal bsgrags gnang dgos pa'i bsam tshul bton 'dugaphyi lo 1984 zla 9 ches 12——15 ring rda sa bod kyi dpe mdzod khang du shar tur ki si than (shin cang / dang / sog po/ bod bcas kyi mna' 'brel lhan tshogs gsar 'dzugs kyi tshogs 'du tshogs/ tshogs 'dur bzhugs mkhan/ phran stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis/ dge bshes dge 'dun bzang po/ (sogapo) rgya reblo gros rgyal mtshan/ ab sgul la e mi log lu/ (shar tur ki si than ) (46755ma'i1 2770815)er khon elab ṭi khrin/ (shar tur ki si than)(21thabame/ji 0smospri)sogs nas nyin gsum ring tshogs pa dang nyin mtha' mar 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i mjal kha gsung gleng bka' drin bstsal/phyi lo 1985 zla 5 ches 17 nyin phran dang dril bsgrags drung che las 'phar rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis a ri'i rgyal sa wa shin kron dang / sus si bcas su 5017126'ipa'ims00 zhes pa'i tshogs 'dur mgron 'bod ltar bskyod zhor a ri gzhung gi gnad yod dpon rigs dang / gros tshogs tshogs mi snyan grags can 'ga' tsanas mjal 'phrad zhus/che 7 ches 12——14 bar sus si ri kon sa gnas la bod dang / shar tur ki si than/ nang sog man 'ju bcas yul khag bzhi yi mna' 'brel lhan tshogs kyi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis par/ phran stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis/ stag 54

'cher rin po che thub bstan 'jigs med/ rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bkras mthong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ skal bzang rgyal mtshan/ab sgul la e mi log lu dang / er khen elab ṭi khon/ sog po'i mkhas dbang sa cin 'jag jid/ (21 bya0057/mtha0517) kun ṭin gar kun gur/(55ba 1ba821 55ba8841) bcas tshogs 'dzoms legs 'grub byung ba dang /mna' 'brel lhan tshogs tshogs thengs gsum pa de bzhin ni'u yog rang gzhung sku tshab don gcod khang du 1985 zla 11 ches 19 21 bar tshogs 'du bskyangs/1985 zu 7 ches 19 nyin tha'i wan lho e shi ya'i tshogs gtso sku zhabs li'ang dbying krang gis phran la tha'i wan du 'tshams 'drir khyug tsam yong rogs zhes pa'i mgron brda de sku zhabs padma rgyal pos bka' shag tu phul ba chibs zhabs bka' blon blo dar mchog brgyud phran la 'byor ba dang sbrags bka' mngags ji gnang bzhin sus si'i tshogs 'du grol ma thag slar yang a ri nas nying hong brgyud tha'i wan du bskyod/rla 8 ches 11 nyin phran dang / rang gzhung nyi hong don gcod padma rgyal po/tha'i wan lan ha'o pa'o yi gsar 'god pa khren bcas thog kyo nas tha'i pe gnam thang du 'byor skabs tha'i wan lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso sku zhabs li'ang dbyin krang sogs gnam thang du bsu len du phebs te de'i dgong dro lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'dur gdan zhus ltar bskyod de tshogs gtso le'ang gis da res sku zhabs stag lha nga tsho'i tshogs pa'i ming thog nas 'di khul gdan zhus ltar phebs thub par dga' bsu zhu rgyu zhes dang / bar skabs shig ring nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba rgyang ring du song yang / lo shas sngon thog khyor bca' bzhugs tā 55

la'i bla ma'i sku tshab sku zhabs padma rgyal po dang / nga tsho tha'i wan gyi lan ho pa'o yi sku tshab sku zhabs khyen gnyis ngo shes kyis phan tshun 'brel lam byung rjes bod kyi chos rgyal tā la'i bla ma snga lo nyi hong du phebs skabs nga tsho tha'i wan lan ho pa'o gsar shog gi gtso 'dzin sku zhabs wang chi u mjal khar bcar ba'i go skabs bzang po thob pa ma zad/ chos rgyal tu la'i bla ma mchog gis gzhung dang gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba ma byung ba'i dus rim nang mi dmangs dbar gyi 'brel ba byed thub na yag po red ces bka' slob gnang ba gzhir bzung nga tsho phyogs gnyis kus tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyur rob tsam gros mol byung ste nga tsho phyogs nas lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa btsugs te tshogs pa'i ming thog nas skya zhabs stag lhar mgron brda phul ba ltar da res phebs thub pa der nga tsho dga' po byung / slad kyi 'brel ba byed phyogs skor nga tsho'i mtho rim mi sna dang bka' bsdur gnang rgyu de yin zhes gsungs song /de nas phran gyis da res 'di khul mgron 'bod gnang ba dang / dga' bsu gnang bar thugs rje che zhes zhus pa dang / nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba rgyang thag ring du phyin pa'i 'gal rkyen ji snyed 'phrad pa'i skor rob tsam gsal bshad dang / slad phan tshun gyi 'brel ba legs po yong thabs su phan tshun gnyis kus lhag bsam ldan pa'i thog nas dgongs pa bzhes te bka' mol gnang na 'bras bu bzang po thob kyi red ces zhus/ de nas lho e she ya'i tshogs pa'i drung che sku zhabs ma'o yis lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa'i sgrig gzhi'i skor snyan sgron gnang rjes phran dang padma rgyal po gnyis nas sgrig gzhi de'i nang du bod rigs spun rla zhes pa'i tshig don 'khod 'dug pa sogs la skyon brjod dang 'brel legs bcos byas/bzhugs mol tshogs 'du grol rjes lho e shi ya'i tshogs pas phran tshor dga' 56

bsu'i gsol ston bshams/ de'i gnangs nyin go min tang gzhung gi bde 'jags las khungs kyi spyi khyab dmag dpon wang ching shes dang / khong gi las rogs bcas mjal 'phrad zhu skabs dmag dpon wang gis/ da res khyed rang nga tsho lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa'i ming thog nas gdan zhus ltar phebs thub par nga tsho'i gzhung dang / nga rang / nga'i las rogs bcas nas khyed la dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ kha sa lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso sku zhabs le'ang gis brjod don/ de sngon phan tshun gyi 'brel lam yag po ma byung bas khyed kyis blo pham yod lugs gsungs 'dug pa dngos 'brel gyi gnas tshul byung song ba nga tsho tshang ma 'gyod pa skye ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de rjes nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba slar gso byung ste chos rgyal tu la'i bla ma'i bka' dgongs bzhin nga tsho'i phyogs nas sku zhabs padma rgyal po dang lhan du phan tshun go bsdur gyis phan tshun gnyis nas mi dmangs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas tshogs pa re btsugs na phan thogs yong rgyur mos mthun byung ba ltar nga cho'i phyogs nas lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyu dang / khyed rang tsho'i phyogs nas shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyu gros mol byung ba red/ tshogs pa 'dzugs rgyu'i ngo bo de nga tsho dang / a ri'i dbar dang / nga tsho dang nyi hong dbar/ gzhung dang gzhung gi 'brel ba bcad nas mi dmangs kyi rnam pa'i thog khungs so so'i tshogs pa brgyud nas gang ci'i thad 'brel ba byed bzhin yod pa bzhin/ nga tshos khyed tsho dang mnyam du mi dmangs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas khungs so so'i tshogs pa brgyud 'brel ba bya rgyu de yin/nga tsho'i phyogs nas lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa btsugs nas dus yun cung zad phyin song zhing / khyed tsho'i phyogs nas shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa gang myur 'dzugs thub ba'i re ba yod/ nye dus ngas de'i skor sku zhabs padma rgyal por bka' mol zhu rgyu byung / khong 57

gi gsungs don/ nga tsho'i gzhung nas bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang la rgyab skyor brtsi bkur yod lugs gsal bsgrags byung mtshams shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa 'dzugs kyi yin zhes gsungs byung / nga tshos de'i skor sku zhabs padma rgyal por snga rjes su gsal po zhus yod/ da lta nga tsho'i gzhung gis gsal bsgrags bya rgyur dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod/ ma 'ongs par bod mi rigs kyi re 'dun 'grub rgyur nga tsho'i gzhung nas rgyab skyor bya rgyu las dgag cha byed kyi ma red/ da res ngas sku zhabs stag lhar zhu rgyu yang de rang yin/ nga tshos khyod tsho la dpal 'byor thog regs ram bya rgyu der chab srid kyi thog nas khe phan lon thabs kyi re ba spu tsam yang med/ ma 'ongs par khyim mches gcig gis gcig la blos 'gel mdza' mthun thog ji srid bar gnas thub pa'i re 'dun gtso bo de yin/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tsho phan tshun gnyis kyi gnas babs mtshungs kyi yod/ rgya'i gtam dper/ nad mthun phan tshun gdung sems gcig ces pa de yin/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i dbar mi 'dra ba zhig la nga tshor sa cha chung chung zhig gi bdag dbang byed rgyu yod cing / khyed tsho mi yul du gnas yod par brten gang ci'i sku ngal yod pa der nga tshos mi spyod ring lugs kyi thog nas khyed rang tshor rogs ram bya rgyu de yin pa ma zad/ khyim mches kyi 'os 'gan yang yin/ de mtshungs nga tshor gung rgol gyi nyams myong yod pa des khyed tshor gang thub kyi rogs ram dang / skul ma zhu rtsis yin zhes gsungs mtshams padma rgyal pos/ da res nga tshos bka' zur stag lha mchog dang / dmag dpon khyed rang gnyis mjal 'phrad gnang ste slad nga tsho phyogs gnyis kyi 'brel ba mdun du spo rgyu'i dus rabs kyi 'go 'dzugs lta bur bsam gyi yod/ ngas de sngon khyed rang tshor bod mi'i rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang zhal bzhes gnang rogs zhes re 'dun thengs 'ga' 58

shas zhus yod/ da res sku zhabs stag lhas srid 'dzin dang / srid blon mjal 'phrad skabs khong gnyis su rung zhig gis bod mir rang thag rang gcod kyi dbang cha yod ces zhal bzhes tshig gcig gnang na yag po 'dug ces zhus par dmag dpon wang gis srid 'dzin nam/ srid blon su rung gis sku zhabs stag lha mjal 'phrad gnang skabs ngas snyan seng dam don zhus chog gsungs pa dang sbrags khong gis nga tsho lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa brgyud rgya gar dang bal yul bcas su yod pa'i bod mi gzhis chags khag gi bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba legs su 'gro ched lag shes slob sbyong dang / bzo grwa chung gras 'dzugs thabs bcas kyi rogs ram zhu 'thus dang / de 'brel nga tsho phan tshun gnyis kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba spel res bya rgyu bcas kyi rogs phan gang thub zhu rtsis yod/ khyed tshos shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa gang myur 'dzugs thub na dge mtshan chen po yong gnas bcas gsungs/phran gyis/ da lta skya zhabs padma rgyal pos re 'dun zhus don skor/ phran gyis srid 'dzin nam srid blon su rung mjal 'phrad zhu skabs bod mi rnams kyi re 'dun rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang yod ces gsung rgyu byung na nga tsho gzhis byes bod mi yongs kyis gung rgol gyi bya ba'i thog dpa' ngar che bskyed kyi sems shugs la skyal ma chen po zhig 'thebs kyi red ces bshad nas mjal 'phrad de mdza' brtse dang /lhag bsam zol med kyi rnam pa mtshon pa zhig byung /ches 13 nyin snga dro go min tang gi drung che rma phu li'i mjal 'phrad du bskyod/khong gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la gus bkur gyi smon tshig zhus thog tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs pa rlabs chen yin pa der gus brtse zhu gi yod/ de sngon nyi hong du sdod skabs sne len tshogs 'du zhig tu tā la'i bla ma khyug tsam mjal myong yod ces dang /59

bod me'i re 'dun la khong sgor gyi thog nas gdung sems mnyam skyed yod ces bsam tshul lhug po gsungs byung bar/phran gyi khong la 'tshams 'dre zhus thog de sngon tha'i wan du thengs 'ga' shas yong nas nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba'i thog bka' mol ji snyed byung yang 'brel yod dpon rigs 'ga' shas kyi bod don thog dgongs pa bzhes stangs de ha cang gu dog ring lugs dang / rgya mi rigs chen pe'i ring lugs kyi 'ardu shes chen po 'dzin gyi yod stabs da bar nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel bar don phan ma byung ba red ces skyon brjod byas par/ khong gis nga tsho go min tang la rgya mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs yog ma red/ go min tang la mi rigs ring lugs gsum yod/ rgya mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs de krung go gung khran tang gis rgya nag skam sa chen po'i bod rigs spun rlas gtsos pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs rnams la lag len bstar dang bstar bzhin yod/ nga cho'i dpon rigs kyi khrod du bsam blo gu dog can re zung yong srid ces khong gis mkhas po'i thog nas dgag cha lta bu byas byung /khong de sngon nyi hong du tha'i wan go min tang gzhung gi skya tshab lo 13 tsam ring byed myong skabs padma rgyal po dang 'brel ba yag po byung 'dug khong ni go min tang gi mtho rim dpon rigs kyi nang nas mi sna bsam shes can zhig yin par mngon/ de rjes dmag dpon cang khri ko'o yis mgron 'bod ltar nyin dgung gsol ston du bcar/ khong ni de sngon thengs gnyis tsam ngo phrad byung myong ba'i grogs po zhig yin/khong gis bod mi'i re 'dun thog blo kha yangs pa zhig yin pa'i skor gong du rob tsam zhus yod/ da res phran 'di khul slebs pa'i gnas tshul shes te khong gis gsol chigs tu mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar ngo bcar zhus nas phran gnyis slar yang ngo 60

'phrad byung ba'i bsam tshul rnams brje len byas/gsol chigs grub rjes go min tang dbus rgyun las kyi tshogs mi rgam gas ku'u greng kyang mjal 'phrad du bskyod/ khong rang lo 85 tsam la slebs 'dug pas bka' mol gnang skabs ldab skyor mang po rgyag pa dang / mgo ma 'tshos kyi skad cha mang po zhig gsung gi 'dug stabs khong gi g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i rogs pa tsho yang kha skyong pa'i rnam pa zhig ston gyi 'dug khong ni/ de sngon cang ke shag 'tsho bzhugs skabs brtsi mthong chen po bya yul gyi gras shig yin/ deng sang go min tang tshogs pa'i dbus rgyun las kyi 'gan 'dzin gyi gas dang / tha'i wan gzhung gi 'dzam gling gung rgol tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso / skam sa chen po'i skyob gso'i las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin bcas kyi las 'khur yod pa zhig red 'dugazla 8 ches 14 nyin gyi snga dro srid 'dzin cang cing go yi bka' slob 'bul mkhan lo na 85 la slebs pa khyen li phu'u zhes pa mjal 'phrad zhus/ khong ni de sngon go min tang tha'i wan du ma yong gong go min tang tshogs pa'i las 'gan gtso bo 'khyer mkhan gyi mi sna zhig yin pa ma zad/ cang ce hre'i khyim tshang dang / khong gi khyim tshang gnyis mi tshang gcig lta bu'i 'brel mthun yod stabs mi dmangs tshos cang khyim tshang gi srid dbang dang / khreng khyim tshang gi tshogs pa zhes yongs khyab tu gleng gi yod/ khong lo na mthon po de lta bur slebs yod kyang / grung sha dod po dang rig pa gsal po/ skad cha shod mkhas pa bcas 'dug cing / khong gis de sngon go gung (go min tang dang/ gung khran tang gnyis kyi bsdus tshig/tang gnyis zhi mthun yong thabs kyi gros mol skabs khong gis go min tang gi skya tshab gtso bo byas nas gung khran tang gi skya tshab kra'u en le dang mnyam du gros mol rgyun ring byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong ji bya

snyed cig phran la ngo sprod lta bur brjod byung / khong gis kra'u en le zhes pa'i mi de phyi'i rnam 'gyur de zhi dul blo dkar sems dkar lta bu zhig yin tshul gyis don du sems pa gnag cing g.yo sgyu khram gsum la byang chub pa zhig red/ skabs re go gung tshogs pa gnyis kyi gros mthun de cung zad legs phyogs su 'gro ba'i skabs der nga tsho go min tang gi mtho rim mi sna mang che bas kra'u en ler re ba chen po bcol kyang kra'u en les g.yo sgyu'i thabs lam gang mkhas kyi rnam 'gyur der mi tshang ma mgo 'khor 'gro ba tsam las don 'bras gang yang yong rgyu med pa ma zad/ de las ldog ste go min tang gi 'bring rim dpon rigs dang / mtho rim dpon rigs dbar mi mthun pa'i dkrugs shing byed pa dang / slob phrug dang bzo zhing / dma' rim las byed dang mang tshogs bcas kyi khrod du gzhung la mi dga' ba'i dkrog gtam gang thub spel te de rnams la mgo bskor bslu bred kyis gung khran tang la dga' mos yong thabs kyi srid byus ngan g.yo dran 'phrul la brten nas phan tshun zhi mthun gyi rtsa don der gtor bshig gang thub byed kyi yod/ skabs der ngas cang tsung thung la/ kra'u en le zer ba'i mi der rdugs zon gnang dgos lugs snyan seng zhu skabs cang tsung thung gis thugs yid ma 'ches par brten mtha' ma gung khran tang gi lag nas thob pa'i gsang ba'i yig cha rnams spyan bstar zhu dgos byung / de dang de 'dra'i gnas tshul mang po zhig ra sprod gsal po byung yod/ kra'u en le'i 'dzum mdangs can gyi g.yo sgyu der rgya nag mi dmangs rnams mgo 'khor ba'i rkyen gyis rgya nag skam sa chen po de las sla por shor thub nas mi dmangs yongs rdzogs gung khran tang gi dra ba'i nang tshud pa red/ da lta yang dogs zon yag po ma byas che gung khran tang gi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus la brten nas mgo bskor gtong gi red/ nga mi rgan zhig gi 62

lo rgyus kyi nyams myong de khyed la cung zad zhig zhus pa yin/ khyed rang tshor yang gung khran gyi mgo bskor gyi srid byus der rdugs zon bya dgos pa'i nyams myong yod kyang da dung mu mthud nas rdugs zon lhod g.yeng du ma song ba nges par gnang gal zhes gsungs byung ba de ni bgres song des lhag bsam zol med kyi slob ston byas pa zhig yin par snyam/de nyin dgong dro/ chu tshod gsum pa'i thog go min tang gi srid blon yus go hwa mjal 'phrad skabs srid blon yus kyis da res sku zhabs stag lha tha'i lhan du phebs par nga tshos dga' bsu yod zer ba'i lan du/ phran gyis/ nga tsho phan tshun gnyis dbar 'das pa'i dus skabs su 'brel ba ji byung skor khong la rob tsam zhus pa'i thog srid blon khyed mjal 'phrad byung ba'i go skabs 'di dang bstun nas ngas khyed la/nga tsho'i bod mi rnams kyi rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang 'os shing 'tshams pa'i las 'gul der rgyab skyor yod ces srid blon khyed kyi zhal bzhes gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu gi yod/ de ltar byung na nga tsho'i dbar gung rgol 'thab phyogs kyi 'brel bar phan thogs chen po yong gi red ces zhus pas/ khong gis nga rang de sngon dpal 'byor gyi las ka sha stag byed mkhan zhig yin stabs chab srid kyi nyams myong de tsam med/lhag par bod don skor ni slob phrug lta bu zhig yin/ bar lam nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba legs su 'gro gi yod pa de ha cang yag po red/ nga tshos bod mi tshor rogs ram bya rgyu'i ched du nye lam nga tsho'i phyogs nas lho e she ya'i tshogs pa de btsugs te slad phyin nga tsho'i tshogs pas khyed rang tsho'i tshogs pa brgyud phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun rla rnams la rogs ram bya rgyu de yin zhes gsungs par phran gyis yang bskur/ gong zhus ltar nga tsho phan tshun gnyis dbar 'gangs che'i 63

'brel ba yong rgyu'i gtso gnad de srid blon khyed kyis bod mi'i 'os shing 'tshams pa'i thob thang de zhal bzhes gnang thub na dge mtshan chen po yong rgyu ma zad/ nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel mthun de sngar las lhag pa yong rgyur yid ches yod ces zhu skabs srid blon yus kyis/ dbu lcog lcog dang / red red ces gsungs pa las de min gyi lan 'debs gang yang gnang ma bde ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan byung / de nas phran gyis/ nga tsho'i 'di khul du 'brel ba'i 'gan 'khur sku zhabs padma rgyal pos gnang gi yod kyang / bar lam bod sog las khungs zhes pa des phyi rgyal khag tu yod pa'i nga tsho'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi bla ma re zung dang / mi sna re zung 'di khul lkog nas gdan zhu byas yod par brten nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel bar phan med gnod skyon yong gi 'dug nga tshos bod sog las khungs zhes pa de brgyud 'brel byed 'dod med/ gang yin zhe na/ bod sog las khungs zhes pa de da lta'i dus skabs 'dir rjes lus kyi las khungs shig la ngos 'dzin zhu gi yod/ ces zhus pa'i lan du/ nga tsho'i bod sog las khungs de rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i las khungs shig yin pas lam seng 'gyur ba gtong khag po red/da lta'i bod sog las khungs de'i u yon krang de lo na gzhon gzhon yin stabs las don thog hol rgyugs kyi nor 'khrul yong srid/ phyin chad khyed rang tsho dang / nga tsho'i lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa de dang 'brel ba gnang na yag po 'dug ces gsungs byung /phran gyis yang bskyar khong la/ gong du zhus don bzhin srid blon khyed nas bod kyi rtsa don la rgyab bskyor yod ces gsungs rgyu'i re ba zhu gi yod ces zhus pas khong gi sngar bzhin legs nyes tshig gcig ma gsungs ba'i thog tshig don de las g.yol nas sku zhabs stag lhar khyed rang 'di khul gzigs bskor gnang 'dod yod na sku 64

zhabs le'ang gi phebs rogs zhu dgos zhes gsungs par/ phran gyis thugs rje che/sang nyin phran phyir thon bya rtsis yod gshis da res blta bskor du bskyod khom byung ma song zhes zhus nas blo pham pa'i ngang mjal 'phrad mjug 'grel gyis mgron khang du phyir log byas/de'i dgong dro go min tang gi drung che rma phu li yis mgron 'bod ltar bskyod skabs phran gyi grogs po rnying pa tsho'o hreng phung yang gsol ston du mgron 'bod ltar phebs te phran gnyis slar yang mjal ba'i dga' tshor chen po'i ngang nas lo mang ma 'phrad pa'i lo rgyus gleng mol byas pa tsam las tshang mas srid don gyi gnad don las g.yol gang thub byas/ches 15 nyin tha'i wan nas ma thon gong snga dro rang gzhung shar lho e shi ya'i don gcod sku zhabs padma rgyal po'i mtshan thog nas ja ston zhig bshams te go min tang gi drung che rma phu li yis gtsos pa'i 'brel gnad dpon rigs mgron brda zhus rigs tshang ma dus thog tu phebs/ ja ston grol mtshams sku mgron gzhan rnams phyir phebs rjes dmag dpon wang dang phran gnyis mtha' ma'i gros mol khyug tsam zhu skabs/ kha sa srid blon ngos mjal skabs nga tsho'i re 'dun la zhal bzhes ma gnang bar blo pham yod tshul skor zhus par/ khyed rang thugs pham ma gnang rogs gnang /da lta'i dus skabs 'dir nga tsho'i gzhung gi lan gsal zhu khag po red/ ma 'ongs par khyed rang tsho'i re 'dun de nges par 'grub thub kyi red/ gang yin zer na/ cang tsung thung dam pas bod don thog bka' gsal po gnang yod/ cang tsung thung dam pas gsungs pa'i don gnad de nga tsho'i gzhung gis 'gyur ba gtong shes kyi ma red/ nga tshor dka' ngal 'phrad pa de khyed la yang skyar gsal po zhus na/ gal srid nga tshos 65

khyed tsho'i re 'dun la khas len gyi gsal bsgrags gnang che nga tsho'i phyir sdod rang mi rnams dang/ lhag par du tha'i wan gyi mi tshos bod de rang thag rang gcod byed chog par tha'i wan rang thag rang gcod byed mi chog pa gang yin nam zhes rnyog dra bzo rgyur nges shing / a ri'i gnad yod mi sna 'ga' shas kyis tha'i wan rang btsan zhes pa'i las 'gul byed mkhan tshor rgyab skyor chen po byed kyi yod par brten srid blon gyis khyed la lanabadebs gsal po gnang ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ bod sog las khungs de nga tsho'i srid blon las khungs kyi 'og las khungs che khag gi gras shig yin/'on kyang da lta khyed la dpe mtshon zhig zhus na las khungs de nga tsho rgya lugs kyi gzhi bdag lha khang lta bu zhig tu gnas yod/ de la lam seng bsgyur bcos byed khag po red/ nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba yag tu phyin na gzhi bdag lha khang de rang bzhin gyis med pa chags kyi red/ da phan phyi rgyal khag tu yod pa'i bod rigs spun zu tshos tha'i wan du yong 'dod yod ces bod sog las khungs la gnas tshul 'byor mtshams las khungs de nas khong tsho'i re 'dun la dga' bsu zhus nas tha'i wan du gdan 'dren zhu gi yod pa red/ de ring skya zhabs stag lha rgya gar du phebs rjes chos rgyal tu la'i bla ma mchog dang / khyed tsho'i bka' shag bcas la khyed tsho'i shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa de 'phral du 'dzugs thub na nga tsho lho e shi ya'i tshogs pa dang 'brel lam gyi sgo phye ste bod sog las khungs zhes pa'i 'brel lam de rim pas 'gog thub pa'i dge mtshan chen po yod ces gsungs pa'i lan du/gong zhus ltar/ da lta dmag dpon khyed dang / drung che rma phu li bcas kyi mdza' brtse'i thog nas nga tsho phan tshun gyi bsam tshul brje len lhug po gnang bar dga' po byung / phran rgya gar du slebs rjes tu la'i bla ma mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas la 66

dngos 'brel gyi gnas tshul snyan seng zhu gi yin/ rang nyid kyi bsam tshul la shar e shi ya'i tshogs pa de lam seng 'dzugs rgyur dka' ngal 'phrad mi yong ngam snyam pa 'dug 'on kyang phan tshun gyi 'brel gtugs da mus bzhin gnang thub na dge mtshan yod par mngon zhes zhus par/ dmag dpon wang gis khyed tsho shar yeshi ya'i tshogs pa btsugs pa tsam gyis nga tsho'i 'brel ba'i thog phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ gong zhus bzhin tshogs pa de gnyis brgyud nga tsho'i phyogs nas bod mi rnams la 'tsho ba yar rgyas dang / bzo gra chung chung 'dzugs rgyu/ slob phrug 'ga' shas tha'i wan khul gyi mtho rim slob grwa khag tu slob sbyong du 'tshud thabs kyi rogs ram bcas bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs par thugs rje che zhus pa dang / de nyin bskyel mar phebs mkhan rnams dang zhal gyes skabs nyin shas gshib 'grogs kyi phan tshun mdza' sems kyi dra bas bcings pa lta bu'i snang ba phran bu byung ngo //67

le tshan so bzhi pa/'brug tu gnas chags bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la dka' chegs 'phrad pa'i skor/dgaye / /phye lo 1973 lo 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen bkrin bskyangs pa'i sar rgya bal 'brug 'bras la dwags bcas su gnas pakāsnga bod mi btsan byol ba tsam ma zad/ gong gsal sa gnas khag gi nang chos la dad pa byed mkhan yul mi mang po zhig kyang bcar ba bcas mi grangs khri drug lhag tsam byung 'dug dus 'khor dbang chen legs grub rjes rang gzhung gi lo 'khor las bsdoms tshogs 'du de lho phyogs bod mi'i gzhes chags ma'i sor lugs zung bsam grub gling du tshogs rgyur thugs gtan sngon 'khel ltar 7gong sa chen po mchog de khul chibs bsgyur gnang ba dang /tshogs 'du grol nas dus yun de tsam ma song ba'i skabs der 'brug gzhung gis glo bur du phyi lo 1974 zla 3 ches 5 bod shing stag rla 1 ches 13 nyin 'brug gi rgyal sa thim phur bca' bzhugs nga tsho'i don gcod lha sding bsod nams dpal 'byor 'brug rgyal pos shog gsung gi 'dug ces lan skyel mi 'byor gshis dngos 'brel yin shag gi 'bul rten rum gdan cha gcig 'khyer te bskyod mtshams 69

'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa dang / de mtshungs lhag bsam can gyi bod mi dang /bod mir brtse zhen ldan pa'i 'brug mi bcas mi grangs 35 tsam gyi nang du 'brug gzhung sku srung dmag mi yong ste don gcod khang gis mtshon tshang ma'i khang pa bsngogs bsher dang / yig cha yod rigs 'khyer bas ma tshad/ khong tshor rgyu mtshan gsal bshad gang yang med par bsdams bkyog gis mgo bor ras g.yog ste 'khrid nas btson 'jug thog khrims gcod drag po bzod par dka' ba gtong gi yod pa dang /lhag par don gcod khang gi yig cha gang yod la mi ched 'dzugs kyis zhib 'jug bya gi yod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul mi snyan pa rda ram sa lar 'byor pas tshang ma ha las hang sang dgos pa zhig byung /gang yin zhe na/ bod mi tsho rang yul du rgya dmar gyis btsan dbang gdug /ba ma bzod par phyi lo 1959 lo khyim mches rgyal khab khag la btsan byol du yong dgos byung ba ltar bod mi khyon che 'brug brgyud yong bzhin pa'i mur rgya gar gzhung la bka' mol gnang ste phyi lo 1951 lo ka li ka tar 'bras spyi blon chen dang / rgya gar phyi srid drung che ku'ul/ 'brug gi srid blon 'jigs med rdo rje/ bod gzhung sku tshab phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal bcas lhan tshogs gnang ste bod mi bzhi stong tsam 'brug nang gzhis chags ched 'jog rgyur 'brug gzhung nas sa cha gnang rgyu dang / de byings gron dngul tshang ma rgya gar gzhung nas gnang rgyu/ gzhis chags 'dzugs bskrun dang 'dzin skyong bod mis bya rgyur de'i 'gan 'khur dang / 'brug gzhung gnyis la 'brel ba zhu rgyu/ bod mir blta rtogs bcas kyi ched du 'brug tu bod kyi don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyu bcas dgongs mthun gros chod 'jog gnang mdzad pa red/gros chod dgongs don bod gzhung don gcod mi 'gro yang 'brug gzhung gis 70

ming 'don dmigs 'dzugs gnang ba ltar phreng ring rig 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / lha sding bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis bsko bzhag gnang ba ma zad/ khong gnyis nas 'brug gzhung gi dgongs bzhes dang bstun pa'i thog phyi lo 1953 nas gzhis chags las don 'go 'dzugs byas te/ phyi lo 1971 bar lo 9 nang mi grangs 3350 tsam yod pa'i gzhis chags khag bdun 'dzugs skrun cha tshang zin pa dang /gzhis chags rer 'dzugs skrun dus yun lo gsum re song mtshams nas sa cha dang / mi la 'khri ba'i khral 'bab/ de bzhin bod mi tshong las sogs 'tsho thabs las don gzhan dag byed mkhan tshang mas 'brug pa'i mi ser khyad med kyi khral rigs sgrub 'jal le med zhus te lab gleng gang yang med par gnas bzhin pa ma zad/ bod mi rnams tshul mthun snyoms chung thog 'tsho gos kyi thabs shes gang yang thub mkhan dang / yul mis las rtsol ched gla glas skabs g.yo zol med par sha tsha rnam dag byed mkhan zhig la song 'brug gzhung dbu 'khrid rnam pa dang / 'brug mi mang tshogs bcas nas 'brug mi byings la'ang mig dpe blta yul gang legs byung zhes bsngags brjod gnang bzhin pa'i mur bsam yul las 'das pa'i byur rdo gnam babs lta bu'i rkyen ngan de byung ba red/de 'phral phyi lo 1974 zla 5 ches 3 nyin bod gzhung bka' blon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan 'brug tu ched phebs kyis bod mi rnams 'dzin bzung gnang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / 'gal 'dzol ji byas ra sprod gsal gsung yong ba dang / gal srid khong tshos 'gal nyes byas pa ra sprod byung che nga tshos 'brug gzhung la rgyab skyor gtsang ma zhu rgyu sogs gnas lugs gsol bar/ 'brug gzhung nas bod mi tshos 'brug nang gtor bshig gtong rtsis byas tshul dang / go lag dang / 'brug gi 7

sa bkra thon tshul lhag par rgya lo don grub dang blo bzang ye shes gnyis de khongs the byus yod tshul/ dbyangs skyid kyi pha ka gnyis bu dang / blo bzang ye shes gros mol gyis dgos gal byung na go lag yod pa'i dmag mi 300 gtong rgyu'i yig cha thon lugs dang / lhag par rtsa ba rgya lo don grub la thug tshul bcas gsungs pa las/bden 'dzin 'os pa'i ra sprod 'pher ba zhig byung med kyang / rang sa mi sa'i khyad par la brten bya thabs bral te gong gsal ming spyos gnang ba rnams la 'dri brtsad mu mthud bka' mol zhu bar bcar rgyu zhus/de mur phyi lo 1974 zla 5 ches 20 nyin 'brug gzhung nas 'brug nang gnas sdod bod mi snga rjes tshang ma bod du phyir log gtong rgyu'i gsal bsgrags gnang ba dang / slar yang / zla ba drug pa'i ches gcig nyin 'brug gzhung gis bod mi tshos 'brug rgyal po bkrongs rtsis byas pa dang / bkris chos rdzong mer bsregs gtong rgyu/'brug gi chab srid mgo rting slog rtsis byas tshul sogs yongs khyab gsal bsgrags gnang ba red/ der brten sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang / bod gzhung ldi li don gcod phun tshogs don ldan gnyis nas gong gsal 'brug gzhung gi gsal bsgrags gnang ba de dag bden pa gtan nas min pa dang / nga tshos bya ngan de rigs byed rgyu ltar bzhag bsam blor 'khor mi thub pa zhig red ces sogs kyi gsar 'god gsal bsgrags bya dgos byung ba red/da dung slar yang 'brug gzhung nas do dam khongs yod rnams srog thog tu gtong rgyu gsungs pa rgya gar chogs shog khag nang thon stabs 7gong sa mchog nas de ltar mi 'byung ba'i 'brug rgyal mchog la phyi lo 1974 zla 5 ches 7 nyin bka' yig gnang ba ma zad/ de 'phral bka' blon kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang /72

bka' blon dbang 'dus rdo rje gnyis 'brug tu ched gnyer dang 'brel bod mi su zhig nas 'brug gzhung gi nang srid la the byus byas dang bya sems rtsa ba nas med pa'i gnas lugs zhib gsol thog kha sngon skyon 'dzugs gnang yul rgya lo don grub dang /blo bzang ye shes gnyis la 'dre brtsad zhib nan byas par/ gnyis kus de rigs byas pa rtsa ba nas med/ gal srid thugs yido ma dwangs che khrims mthun brtsad zhib yong ba nas der dag skyel zhu gi yin zhu 'dug na/ de ltar khrims zhib mdzad thabs yong ba dang / gzhan yang do dam khongs yod bcas bod mi tshos 'gal 'jol ji byas dang / go lag gang dang ji thon/ go lag rang 'grigs dmag mi 300 gtong rgyu byas pa'i yig cha rtags 'byar yod gsungs pa sogs nga tshor mig ston yong ba ma zad/ gnas tshul 'di rnams nges par du gsal po bzo gnang yong ba/ nye char tshags par khag nang do dam khongs yod bod mi srog thog tu gtong rgyu'i gnas tshul thon pa de rigs mi 'byung ba'i byams gzigs thugs rje che ba dang / bod mi rnams rgya dmar gyi gdug rtsub btsan dbang ma bzod par btsan byol du yong dgos byung gshis/ da cha 'brug nang 'jigs snang dngangs tshab med par bzod bder gnas 'thus dgongs bzhes yong ba sogs zhu bskul rim pa byas rung / kho tshos bod nang bso pa btang tshul tsam las gong don khag gi skor rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i ra sprod gzhan pa gang yang gnang med/'brug gzhung gis 1974 zla 10 ches 17 nyin bod mi 77 skor la tshang ma skra bcad lus bsgyur gyi 'brug mi ma byas che bod du phyir log gtong rgyu yin gsungs pa dang / slar yang zla 10 ches 28 nyin bod mi gzhis chags dang /rang 'tsho/ sngon 'byor bcas nas mi 'thus 80 bsdu bkong gis 'brug rgyal 73

mchog nas bar lam bod mi 'ga' zhig nas 'brug gi srung skyob la gnod pa'i las ka byas rkyen 'dzin bzung bya dgos byung rung / bod mi byings la rdugs pa med gshis sngar ltar rgyun gnas sdod chog rgyur mang tshogs la slob gso dgos pa'i bka' bzang phebs kyang / de mur rgyu mtshan ji byung gsal rtogs med par gong gsal mi 'thus rnams gzhan bskyod ma chog par lo gnyis ma zin tsam thim phur bkag nyar gnang /gzhan yang 'brug sdod bod mi rnams 'tsho thabs ched rgya gar nang 'gro rgyu ltar bzhag gzhis chags phan tshun dbar la yang 'grems 'grul mi chog pa'i dam bsgrags dang / khong tsho'i phru gu rgya gar nang slob grur yod pa rnams pha ma'i sar gung seng bskyod skabs bkag 'gog gnang /da dung phyi lo 1974 zla 10 ches 39 nyin 'brug gzhung gis/ 'brug gzhung la bod chig bsgril tshogs pas byus ngan las 'gul brtsams pa 'dzin bzung do dam gnang tshul drang bden 'grel bshad/ ces pa'i deb chung zhig 'grems spel gnang / de'i nang sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub kyis 'brug rgyal khab kyi nang srid la the byus byas pa dang / chig bsgril tshogs pas 'brug gzhung mgo rting bslog rgyu dang /dbyangs skyed kyi bu rgyal khrir 'god rgyu'i ngan gshom lag len bstar rtsis yod lugs sogs khungs med mang dag bkod yod pa red/der brten phyi lo 1975 che 'a dang 10 pa'i nang bka' blon dbang rdor nas 'brug rgyal blon snga rjes mjal 'phrad kyis nga tshos bod don 'bad sgrub bya rgyu rang 'gan g.yol thabs med pa zhig las/ de min su zhig gi nang srid la the byus byed dgos don med pa ltar da lam gyi dka' rnyog 'di skor zhib brtsad nan gtan byas par bod mi su zhig nas the byus 'gal 'dzol byas pa gtan nas byung mi 'dug 74

pa ma zad/ slad kyang de rigs mi 'byung ba nga tshos 'gan len zhu rgyur do dam khongs yod rnams glod bkrol dang / drang bden thag gcod 'phral la yong ba/ bod mi rnams 'brug mi byed dgos zhes bka' phebs/ pa'i thad/ bod mis khrims 'gal byas tshul gyis do dam gnang ba'i thog ma'i rtsod rnyogs de dag sngon la thag gcod yong ba dang / de mtshams 'brug mi byed rgyu'i skor bka' mol zhu 'thus chog pa'i gnas lugs gsol bar/ 'brug gzhung gis bod mi rnams 'brug mi bya rgyu de rjes su bzhag ste rnyog dra sngon la thag gcod bya rogs/ gsungs pa de 'os po mi 'dug ces dgongs bzhes ma thob/phyi lo 1977 zla 2 ches 13 dang 14 nyin 'brug sku srung dmag sgar gyi drag shos don grub che ring can bod mi'i gzhis chags dkar bye sa dang / bod sgar nang gnyis su yong ste da cha 'di rnams sku srung dmag mi'i ched gsol bstsal byung bas stong pa bzo dgos/ khyod tsho la sa tshab gzhan nas gnang rgyu dang / khang pa khyod tshos 'khyer 'thus brjod/de rjes slob phrug bkag 'gog gnang bar brten phyi lo 1978 zla pa'i nang sa 'du rin chen lags 'brug tu ched bcar gyis 'phral sel 'brug nang slob grwa btsugs 'thus dang 'brel dge rgan dang / slob deb btang 'thus yong ba/ rgya gar nang slob grwar 'gro mos yod rigs btang 'thus chog pa bcas zhus par/ 'brug gzhung nas 'brug nang slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu dang / slob deb/ dge rgan gtong rgyu bcas 'grigs thabs med cing / rgya gar nang ye shu sogs sger slob khag la btang na 'thus kyang / bod pa'i slob grwar btang na mi 'gregs gsungs pa dang / phyi lo 1979 zla snye nang 'brug rgyal yongs tshogs 'du chen mo thengs 50 pa'i thog 75

bod mi rnams bod du phyir slog gtong rgyu'i gros chod bzhagalo 'dir rda ram sa lar las bsdoms tshogs 'dur bcar 'thus 'brug gzhung gi bka' 'khrol bstsal thon 'thus mi 12 phru gu skyel mi gsum bcas 'brug tu phyir 'khor rjes khong tsho dang / bod mi bsam yod rigs zhen can rnams dbye 'byed kyi rgya gar dang 'brug gi sa mtshams ḍa'i pham zer ba'am/ yang na rang rang thog mar bod nas yong khungs sa mtshams gang yin de rang la phyir slog gtong rgyu byas te phyi lo 1979 zla 10 ches 27 nyin 'brug gzhung nang srid khang nas 'brug sdod bod mi'i lag 'khyer phyir bsdu byas thog skyel 'dren 'khor lo bcas rtsis sprod byas pa red/ de 'phral bod mi mang tshogs yongs nas 'brug gzhung dang /rgya gar gzhung tshab khang ridu ngu 'bod bde sdug zhu bar bsdebs gcig tu bskyod pa dang /7gong sa mchog nas 'brug rgyal mchog la bka' tar gnang bas dus 'gyangs gyur pa bcas de lta bu'i dka' rnyogs byung rung / nga tshos 'brug gzhung la me 'chigs mer gtugs kyi thog nas dka' rnyog rnams sel zhing / bod 'brug 'brel lam snga sor chud pa dang / bod mi gzhes chags sngon yod rnams 'brug nang rang 'jags gnas thabs bcas la bka' blon rnams rgyun mthud bcar te 'bad brtson gang yong byas kyang / dgongs bzhes don 'bras gtan nas ma son gshis da cha bod mi rnams rgya gar nang gnas spo bya rgyu las/ thabs gzhan med stabs 'u thug gis rgya gar gzhung la zhus te phyi lo 1981 lo 'brug nas bod mi 1500 rgya gar nang len thub pa byung zhing / 'phros bsdad rnams kyang len thabs gnang rgyur bzhagagong gsal dka' khyog 'di'i yong rkyen rtsa ba ni/ 'brug rgyal zhing gshegs 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gi btsun mo ngo ma a she skal bzang yod bzhin du phyi lo 76

1955 tsam nas 'brug tu sngon 'byor bod mi ka gnyis bu bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi bu mo dbyangs skyed zer ba zur mor bdag nyar gnang bar brten btsun mo skal bzang mi dga' ba'i 'khon 'dzin yong rgyu chos nyid kyang / rgyal po 'tsho bzhugs ring gang yang byed ma thub pa'i mur phyi lo 1954 lo btsun mo skal bzang gi gcen po 'brug gi srid blon 'jigs med rdo rje glo bur 'brug dmag cig gis me mda' brgyab ste bkrongs pa'i lag dmar 'dzin bzung thog 'brug rgyal mchog gis srid blon 'das po'i gcung po lam dpon lhun grub rdo rje srid blon las tshab tu bsko gzhag gnang /khong gis 'brul rgyal po'i gnyen tshan 'brug gi drag po'i spyi khyab khyab bdag rnam rgyal bla dur srid blon bkrongs mkhan byed gtsor ngos 'dzin gyi srog thog btang ba red/ de nas bzung rgyal po dang / btsun mo skal bzang gi phyogs gtogs dbar 'gal zur gyur cing / phan tshun gnyis mas mngon med kyi sgo nas gri bton gzhu bkang lta bu'i gnas tshul chags thog dbyangs skyid bod mo yin pa'i cha nas btsun mo'i phyogs gtogs rnams nas bod mi byings la'ang gzigs tshul mi legs pa yod bzhin pa red/ skabs der 'brug rgyal mchog bsnun mnar sud sir sman bcos su phebs te bzhugs min dbar srid tshab lam dpon lhun grub rdo rjes dbyangs skyid med pa bzo 'char byas pa dang / rgyal po phyir phebs skabs bkrong rgyu'i 'char gzhi bting lugs gleng lhags yod pa bcas ngan byus lam lhongs ma byung ba'i mur/ 'brug rgyal sud si nas phyir phebs gnang bar brten rang nong ma bzod par lam dpon lhun rdor dang khong gi gcen mo a she bkris can mi drug glo bur bal yul du gsang bros phyin pa red/ der brten 'brug rgyal yongs tshogs chen nas khong tsho ngo 77

log par brtsis te 'brug nang phyir log mi chog pa'i gros chod kyang bzhag pa red/phyi lo 1974 lor 'brug rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug a phe ri ku'i yul du ma gshegs gong 1972 lor rgyal sras 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug 'brug gi spa gro dpon slob kyi khri gsol zhus shing / rgyal yum skal bzang phyogs gtogs kyis dbyangs skyid med pa bzo rgyu dang / lam dpon lhun rdor can bal yul nas phyir log thub thabs bya rgyu'i dmigs yul ched dbyangs skyed kyis bya spyod ngan rgu tshang ba byas tshul dang / srid blon 'jigs med rdo rje bkrong mi gtso bo kho pa yin tshul/ lhag par du rgyal sras 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug la mthu gtad ngan gshom lag len bstar tshul dang / dbyangs skyed lags la rgya lo don grub kyis gtsos pas bod mi 'ga' shas kyis rgyab skyor 'og rgyal sras lkog gsod gtong 'char dang / rgyal sa thim phu bkris chos rdzong mer bsregs btang nas 'brug gzhung mgo rteng slog ste dbyangs skyid kyi bu gcig 'brug gi rgyal khrir 'god rgyu bcas kyi ngan gshom byas tshul sogs de snga'i zhe nad 'khon 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs te rdzun gtam mi 'dra gal bsgrigs kyis 'brug rgyal sku na phra bas dbu mongs su bcug ste bod mi khag gcig la nag med nyes 'gel gyis khrims gcod 'dra min sna tshogs ya nga ba btang yod pa red/phyi lo 1982 zla na ches 18 nyis 'bras ljongs chos rgyal don grub rnam rgyal mchog dgongs rdzogs zhugs 'bul gyi mdzad sgor 7gong sa mchog gi sku tshab tu phran bsko brdzong gis sgang tog la bskyod de zhugs 'bul mdzad sgor zhugs pa yin/de skabs 'brug gi rgyal yum a she skal bzang yang phebs 'dug par mdzad sgo zin bstun phran nas mjal 'phrad zhus te snga lo 'brug khul du gnas sdod bod mi rnams la dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i skor gang myur thag gcod gtsang sel yong ba'i skor don tshan gsum snyan skyal zhus par/78

dang po/ bar lam bod 'brug dbar rkyen ngan byung ba 'di phan tshun gnyis ka blo pham gyi rang bzhin can zhig chags yod kyang / 'das pa'i lo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i reng bod 'brug gnyis thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung / skad yigagom gshis bcas gcig gyur thog phan tshun gcig phan gcig rogs kyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba bzang po zhig yong ba de dag bskyar gso yong ba rgyal yum mchog nas mnga' bdag rgyal po mchog la snyan seng zhu gnang yong ba dang /gnyis pa/ rkyen ngan byung nas da bar lo ngo drug tsam song ba da cha 'brug gzhung dgongs pa rim dwangs yong bzhin par brten bod mi btson pa rnams mgyogs nas myur du glod bkrol yong thabs rgyal yum mchog gi byams snying la dgongs nas 'brug gzhung la snyan seng zhu skul yong ba/gsum pa/ bar lam bod nas 'brug tu 'byor ba'i bod mi btsan byol ba khag gcig bod du phyir slog btang yod lugs kyi gnas tshul go thos byung ba slar bod mi gsar 'byor rnams phyir sgrod mi yong ba 'brug gzhung nas dgongs bzhes skyabs 'jug yong ba zhes zhus par/ rgyal yum a she skal bzang nas gong du zhus pa'i don tshan dang po dang gnyis pa'i skor lan gsal gang 'ang ma gnang ba dang / don tshan gsum pa'i thad da bar bod nas 'brug yul du gsar 'byor bod mi rnams 'brug gzhung gis rgya gar du ma thon bar 'brug nang sdod du bcug gi yod/ bod nas 'brug gi sa thog 'byor ba'i bod mi rnams gcig kyang phyir slog byas yod pa ma red ces gsung par/ kho bos nye lam bod 'brug sa mtshams la ya zhes pa'i 'brug sa nas bod mi btsan byol ba khag gcig bod du phyir slog btang yod pa'i gnas tshul 'dug par slad de rigs mi byung ba'i dgongs pa che bzhes yong ba dang / gong gsal zhu don rnams mnga' bdag rgyal po chen por snyan seng gang legs zhu rogs zhes zhus/de rjes tsam 'brug rgyal yum gcung po srid blon zur pa lam dpon lhun rdor 79

dang mjal te da lta rgyal yum mchog la snyan seng zhus don rnams drag shos nas kyang skyabs 'jug yag po zhu rogs/ bar lam lo ngo drug ring bod mi btson pa rnams kyi nang mi dang / dga' nye bcas kyis btson pa rnams shi gson ji byung dang / btson khang gang du yod med shes rtogs tsam med par bod mi gzhis byes yongs blo pham chen po'i ngang nas gnas yod par brten drag shos khyod kyis mnga' bdag rgyal po mchog dang / rgyal yum rnam gnyis la btson pa tshor byams snying la dgongs nas gang myur glod bkrol yong thabs kyi snyan seng skyabs 'jug yong ba zhus par/ drag shos lam dpon lhun rdor gyis de sngon byung ba'i gnas tshul der nga rang yang blo pham byung / der brten snga lo tsha rong 'jigs med lags dang nga gnyis sa gnas 'di rang (sgangatog ) la thug 'phrad skabs khyed tsho'i gzhon nu re zung 'brug tu phebs nas 'brug gzhung dpon rigs lhan du bka' mol gnang na yag po min nam zhes ngas bsam tshul bton te rjes su tsha rong 'jigs med che dbang lags dang /rogs pa gzhon nu zhig 'brug tu phebs yod kyang / skabs der khyed tsho'i gzhon nu'i gsar shog thog ma bden ma mthun pa'i gnas tshul ji snyed 'khod pa'i rkyen gyis phan tshun gyi 'brel bar bar chad byung ba red/ sku ngo khyed rang 'brug tu gcig phebs thub na yag po 'dug da res rgyal yum mjal 'phrad gnang ba yag po byung / slad phyin 'brel ba thengs gcig ma yin pa yang yang gnang rgyu byung na phan tshun gyi rdugs gzhi 'khon 'dzin rnams rang bzhin sel thub kyi red/ de sngon khyed tsho'i sku tshab 'brug tu phebs yod kyang / phan tshun ngo shes grogs 'dres med stabs 'brel ba gsang po de tsam ma byung ba red ces gsung 'dugakho bos de rang yin shag byas kyang / de rjes tu la'i bla ma mchog gis sa 'du rin chen lags 'brug tu ched du mngags nas 'brug gzhung dpon rigs khag dang /lhag par drag shos khyed rnam pa chung dus nas grogs po legs po yin stabs khong 80

'brug tu 'brel gtug legs po yang re byas kyang / 'brel ba de tsam ma byung ba red ces brjod par lhun rdor gyis de khyad mtshar po byung ba red ces gsung pa las 'grel bshad gzhan gang yang gnang ma byung /de nas bzhugs sgar rda ram sa lar phyir log rjes drag shos lam dpon lhun rdor lags su gnas 'brel snga phyi thengs gnyis tsam btang yang lan gsal gang yang ma 'byor ba red/bod 'brug btson pa rnams la nag med nyes 'grel btsan dbang gi 'dri brtsad cha tshang byas zin rung / rgyu rkyen zhig la brten nas khrims mthun gyi zhib 'jug byas pa'i rnam pa ston thabs ma byas mthu med byung ste khrims khang gong mar tshang 'dzoms sar zhib 'jug byas tshul brjod yod kyang / don dngos khrims zhib byed mkhan de rnams khrims khang gong ma'i khrims dpon dang bsher dpang rnams min pa red/ de ni skabs de'i 'khrab ston pa gtso bo blo gros tshogs sde'i bka' blon rgya phag rdo rje dang /tshogs mi ser skya 'ga' shas/ rgyal po'i sku bcar zhabs zhu'i gras 'go pa dbang chen/ sa khul khag nas gang bshad de sgrub byed mkhan dang bod mir sdang 'dzin can zhe cig las grub pa'i khrims zhib tshogs chung dmigs bsal zhig red/ khrims zhib de ni drang 'brel min pa dang / 'brug rgyal khab kyi gzhung 'brel khrims zhib pa'i ngo bo mtshon mi thub cing / tshogs mi tshor yang lkog brngan sprad yod pa dper na/ 'brug sdod pa sa khul gyi dmangs 'thus spyi mi ka rdor zer bar bod gzhung don gcod lha sding pa'i las shag cha tshang dang / rgya gar gzhung nas gnang ba'i mo ṭa bcas rin med gtsang bdag tu sprad pa bcas skabs de'i byed gtso gong smros de chos blo chung phan btags kyi nyes med bod 'brug mi mang la bzod du med pa'i dka' sdug de lta bu sprad pa dang / 'brug gzhung la shin tu tshabs che'i mtshan shas bzos te phyi lo 1974 lo do dam byas pa'i bod mi'i khongs nas mi drug lo gsum mtshams glod 8

bkrol btang ba dang / de 'phros nas bod gzhung don gcod lha sding bsod nams dpal 'byor/ gzhis 'go dga' byang zhal zur ngag dbang mthar phyin/ don gcod drung yig nges don shes rab/ lho kha ba phun tshogs/ phag ri bkris don grub bcas khrims gcod kho na'i 'og dus min du che srog shor/lo bcu gnyis song mtshams phyi lo 1985 lo dang de rjes mi gcig bcas glod bkrol btang yod kyang / tshang ma dbang po yan lag skyon can gyi gcong can du gyur ba sha stag red/ 'dzin bzung lus bsher skabs 'phrog len byas pa'i chu tshod dang / gser gyi mdzub dkris/ dngul sogs kyang phyir slog sprad med pa bcas 'os min gyi bya ba 'di rigs byed gtso gong gsal rnams kyi byed las yin pa'i dngos byung gnas lugs brjod pa las/ 'brug rgyal mnga' bdag rin po che mchog dang /'brug gzhung gi mdzad byus min gshis ma 'ongs par bod dang 'brug gnyis chos dang rig gzhung / mi rigs bcas gang ci'i cha nas gcig gyur thun mong ma yin pa'i mdza' 'brel bzang po de sngar bzhin yong thabs la nga tsho'i phyogs nas 'bad brtson gang yong mu mthud byed rgyu yin//82

le tshan so lnga pa/glo smon thang gi drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi don rkyen/༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 1974 lo 'brug yul du gnas pa'i bod mi btsan byol rnams la dka' ngal 'phrad pa de bzhin bal yul byang phyogs glo smon thang du gnas pa'i rang re'i drag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs der yang gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi dka' ngal 'phrad yod/ drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs de 1959 lo 7gong sa mchog bod nas rgya gar la btsan byol du phebs rjes sku'i gcen rgya lo don grub mchog dang /dza sag a 'brug mgon po bkris gnyis kyis bar lam bod du rgya dmar la btsan rgol byed myong mkhan bstan srung dang blangs dmag rgya gar khul du btsan byol du 'byor ba'i nang nas na gzhon khag 'dems sgrug gis bal yul byang rgyud bod bal sa mtshams glo smon thang zhes pa'i sa gnas su mi grangs na000 lhag tsam rim bzhin gsang ba'i thog btang ste drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang /sa gnas de'i shar nub gnyis su brjed chags kyi gangs ri mu 'brel dang /g.yang gzar can gyi brag ris bskor zhing de'i lho ngos su bal yul gyi snyan grags can gyi gangs ri a na pur na dang / shlau la 'gi ri'i ri bo 'gying nger langs yod pa de ni ma bcos lhun gyi grub pa'i mkhar rdzong lta bur mngon/glo smon thang gi shar nub byang gsum la bod mnga' ris spu hreng rdzong khongs kyi sa 83

cha dang mu 'brel yin/ de nas bod kyi byang phyogs rtsa thang du phar rgol byed bde la sa cha srung bde ba'i btsan 'gag gi khyad chos rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin gshis sa gnas der 'jab dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs/glo smon thang ni de sngon bod kyi mnga' khongs kyi rgyal phran zhig yin zhing / shing phag 1755 lo glo bo smon thang sa spyod pa dang/ khong gi khu bo dge lung pa o rgyan bdud 'joms dang ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis 'khrags rtsod byung ste phyogs gnyis kus bod gzhung la rgyab gnyer bka' dpyad gnang rogs zhes mi sna ched brdzong gis 7snyan zhu rim phul ltar bod gzhung nas sa gnas su skya tshab ched brdzong thog phan tshun rtsod gleng de dag legs 'dum gnang ba ma zad/ khungs so sor slad phyin rgyal srid dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bde bar skyong dgos pa'i bka' rgya dang gnang sbyin bcas bstsal ba dang / de bzhin shing stag 1794 lor bod gzhung gis glo bo smon thang rgyal blon rnams la khyal 'bab (rtsis dpon zhu sgab pa'i bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs/ glegs bam dang po'i shog grangs 580 la gsal /chad lugs skor bka' rgya zhig stsal 'dug par globo rgyal blon rnams kyis bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i bkrin rjes dran gyis dgongs chekhog zhus pa dang sbrags khyal chad rnams gtsang 'bul bcas zhus 'dug (rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa'i bod kyisrid don rgyal rabs/ glegs bam dang po'i shog grangs 550 la gsal )me 'brug 1795 lor bod rla bcu gnyis pa'i nang glo bo smon thang pa'i mi sna nas snga lo gser khral chad pa de bzhin bod gzhung mchod rgyun gyi thog tu snga mo bzhin phul 9skyu la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa'i mdzad rnam du gsal / chog pa bcas kyi lo rgyus byung 'dug par brten/ da lta'ang de khul gnas sdod rgyal 'bangs rnams bod rigs 'khrul med glo tsho drug ces su grags/84

de sngon dza sag a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis stod gangs rin po cher gnas mjal du bskyod skabs lam zhor glo smon thang sa khul du phebs yod stabs khong gi yul de'i gnas babs gsal po rtogs nas 'jab dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs de gsar 'dzugs bya rgyur shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/ sa gnas der drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs 'dzugs rgyu gtan 'khel nas de'i 'go khrid 'ba' pa skal bzang ye shes (yongs grags 'ba' pa rgan ye shes ) zhes pa de bsko bzhag gis glo smon thang du bka' brdzong gnang / kho pa de sngon 'ba' chos sde dgon gyi grwa pa yin zhing / de sngon dgon pa'i spyi bso'i las 'gan 'khur myong ba ma zad/ dgon pa'i 'du 'god kyi tshong las kyang byed myong yod/1958 lo bod nang bstan srung dang blangs dmag khongs zhugs te btsan rgol /gyi las 'gul la lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs 'degs sgrub yod stabs dza sag a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis khong la yid ches blos 'grel kyi glo khul drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi las 'gan bskur/ 'go dmag tshang mas mthun sgril dam zab thog rang cag gi rtsa don bstan pa chab srid kyi don du dka' ngal khyad du bsad nas byas rjes mang po bzhag yod kyang / sgrig 'dzugs de 'thus sgo tshang ba de tsam med pa dang /'go 'dzin gyis dngul dngos sger bdag byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'go 'dzin dang sde tshan khag gi brgya dpon dbar rtsod gleng ji snyed byung ste gong rim gyis 'go 'dzin 'ba' pa ye shes dang / brgya dpon khag gcig rgya gar du bka' 'gugs gnang ste khong tsho phan tshun dbar mthun thabs kyi bka' mol gnang ba dang sbrags ma 'ongs bar sgrigs 'dzugs de'i byed sgo gang ci bka' sdur zhib lhod kyi sgo nas thag gcod gnang thog 'ba' pa ye shes kyi las rogs su li thang rgya rdo dbang 'dus bsko bzhag gnang /85

rgya rdo dbang 'dus ni 1959 sngon bod nas rgya gar du 'byor nas a ri khul 'jab dmag gi slob sbyong zin rjes bod shar phyogs li thang sa khul du gnam thog nas dbyugs te dbang 'dus kyis dus yun lo gcig lhag tsam ring yul mi'i 'go khrid nas rgya mer rgol 'dzings byas mthar dgra bos gnam sa gnyis thog nas mtha' bskor stabs mang sne nyung gis ma bsten par mnga' zhabs mi gsum khrid de bros thar nas rim bzhin rgya gar du 'byor thub pa byung / khong ni gzugs stobs dang dpa' rtsal che ba/ dmag byus mkhas la blo thag chod po/ gshis rgyud drang zhing spung grung 'dzoms pa bcas kyi mi zhig red/ khong glo khul du 'byor rjes sgrig 'dzugs gnas stangs kyi khyad chos babs bstun gyis gang cir legs bcos thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprug byas nas sngar bas tshags tshud yar rgyas chen po byung yang / 'go 'dzin 'ba' pa ye shes kyi blo la ma babs pas zhe sdang phrag dog dbang gis las don bsgrubs rigs rnams la dngos shugs rgyud gsum nas dka' rnyog mang po bzos par brten las don bsgrub bu'i rang bzhin ngam ngam shugs kyis 'thus shor byung /gong rim nas glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go 'dzin dang / las rogs sde tshan khag dbar mthun 'brel legs po yong thabs dang / drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi las don yar rgyas gtong ched rgya gar nas phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / sku zhabs lha mo tsho ring / cha phreng skal bzang chos 'dzin bcas mi gsum glo khul 'go dmag rnams la lta bskor 'tshams 'drir bskyod rgyur bka' mngags gnang ba ltar/ phyi lo 1958rla 10 ches 27 nyin ldi li nas thon te lam bar bal yul sa gnas brgyud rim bzhin gom bgrod kyis zu 11 ches 5 nyin glo'i sgrigs 'dzugs kyi spyi khyab dmag sgar skal bzang sbug ces pa'i sa gnas su 'byor te der yod 'go dmag 86

rnams la 'tshams 'dri zhib lhod zhus/ brgya shog sde tshan khag rnams la 'tshams 'dri lta bskor du bskyod/ skabs der phran tsho'i mdun 7gong sa mchog gi de khul 'go dmag rnams la bka' slob gsung 'khor gdan 'dren zhus yod pa ltar sa gnas so so'i 'go dmag rnams la gsung 'khor sgrog sbyang gis tshang mas gsung par thos skabs dngos mjal dang gnyis su med par gsung thos pa'i skal bzang dga' sgom chen po'i ngang nas sems shugs chen po bskyed/de nas rla 13 ches 9 nyin slar yang skal bzang sbyag tu phyir log gis 'go 'dzin 'ba' pa ye shes dang las rogs rgya rdo dbang 'dus gnyis kyis gtsos brgya shog khag gi brgya dpon dang / las byed mi 70 lhag tsam bcas mnyam du tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas glo sgrig 'dzugs de sngar las lhag pa'i tshags tshud yar rgyas gtong phyogs skor gros sdur zhib mol nyin shas byas ring tshang mas bsam tshul lhug po bshad pa ma zad/ nga tshos glo drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs des bod rang btsan slar gso'i snying don rtsa bzung bya rgyu dang / ma 'ongs sgrig 'dzugs de'i las rigs khag nas drag po'i ngo bo ldan pa'i nus shugs cher skyed dgos rgyu'i re skul zhus pa ltar khong chos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis khas len dam bca' brtan po bzhaga'atshams 'dre lta skor mjug 'grel zin mtshams snye shang brgya shog brag thang zhes pa'i sar 'tshams 'drer bskyod/ lam bar gangs ri mthon po zhig brgal bskyod skabs sku zhabs lha mo che ring sku khams bde min gyis sku ngal chen po 'phrad kyang snye shang sa khul du 'byor nas rim bzhin dwangs skyed byung / snye shang 'go dmag rnams la 'tshams 'dre lta bskor zin rjes de nas slar yang glo khul brgyud rgya gar du 1959 zla 1 ches 11 nyin phyir log skabs der sku zhabs lha mo che ring glo khul 87

gyi phyag las las mjug bskyel ched du de khul bzhugs/ glo khul du lta bskor 'tshams 'dri zhus pa'i gnas tshul dngos yod rnams kho bos yig ngag gnyis thog nas gong rim la snyan seng zhib phra zhus/de'i rjes tsam la/ rang gzhung bde srung bka' blon dbang 'dus rdo rje mchog nas glo drag po'i 'go 'dzin 'ba' pa ye shes 'di lo gsum bcu'i dus dran dang 'brel lo 'khor las bsdoms tshogs 'dur rda sar nges phebs dgos lugs kyi phyag bris shig gnang ba ma zad/ kho bo sger thog nas 'ba' pa ye shes bzhugs sgar rda ram sa lar khyug tsam phebs na legs tshul gyi yi ge zhig 'phral gtong dgos lugs bka' phebs ltar kho bos btang ba'i yi ge'i nang bde srung nas bka' yig gnang ba/ phyag 'byor byung shag ltar 'di lo khyed rang tshogs 'dur phebs thub na slad kyi phyag las mdzad phyogs skor la dge mtshan che lugs bris te/ 1959 zla 2ches 13 nyin ldi li nas bang mi zhig glo khul du ched brdzong byas/ gnas tshul de 'ba' pa ye shes sar 'byor 'phral rla 3 ches 11 nyin glo khul nas thon te lam bar nyin rma tshan ltos med kyi rda sa bzhugs sgar du bcar 'byor skabs rang gzhung gis khong la bde srung gi bka' blon las rogs kyi go gnas bstsal te rda sar gtan sdod byas dgos gsungs par/ skabs der khong rang blo yid tshim pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas khas len zhus yod kyang / glo khul du las mjug skyel 'phros lhag yod stabs rla shas ring de khul phyir log chog pa'i snyan seng zhus par 7gong sa mchog nas khong la zla gnyis ring las mjug skyel bar 'gro chog pa'i bka' 'khrol stsal ba ltar rda sa nas ldi li brgyud glo khul du thon skyod bya rtsis kyi khong ldi lir 'byor skabs gong rim nas/ da cha glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go khrid legs bcos dang / sgrig 88

'dzugs nang khul gang ci'i bkod sgrig thad 'gyur ba gtong rgyu'i 'char gzhi lag len bstar rgyur brten sku zhabs lha mo che ring dang / 'go 'dzin las rogs rgya rdo dbang 'dus gnyis kyis gtsos tshogs chung zhig btsugs yod pa de rnams kyis 'gan khur byed bzhin yod pa ma zad/ da bar lo mang gi rtsis rgyag gtsang ma ma tshar bar glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'gan 'dzin 'ba' pa ye shes glo khul du gtong rgyu mi 'dug ces nang khul thag gcod gtan 'khel byas kyang / phyi rgyar khong re zhig ldi lir bzhugs ste glo sgrig 'dzugs thog mar btsugs pa nas da bar gyi lo rgyus shig dgos gal 'dug pa da lam khyed rang rda sar tshogs 'dur phebs zhor gyi skabs 'dir yig thog rtsom bri byed thub na phan thogs gang legs yong rgyur brten gnas skabs ring glo khul gyi las don rnams las rogs rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis 'gan 'khur byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ khyed rang 'di khul bzhugs ring sku zhabs lha mo che ring nas 'go 'dzin las rogs rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyi phyag rogs su bzhugs rgyu yin stabs khyed rang brel 'tshab gnang dgos med lugs zhes bka' mngags gnang / 'on kyang 'ba' pa ye shes ni spung grung 'dzoms shing g.yo sgyu ldan pa'i mi zhig yin stabs skabs der rda sa dang / ldi li gnyis kyi bka'i phebs sgo phyogs 'gal gyi rnam pa de mthong skabs rang bzhin gyi rdugs pa chen po skyes kyang khong gis g.yo thabs mkhas po'i sgo nas rab byung na rla gnyis ring las mjug skyel bar 'gro chog pa dang / de nas phyir 'khor mtshams gong rim gyi bka' mngags ltar sgrig 'dzugs kyi lo rgyus bzo 'thus chog pa dang / gal srid lo rgyus bzo rgyu de dza drag yod na ldi lir sa chu 'phrod min stabs lo rgyus phyogs sgrig byed par rdor gling du bskyed 'thus chog pa zhes nan zhu byas kyang bka' ma 'khrol bar ldi lir bzhugs dgos byung 'dug89

skabs der 7gong sa mchog nas khong la rla ba gnyis ring glo khul du las mjug skyel bar 'gro 'thus chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang ba de lag len bstar yod na rjes su glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi don rkyen de lta bu byung e yong snyam/ khong ngo g.yog gsum ldi lir phran gyi sdod shag la rla 3 tsam sdod ring sne len tshang ma kho bo sger thog nas zhu dgos byung / las don gang dang gang yin rung dza drag gi dus tshod de gang tsam song rjes gnas babs rang bzhin gyis lhod g.yeng du 'gro ba de ni ldog med kyi chos nyid yin pa ltar/ 'ba' pa ye shes ldi lir rgyun ring sdod ring 'gro bzo sdod mkhas byas te de'i g.yas g.yon du lta skyong byed mkhan tshos kyang rim bzhin lhod g.yeng du gyur pa'i skabs dang bsnun nas dang thog ldi li khul gnas sdod khong gi pha yul gcig pa'i sar yang yang bskyod de snga dro phyin nas dgong dro log yong ba dang / de nas rim bzhin zhag gcig tsam sdod pa/ de nas dus yun gang 'tshams song rjes zhag gnyis gsum bsdad nas phyir log yong ba bcas byed cing / de nas nyin shas log ma yong bar ldi li nas bal yul sa mtshams brgyud glo smon thang du bskyod pa'i gnas tshul khri lir 'byor te mi tshang ma ha las hon thor du gyur zhing / 1959 zla 10 ches 30 nyin 'ba' pa ye shes ldi li nas gsang bros kyis glo khul nye 'gram krug ci zhes pa'i sa gnas su 'byor te sngar bzhin glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi dbang cha rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi bkod de khong rang gi pha yul gcig pa dang / dga' nye khag la gsang ba'i sgo nas bang mi mdun yig ngag gnyis thog nas 'brel gtugs byas pa ma zad/de rnams la sku zhabs lha mo che ring thabs mkhas kyi btsan bzung bya rgyu dang / glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi sde tshan khag nang gi mi dmangs gang mang lag sbrel thog go mtshon rang 'grigs khyer nas sa gnas snye shang ngam/ dol po phyogs gang rung du dmag sgar zhig 90

logs su gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu dang / la sa don lag len ma bstar gong las rogs rgya rdo dbang 'dus la 'ba' li rgyal gsum ste/ 'ba' pa/ li thang / rgyal thang 'brel yod kyi lar zhen thog nas thabs shes mkhas po'i 'brel ba byas te rang phyogs su 'gugs thabs byed gal dang / sde tshan khag nang du yod pa'i 'ba' li rgyal gsum gyi 'go dmag rnams la 'ba' pa ye shes kyi mgo skor bslu brid kyis mun 'thoms dkrugs shing gis rkyen pas zing 'khrug langs thabs kyi lkog gshom byed kyi yod kyang / de dag lhing 'jags bag phebs gnas thabs su rda sa bzhugs sgar nas mi sna sku tshab snga rjes ched brdzong gis glo khul 'go dmag rnams la bstan srid kyi don chen snying dbus su bcangs te sgrig 'dzugs nang khul lcags gyi gong bu'i mthun sgril dam zab dgos gal sogs slob ston zhib nan gnang bar brten glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi nang gi rnyog gleng de zhi 'jam du gyur gshis/ 'ba' pa ye shes glo khul du gnas thabs bral nas rgya gar du phyir log bya rgyu yin zhes bshad de bar lam lo shas ring de khul gsog 'jog byas pa'i dngul dngos rnams 'khyer 'thus chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang ba ltar glo khul nas spog ra brgyud rgya gar phyogs su ma yong bar bal yul rgyal sa kusta man ḍūr gsang skyod kyis bal gzhung la mgo btags zhus te glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi gang ci'i gnas tshul zhib brjod byas pa ma zad/ sgrig 'dzugs de rtsa gtor gtong rgyu'i lkog g.yo ngan byus bton te sa gnas rgyus babs kyi glo khul sa gnas khag la bal gzhung gi zhi drag las byed khongs su rogs mi btang ba dang / sgrig 'dzugs nang khul du 'phung dkrugs slong ched yi ge dang / mi sna gsang brdzongs kyis thabs shes gang thub byas yod pa red/ gnad don de 'dra'i 'og glo sgrig 'dzugs de la bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul gcig rjes gnyis mthud byung /9

glo sgrig 'dzugs de thog mar btsugs pa nas bzung / 1970 zla 3 bar go mtshon dang / zas gos sogs kyi mthun rkyen rgyab skyor gnang mkhan a ri gzhung gis gsang ba'i las khungs nas roḍa ram byed bzhin pa'i mthun rkyen de mtshams 'jog phyir 'then byas pa dang / de nas bzung lo gsum ring sgrig 'dzugs de gzhis chags su bsgyur rgyu yin zhes bshad nas gnas babs (5 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba red/1974 zla 5 pa'i nang bal gzhung nang srid blon chen nas gsal bsgrags shig spel ba'i nang / 1974 zla 7 ches 18 nyin bal rgyal byang phyogs sa khul du gnas chags khams pa rnams la khrims 'gal gyi go mtshon dngos po yod rigs zhi 'jam thog bal yul gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhus na bal yul gzhung nas de rnams la gzhis chags kyi sa cha dang / mthun rkyen sogs rogs ram gnang rgyu dang /gal srid de ltar ma byung che bal gzhung gis drag pos bsdu len bya rgyu thag gcod byas yod ces 'khod pa ma zad/ skabs der bal gzhung gi glo khul du drag po'i dpung dmag rim bzhin btang ste rang re'i glo drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi mtha' skor rtsis byas shing / gong gsal gnas tshul thabs sdug de lta bur gyur pa'i 'og sgrig 'dzugs 'go dmag yongs rdzogs blo pham chen po byung ste zhi 'jam du go mtshon rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu re thag chod de drag lan drag slog bya rgyu'i sems thag gtsang ma bcad de ang bsar byas nas bsdad/gnas tshul de lta bu chags pa'i skabs der glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi mi dmangs rnams gang myur gzhis chags kyi las 'gul tshugs thabs su sku zhabs lha mo che ring bal yul sa gnas gang 'os la gzigs zhib dang sbrags sa gnas de khul du 'dzugs skrun byas zin pa'i las rigs khag la zhib 'jug tu/ 1974 zla 392

ches 3 nyin ldi li nas bal yul du phebs nas bal yul rgyal sar nyin shas bzhugs/ de khul las mjug sgril ma thag spog ra khul du phebs te de khul gyi las rigs khag la zhib 'jug gnang bzhin bzhugs/ sku zhabs lha mo che ring bal yul rgyal sar bzhugs ring bal yul gzhung gis gsang myul mi sna zhig gis bod mi ngo shes shig la lha mo che ring ga par bzhugs yod dam zhes 'dre brtsad byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ bskor srung bas lha mo che ring brtsad gcod byas pa'i gnas tshul de rang gzhung gi bal yul don gcod don grub rnam rgyal gyis thos ma thag sku zhabs lha mo che ring la bal gzhung nas sku zhabs khyed rang brtsad gcod byed kyi yod 'dug pa de ni legs po zhig min pas dornga zon gnang gal chen po 'dug ces lan brda gnang yang /de dag la de tsam gyis thugs snang med pa lta bus lam seng rgya gar du phyir phebs ma gnang bar spog ra sa gnas su sngar bzhin las don sgrub nas lhod bzhugs skabs spog ra sa gnas kyi skor srung bas lha mo che ring 'dzin bzung do dam byas/bkra ma shis pa'i gnas tshul de spog ra khul du sdod pa'i glo sgrig 'dzugs khongs kyi 'gan 'khur ba dar dgon rgan ngag phrug rda sa bzhugs sgar du bcar te gong gsal gnas tshul gyi yong rkyen dang / bal gzhung gis rgyal sa kusta man ḍū dang /spog ra khul/ wa lung bcas sa gnas khag la sdod pa'i dmag rnams glo khul du bskyod bzhin yod par brten rang re'i glo sgrig 'dzugs 'go dmag rnams kyis bal gzhung gis srid byus ngan pa 'dzin pa der blo pham chen po'i ngang nas drag lan drag slog bya rgyur sems thag bcad yod lugs sogs kyi gnas tshul 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag la snyan seng zhus pa dang / de bzhin bal yul don gcod nas kyang nye lam bal gzhung nang srid drung che she'i sba dur gyis 'bod bskong byas pa ltar bcar 93

bar da bar bal gzhung gis sngon chad bal gzhung dang bod gnyis khyim mches su gnas pa'i 'brel ba bzang po'i 'du shes bzung nas bal yul byang rgyud glo smon thang du gnas pa'i khams ga rnams khrims dang ma mthun pa'i go mtshon khyer te lo mang sdod du bcug kyang / da cha de rnams da mus bzhin zhog thabs med pas go mtshon rnams bal gzhung la 'phral du rtsis 'bul dgos lugs skor nan tan gsungs pa dang / de bzhin khong gis de snga rgya rdo dbang 'dus dang yang bka' mol byung yod kyang da bar grub 'bras gang yang ma byung bar brten bal gzhung gis drag po'i thog nas lag len bstar rgyu thugs gtan 'khel yod/ nye lam sgrig 'dzugs de'i 'go 'dzin lha mo che ring nga tsho'i spog ra sa gnas rdzong gi bskor srung bas 'dzin bzung do dam byas yod pas go lag rnams 'phral du rtsis sprod dgos pa'i skor khyed chos rda sa'i gong rim la 'phral du snyan seng zhus te khams pa mi dmangs rnams la bka' slob thog go mtshon rtsis sprod legs po byung na sngon du khas len byas pa bzhin de rnams la gzhis chags kyi mthun rkyen rogs ram gnang gi yin zhes nan tan brjod kyi 'dug stabs bzhugs sgar nas 'di ga bal gzhung la bka' mol gnang mkhan sku tshab 'phral du ched brdzongs gnang gal 'dug ces snyan zhu phul 'byor byung don bka' shag lhan rgyas bka' bsdur thog 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhib zhu gnang mthar phran bde srung bka' blon 'phral du ldi li brgyud bal yul rgyal sa kusta man ḍūr bskyod nas bal gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs khag la mjal 'phrad kyis sku zhabs lha mo che ring 'phral du glod bkrol yong ba dang / de bzhin glo khul du gnas pa'i mi dmangs rnams la bal gzhung gi drag po'i thog nas lag len bstar ma dgos par de rnams kyi go mtshon bal gzhung la rtsis sprod rim pas zhu dgos pa'i slob ston byed 94

par bskyod dgos bka' mngags gnang ste/ 1974 zla 5 ches 18 nyin rda sa nas ldi lir thon/ skabs der sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog phyi rgyal du phebs yod stabs nyin shas ldi ler phebs sgug zhus nas zla cu ches 1 nyin ldi li nas bal yul du 'byor te ches 3 nyin nas ches 13 bar bal yul gzhung gis nang srid drung che she'i 'ba' dur dang / bal rgyal zhang po su shil sham sher ra dza/ kusta man ḍū grong khyer spyi khyab ma ghar sba dur/ rgyal po'i sku sger drung che bcas la rim bzhin phran dang bal yul don gcod don grub rnam rgyal gnyis kyis mjal 'phrad zhus nas/ nye char bal gzhung gi glo khul du gnas pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba'i lag tu yod pa'i go mtshon rnams bal yul gzhung la rtsis sprod 'bul dgos lugs kyi bka' btang ba dang / gal srid go mtshon ma phul na bal gzhung gi de rnams la drag gnon thog rtsis len bya rgyu yin zhes dza drag gi gnas tshul thos zhing / bal bod gnyis kyi 'brel ba bzang po lo ngo stong phrag lhag tsam byung yod par brten/ 1959lo bod la thabs sdug gi gnas tshul byung rjes bod mi mang po bal yul khul la btsan byol du yong ba'i skabs der bal yul rgyal po sku gshegs ma han dras thugs rje byams skyong gis rogs ram skyabs 'jug gnang ba des bod gzhis byes mi dmangs rnams kyis bal gzhung gi bkrin bsam shes byed kyi yod/ glo khul du yod pa'i bod mi tshos bal gzhung gi bka' la rtsi bkur ma zhus pa byung che thabs sdug gi gnas tshul yong rgyur 7gong sa mchog nas thugs g.yengs chen po gnang nas da lam phran 'di phyogs ched mngags gtong gnang byung bas gnad don de zhi ba'i thog nas thag gcod yong thabs su nga tsho phan tshun go bsdur zhu gi yin/ thag gcod 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig byung na nga chos glo khul du gnas pa'i bod mi rnams la slob gso 95

btang nas bal gzhung gi bka' la brtsi 'jog nges par zhu rgyu/ 'on kyang de dag lag len legs grub ched du dus yun gang 'tsham zhig go skabs gnang dgos kyi 'dug ces re 'dun zhus par bal yul gyi dpon rigs rnams mgrin gcig gi thog nas da bar bal gzhung nas lo ngo 14 ring tu la'i bla ma mchog gis dbus pa'i bod mi rnams rang yul du phyir log phebs thub pa'i re 'dun zhus pa yin/ da cha 'dzam gling gi gnas babs 'pho 'gyur chen po 'gro gi yod stabs glo khul du gnas pa'i khams pa tshos go mtshon khyer nas sdod thabs bral bas bal gzhung la rtsis sprod / nges par zhu dgos kyi red/ de nas bal gzhung gis de rnams gzhis chags kyi sa cha gang 'os mthun rkyen rogs ram byed kyi yin lugs sngon nas khas len byas yod/'on kyang glo smon thang dang / wa lung khul la gzhis chags su sdod mi chog de skor de sngon rgya rdo dbang 'dus nged gnyis thug 'phrad skabs 'phros mol byung yod cing / rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis khas len yang byas yod/ nye char nga'i ming thog nas rgya rdo dbang 'dus spog ra sa khul du nga tsho dang bka' mol gnang bar yong dgos zhes yi ge btang yang / khong slebs ma byung / da cha bal gzhung gi srid byus gtan 'khel zin par brten bka' bkod dang len zhu rgyu las ma 'das/ gal te ka kor ngang nas dus thog go mtshon rtsis 'bul ma zhus che bal gzhung gis ma 'dod bzhin du drag gnon gyi lag len thabs sdug bstar gyi red/ nga tshogasmon thang gi sa khul gyi 'gro lam tshang ma bkag yod/ zla drug nang tshud la khams pa de rnams rtsa med gtong thub kyi red/ smon thang sa gnas de bal gzhung gi mnga' sde yin par brten rgya rdo dbang 'dus sa gnas der 'dzin bzung byed ma thub pa rtsa ba nas med/ 'on kyang de ltar ma dgos pa'i thog nas zhi 'gregs bya rgyur brten de rtsis khyed tshos dgongs pa 96

bzhes rogs/ khams pa tshos go lag rtsis sprod tan tan zhus na dus yun nyin bco lnga las 'gor gyi ma red/ bar lam bal yul nang du kong re si tshogs pa nas bal rgyal gzhung dmangs dang mi mthun par mtshon cha sogs bed spyod btang ste bzod mi bde ba'i ngo rgol gyi las don ji snyed cig rtsom mus red/ khams pa 'ga' shas kyis de tsho dang go mtshon nyo tshong bya rgyu'i las ka rtsom gyi yod pa'i rdugs pa yod ces dang /de 'brel rgyal sa kusta man ḍū'i nang du khams pa re zung gis me mda' thung mda' nyo tshong byed kyi yod par brten nga tsho sems 'tshab chen po skyes kyi 'dug da cha glo khul gyi khams pa'i go mtshon rnams nges par du rtsis 'bul zhu dgos/ gnad yod mi sna so so'i srung skyob ched go lag re zung sprad chog kho tsho bod phyogs dang / rgya gar phyogs gang rung du 'gro 'dod yod che nga tshos dgag cha med/ nga cho'i go thos la khams pa'i 'go byed 'ga' shas ma gtogs mi dmangs byings rnams nga tsho'i gzhung la mgo btags zhu 'dod yod lugs gsal po shes kyi yod ces bshad byung bar/phran gyis nga tsho bal gzhung gi dgongs gzhi dang mthun pa'i don gnad gsum gong du rob tsam zhus don ltar de dag bskyar du zhib bshad zhu rgyur/dang po/ sku zhabs lha mo che ring glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi khongs mi ma yin pas khong 'phral du glod bkrol yong ba zhu rgyu/gnyis pa/ glo khul du yod pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba rnams 'di khul lo ngo 14 lhag tsam bsdad yod par brten yul de'i mi dmangs dang skad yig goms gshig gcig gyur yin 'dug par de rnams kyi khongs nas yul mi dang gnyen bsgrig gis bu phrug 'brel rigs dang / 'ga' shas kyis sa cha nyos te khyim gzhis chags yod stabs slad de khul yul mi dang gcig mtshungs kyi bsdad 'thus chog pa/97

gsum pa/ glo khul du yod pa'i bod mi rnams kyi lag tu yod pa'i go mtshon rnams bal gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhu dgos rgyur nga chos slob ston nges par zhus 'thus/ 'on kyang dus yun gang 'tsham zhig ring de rnams la 'grel bshad bya rgyu sogs gyi 'gor gzhi yong rgyur dus tshod ring tsam zhig gnang rogs/ gang yin zhus na/ de rnams kyi goms gshis la go mtshon de rang gi srog las gces pa byed kyi yod stabs go bskon gsed dkrol legs po zhig ma byung na lam seng rtsis sprod zhu dka' ba bcas brjod par/bal phyogs nas lha mo che ring gis de sngon las don ji byas nga tshos gsal po shes kyi yod/ khong gis nga tsho'i sa thog tu khrims 'gal gyis nga tsho'i rgyal khab dang /khyim mches rgyal khab khag dbar gyi mdza' 'brel la gnod pa'i las don byas yod par ra 'phrod gsal po byung yod kyang / da bar gsang ba'i thog bzhag pa las phye bsgrags byas med/ nye lam khong rgya gar nas nga tsho'i rgyal sa kusta man ḍū dang / de rjes spog ra sa khul du phebs te yang skyar khrims 'gal gyi las don byed kyi yod par brten nga tshos khong do dam bya dgos byung ba'i thog glo khul yod pa'i khams pa rnams kyi 'go 'dzin rgya rdo dbang 'dus spog ra 'am/ kusta man ḍū/ rdzong gsar pa gang rung du yong nas nga tsho dang mnyam du khams pa rnams kyi go mtshon rtsis sprod skor bka' mol zhus na lha mo che ring lam seng glod bkrol yong gi red ces lan gsal sprad kyang / khong rang slebs med/ rtsa ba'i khyod tsho bod mi tshos nga tsho'i rgyal po'i bka' gsung brtsi bkur dang len zhu gi yin lugs zer gyi yod kyang / don dngos thog rgyal po'i bka' la nyan gyi med pas da cha 'phral myur lag len du ma bkal na rang bzhin skad cha bshad pa tsam la yid ches thub pa dka'/ rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i gzhung 98

gis glo khul dang wa lung gnyis kyi sa gnas su bod mi bzhag 'dod med/ de min ji gzhis chags bya yul gyi sa cha khyed tshos 'dod mos yod sar 'dems sgrug byed chog rgya rdo dbang 'dud nas sa gnas gang rung du nga tsho dang bku' mol gnang na nga tshos khong 'dzin bzung nam yang mi byed pa'i 'gan len gtsang ma zhu gi yin/ gang ltar nga tsho'i gzhung gis don gnad der zhi ba'i thog thag gcod kyi re ba byed kyi yod ces zer/phran gyis bar lam bal gzhung gis rang re glo khul du gnas pa'i 'go dmag rnams kyi go mtshon rtsis len bya phyogs sogs nga tshos gong zhus ltar bal yul rgyal po'i bka' la brtsi bkur dang len zhu rgyur 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog nas phran 'di khul du ched brdzongs mdzad de sku zhabs khyed rang dang bka' bsdur zhus nas rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu las ka kor g.yo byus gang yang zhu rtsis med pa de dag la yid ches gnang dgos kyi 'dug ces zhus par/khong gis da res phran tsho bka' mol ji byung skor nga tsho'i tshogs chung la snyan seng zhus nas nyin shas rjes nga tshos slar yang thug 'phrad kyis bgro glengabya rgyu yin zer/ dus skabs der bal gzhung gis bod mi dang / bal gzhung kong re si tshogs pa gnyis lag sbrel byed kyi med dam snyam pa'i rduḍa pa chen po zhig skyes yod par mngon/skabs der bal yul yongs su bal yul kong re si tshogs pas bal rgyal gyi srid dbang mgo rteng bslogs rtsis kyi las 'gul slong ba'i skabs dang 'khel bar brten bal gzhung gis rang re'i glo khul gyi go mtshon rtsis len gyi lag len bstar rgyu'i gsal bsgrags byas thog bal gzhung nang srid blon chen gyis gtsos pa'i tshogs chung zhig gsar 'dzugs byas te tshogs mi'i gras su nang srid drung che dang / nasta 99

man ḍū grong khyer spyi khyab/ bal gzhung nyen rtog dmag spyi dang / rgyal srung dmag spyi/spog ra dang wa lung mnga' sde sa khul gnyis kyi spyi khyab/ glo khul rdzong gsar pa'i rdzong dpon bcas yod zer/ tshogs chung de'i rgyun las drung che ni nang srid drung che yin pas/ khong gi gtso 'gan khur gyi yod 'dug khong gis smon thang dang / wa lung sa khul gnyis la bod mi gzhis chags su 'jog 'dod med ces yang nas yang du gsal bshad gnang ba de ni/ gong du spros pa ltar rtsa ba'i sa khul de gnyis dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug tu bod kyi mnga' khongs kyi chab 'bangs yin pa ma zad/ yul mi rnams bod rigs gcig gyur yin par brten rjes su rnyog gleng mi yong ngam snyam pa'i rdugs gzhi byung ba yin nam snyam/wa lung sa khul gyi gnas yul ni 'bras ljongs kyi nub tu yod cing / de'i byang phyogs bod kyi mnga' khul gting skyes rdzong dang / lho ngos 'bras ljongs gnyis kyi sa khul dang 'brel yod/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i sngon du de dag bod kyi mnga' khul yin bzhin du/ shing lug phyi lo 1775 lor gor dmag gis wa lung brgyud 'bras ljongs su btsan 'dzul byas pa nas bzung bal po'i mnga' 'og tu shor 'dugaphyi lo 1959 lo gong gsal bod kyi mnga' khul yul gru khag nas bod mi btsan byol ba ji snyed wa lung khul du bros yong ste de khul gzhis chags su gnas/rgya mis bod kyi sa mtshams khag tu gnas pa'i bod mi rnams la dus yun gang tsam zhig ring gu yangs srid byus lag bstar byas yod par brten wa lung du bros yong ba'i bod mi rnams rgya mi'i mgo bskor bslu brid kyi srid byus 'og de snga'i rang dbang gi dus bzhin 'gro skyod chog par ngos 'dzin byas te rang yul du phar log tshur 'ong gis bod zog mang po khyer yong ba dang / rdor gling khul du gnas pa'i bod 00

mi btsan byol ba 'ga' shas wa lung du tshong las byed par bskyod de skabs shig ring de gar bsdad pa dang / de mtshungs rang re'i 'brel yod nas sa khul de brgyud bod kyi gnas tshul rtog zhib mi sna re zung bkod brdzong byas yod pa de dag la bal gzhung nas glo khul khams pa dang gcig mtshungs kyi drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs chags yod par rdugs 'grogs byas yod pa red/bal yul nang srid drung che thug 'phrad byung ba de'i sang nyin phyi rla 5 ches 4 nyin gong gsal tshogs chung gi tshogs mi'i gras yin pa kusta man ḍū grong khyer gyi spyi khyab ma gha sba dur zhes pa thug 'phrad du bskyod/ khong ni bal yul rgyal po'i thugs blos byings 'grel gnang yul gyi mi zhig yin tshod dang / rnam kun bod mir sha tsha rogs ram gnang mkhan zhig yin/phran gyis khong la nga tshos bar lam glo khul gyi rnyog gling skor nang srid drung che dang bka' mol ji byung skor brjod skabs khong gis bod mi'i skor ngas mang po shes kyi yod/ rtsa ba'i bod mi dang ne pa li mi rigs mi rgyud gcig pa red/ nga tsho ne pa li'i mi re zung gis khams pa tshor 'dre nang bzhin gyi 'du shes shig 'dzin gyi 'dug de ni nor 'khrul zhig red/ mi de chos khams pa tshos ma byas pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed cig shod kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i rgyal po zhing gshegs dang / da lta'i rgyal po des bal bod gnyis lo ngo stong phrag lhag tsam ring mdza' brtse zab mo byung yod pa'i lo rgyus la dgongs te da bar rgya mis nga tsho'i gzhung la glo sa khul du yod pa'i log spyod pa khams pa tsho rtsa med dam/ mthar skyod ma btang na log spyod pa de tshos bal rgya gnyis kyi sa khul du khrims 'gal gyi las 'gul byas dang byed bzhin pa des yul phan tshun gyi sa mtshams su gnas pa'i mi dmangs rnams kyi bde 'jags la 10

dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'dug gal srid bal rgyal nas log spyod khams pa tsho mtha' sgrod gtong ma thub na nga tshos rogs ram zhus chog ces nga tsho'i gzhung la yang yang bsun gtser zhu gi yod kyang / nga tsho'i rgyal po zhing gshegs dang / da lta'i rgyal pos da bar sa khul de rnams la gnas pa'i bod mi rnams tshul mthun sha stag yin zhes rgya phyogs nas bshad pa de snang med du btang ste khams pa tsho da bar gnas thub pa byung ba red/ dngos 'brel nga tsho'i lung par drag chas khyer ba'i khams pa tsho bzhag 'dod rtsa ba nas med na yang / de rnams la sdug po gtong 'dod med pa'i thog bza' bca'i rigs kyang bkag 'doms ma byas par da bar sa khul der btang dang gtong bzhin pa yin/ da cha khams pa tshos go mtshon rnams nga tsho'i gzhung la rtsis 'bul ma zhus na bza' bca' bkag 'doms byed kyi red/ gal srid da dung ma nyan na drag po'i lag len bstar gyi red/ de min rgya mir mig btsums shig brgyab na khyug tsam zhig la khams pa rnams rtsa med gtong thub kyi red/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i sa thog tu de lta bu rtsa ba nas byed 'jug gi ma red/ gal te rgya mi nga tsho'i mnga' khul der slebs na rnyog gleng chen po zhig chags kyi red/ lhag par du da phan lo rgyus thog nga tsho bal bod gnyis kyi mdza' brtse'i 'du shes ha cang rtsa chen zhig byung yod pa der nga tshos dran shes bya dgos pa zhig yin/ de ltar ma byas na nam zhig nga tsho'i yul 'di'i gnas stangs ji 'gyur nges pa med pa zhig yin/ bar lam phye rgyal gyi mi re zung glo khul lta bskor du bskyod skabs sa gnas de'i yas mas phan tshun la go mtshon khyer ba'i khams pa 'jab dmag phar tshur bskyod pa mthong byung zhes nga tshor lab gleng byung dus nga tsho ngo tsha po byung / nga tsho'i gzhung gis rnam kun de khul sdod mkhan bod mi rnams tshul mthun gang legs yod ces yang yang shod pa da lta gong gsal skad cha 02
