des nga tsho'i rdzun rkub brtol ba lta bu yong gi 'dug gnas tshul des rkyen pas rla gcig gi sngon du nga tsho'i rgyal po mchog nas glo khul du gnas pa'i khams pa tshang ma'i go lag yongs rdzogs bsdu len byas thog de rnams la sa cha gang 'os shig tu gzhis chags legs par bya dgos pa'i bka' btang yod par brten nga tsho'i gzhung gis de rnams la sdug po rtsa ba nas gtong shes kyim red ces zer/gong gsal bal gzhung nang srid drung che dang / kusta man ḍū'i spyi khyab ma gha sba dur gnyis kyi brjod tshig la gzhigs na/ bar lam bal gzhung gis rang re glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi thog la phyi'i 'gal rkyen khag bzhi tsam 'phrad pa'i dbang gis dza drag gi thog lag len bstar rgyu'i srid byus gtan 'bebs byas pa zhig red/'gal rkyen gcig ni dus skabs der bal yul srid blon zur pa ko ra las 'go khrid byas pa'i kong re si tshogs pa des bal yul sa khul khag la 'khrugs rkyen chen po bslangs pa'i 'og bal rgyal gzhung de mgo rteng bzlogs rgyu'i 'jigs nyen tshabs chen du 'gyur rdugs kyis bal yul gzhung gis bsam par rgya gar gzhung gi rgyab skyor byed kyimed dam snyam pa dang / glokhul du yod pa'i bod mide rnams bed spyod kyis bal yul tong re si dang lag 'brel byas mi yong ngam snyam pa'i rdugs gzhi byung ba/'gal rkyen gnyis pa/ bar lam 'brug yul du bod mir mi dkar la zhwa nag g.yogs pa'i don rkyen de'i shugs rkyen ngan pa bal yul du thebs pa/'gal rkyen gsum pa/ phyi rgyal lta bskor ba mi sna re zung gis glo khul la lta bskor la bskyod nas rang re'i sgrig 'dzugs rnams la par dang glog brnyan brgyab pa dang / rtsom yig 'dzam gling thog 'grems spel gyis gleng phyogs mang dag byung ba des rgyal spyi'i thog bal yul gzhung ngo tsha kha skyongs kyi gnas tshul byung ba/ 03

'gal rkyen bzhi pa ni/ rgya mos thog mtha' bar gsum du bal yul gzhung la gnon shugs brgyab thog yul der gnas pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba dang bal yul gzhung dmangs dbar dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing gis the byus byas nas shugs rkyen chen po byung ba bcas kyi 'bras bu zhig yin par snyam/bal gzhung nang srid drung che dang / ma gha sba dur gnyis thug 'phrad byas rjes de sngon phran gyi ngo shes bal rgyal gyi zhang po sku zhabs su shil sham sher ra dza dang / skya sger drung che na ra yan par satha sher si tha gnyis mjal 'phrad zhus nas glo khul du gnas pa'i bod mi rnams la dza drag gi gnas tshul 'phrad pa'i skor zhib phra zhus te/bal rgyal gyi bka' la brtsi bkur dang len gyis dus yun ring tsam thog go mtshon 'bul 'thus chog pa'i bal rgyal la stan sgron zhu thabs dang / phran yang bal rgyal khyug tsam mjal 'phrad yong ba gnang rogs zhes zhus pa sku zhabs so shi sam shisade skor rgyal por snyan seng zhus 'thus dang / bod mi rnams kyi dka' rnyog sel thabs skor bar lam nang srid drung cher bka' mol byung yang da lta de skor gnas tshul ji byung shes ma byung / 'brel yod khag la 'dre brtsad kyis sang nyin dgong dro lan gsal phul chog gsungs/de bzhin sku sger drung che mjal 'phrad skabs khong gis bod mis go mtshon rnams mgyogs nas myur du bal gzhung la nges par rtsis 'bul dgos rgyu las rang bzhin dus 'gyangs gyur na bod mi tshor dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red/ de skor nang srid drung ches 'gan 'khur gtso bo len gyi yod pas khong dang bka' mol gnang na legs tshul brjod pa las/ de min gyi bka' mol de tsam ma gsung par bsun snang gi rnam 'gyur bstan gyi 'dug 04

bal gzhung nang srid drung che thengs gnyis pa ngo mjal skabs khong gis/ kha sa tu la'i bla ma'i sku'i gcen po sku zhabs rgya lo don grub kyis ldi lir bca' bzhugs nga tsho'i gzhung tshab dang mjal 'phrad thog khong gis glo khul khams pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de'i snga phyi bar gsum gyi lo rgyus rnams 'grel bshad gnang ba dang / da cha bal rgyal gyi dgongs gzhi ltar de khul yod pa'i go mtshon rnams 'phral du rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu dang / de skor rgyal por snyan seng zhu rogs zhes bka' mol byung 'dug pa/ khyed rang tshor gnas tshul 'byor yod shag ces brjod nas dga' snang chen po'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug par phran nas sku zhabs rgya lo don grub kyis de skor da lta bka' lan gang yang phebs ma song yang / phal cher de ring sang nyin phebs 'byor yong re yod/ngas khyed la sngon zhus ltar nga tshos glo khul mi dmangs kyi go mtshon rnams rtsis 'bul zhu rgyur lhag bsam rnam dag gis de skor khong tshor slob ston gang thub zhu rgyu rang yin/ 'on kyang / dus yun ring tsam dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ de skor ring min phran dang don grub rnam rgyal gnyis spog ra sa khul du sku zhabs lha mo che ring khyug tsam mjal du bskyod nas khong dang mnyam du go sdur gyis de nas glo khul du mi sna ched brdzong bya rgyu'i bsam blo yod/ khyed kyis spog ra mnga' sde'i spyi khyab la phran tsho sku zhabs lha mo che ring mjal 'phrad chog 'thus kyi bka' mngags gnang rogs zhes zhus te rla 5 ches 10 nyin phran gnyis spog rar bskyod rgyu byas/ kusta man ḍū nas spog rar ma thon gong glo khul rgya rdo dbang 'dus lags su/ da lam rang gzhung nas phran 'di khul ched brdzong gnang ba ltar/ bal gzhung gi 'brel gnad dpon rigs khag thug 'phrad kyis phan tshun bka' mol ji byung gi tshig tho khag dang / 7gong sa mchog nas glo khul mi dmangs rnams la der yod go mtshon rnams bal gzhung 06

la rtsis 'bul zhus na legs gnas kyi bka' slob gsung 'khor gcig bstsal yod pa nye lam de khul nas 'dir 'khor zhag tu yong ba'i rgya dpon bstan pa'i mdun ched bskur zhus/zu 7 ches 10 nyin phran dang don grub rnam rgyal gnyis thog rar skya zhabs lha mo che ring thug 'phrad du bskyod de nga tsho thug 'phrad chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam gyi lhod po byung nas bal gzhung la go mtshon rtsis sprod bya phyogs skor phan tshun bsam tshul brje len gyi gros mol byas par tshang ma'i bsam tshul gcig mthun byung thog nga tsho thun mong thog rgya rdo dbang 'dus can la go mtshon gang myur 'bul rgyu'i skor gyi bsam tshul 'khod pa'i gnas bris shig btang /lha mo che ring dang thog spog ra sa gnas kyi skor srung dmag gis do dam byas pa'i stabs mi legs pa'i gnas tshul de sgrig 'dzugs nang 'byor skabs 'go dmag tshang ma yid gdung chen po byung ste de rnams kyis sku zhabs lha mo che ring do dam 'og nas gsang 'phrog bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi bkod kyang sku zhabs lha mo che ring gis thal skyon bsam tshul de rigs legs cha mi che ba'i skor gsungs te thugs mos ma gnang bar brten 'char gzhi de lag len du bkal ma thub par de mur lus/de nyin phran gyis skya zhabs lha mo che ring la ku re dang sbrags/ sku zhabs khyed rang gi bzhugs yul gyi khor yug la bltas na 'di nas dpa' rtsal zhig bton te bde blag ngang bros thub kyi red ces zhus par/ khong gis 'dzum dmul dmul gyi ngang nas gal srid nga rang bros thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi khongs mi rnams dang / dngos po sogs la dka' ngal chen po 'phrad rgyu nyag cig red/ de las nga gcig pu re zhig dka' ngal phran bu myong rgyu las gzhan rnams la dka' sdug 06

chen po de tsam yong gi ma red ces gsungs byung /skabs der khong do dam bya yul de spog ra mnga' sde'i skor srung dmag sgar gyi las khungs kyi khang mig gcig nang bzhag 'dug thog ma'i nyin shas ring de'i g.yas g.yon du srung bya dam po byas 'dug kyang sku zhabs lha mo che ring gis sems chung tshul ldan gnang bar brten rim bzhin srung bya gu yangs su gyur 'dug nga tsho der 'byor nyin nyen srung pa gnyis tsam yod pa de tshos rgyang thag gom pa nyi shu tsam gyi sar nyab be nyob be byas nas sdod cing/ khang pa'i g.yas g.yon du lcags skud gze ma ra mgo'i lcags ri mtho tshad phe ṭi gcig lhag tsam las mi 'dug pas gal srid de nas mtshan mo bros na bros bde po yong rgyu red bsam byung /de'i sang nyin nga tsho kusta man skyur phyir 'khor rjes bal gzhung nang srid drung che dang mjal 'phrad thog nye lam spog ra sa gnas mnga' sde'i spyi khyab kyi rogs ram gnang nas skya zhabs lha mo che ring thug 'phrad lhod lhod byung ba dang / sku zhabs lha mo che ring gis glo'i go mtshon rnams bal gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu'i dgongs tshul nga tsho gcig mthun yin pa ma zad/ de dag gang myur 'bul dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul yig thog nas glo khul du rgya rdo dbang 'dus can la bang mi ched brdzong gdong gnas bris btang lugs dang / de mtshungs go mtshon 'phral du 'bul ched phran dang don grub rnam rgyal/ blo bzang tshul khrims bcas glo khul du khyug tsam bskyod 'thus thog skya zhabs lha mo che ring yang nga tsho mnyam du gtong rogs zhes bsam tshul zhus pa dang / nye lam khyed kyi gsung don bzhin sku zhabs rgya lo don grub mchog khyed tsho'i ldir lir bca' bzhugs gzhung tshab sar ched mngags phebs te de sngon rgyal po zhing gshegs 'tsho bzhugs skabs gzhung 'brel thog nas glo khul du nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs 07

de btsugs pa nas bzung da ba ra gyi gnas stangs ji byung skor zhib mol gnang ba'i thog de rnams kyi go mtshon 'phral du rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang yod pa ltar phran tshos glo khul la khyug tsam bskyod nas mi de rnams la slob gso gang thub zhu bsam pa yod/ ma 'ongs par dus kyi 'gyur ba byung mtshams bal gzhung nas de sngon bod bal gnyis kyi dus yun ring po'i mdza' brtse'i 'du shes la dgongs nas nga tshor rogs ram gnang rgyu'i yid ches zhu gi yod/ sngon du re 'dun zhus don bzhin nga tsho glo khul mi dmangs kyi go mtshon rnams rtsis 'bul zhus rjes de khul gzhis chags su gnas thabs yong ba zhu rgyu/ gang yin zhe na/ de rnams sa khul der zhing 'brog dang / lag shes bzo grwa sogs gang tsam zhig 'dzugs skrun byas yod stabs sa gnas gzhan du spo zhugs ma dgos pa dgongs bzhes yong ba zhes zhus par/ de sngon nga tsho'i gzhung gis khyed tsho'i mi de rnams kyi sdod gnas spo bshug bya rgyu'i dgongs bzhes med kyang bar lam gyi gnas tshul gang ci'i 'gyur ba chen po byung yod par brten gang myur thog thag gcod bya rgyur gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ da cha khyed tsho'i phyogs nas nga tsho'i rgyal po'i bka' la brtse bkur dang blangs zhu rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang rgyu yin zhes gsungs par dga' po byung / de sngon bod dang bal yul gnyis spyan mched lta bu'i brtse gdung yod pa de da mus bzhin gnas kyi red/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir srid don thog nga tshos khyed tshor rogs ram byed mi thub/'on kyang dus kyi 'gyur ba byung mtshams nga tshos nges par du zhu gi yin/ khyed tsho glo khul du khyug tsam phebs rgyu de ha cang yag po 'dug nga tsho'i phyogs nas khyed rnams dang lhan du las byed gcig gtong gi yin/ skya zhabs lha mo che ring phebs rgyu'i skor gong rim la bka' 'khrol zhus te lan gsal phul chog nga tsho'i phyogs nas khams pa rnams kyi go mtshon rtsis 'bul zhu phyogs skor khyed rang gi mtshan thog nas nga tshor 108

don tshan bzhi 'khod pa'i khas len yi ge zhig 'bul dgos kyi 'dug don tshan de dag zin bris bkod yod pa khyed tshos gzigs zhib gnang ste dgongs 'char ji yod dgongs bzhes gnang nas khyed dang don grub rnam rgyal gyi ming rtags bkod de gnang rogs zhes sprad byung ba'i zin bris de'i nang don gsham gsal/༈bal gzhung nang srid drung che mchog la/bal rgyal gzhung gi gzhung zhabs tsho dang lhan du bka' mol byung don la phran tsho 'dod blo khengs pa byung / phran zung dang / skya zhabs lha mo che ring bcas glo khul rdzong gsar par bskyod de nga tsho'i mi tshos bal gzhung gi bka' la brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa'i 'bod skul byed par 'gro chog na nga tshos gsham gsal khas len zhu rgyu/1 bod mi tshos bed spyod btang yod pa'i rlung 'phrin tshang ma 1974 lo'i zla 8 pa'i rla dkyil nang rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu/3 1974 lo'i zla 8 zla dkyil nang go mtshon tshang ma rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu/3 1974 lo'i zu 8 zla dkyil nang bod mi tshang mas lag khyer zhu rgyu'i khas len zhu rgyu/sge gnam gshis mthun pa'i gzhis chags bya yul sa cha bal gzhung gi bka' dgongs bzhin sdod rgyu bcas/ bod gzhung bde srung bka' blon phun tshogs bkris dang / bal yul du bca' bzhugs tu la'i bla ma'i sku tshab don grub rnam rgyal bcas kyis zla ches la/ zhes 'khod pa'i zin bris nang gi don gnad la zhib rtogs kyis phran gyi ming thog nas bal gzhung nang srid drung cher don tshan 10 'khod pa'i tshig tho zhig phul ba gsham gsal/de sngon bal gzhung gis glo khul du yod pa'i bod mi btsan byol rnams la ma 09

'ongs pa'i gnas stangs skor don tshan bzhi gnang ba de dag ngas khong tsho'i tshab zhus te khas len gtsang ma zhu gi yin/ de dag lag len bstar ched gsham gsal don tshan khag 'god 'bul zhu rgyu/1 lha mo che ring khong tshor 'grel bshad rgyag rgyu'i ched nga tsho dang mnyam du gtong gnang thub na mi de rnams la 'brel ba phran bu yod thog khong la dga' po yod pa dang / go lag rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu yang myur ba yong rgyu de 'brel khong tsho gzhis chaṇa bya yul sa cha'i thad sngon du bka' phebs bzhin khong nas lta skor zhu khyad yong nges/2 go lag rtsis 'bul zhus rjes lha mo che ring dang / dbang 'dus kyis gtsos pa'i 'go byed rnams la bal gzhung nas ka kor klan ka mi yong ba khas len gtsang ma gnang rogs zhu rgyu/3 go lag rtsis 'bul zhus rjes khong tsho sa gnas de rang du gzhis chags gang thub byas 'thus chog pa/ sngon zhus ltar khong tsho de khul lo ngo 14 lhag tsam bsdad zin yod stabs yul mi dang bza' 'brel byung ba dang/ de bzhin zhing 'brog dang /lag shes bzo gra sogs kyi 'dzugs skrun byas yod par brten sa gnas gzhan du gnas spo bya rgyu dka' ngal chen po yong gnas/4 gong gsal sa gnas su sa cha ma ldeng ba rnams de ga'i nye mtshams sam/sa gnas gang 'os shig bal gzhung la nga tsho'i sku tshab mnyam du lta skor zhus thog su cha gtan 'khel zhig gnang dgos kyi 'dugakhri gzhis chags gtan 'bebs ma zin bar khong tshor 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bal gzhung nas rogs ram gnang dgos kyi red/0

5 sngon du bka' phebs ltar de khongs nas re zung bal gzhung gi mi khongs su gzhug 'dod yod rigs de don zhu gi yin/7 nga tshos nan tan thog nas zhu rgyur/ bal rgyal mchog la ngo rgol byed mkhan su yin rung de dang lag 'brel nam yang mi byed pa'i khas len gtsang ma zhu gi yin/8 ༄na du sku zhabs nang drung mchog gis zhal bzhes snga rjes gnang don ltar khekhong tshos go lag rtsis 'bul zhus zin mtshams rang srung ched go lag dgos gal nges par ༄cho 'thus gsungs pa bzhin dgongs bzhes nges par gnang skyong yod pa/9 bal gzhung dang / nga tsho'i dbar 'brel ba lo ngo stong phrag ring dam zab tu yod pa de la 'ba' pa ye shes kyis mtshon dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing bya mi'i dbang du mi 'gro ba gnang dgos zhes nga chos re 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ gal srid de 'dra'i dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing la gsan 'jog mdzad che bal gzhung gi mtshan shas yong rgyu dang /nga tsho bod mi phyi nang du gnas pa tshang ma blo pham yong gzhi chags kyi red/10 slad go lag rtsis 'bul zhus rjes khong tsho gnas yul du 'ba' pa ye shes kyi khongs mi'i rigs gtan nas yong mi chog pa bkag 'doms nges par gnang rogs gnang / gal srid 'ba' pa ye shes nas ngan pa lang shor dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing byed ched kho pas mi btang 'byor byung che las rnyog ji yong blos 'gan bzod min la brten nga tshos 'gan len zhu thub kyi ma red 1974 zla 5 ches naXl zhes 'khod phul/phran nas bal gzhung nang drung dang bka' mol snga rjes zhus pa'i snying don tshig tho phul ba ltar rla 5 ches na0 nyin bal gzhung nang srid drung ches khyed tsho'i dgongs tshul ltar glo khul khyug tsam phebs rgyu'i skor nga tsho'i tshogs chung nas da la ma

sku zhabs stag lha thugs khur che bzhes kyis glo khul gyi rnyog dra sel thabs gnang bar brten sku zhabs lha mo tsho ring lhan du sa mtshams su gnam thog ga dus phebs thub pa yin yang nga tshos gra sgrig zhus nas lan gsal 'bul rgyu dang / khyed tsho phebs thon chog chog gi gra sgrig gnang rogs zhes dang / de bzhin khong gis rla 5 ches 15nyen rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis nga tsho'i rdzong gsar pa'i sku tshab dang thug 'phrad kyis brjod gsal du/ go mtshon rnams thengs rer lnga brgya re sprod rgyu dang / phyi lo 1975 lo nang sprad tshar ba bya rgyu/ khong tshor bal gzhung gi gtan sdod lag khyer len rgyu'i ngos len bya rgyu/ mi de rnams bal yul khul phar tshur 'gro skyod la dka' snyog mi 'phrad pa'i bal gzhung nas lag khyer sprod rgyu bcas re 'dun zhus 'dug par go mtshon dus 'gyangs gyur na mi 'grigs pas khong la de lugs lan sprad yod pa khyed rnams de khul phebs skabs rgya rdo dbang 'dus la slob gso rgyag rogs zhes lan byung /phran tsho kha nyin spog ra nas kuṇḍa man ḍūr phyir 'khor skabs ldi li nas sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog gis zhal par phebs gsal/ kha sa khong gis ldi lir bca' bzhugs bal gzhung skya tshab ngo ma mjal 'phrad zhus nas glo sgrig 'dzugs thog mar ji ltar btsugs pa dang / dmigs yul gang yin bcas snga phyi bar gsum gyi lo rgyus zhib cing phra ba gsal bshad dang / da lta bal rgyal gyi bka' dgongs ltar glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi go mtshon yongs rdzogs nges par rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu yin lugs dang /bal gzhung gis nga tsho bod mi rnams la ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam gzhis chags legs po 'dzugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar/ phyag len don 'khel gyi dgongs bzhes nges par gnang dgos rgyu'i rgyal po rang la snyan seng zhu rogs gnang zhes zhus yod pa dang / go mtshon rnams 'phral du rtsis 'bul bya thabs su bal yul khul du ga 2

yod pa'i stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / lha mo che ring gnyis glo khul du 'go dmag rnams la go mtshon 'phral du rtsis sprod byed phyogs thad go rtogs sel dkrol gyi slob ston byed par bskyod thub na yag po yong rgyur bal gzhung gis lha mo che ring glo khul du 'gro 'thus chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang rogs zhu rgyu bcas kyi bsam tshul zhus par/ bal gzhung gzhung tshab kyis bal rgyal la snyan seng dam don zhu rgyu'i thog khong gi rgyab skyor gyi bsam tshul yang zhu gi yin zhes gsungs byung ba dang / zhib pa'i gnas tshul de nas a mdo 'jigs med lags de khul phyir rdzong mdun gnas bris zur bskur thog gang ci'i skor zhib mngags byas yod pa kho pa do nub bam/ sang nyin snga thog tsam der 'byor yong lugs zhes bka' byung ba ltar/ de nyin nam phyed tsam la a mdo 'jigs med ldi li nas 'dir 'byor te gang ci'i bka' mngags gnang ba'i skor dang gong bzhin bka' yig bcas gnang son byung zhing /skabs der glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go 'dzin khang nas kusta man ḍū dang spog ra sa khul sogs sgrig 'dzugs khongs kyi lag shes bzo grwa dang mgron khang sogs kyi khongs su zhugs pa'i 'go dmag ji yod rnams glo khul du 'phral du yong dgos lugs dza drag gi bka' snga rjes 'byor song ba de dag la bal gzhung gis rdugs 'grogs yong gzhi phan las gnod tshabs che bar brten gnas skabs glo khul du 'gro mi dgos pa'i bkag 'doms byas pa'i thog de'i rgyu mtshan skor glo sgrig 'dzugs 'go 'dzin rgya rdo dbang 'dus can la gnas bris shig dang / de mtshungs ldi li nas skya'i gcen po rgya don mchog gis bal yul gzhung tshab mjal 'phrad gnang sgo dang / phran dang sku zhabs lha mo che ring / bal yul don gcod don grub rnam rgyal bcas de khul yong rgyu'i bka' mol lam tsam byung yang / da lta bal gzhung gis dus tshod gtan ma 'khel bar sgug bsdad yod pa phran tsho ma 'byor bar de khul 'go dmag rnams kyis 3

zhi snyings thugs snang zab nan gnang gal che lugs bcas bkod de bang mi ched brdzongs byas/rla 5 ches 20 nyin phran gyi ming thog nas slar yang bal gzhung nang srid drung cher don tshan bcu 'khod pa'i gnas bris zhig phul ba gsham gsal/bal gzhung nang srid drung che mchog la/ glo khul bod mi tsho'i skor bal gzhung gi las byed tsho dang bka' mol 'dod pa khengs pa byung ba ltar/ bal gzhung gis thugs 'dod ltar gtan 'bebs zhu rgyu/don tshan dang po/ sngon zhus ltar phran dang bal yul du bca' sdod sku tshab don grub rnam rgyal dang / lha mo che ring bcas glo khul du bod mi rnams la bal gzhung gi bka' la brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa'i skul slong byed par 'gro 'thus chog pa/gnyis pa/ glo khul bod mi tshor rlung 'phrin yod che dus tshod gang 'tshams zhig nang tshud rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu/gsum pa/ go lag tshang ma gang myur rtsis sprod zhu rgyu/bzhi pa/ bod mi tshang ma bal yul du gtan sdod chog pa'i lag khyer zhu rgyu/lnga pa/ skya nyid nas zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar/ bod mi 'ga' shas la rang srung ched lag khyer dang ldan pa'i go lag nyar chog rgyu/drug pa/ mos mthun byung ba ltar/ da yod lag shes bzo gra dang / 'brog las/so nam sogs da bar byed ma thub pa'i bod mi rnams la gnam gshis mthun pa'i sa cha 'os pa'i thog gzhis chags kyi rogs ram gnang rogs/bdun pa/ skya nyid kyis zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar/ bod mi rnams 'tsho ba rang 'tsho ma chags bar bal gzhung gis de rnams la 'tsho ba'i rogs ram gnang rgyu/4

brgyad pa/ bod mi tsho'i bde don las sla po yong slad mi nyung shas shig bal rgyal gyi mi khongs su zhugs chog pa/dgu pa/ glo khul 'go khrid rgyal rdo dbang 'dus dang / lha mo che ring sogs la 'das pa'i las don rnams la bsnyad de khrims gcod med pa dang / de sngon khong tshos las ka byas pa'i dmigs yul ni rang yul la gang myur phyir log gi thabs las de min dmigs yul gang yang med pa'i skor sngon zhus ltar yin pa de don phran gyis 'gan len gtsang ma zhu rgyu/bcu pa/ ma 'ongs par bal yul nang yod pa'i bod mi byings rnams kyi bde don dang / bod bal mi rigs gnyis kyi mdza' brtse da mus bzhin rgyun 'khyongs su gnas par bal gzhung gis 'ba' pa ye shes can gyi dkrugs shing la yid ches mi yong ba gnang rogs zhu rgyu bcas gong gsal don tshan khag la zhal bzhes gnang ba'i yig thog bka' lan yod pa zhu rgyu bcas 1974 zla khu ches 20 la zhes gong gsal gnas bris phul ba'i sang nyin yang skyar phran gyi ming thog nas bal gzhung nang srid dru cher zhu yig cig 'bul dgos byung ba gsham gsal/༈bal gzhung nang srid drung che mchog la/glo khul bod mi'i gnas stangs skor 1974 lo'i zla 5 ches 20nyin 'khod gnas phul ba der zhib gzigs mdzad na de'i nang don gnad gsal po bkod yod kyang / da lam skyar bshad zhu rgyur/ bal gzhung gis don tshan khag bzhi gsal 'god gnang ba rnams phran gyis mos mthun zhu gi yod pa ma zad/ de rnams lag len 'gel thabs su mnyam las zhu rgyu yin/ 'on kyang da yod lag shes bzo las dang / sems can gso tshags/ so nam/ rta drel gyi dbor 'dren sogs de'i 5

nang 'khod ma thub pas bod mi rnams gzhis chags bya yul sa cha gnam gshes mthun po zhig la bal gzhung gis bka' 'khrol bzang po gnang na bkrin chen po bsam rgyu bcas/ tā la'i bla ma'i bde srung bka' blon phun tshogs bkris kyis/1974 zu 5 ches 31 nyin phul zhes gsal ba 'bul lam zhus/glo khul du ma thon gong tsam la rda sa bzhugs sgar bka' shag nas da bar gyi las don skor dang/ slad kyi lag len bstar phyogs skor bka' bsdur zhu bar rda sar khyug tsam yong dgos bka' tar phebs pa ltar ldi li brgyud rda sar bcar te 7gong sa chen po mchog dang bka' shag la/ bar lam gyi gnas tshul skor zhib phra snyan seng zhus thog bka' bsdur gnang ba'i snying don tshig tho gsham gsal/bal yul gyi dka' rnyog skor bka' bsdur gnang ba'i tshig tho bde srung bka' blon la 'bul gnang mdzad pa/1 nye char bde bka' nas bal gzhung la don tshan 11 dang / don tshan 10 'khod pa'i shog lte snga rjes phul gsal ltar/ bde srung bka' blon glo khul du nges phebs dgos min dang / bka' mol gnang phyogs skor bzhugs sgar du ngo phebs kyis skur du bka' sdur gnang rgyu/3 glo'i 'go dmag nas da cha gnas tshul gang la gzhigs kyang bal gzhung gi bka' don ltar go lag dang rlung 'phrin sogs rtsis 'bul zhu rgyus mtshon khas len byas na rgyu mtshan mang po'i thog nas khe phan che shos mthong ba ltar 'go mang blo mthun gyis khas len byas na yag shos red/3 gal te go lag rtsis sprod bya rgyur sa gnas su blo mthun ma byung ba yin na bal gzhung dmag la kha gtad de me mda' rgyag pa las dmigs yul don thog tu 6

'khel ba'i go lag bed spyod byed pa'i ched du bod nang 'dzul te 'dzings bros gang thub kyis mtha' ma bod kyi skyabs bcol pa gsar pa'i rnam pa thon pa'i rgya gar sa thog nye mtshams gang 'os su 'dzul zhugs thub pa bya rgyu/4 bod nang 'dzul rgyu gtan 'khel byung che nga tsho'i go lag rnams kyis bal gzhung la tshur rgol rtsa ba nas nus thabs med par brten nga tsho'i dmigs yul don thog tu 'khel ba'i ched du bod kyi nang la ma 'dzul mthu med byung song zhes bal gzhung la yig thog nas gnas tshul zhig phul na 'phral phugs gang ci'i phan thogs shig yong gnas bcas kyi bka' sdur byung ba'i bsnyel tho/ bka' shag nas 74lo'i bee 7 ches 25 la zhes gsal/phran kusta man ḍū nas glo bur rda sa bzhugs sgar du thon pa'i skor bal yul khul bod mi'i khrod du bde srung bka' blon stag lha phun tshogs bkris rgya gar du bros phyin pa red ces 'chal gtam zhig khyab 'dug de ni rgya dmar nag gnyis kyi so nyul dang / 'ba' pa ye shes kyi phyogs gtogs khag bcas kyis ched du bzos pa'i dkrog gtam zhig khyab pa red/rda sa nas kusta man ḍūr slar yang phyir 'khor ma thag bal gzhung nang srid drung che mjal 'phrad kyis zla 9 ches 5 nyin phran dang don grub rnam rgyal gnyis kusta man ḍū nas spog ra brgyud sku zhabs lha mo che ring mnyam du glo sman thang gi nye 'gram rdzong gsar pa bar bal gzhung gi thad 'phur gnam gru'i thog thon/ phran tsho mnyam du bal gzhung gi las byed cig kyang btang yod/ gnam gru'i kha lo ba de dbyin ji'i mi rigs zhig 'dug kasta man ḍū nas rdzong gsar pa bar chu tshod gcig tsam las 'gor ma song / cha rgyus med pa zhig gis bltas na sngo sangs nam mkha' mtha' 7

yas par gnam gru rang 'dod ltar phur chog pa lta bur snang yang / don dngos thog grog rong gi chu'i rgyugs lam ded nas 'phur dgos pa las rang 'dod du 'phur dka' ba zhig red 'dug gang yin zhe na/ bal yul byang rgyud kyi sa khul de hi ma la ya'i gangs ri dang brag ri mu khyad du 'brel ba'i rtse mo gnam la zug pa lta bu rim par chags yod pa de dag gi mtho tshad phal cher mi ṭar gcig stong gsum brgya lnga bcu nas gcig stong drug brgya bdun bcu brgal ba yod gshis spyir btang gi gnam gru ri rtse mthon po de tsho'i steng du 'phur dka' bas grog rong brgyud nas mi 'phur ka med red 'dug de bzhin gnam gru'i kha lo ba de nyams myong ldan zhing lag rtsal mkhas pa zhig ma byung na nyen kha chen po 'phrad rgyu dang / lhag par dus rgyun phyi dro de khul rlung 'tshub langs pa'i skabs gnam gru 'phur bskyod dka' ba'i gnas tshul yong gi yod 'dugade nyin gnam gshis gang legs byung yang grog rong gi dkyil du 'phur skabs de'i g.yas g.yon du mtho gzar gyi brag ri mu khyud du 'brel ba rnams 'jigs su rung ba'i lcags ri ltar mig lam du 'char skabs mi tshang ma'i sems nang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i dngangs skrag chen po skyes/ gal srid kha lo ba de skad cig tsam ring snang chung lhod g.yeng du gyur nas gnam gru de brag ri de tshor reg tsam byas na nga tsho'i gces pa'i srog de grog rong de'i nang 'dor rgyur the tshom mi 'dug snyam pa'i snying tsha long long lta bu'i tshor ba zhig byung ba'i ngang rdzong gsar par 'byor/skabs der rdzong gsar pa'i gnam gru 'bab thang du skya zhabs rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis nga tsho bsu len du mi rta bcas btang 'byor gyis sgug sdod ang bsar 'dug kyang / der yod bal gzhung gi dpon rigs kyis phran dang don grub rnam rgyal ma 8

gtogs sku zhabs lha mo che ring rang re'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi sdod sgar du phebs rgyur bkag 'doms byas te bal dmag sdod sar khong gi bzhugs khang gra sgrig byas 'dug pa der 'jog dgos byung / re zhig gzhan dbang du gyur gshis nga tsho ma 'dod bzhin nyin gcig gnyis ring kha bral bya dgos byung /glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi bka' bkod khang skal bzang sgug ces pa'i chags yul de rdzong gsar pa'i lho ngos gangs ri'i nye 'gram du yod/ rdzong gsar pa nas lam bar chu tshod gsum lhag tsam ri gzar gyi gyen du 'jegs nas 'gro dgos kyi yod/ nga tsho skal bzang sbug tu 'byor skabs 'go 'dzin rgya rdo dbang 'dus dang / der yod 'go 'dzin tshang mas phebs bsu zhu gi 'dug kyang / de sngon phran de khul du 'tshams 'drer bskyod pa'i skabs tshang mas dga' snang gi rnam 'gyur ston pa de da cha gdung ba'i khur chen gyis non pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig tu gyur 'dugade'i sang nyin rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis gtsos pa'i gnad yod 'go byed tsho dang /thug 'phrad kyis bar lam bal gzhung gis rang cag glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi go mtshon gang yod rnams rtsis len bya phyogs skor gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur te rang gzhung nas phran bal yul du ched brdzongs gnang don bzhin 'brel gnad dpon rigs khag rnams snga rjes su mjal 'phrad thog zhi ba'i lam nas lag len bstar rgyu'i gros mol ji byung skor dang / nye dus sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub nas ldi li bca' bzhugs bal gzhung gi sku tshab ngo ma dang bka' mol ji byung skor brjod pa dang / lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs bzhed bla na med pas bstsal ba'i bka' slob gsung 'khor der yod 'go 'dzin rnams la sgrog sbyang zhus nas der yod go mtshon ji yod rnams bal gzhung la rtsis 'bul dgos lugs dang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'go dmag 19

rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i mdun lam gyi gzhis chags bya yul dang / 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sogs bal gzhung gis rogs ram gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang yod pa'i gnas lugs 'grel bshad gang thub zhus par 'go dmag rnams nas bal gzhung la dgra lan slog rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod kyang da cha 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob dang phyogs 'gal zhu nus bral bar brten zhi 'jam gyi thog nas go mtshon rnams rtsis 'brul zhu rgyu'i khas len zhus tsam byung /7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob gsham gsal/༈da ring rgya rdo dbang 'dus dang / 'brel yod khyed 'go byed mkhan tshor gnas lugs thung thung zhig brjod rgyu yod/ bar lam bal yul nang la bal gzhung nas nga tsho'i mi 'ga' shas 'dzin bzung byas/ des rkyen pas gnas tshul rnyogs dra byung ba de'i skor/ 'dir gnas tshul thos pa nas bsam blo tan tan btang ste go bsdur byed rgyu byung / da cha de'i skor la 'di nas bde srung gi bka' blon phun tshogs bkris de phyogs slob ston byed par btang ba 'di'i gdong la zhib mngags yod pa khyed rang tshos sa gnas sa thog tu go thos yong gi red/rdo don snying po bal yul gzhung gi bka' btang ba de la nga tshos mkhregs po byas te mjug la rgyag res shor ba yin na yag po yong gi ma red bsam gyi 'dug nga tshos phyogs mang po zhig gi gnas tshul la blta dgos kyi red/ khyed rang tshos kyang zang nge zing nge byas pa yin na 'phral sel gcig byas na rla ba kha shas 'dra 'khyol srid kyi red de/ de byung bas ha las yag gang yang med/ nga rang tsho mi sa rang sa thug nas bsdad yod pas mtha' mar myong rag rgyu zhig ma gtogs med/ de 'dra byung na 'phral sel thabs sdug po dang / nyams dma' po byung ba a cang ste/ phyin chad kyi 120

mdun lam yang 'gag rgyu red/ de ga nang bzhin bal yul nang la da lta bod mi gzhis chags byas pa dang bya rgyu mang po zhig yod pa/ de tsho'i thad la yang gnod skyon 'gro gzhir song na sdig po mi 'dug de las da res bal yul gzhung gi dgongs pa dang mthun pa gang nying nying dang / gang 'dra chags chags shig byed rgyu'i thabs shes byed rgyu yong srid kyi red/ da res bal yul gzhung gi dgongs par 'jug po zhig byed thub na/ rtsa ba'i nga tsho'i bde ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas tshul rnams bal yul gzhung gi las byed gnad yod de 'dra la 'grel bshad dang sbrags pa'i thog nas shod sa yong gi red/ dngos gnas nga tsho rang gi lung pa nas gyar te mi'i lung par gnas tshul thabs sdug po 'di 'dra zhig la bsdad yod/ nga tshor de lta'i gnas tshul yong ba 'di nga tshos rgya mir dga' mi dga' thog byas pa dang / lta ba mthun ma mthun/ rgyal khab gzhan dag gi srid don gyi gnas tshul zhor 'gros la nga tshos de'i nang 'gran bsdur byas pa sogs de 'dra min par/ don dam yang snying bod la bde skyed cig chags yod na nga tshos rgya mir kha gtad gcog dgos don rtsa ba nyid nas med/ de las ldog ste bod nang la rang dgar chos dang / shes rig sogs med pa bzos pa tsam min par mi la nyin re nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang dgos nges thing nges kyi mthun rkyen rnams med pa dang / bya spyod cung zad 'grigs min tsam gyis skyon 'gro ba'i gnas tshul thabs sdug 'di 'dra zhig gi 'og la gnas yod/'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la mi rigs kyi rang dbang 'phrog pa dang / btsan gnon gyi 'og nas thar ba'i ched du drag po'i thog nas thabs shes byed pa zhig 'dzam bu gling 'di'i sgang la yongs grags gnas tshul chags bsdad pa ltar nga tshos kyang de 'dra'i bsam tshul zhig 'khyer ba red/ nga rang tshos gsang ba byas pa red de/ga2

yin na'ang bar lam deb bris mkhan 'ga' res rtsom 'bri byas te yongs grags kyi gnas tshul zhig chags/ de 'dra'i rkyen gyis bal yul gzhung la rgya mis gnon shugs chen po brgyab nas gang ltar yang snying bal yul gzhung la don dam thugs 'dod yod rung med rung de 'dra zhig ma byas thabs med tsha na ma thegs pa zhig chags pa red/ nga tshos de dag mthong dgos pa red/ de 'dra yin dus da res nga tsho'i phyogs nas gang bzo bzo zhig dang / gang mkhas mkhas shig byas na legs pa mthong gi 'dugagazhi rtsa nga rang tshos so so'i don dag bsgrub ched khyed tshos srog 'ben btsugs kyis lo mang dka' las brgyab ste bsdad pa la/ da res gnas tshul 'di 'dra yong dus khyed rang tsho blo pham yong ba a cang ste/ nga tsho 'brel yod las ka byed mkhan tshang ma yang deng sang gcig thog gnyis brtsegs phyogs mang po zhig nas kha chag rna ral thon yong dus dngos gnas blo pham lta bu 'dug ste/ yin na'ang nga tsho blo pham byung zer nas mi bsgrags dgu bsgrags dang / rlung langs pa'i byed thabs de 'dra byed kyin bsdad na dgos pa gang yang med/ de las ba bsad pa las bzhos pa drin che zer ba bzhin/ da res gra ma 'grigs thon na yang / phyin chad mu mthud nga rang tshos thabs shes rim pas byed sa'i lam kha zhig nges par rnyed yong gi red/ de 'dra rnyed pa'i bsam blo gtong dgos pa ma gtogs da lta 'dod pa khengs pa zhig ma byung na phyin chad re ba rgyag sa med pa'i bsam blo btang na col chung yin/ bsam blo gu dog de 'dra gtong mi rung / de 'dra yin dus da res sngon la bal yul gzhung la gang 'dra chags chags shig dang / ga ler 'grigs pa zhig gi thog nas bal yul gzhung gi dgongs pa mthun pa zhig byung na/ dus tshod la 'gyur ba tan tan 'gro gi 22

red/ 'gyur ba phyin pa'i skabs su 'grigs 'gro gi red/rtsa ba nga rang tshos bal yul gzhung gi sha tsha mthong phyogs da lta nang bzhin yag po bsdad thub pa'i thabs shes byed dgos/ gtso che shos nga rang tsho bod mi nang khul nas phugs rgyang ring po'i bsam blo ma btang bar/ 'phral sel phran bu so so'i 'dod pa khengs min gyis blo pham byas/ blo zhum nas sems shugs chag na mi 'grigs sems shugs ma chag pa byed rgyu khyed rang 'brel yod 'go byed mkhan tshos bslab bya yag po rgyag dgos/ nga tsho'i sems shugs ma chag par da lta nang bzhin yod pa byung na nam zhig de'i che de'i dus nga tshos tan tan thabs shes 'du 'god byed thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug de 'dra yin dus thal cha zang zing de 'drar ma song ba zhig khyed rang tshos gzab gzab byas nas blo la bcangs dgos/da lta ngas gnas tshul de 'dra zhig bshad yong dus khyed rang tshos kha shas blo la shong ma shong dang / kha shas nyob ste blo pham yong srid kyi red de/ lhod lhod byas te bsam blo tan tan thongs/ nga tshos bal yul phyogs la dgra gcig bzos/ phyin chad las ka byed yul sgo brgyab pa 'dra po chags pa yin na don phan ci yang med/ bal yul dang / bod sa 'brel chags bsdad yod pas de snga phan chad yin na'ang nga chos bal sa brgyud nas thabs shes mang po zhig byas yod/ bal yul gzhung gis de rnams phyed ka mthong ba dang / phyed ka ma mthong ba'i tshul du bsdad pa red/ da cha rgyal khab chen po rgya mi'i stobs shugs kyi 'khris la bal po'i nus pas ma ldeng pa'i skabs su nga rang tshos gshis ka ma slog par gang bzo bzo zhig byed thub na phyin chad de'i che de'i dus la tan tan nga tshos thabs shes byed thub kyi red/ de tsho'i skor khyed rang tshos shes kyi red la/ khyed rang tshos bsam blo tan tan thongs/ rdo don snying po 23

gang snying cha gang che dang / 'jam po'i thog nas nga rang tsho'i don dag 'grub thub pa zhig byed dgos/ mkhregs po dang / gyong po byas na don dag 'grub rgyu phal cher khag po red/ de rnams khyed rang tsho 'go 'doms tshang ma'i sems la 'jags nas gzab gzab byed shog a/ gzhan dag brjod rgyu gang yang mi 'dug tshang mar bkris bde legs yod/ces bka' slob gsung par sgrogs sbyang grub pa dang der yod mi mang rnams kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyi sgo nas brjod gsal bar lam glo'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go 'dzin rnying pa 'ba' pa ye shes kyis rang re'i rtsa don la rgyab ltos bod mi rigs kyi la zhen dor nas bal gzhung la mgo btags byas pa'i rkyen gyis bal gzhungagis drag po'i thog nas go mtshon rtsis len bya rgyu'i srid byus lag len bstar ba'i 'og skya zhabs lha mo che ring 'dzin bzung do dam byas pa dang / de mtshungs glo khul nye 'gram sa gnas rdzong gsar pa'i yas mas sogs la drag po'i dpung sde gsog 'jog gis dmag sbyong gi 'jigs snang skul bar brten rang re'i glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi khongs mi rnams nas 'u thug bzod thabs bral nas dgra lan slog rgyu'i sems thag gtsang btsad zhu dgos byung zhes zer ba dang /rgya rdo dbang 'dus nas de ring 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob gson rjen 'di lta bu zhig phebs med na rda sa nas mi sna gzhan dag su 'dra zhig phebs pa yin na'ang nga tshos brtsi 'jog zhu dka' ba zhig red/ 'on kyang da lam 7gong sa mchog nas bka' slob 'di lta bu gnang bar brten nga tsho 'go dmag rnams kyis 7gong sa mchog gi bka' bcag nus bral ba red/ nga tshos bal gzhung gi dpung sder gdong thug bya rgyu'i gra sgrig yod cing / nga tshor lo gsum bzhi'i ring ldeng nges kyi bza' chas dang / 24

go mtshon yod/ gal srid lo ngo gsum bzhi'i rjes bza' chas rdzogs che glo khul mi dmangs kyi lag nas len rgyu rang yin/da lta de khul 'byor ba'i bal gzhung gi dmag de rnams nga chos bdun phrag gnyis gsum ring las ma 'gor bar rtsa med mthar skrod gtong thub kyi red/ gal srid bal yul nas dmag snon btang yong na yang grog rong de tsho nas bkag pa yin na mi gcig kyang thar ba dka'/ gal srid rgya mi'i phyogs nas bal gzhung la khams pa log spyod pa de rnams glo khul nas mthar skrod bya rgyur rogs ram byed kyi yin zhes sngar bzhin shod kyi yod pa ltar bal gzhung la bsam tshul de mu mthud bton na'ang bal gzhung gis rgya mi'i bsam tshul der khas len byed khag po red/ gang yin zhe na/ rgya mis glo khul du dpung 'jug byas che rgya gar gzhung gis kha rog sdod thabs bral bar brten da lta'i rnyog zing chung chung 'di las che bar 'gyur rgyur the tshom med/ der brten bal gzhung gi rnyog dra chen po mi yong bar g.yol thabs bya rgyu las gzhan gyi thabs lam med/ gal srid rgya dkar nag gnyis bal yul sa thog la gdong thug gi g.yul sa zhig chags na bal yul rgyal dmangs gnyis kur dka' ngal chen po 'phrad rgyu nyag gcig yin/ de mtshungs glo smon thang sa khul de de sngon bod kyi mnga' khongs yin pa sa gnas de gar yod pa'i mi rgan rigs rnams kyis shod dang shod bzhin pa yin/ rgya mis sa khul der 'dzul rjes lo rgyus thog 'phros lus kyi gleng rnyog cig langs mi yong ngam snyam pa bal gzhung gis nges par tshor ba rnon po byed kyi red/ gong gsal gnas tshul rnams la gzhigs na nga tshos sa khul der lo 'ga' shas ring blo bde bag phebs kyi ngang nas gnas thub/ dus yun de'i ring rgyal spyi'i 'gyur ba zhig yong rgyur nges/ 'on kyang da cha 7gong sa mchog gi bka' 125

slob gsung 'khor stsal ba ltar nga tshos zhi 'jam thog nas go mtshon rnams rtsis sprod bya rgyu rang yin zhes khong gis gnad yod 'go byed rnams la nan po'i thog nas gsungs pa'i skabs khong gi brjid nyams ldan pa'i 'dren byed zung las mig chu lhung lhung du babs song / de nas khong gis mu mthud nas 'go byed rnams la/ 7rgyal ba rin po ches nga tsho chu'i nang mchongs dgos zhes ba 'a phebs na yang nga tshos nges par du mchongs rgyu rang red ces gsungs par tshang mas lan gang yang ma brgyab par gcig gis gcig la mig hrig ger bltas te yud tsam 'jam thing nger gnas/de'i sang nyin der yod 'go byed rnams slar yang skong tshogs kyis der yod go mtshon yongs rdzogs rtsis sprod bya rgyur gra sgrig byas/phran dang don grub rnam rgyal gnyis de khul nye 'gram gyi phogs khang gnas sa tag ces pa'i sa char bskyod de der yod 'go dmag rnams la 7gong sa mchog gi gsung 'khor sgrog sbyangs thog 'grel bshad gang thub zhus/ rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis de khul go mtshon rtsis sprod gra sgrig lam tsam zin rjes brgya shog khag la go mtshon rtsis sprod dgos pa'i slob ston du phebs bskyod gnang / go mtshon rtsis sprod ma byas gong rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis gsang stabs kyi thog nas sku zhabs lha mo che ring 'phrog len bya rgyu'i bsam tshul bton pa der sku zhabs lha mo che ring gis mos mthun ma gnang /sku zhabs lha mo che ring gis mdzad pa'i bod mis btsan rgol rgyal skyob ces pa'i lo rgyus las/ 7gong sa mchog gi thugs rje nyag cig la brten nas glo khul du thabs sdug gi gnas tshul chags yod pa ma red ces gsal ba ltar de khul mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi nyen kha de zhi 'jam du gyur/1974 lo'i zu 7 ches 20 nyin gyi mtshan mo glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi spyi khyab 26

khang skal bzang sgug nas rdzong gsar pa'i bal gzhung gi skor srung dmag snar nang du go mtshon thengs dang po rtsis sprod kyi 'go 'dzugs byas pa dang chabs cig sgrig 'dzugs khongs nas mi grangs 31 gis skyabs bcol ba'i lag khyer zhu rgyu byas/phran zung skal bzang sbyag tu nyin shas bsdad pa'i dgong dro zhig rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis phran gnyis la/ 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob gsung 'khor la nga chos srung brtsi nges par zhu dgos kyi red/ go mtshon rnams rtsis 'bul zhus rjes bal gzhung gis sku zhabs lha mo che ring glod bkrol gtong rgyu phar bzhag nga yang 'dzin bzung do dam bya rgyur the tshom med/ dus yun ring po'i nang bal yul btson khang nang du sdod dgos pa zhig yong rgyur de ltar byung che spyi sger gnyis phan yong dka' ba zhig yin par snyam/de las 'di nas mi hrag po 'ga' shas khrid de 'char can gyi lam brgyud rgya gar du gsang bros byas te nga tsho rgya gar sa thog tu gal srid 'byor thub na/ bal gzhung dang nga tsho phan tshun gyi dka' rnyog sel thabs bka' mol zhu rgyur dge mtshan chen po yong gi red/ 'on kyang lam kha de brgyud nas phyin na da lta thar rgyu dka' ba red bsam gyi 'dug de las bka' shag gi dgongs 'char ltar mi rta hrag po dang / go mtshon legs po 'khyer te bod sa brgyud rgya gar yu'u ba'i sa mtshams su gsang 'dzul byas na nyen kha chung ba 'dug sku ngo khyed rang kusta man ḍūr phyir phebs kyis gang myur rgya gar du phebs thon gnang na legs/ gal srid dus 'gyangs ka kor byung che gcig thog gnyis brtsegs yong rgyu las ma mthong / bal po'i bsam ngan la rdugs zon nges par gnang dgos/ sku ngo khyed rang rgya gar du phebs grub pa'i gnas tshul de 'byor rjes ngas sde tshan khag la 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob gsung 'khor gdan zhus kyis go mtshon rtsis sprod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed kyi yin khul gyis 'gro gi yin/ nang 27

don sde tshan khag nas blos 'khel ba'i mi 'ga' shas mnyam 'khrid kyis rta dang mtshon cha rang 'grigs bod nang du 'dzul te rgya mi'i lag nas nor phyugs gang tsam zhig 'phrog bcom gyis rgya gar sa thog tu khrid yong gi yin zhes khong gis gdengs spobs chen po'i dgongs 'char de gsungs pa dus da lta yang kho bo'i dra na lam du lhang lhang me ra bzhin 'dugang tsho glo khul du nyin bdun gcig tsam bsdad ring go mtshon rtsis sprod gang thub byas te skya zhabs lha mo che ring lhan du glo khul nas kusta man skyur phyir log bya rtsis yin yang de khul nyin ltar sda dro nas dgong dro bar rlung 'tshub chen po brgyab rkyen gnam gru yong ma thub par nyin shas 'gor/ ches 25 nyin rdzong gsar pa nas phran zung spog ra brgyud phyir log byas/ spog ra gnam thang nas sku zhabs lha mo che ring slar yang sa gnas skor srung dmag gis btsan spyod thog nas gdan zhu byed pa'i skabs nga tsho tshang mas yid gdung chen po byung yang gzhan dbang gi gnas su gyar bas bya thabs bral ba'i ngang kusta man skyur phyir log bya dgos byung ba de ni/ sa skya legs bshad las/ rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste/ gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/phran gnyis kusta man ḍū gnam thang du 'byor skabs mun pa rub 'dug gnam gru nas thon ma thag bal gzhung gi skor srung pa zhi chas gyon pa gnyis dang / drag chas gyon pa gnyis kyis phran gnyis gnam thang skor srung ba'i srung nyar khang du 'khrid de khyed gnyis do nub 'dir sdod dgos lugs bshad nas grong khyer nang ma btang bar nyar rtsis 'dug kyang / stabs legs pa zhig la khang pa de'i nang kha par zhig 'dug pa don grub rnam rgyal gyis lam seng bal gzhung nang srid drung che'i nang du phran gnyis 28

de ring glo khul nas 'dir 'byor yod pa dang/ gnam thang du yod pa'i khyed tsho'i skor srung dmag gis rgyal sar gtong gi mi 'dug pa'i gnas tshul ji yin mi rtogs pa'i skor drung cher kha par thog bshad par khong gis gnam thang gi skor srung ba de tshos go nor thebs pa min nam/ khyed gnyis la dgongs sel zhu rgyu yin zer/ de nas khong gis lam seng skor srung 'gan 'khur bar bka' btang ste phran gnyis blo bde zhi lhod ngang nga tsho'i don gcod khang du phyir log byas/de'i sang nyin snga dro bal gzhung nang srid drung che mjal 'phrad gyis bar lam phran tsho glo khul du bskyod pa'i las don skor zhib par gleng mol zhu skabs khong gi da dung blo yid ma chim pa'i rnam gyur ston gyi 'dug pa de ni sa skya legs bshad las/ser sna can gyi nor rnams dang / phrag dog can gyi grogs po dang / blo ngan can gyi rig pa rnams/ yod kyang dga' ba skye mi nus/ zhes gsungs pa'i dngos don bden par snang /glo khul nas kusta man ḍūr phyir log gis bzhugs sgar rda ram sa lar khyug tsam snyan zhur bcar rtsis ngang gnas pa'i skabs der de khul gtan sdod ngo shes a mdo blo bzang zhes pas phran la khyed rang rgya gar du gang myur thon na legs/ kha sa nga'i ngo shes bal gzhung gsang ba'i gnad yod mi sna zhig gis brjod babs la gzhigs na glo khul gyi go lag rtsis spyod gtsang ma ma byung bar re zhig khyod rang bal yul du bkag nyar bya rgyu'i bsam tshul ngan pa yod 'dug gshis de dag la dogs zon nges par gnang nas de ring rang glo bur thon thub na legs ces zer/de skor phran nas bal don don grub rnam rgyal dang / blo bzang tshul khrims bcas par go bsdur byas par lam seng thon rgyur bsam gros gcig mthun byung ste ldi 29

ler thon rgyu'i gnam gru'i lag 'khyer nyo thabs kyis gnam thang nas thon khar der yod skor srung mi sna 'ga' shas nas phran gnam gru'i nang ma btang bar ka kor byed pa'i ngang don grub rnam rgyal gyis slar yang bal gzhung nang srid drung cher kha par btang don/ sku zhabs stag lha glo khul nas 'dir 'byor ma thag rda ram sa lar 'phral du snyan seng zhu bar phebs dgos rda sa nas tar 'phrin 'byor stabs sku nyid sar bcar khom ma byung bar lam seng thon dgos byung ste da lta gnam thang du 'byor yod kyang / 'dir khyed tsho'i skor srung 'ga' shas kyis ka kor shod kyi 'dug pa khyed kyis khong rnams la bka' khyab gnang rogs zhes brjod par khong gis stag lha rda sa nas gang myur bal yul du phyir phebs kyis khams pa'i go lag rtsis 'bul las mjug legs skyel yong rgyur nga chos khong sgug sdod byed kyi yin zhes dang / gnam thang du yod pa'i skor srung bar sku zhabs stag lha phyir thon skabs bkag 'doms mi chog pa'i bka' btang nas rnyog dra med pa'i ngang kusta man ḍū nas ldi li brgyud rda sa bzhugs sgar du 'byor te bar lam glo khul du bskyod pa'i las don gnas tshul rnams zhib phra snyan seng zhus/—— bal yul nas rda sar 'byor rjes nyi hong thog khyo la lho ko ri ya'i mi rigs yin pa'i mkhas dbang co'i (spe sa5mi3625 0500) gis ma 'ongs par e sha ya'i gnas stangs skor thengs gnyis pa'i gros mol tshogs 'dur phran mgron 'bod byung ba ltar/ 1974 zla 8 ches 30 nas zu 9 ches 3 bar nyin gnyis ring gi tshoḍa 'dur 'gro rgyu sngon nas gtan 'khel te tshogs 'du'i thog da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i bod don skor rtsom yig phyogs sgrig byas nas khyug tsam bskyod dgos byung /nyi hong nas phyir 'khor skabs glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas tshul la yang skur 30

'gyur ba chen po byung 'dug de ni 'go 'dzin rgya rdo dbang 'dus sde tshan khag tu bskyod de der yod go mtshon gang tsam rtsis sprad zin pa'i skabs der bal gzhung gi dmag gis glo bur sde tshan bco lnga la mtha' skor te bsngogs bsher byas pa ma zad/sde tshan gzhan dag khag la yang dmag mi gtong rkyang gis bsngor bsher byas par brten 'go 'dzin rgya rdo dbang 'dus sdod blos ma bzod par nyen kha g.yol thabs su rir bros byol bya dgos byung bar bal dmag 40 skor gyis rjes 'ded byas 'dug kyang gar song ma rnyed par bal gzhung gis rang re'i don gcod don grub rnam rgyal glo khul du 'khrid de nyin shas ring bal dmag mnyam du thad 'phur gnam gru'i thog ri klung gang sar nyin mtshan ltos med kyis 'tshol myul byas kyang gang yang ma rnyed par bya thabs bral nas 'tshol myul byed mtshams 'jog dgos byung /phran tsho glo khul nas phyir thon rjes rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis skal bzang sgug nas rim bzhin sde tshan khag tu bskyod de 'go dmag rnams la 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob de rnams kyi nang du nga tshor dka' ngal 'phrad pa de zhi bde'i lam nas sel dgos pa'i skor gsungs yod stabs da cha nga tsho'i lag tu yod pa'i go mtshon rnams ka kor med par bal gzhung la rtsis sprod bya dgos lugs dang / da nas bzung nga tsho'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas stangs de 'pho 'gyur chen po zhig 'gro rgyu yin pa tshang mas shes gsal red/ 'on kyang gnas stangs de ji ltar gyur yang 7gong sa mchog gi dbu khrid rim pa khag dang / lhag par khong gis bka' slob gang gnang ba de rang srog blos btang gis zhabs 'degs sgrub rgyu ni nga tsho bod mi tsho'i las 'gan yin zhes slob ston mdzad/ khong glo khul nas bod sa brgyud gsang thon gnang khar mnyam khrid 'go dmag rnams la rang gi 'dod mos ltar 'gro sdod bya dgos pa las gzhan cig

dbang gi thog nas byas na don dag bsgrubs thabs dka' ba'i snying don bzung nas/mi re ngo rer bka' 'dri gnang ste 1974 zla 8 ches 15 nyin klu mi rong nas bod kyi sa khul brgyud rim bzhin rgya gar sa mtshams su myur bskyod skabs mi rta gnyis kur dka' sdug chen po 'phrad stabs rtsa chu phran bu 'dzoms pa'i sa gnas su nyin shas ngal gso bya dgos byung / de'i ring rgya dmag gis bal gzhung la gsang brda btang ste bal rgya gnyis kyi dmag gis rgyab mdun gnyis nas bkag gnas babs de las g.yol thabs su bal yul sa mtshams gting dkar la brgyud rgya gar mnga' khul du bros thabs su 1974 zla 9 ches 9 snga dro ting dkar la'i nye 'gram gyi sa gnas su 'byor/ de nas rgya gar sa mtshams ha cang thag nye por slebs par brten lam bar ngal gso ma byas par rgya rdo dbang 'dus rang nyid dang /rogs rla bcas rta bzhon nas snang med thog mdun bskyod byas stabs bal dmag gi sgug ra'i nang du tshud de bal dmag gi me char las g.yol thabs bral nas rgya rdo dbang 'dus can rta las babs te phar rgol gyi me mda' rgyag res phran bu byas mthar rgya rdo dbang 'dus dang / khong gi g.yog rta mgrin che 'phel bcas de gar sku srog shor/ rnam kun rgya rdo dbang 'dus kyis 'khukhu zhugs skabs mdun rgyab gnyis su so lta ched gtong byed kyi yod kyang de nyin rgya gar sa mtshams thag nyer slebs pa'i dga' g.yeng snang med du shor te mdun skyod so lta ma btang bar rang nyid kyis mi nyung shas shig khrid de mdun skyod byas pa'i rkyen gyis bal dmag gi sgug ra'i nang tshud pa de'i nor 'khrul gtso bo ni dgra bor mthong chung byas pa'i nyer len red/kho bos rgya rdo dbang 'dus rkyen 'das song ba'i gnas tshul thos skabs yid ma ches pa lta bu byung / khong ni bod rgyal bstan chab srid kyi don du rang srog blos gtong 32

phod pa'i dpa' mdzangs gnyis ldan zhig yin pas da lta nyag phra'i dus skabs 'dir rkyen 'das su song ba de bod gzhung mang rnams la gyong gun chen po phog zhing / ha cang phangs sems skye 'os pa zhig red/ 'on kyang khong gis rang gi rgyal khab dang / mi rigs kyi don du rang srog blos btang ba'i dpa' bo'i snying stobs dang mdzangs pa'i blo gros kyi snang tshul de bod mi rnams kyi snying dbus su ji srid bar gnas rgyur nges/gal srid skabs der khong gi 'char gzhi ltar lag len bstar yod na glo sgrig 'dzugs de bal yul sa thog gi pa le si stan gnyis pa lta bu zhig chags rgyu yin pa gor ma chagagong gsal glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas tshul rags tsam yin zhing / gal srid klog pa po rnams nas de bas zhib phra ba'i gnas tshul mkhyen 'dod na/ thog mar glo sgrig 'dzugs ji ltar btsugs pa dang / mthar 1974 lo bal gzhung gis drag po'i srid byus bzung ste glo sgrig 'dzugs kyi go mtshon btsan len byed stangs/ rgya rdo dbang 'dus can 'u thug bzod bral gyis glo khul nas bod sa brgyud rgya gar du bros skabs lam bar bal dmag gis sgug ra sprad de rkyen lam du btang ba bcas kyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul rnams skya zhabs lha mo che ring gis brtsams pa'i bod mis btsan rgol rgyal skyob ces pa'i lo rgyus zhes pa'i nang du 'khod yod// 33

le tshan so drug pa/7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog gi skya tshab bod ljongs yongs su lta skor du bskyod pa'i skor/༄༅༅/ /bod mi'i btsan byol gzhung dang / tha'i wan go ming tang gzhung gnyis kyi 'brel ba rab rib dang / chad chad mthud mthud kho nar gnas pa'i ngang 1979lo'i 'go tsam la hong tong du bca' sdod rgya dmar gzhung gi shin hwa gsar 'gyur yan lag khang gi mi snas sku gcen rgyal don mchog gi thugs ngo mkhyen pa'i a ri'i mi sna zhig brgyud rang gzhung dang / pe cing dbar da phan lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring 'brel ba ya 'gal du gyur pa de slar yang 'brel mthud 'go 'dzugs gnang na go skabs bzang po zhig yod lugs bsam tshul bton pa de sku gcen rgyal don mchog nas 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus par 7gong sa mchog nas da lam pe cing gis nga tsho'i sgo brdungs par nga tshos brda lan byas pa las/ 'gal ba med pas rgyal don sger thog nas pe cing du khyug tsam bskyod de gnad yod dpon rigs rnams mjal 'phrad kyis ji zer nyan nas slad phyin ji 'gab bsam blo gtang na 'grigs ces bka' mngags sgyuganang ste sku gcen rgyal don mchog phyi zu dang po'i nang pe cing du phebs nas teng zha'o pheng gis gtsos pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur dang / mi rigs las khungs bcas 35

kyi gnad yod dpon rigs rnams mjal 'phrad kyis phan tshun dgongs tshul bka' mol ji snyed cig byung 'dugaskabs der teng zha'o pheng gis khyed tsho phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod mi rnams da bar bod la 'gyur ba byung ba'i gnas tshul 'dra min sna tshogs khyed rang tshos thos yod kyi red/ rgya'i gtam dper rna thos brgya las mig mthong gcig lhag zhes zer ba ltar red/ da lta nga tsho'i rgyal yongs nang du deng rabs can bzhi lag len bstar bzhin pa yin/ lo bcu'i rjes su zhing las de 'phrul chas can du 'gyur ba'i tshad mtho shos la 'gyur rgyu dang / phyi phyogs nyo tshong 'phel rgyas 'gyur gyi red/ las riḍa tshang ma yar rgyas yong rgyur brten mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshad mtho ru 'gro gi red/ lo nyi shu'i rjes su deng rabs can bzhi mngon du gyur nas mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba cha snyoms kyis chu tshad mthon por slebs kyi red ces dang / yang khong gis nga tsho'i rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs byas pa nas bzung grub 'bras chen po byung yod kyang / kyag kyog mang po yang brgyud yod/ gang ltar krung go rgyal khab de rgyal spyi'i thog mthong chen po yong gi yod/ rgyal spyi'i nang a ri dang / mnyam du rgyal spyi'i gnad don gros sdur byed mkhan rgyal khab mang po med ces dang / teng zha'o pheng gis a ri ni rgyal khab phyug po dang / chen po zhig red/ nga tsho'i krung go ni rgyal khab dbul po dang chen po zhig red ces dngos yod drang bden lta bu'i skad cha yang bshad 'dugakhong gis tā la'i bla ma rgyal khab tu phyir phebs nas mes rgyal 'dzugs bskrun gyi las don la thugs khur bzhes na dga' bsu yod/ 1959 lo nga tshos tu la'i bla ma'i bzhugs khang zhig gra sgrig byas yod pa de mi rigs pho brang thog brtsegs gsum pa de red/ phyin chad tshur phebs na der bzhugs na nga tshos phebs sgrig zhu gi yin/ga36

yang gzigs skor gnang ste rgya gar la phebs na'ang 'grigs/ 'gro 'ong la rang dbang yod/ yang khong gi khyed tshor na gzhon gyen log pa khag yod pa de rnams kyang lta skor du yong na 'grigs/ khong tsho'i bsam tshul gang yod yig chen gsar shog sbyar na 'grigs kyi red/ nga tshos chos dad rang mos dang / mi rigs 'dra mnyam gtan 'bebs zin pa yin/ gtso bo bod de mes rgyal gyi cha shas shig yin pa der cha 'jog bya dgos pa las bod rang btsan gyi skad cha bshad na mi 'grigs/ de min gnad don gzhan dag ji 'dra zhig yin kyang nga tsho go bsdur byas te dka' ngal tshang ma sel thub kyi red ces sogs gtam bshad ji snyed cig byas 'dugasku'i gcen po rgyal don mchog pe cing du nyin shas bzhugs ring kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas bod mi gnad yod rnams mjal 'phrad kyis phan tshun dgongs 'char brje len gnang ste pe cing nas hong kong brgyud rgya gar du phyir phebs kyis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas la snyan seng bka' bsdur zhus mthar rgya gar nas pe cing brgyud bod ljongs yongs su gzigs skor tshogs pa zhig ched brdzong bkod sgrig gnang /1959 lo nas da bar lo ngo nyi shu'i ring rgya phyogs kyis 7gong sa mchog gis dbus phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod mi rnams la ches log spyod dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bshu gzhog gral rim/ mes rgyal la rgyab ltos byed mkhan/ bod rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la mgo skor bslu brid kyis ro langs rgyag mkhan sogs tshig ngan yod rdu brjod nas 'dzam gling gi khyon du sdug skad gnam sa gang ba lta bu rgyag gi yo da kyang glo bur du 7gong sa mchog la 'brel ba zhu 'dod yod lugs kyi rnam 'gyur ya 37

mtshan can mang po zhig bstan 'dug pa de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni ma'o tse byung grongs rjes pe cing mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa'i dbar srid dbang 'phrog res byas/ ma'o tse tung gis khyed kyi las ka byas na nga blo bde po 'dug zhes shod yul kho pa'i blos 'gel yul gyi mi sna hwa go hphang gis gtsos pa'i mi 'ga' shas kyis ma'o tse tung 'das po'i bza' zla cang ching gis gtsos pa'i mi bzhi glo bur du 'dzin bzung byas nas de rnams la mi bzhi shog khag ces ming ngan btags ste btson 'jug byas pa ma zad/ da bar lo 30 lhag tsam ring krung go gung khran tang gis rgya nag mi dmangs la gdug /ba mnar gcod byas pa'i nyes 'gal yongs rdzogs mi bzhi shog khag gi mgo la g.yogs/ de sngon ma'o tse tung rang gis thag gcod lag len bstar ba'i mi dmangs spyi khang zhes pa sogs rim bzhin phyir 'then dang / gdug rtsub can gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi sred byus de phran bu'i gu yangs su btang thog phye rgyal khag dbar 'brel lam gyi sgo mo sngar las lhag pa phye ba'i srid byus lag bstar byas/ de mtshungs tha'i lhan go min tang gzhung la yang zhi mthun thog thag gcod bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan te hwa go phong gzhung gis tha'i wan go min tang gi srid 'dzin cang cing go la cang ke shag gi sku gdung de khong gi skyes yul du sa sbod byas 'thus dang / de sngon go gung dmag 'khrugs skabs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i go min tang gis dmag dpon khag gcig tha'i wan du gnyen 'phrad du gtong ba'i srid byus 'dzin pa'i skabs der/1977 lo'i rla 2 ches 5 nyin rgya nag du 'tshams 'drer yong ba'i nyi hong gi mi sna khag gcig nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mjal 'phrad skabs de rnams kyis/pe cing gzhung gi tha'i wan du 'dzin pa'i srid byus gsar par 'gyur ba byung yod pa de ltar tu la'i bla mar 'dzin pa'i srid byus la 'gyur ba byung yod dam zhes dres par/ 38

khong gis skabs der pe cing dbang 'dzin mtho rim pa tshos tha'i wan go min tang gzhung la srid byus gsar pa 'dzin pa'i skor bsam blo 'khor nas nga phod kyi de bzhin yin shag bsam nas gal srid tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du phyir phebs na dga' bsu zhu gi yin zhes tshig kha thal ba'i gnas tshul bshad ma thag de'i sang nyin phyi rgyal khag gi gsar shog thog pe cing gzhung gis tu la'i bla ma phyir phebs gnang na dga' bsu yod ces bshad lugs gsal bsgrags byung ba red/nga phod kyi tshig thal shor ba'i skor pe cing gi dbang 'dzin pa tsho hang sangs shing /bsam yul las 'das pa zhig byung na yang/ lam seng don gnad der 'di byas 'di min gyi thag gcod gang yang byas mi 'dug 'on kyang 'dzam gling yongs su rgya dmar gzhung gis tā la'i bla mar 'dzin pa'i srid byus la 'gyur ba btang yod pa'i gnas tshul de grags chen po byung rkyen hwa go thang kha skyengs ci bya gtol med kyi dka' ngal 'phrad 'dug pa/ de ni rgya'i gtam dper/ stag thog nas babs dka' zhes pa lta bu'i gnas tshul byung 'dug de bzhin thag sgul 'dra gzugs lta bu'i nga phod rang nyid kyis tshig thal gyur ba'i nor 'khrul der nag nyes phog mi yong ngam snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag chen po byung yod pa gor ma chag 'on kyang dus yun gang 'tshams song rjes pe cing gi dbang 'dzin pa chos 'jam thing thing gi ngang nas nga phod kyi gtam bshad de 'dra chags po lta bus khas len bya dgos byung 'dug1979 lo 'gor krung go gung khran tang dbus chab srid cus kyi tshogs 'du'i thog dmigs bkar kyis tu la'i bla ma phyir phebs skor srid byus de thag gcod byas shing / tshogs 'du de'i gros chod gzhir bzung dbus 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi 'brel yod las khungs khag la 'grems spel byas pa'i yig cha'i zin bris kyi nang du 39

tā la'i bla ma phyir log thub pa'i brtson len bya rgyur gal che'i don snying yod ces gsal yod pa red/ yig cha de'i nang don tshan bzhi kha gsal du bkod yod pa ste/dang po/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du phyir log gi brtson len de bod ljongs kyi bde 'jags dang / mi rigs gcig gyur la phan gyi yod/ de bzhin bod mi rnams kyi bsam pa phyi rol du ma phyogs par nang du tshud thub kyi red/gnyis pa/ ru su nas nus shugs bang yod bton nas tu la'i bla mar brtson len byed kyi yod pa red/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma ru sus brtson len byas che nga tshor 'jigs snang chen po skul gyi red/ gnas babs de ni shin tu tshab chen dang /shin tu rnyeg 'dzings can du gyur gyi red/ 'on kyang de sngon gyi gnas tshul bltas na/tā la'i tshogs khag gis ru su la rdugs zon byed dbang la bltas na 'brel ba byed 'dod e yod snyam/ der brten dus skabs de dam 'dzin gyis tu la'i bla ma phyir log gi brtson len byed dgos gal che/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma lam seng phyir log ma thub na yang sgo rgyag mi rung / ru su'u phyogs la ma phyogs pa'i sngon 'gog bya dgos/gsum pa/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du phyir log gi brtson len bya rgyu de rgyal spyi'i thog don snying gting zab yod/ deng skabs nga tshos hong kong dang / tha'i wan gyi skor thag gcod bya rgyu de mi tshos bod don la lta gi yod pa red/ gal srid bod don skor phun sum tshogs pa'i thag gcod byung che hong kong dang / tha'i wan gnyis kyi gnad don yang bde blag tu thag gcod byed thub kyi red/ de ltar thag gcod thub pa'i skyal 'ded kyi gnad don la phan nus chen po yod pa red/bzhi pa/ deng sang tu la'i tshogs khag rang la dmag khri gcig gnyis tsam yod 40

pa red/ dmag dpung de dag la rgya gar dang / ru su'i rgyab skyor yod par brten nga tsho'i rgyal mtshams su 'jigs skul gyis rkyen pas bod ljongs nang khul gyi bde 'jags dang / mi dmangs kyi lus srog rgyu nor bcas la gnod skyon yong gi red/gal srid nga tshos tu la'i phyir log thub pa'i brtson len byed thub tsho 'jigs skul de rigs mthar phyin pa'i rtsa med bzo thub kyi red/ tu la'i gnas skabs ring phyir log ma thub na'ang nga tshos mu mthud nas las don grub thabs byas na dmag dpung de dag bed spyod bya rgyur sngon 'gog thub kyi red ces gsal 'dugaphye lo 1949 lo nas da bar lo 30 ring rgya dmar gyis rgya nag rgyal yongs su dbang sgyur 'og rgya nag mi dmangs rnams la srid dbang gcig bsdud kyis gdug rtsub dbang sgyur byas pa'i rkyen gyis rgya nag yongs kyi dpal 'byor ha cang nyams rgud du gyur par brten mi dmangs rnams dbul zhing phongs par gyur te mi dmangs rnams kyis srid dbang der yid ches brlag pa ma zad/ 'khon 'dzin je cher 'gro ba dang / de mtshungs rgyal spyi'i nang gung phran ring lugs kyi bsam shes 'khor phyogs je zhan nyams rgud du gyur ba/ dmangs gtso rang dbang gi 'gro phyogs nyin re bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro gi yod pa/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi mtshan snyan rgyal spyi'i nang nyin re bzhin je cher 'gro ba ma zad/ phyi rgyal khag gi gzhung dang /mi dmangs rnams kyis bod mi'i bden pa'i las 'gul der gdung sems mnyam skyed rgyab skyor nyin bzhin je mang du 'gro gi yod par brten rgya dmar gyi dbang 'dzin pa chos nga phod kyis tshig thal shor ba de las g.yol thabs bral te tu la'i bla ma rgya nag tu phyir phebs gnang rgyur dga' bsu yod ces srid byus gsar pa zhig bton nas lag bstar byas pa zhig yin 'dug 4

lo shas sngon 1974 lo'i zu nga nang rang gzhung nas rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor rdzong khongs spe la ko pe bod mi'i gzhis chags su lo 'khor las bsdoms tshogs 'du tshogs skabs 7gong sa mchog nas mi dmangs yongs la bka' slob gsung bshad du/ da bar rang re bod mi gzhis byes rnams kha bral nas lo nyi shur nye ba song yod pa da cha rgya nag gi gnas babs la 'gyur ldog chen po 'gro bzhin 'dug pa nyin zhig rang re gzhis byes bod mi phan tshun thug 'phrad kyis dus skabs shig shar gyi red ces ma 'ongs gsal gzigs kyi bka' slob gnang yod kyang / skabs der rang gzhan tshang mas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' gnang bar de tsam gyis do snang ma byung / 'on kyang lo bzhi song rjes 7gong sa mchog gi ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi bka' slob gnang ba de ra 'phrod gsal po byung ba red/1973 lo rang gzhung chos rig bka' blon kun bde gling nyi hong dang / tha'i wan/ hong kong bcas su 'tshams 'drer phebs zhor hong kong du bca' bzhugs dbyin ji'i mi rigs yin pa de sngon bod shar phyogs su sdod myong mkhan 'jor ji pe ṭar sen zhes pa des kun bde gling mchog la pe cing gzhung gi shin ha gsar 'gyur khang gi hong kong la bca' sdod yan lag lasakhang gi gnad yod las byed ngo sprod zhus pa ltar mjal 'phrad gnang yod kyang / skabs der rang re'i phyogs nas pe cing gzhung gi chab srid kyi 'gyur ba de 'dra 'gro gi yod pa bsam yul la de tsam gyis do snang ma byung bar rang bzhin gyi lus yod pa red/gong smos ltar sku gcen rgyal don mchog pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir phebs kyis 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag la snyan seng byung ste 7gong sa mchog nas da bar rang re'i gzhis byes bod mi rnams phan tshun ma 'phrad par lo 20 tsam phyin yod 42

pa dang / da cha pe cing gi dbang 'dzin pa tshos bod du lta skor bya rgyur mos mthun byar pa ltar lta skor tshogs pa zhig bod kyi sa khul rgya gang cher ngo bskyod kyis bod nang gi gnas stangs ngo ma ji yod la zhib 'jug thog bod mi mang gi bsam tshul ji yod shes rtogs thub pa bya dgos bka' phebs bzhin/ bka' shag nas lta skor 'gro mi rnams kyi ming tho bkod sgrig zhus pa dang / skabs der bka' shag gis lta skor tshogs pa'i nang du chol kha gsum so so nas nyung mthar mi re re yod pa zhig bkod sgrig zhu skabs phran gyis/ dril bsgrags bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal lta skor du phebs thub na dge mtshan med dam snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhus don bzhin te phran bde bka' stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / dril bsgrags bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal/ sku gcen blo bzang bsam gtan/ btsan byol gzhung gi mi dmangs spyi 'thus tshogs gtso gzhon pa blo bzang dar rgyas/ nang bad drung che bkris stobs rgyal bcas mi lngar bsko bzhag gis rgya nag brgyud bod ljongs su phebs rgyu gtan 'khel byas/spyir btang 'gro lugs ltar na bka' blon bgres pa des dbu khrid gnang srol yod stabs lta skor tshogs pa'i 'go khrid kyi las 'gan de phran gyi phrag thog tu babs yod kyang rang nyid rnam kun mi tshogs yod sar gtam bshad bya rgyur 'tshor snang dang / skad cha gral 'grigs po shod dka' bar brten dril bsgrags bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan mchog la khong gis tshogs gtso gnang rgyu dang / phran rang tshogs gzhon gyi las 'gan gyi thog la khong la rgyus babs rogs ram zhu rgyu'i bsam tshul bcas snyan seng zhus pa ltar bka' 'khrol byung nas nga tsho mi lnga phyi lo 1979 zla 8ches 2 nyin ldi li nas hong kong brgyud pe cing du thon/143

de nyin hong kong gnam thang du 'byor skabs sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang / hong kong la bca' sdod rgya nag gzhung gi shing ha gsar khang yan lag khang gi spyi khyab gzhon pa sku zhabs li ju hreng gis gtsos pa'i gnad yod las byed drug phebs bsur phebs 'dug pa nga tsho mi lnga sdod gnas hong kong nub phyogs mtsho 'gram gyi shin ha yan lag khang gi sne len khang du go sgrig byas 'dugade'i dgong dro shin ha yan lag gi las khungs su sku zhabs li cu hreng gis nga tsho mi lnga la dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams/ gsol ston thog sku gcen rgyal don mchog kyang gdan 'dren zhus 'dug li cu hreng gis da lam nga dang skya zhabs rgya lo don grub gnyis phan tshun ngo shes nas krung dbyang dang / tu la'i bla ma'i dbar lo 20 lhag tsam ring 'brel thag chad pa de bar lam skya zhabs rgya lo don grub pe cing du phebs te krung dbyang dbu khrid tsho mjal 'phrad zhus nas rgya gar du phyir phebs rjes tā la'i bla mar snyan seng zhus don bzhin da res tā la'i bla mas khyed rnam pa mes rgyal du 'tshams 'dre gzigs skor du gtong gnang gis de ring khyed rnam pa lam zhor hong kong la phebs 'byor byung bar ngas shin hwa yan lag las khungs kyi tshab zhus nas khyed rnams la dga' bsu'i gsol ston 'bul rgyu byung ba de ha cang dga' po byung / rnam pa tsho sang gnangs pe cing du phebs nas krung dbyang dbu khrid rnam pa mjal 'phrad yag po yong ba dang / bod ljongs khul du gzigs skor legs grub yong ba dang phebs lam du sku khams bzang po yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/gzigs skor grub nas tong tong brgyud rgya gar du phyir phebs gnang rgyur dga' bsu dang / dga' skyel zhu gi yin/ tu la'i bla ma skya khams bzang po yong ba bcas kyi smon 'dun dang sbrags tshang mas bzhes rag mnyes dag gnang rogs zhu zhes gsung lan 44

du/ bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan gyis thugs rje che zhu'i gsung lan gnang /nga tsho hong kong la ngal gso dang sbrags nyin gnyis bzhugs nas de khul nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis dbus pe cing du yod pa'i bod rigs gnad yod khag dang / 'brel yod rgya me'i las byed bcas la 'bul byed phyag rtags phran bu re gzigs sgrub gnang /ches 5 nyin hong kong nas rgya nag gi gnam gru chung ngu zhig gi thog dus yun skar ma 30 tsam la kong kru la 'byor/ kong kru gnam gru thang la kong kru zhing chen gyi 'brel yod dpon rigs mang po phebs bsur 'byor 'dug pa nga tsho mi lnga kong kru grong khyer gyi sne len khang du nyin dgung gsol tshigs gra sgrig byas 'dug par khyug tsam bskyod de phyi dro chu tshod gsum pa'i thog kong kru nas pe cing du thon/lo ngo sum cu lhag tsam ring rgya dmar gyis rgya nag nang khul yongs su gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu'i chab srid kyi las 'gul gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis spel ba ma zad/lhag par lo ngo bcu'i ring ma'o tse tung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul de bslangs nas rgya nag yongs su zing long chen po byung yod pa'i rkyen gyis mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba nyams thag tu gyur pa'i gnas stangs ji 'dra zhig yod dam snyam pa'i ngang hong kong nas kong kru gnam thang du 'byor skabs kong kru gnam thang de blo yul las 'das pa'i sgrig chas shin tu nas gog rul gyi rnam par gnas pa'i thog gnam thang der hong kong dang mi 'dra ba phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi 'grul pa ha cang nyung nyung red 'dugahong kong nas kong kru bar nyin re snga dro thengs gnyis re gnam gru 'gro 'ong byed kyi yod zer ba de ni 'grul pa mang che ba hong kong la sdod pa'i mi rnams rgya nag sa 45

khul khag tu gnyen 'phrad du bskyod mkhan dang / de min kong tung zhing chen khongs kyi mi dmangs nyung shas tong kong dang phyi rgyal khag tu gnyen 'phrad du 'grul skyod byed kyi yod zer/ hong kong dang kong kru gnyis sa 'dres yin na yang phan tshun du gnas pa'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba de lha yul dang dmyal khams lta bu'i dbye ba chen po 'dugakong kru gnam thang nas mgron khang bar bskyod skabs lam bar phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi 'grim 'grul cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa dang / 'gro mi mang che ba gyon chas rtsab ral lhan thog lhan brtsegs red 'dug de bzhin lam gyi g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i mi dmangs kyi sdod khang de dag kyang mi dmangs tsho'i gyon chas dang mtshungs pa zhig red/phran tsho mnyam du bsu len du yong ba'i kong kru zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u krang gzhon pa zhig yod pa der/ bar lam rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kong kru khul gyi mi dmangs la rgya nag zhing chen gzhan gyi mi dmangs dang gcig mtshungs kyi dka' ngal byung yod dam zhes dris pa'i lan du/ dka' ngal gcig mtshungs byung yod kyang mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlag rjes kong kru zhing chen 'di zhing chen gzhan dang mi 'dra bar mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba mngon gsal gyis yag tu phyin yod/ de'i yong rkyen ni/ zhing chen de'i khongs nas phyi rgyal gang sa gang la phyir sdod rang mi gnas yod par brten khyim tshang nang dang mnyam 'brel bcas la phan thogs chen po byung yod/ lhag par hong kong / a'o man gnyis sa 'dres yin tsang kong kru mi dmangs tshos sa gnas de gnyis la 'tsho ba'i thabs len la 'gro skyod byed bde po byung yod/krung gung rgyal yongs tshogs 'du thengs 11 rjes phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba'i sgo mo phye pa'i srid byus lag bstar byas pa nas bzung kong kru zhing chen gyi mi dmangs 46

rnams kyi 'tsho ba zhing chen gzhan las lhag pa'i yag tu phyin yod pa red zer/ khong gi bshad tshul la gzhigs na/ rgya nag zhing chen gzhan gyi mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba de las zhan pa yod lugs brjod pa de ni blo yul las 'das pa lta bu byung /kong kru nas pe cing bar gnam thog chu tshod na tsam 'gor/ pe cing gnam thang du 'byor skabs krung go gung khran tang dbus 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u krang gzhon pa li'u lan tha'o yis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs 10 lhag tsam phebs bsur phebs 'dug de'i nang phran de sngon 1950 dang / 1952 nas 1953 lo bcas su pe cing du bskyod skabs mi rigs las khungs kyi sne shan pa le'u lung zhes pa de slebs 'dug pa las de min tshang ma de sngon 'phrad ma myong ba sha stag red/ le'u lung gis sku gcen blo bzang bsam gtan dang / phran gnyis mthong ma thag dga' po'i rnam 'gyur thog nas thag ring nas lag pa g.yugs g.yugs byed kyi 'dug lo mang ma 'phrad pa'i grogs rnying glo bur du 'phrad pa der dga' snang brjod kyi mi lang ba zhig byung / le'u lung gis phran gnyis dang lag pa gtong res byed skabs mig gnyis kyi nang mchi ma 'khor 'dug kyang skad cha gzhan gang yang ma bshad par 'dzum dmul dmul gyi ngang nas tu la'i bla ma dang / rgyal yum chen mo/ mnga' ris rin po che bcas sku khams bde po yin nam zhes dris byung / de nas gnam thang gi mtho rim mi sna'i sne len khang du khyug tsam bzhugs nas pe cing grong khyer nang dmag dpon mtho rim rnams la sne len bya yul cing shi ping kon zhes pa'i nang du nga rjo'i bzhugs gnas phebs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der bskyod/pe cing du 'byor pa'i sang nyin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dang / mi rigs las khungs thun mong nas mi dmangs tshogs khang nang du dga' bsu'i gsol ston 447

bshams pa der bskyod de gsol ston gong 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u krang gzhon pa dang po le'u lan tha'o dang / mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin dbyang chen rin gnyis kyis gtsos dpon rigs rnams kyis nga tshor sne len gyis phan tshun ngo sprod byas/ de nas le'u lan tha'i yis da res tu la'i bla mas gtong gnang mdzad pa'i skya tshab rnam pa mes rgyal du 'tshams 'ji lta skor gnang bar pe cing du phebs 'byor gyis nga tsho mnyam du 'dzoms pa 'dir dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin/ tu la'i bla ma dang /krung dbyang dbar kha bral nas lo 20 lhag tsam song ba de'i ring mes rgyal nang khul la kyag kyog gi gnas tshul mang po byung ba'i rkyen gyis rgyal khab dang mi dmangs rnams la lo bcu'i ring gyong gun brjod kyis mi lang ba phog yod lugs dang / mi bzhi shog khag thal dul du brlag rjes krung go gung khran tang rgyal yongs tshogasachen 11 pa'i thog deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs skrun gyi srid byus lag len bstar bar brten slad lo bcu phrag rjes rang re'i rgyal khab kyi rnam pa de mi 'dra ba zhig chags kyi red ces zer/ khong gis khyed rnam pa bod ljongs su gzigs skor phebs nas sdig nyes ji yod rnams gzigs rgyu dang / mi su thug 'phrad gnang na yang thug chog gi red/ krung dbyang gis khyed rnam pa mes rgyal du gzigs skor 'tsham 'drir phebs pa der brtsi mthong chen po gnang gi yod/ gzigs skor grub nas dgongs 'char ji yod nga tshor sbas gsang med par gsal por gsung rogs gnang / mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs su 'gro gi yod ces zer/ de nas yang chin ren gyis kyang de mtshungs kyi 'grel bshad byas/de'i sang nyin nga tshos kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas rim bzhin mjal ga48

'phrad zhu rgyur rgya phyogs kyi sne shan par go sdur byed skabs sne shan pas dang thog nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / de nas paṇa chen rin po che dang phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas rim pa bzhin mjal rgyu'i bsam tshul bton kyang / nga tshos dang thog kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher mjal khar bcar rgyu yin lugs kyi bsam tshul nan bshad byas nas paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du bod chas gyon nas mjal khar bcar/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs yul pe cing ri li'i babs tshugs kyi nye 'gram du bzhugs khang thog gcig ma zhig nang bzhugs 'dug pa de ni de tsam gyis rgyas spros med pa dang / gzim sgo phyi nang gnyis la sku srung dmag gang yang mi 'dug nga tsho rgyal sgo'i nang du 'dzul skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i yab yum dang / sku'i gcung po rnam pa gsum/ zhabs 'bring 'ga' shas bcas kyis dga' bsu sne len gnang byung / nga tsho gzim chung du bcar skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che gzim chung gi mjal 'phrad khang gi gzim sgo'i nang zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas skya bzhings kyis phebs sgug gnang nas bzhugs 'dugang tshos khong la bod kyi chos lugs kyi gus srol ltar skya phyag gsum re phul nas dril bsgrags bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal gyis maṇaḍal rten gsum phul rjes tshang mas phyag dbang zhus/ 7gong sa mchog nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher 'tshams 'dre mdzad lugs brgyud zhu dang sbrags 7gong sa mchog nas da lam nga tsho mi lnga pe cing brgyud bod du lta skor du gtong gnang mdzad pa'i skor snyan seng dang sbrags bka' slob zhus par/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches/ thams cad mkhyen pa sku khams bzang 49

ngam zhes bka' 'dre gnang skabs khong gi phyag gnyis dbu dpral gyi mtshams la thal mo sbyar nas dad gus chen po'i rnam pa ston gnang mdzad song / de nas khong gis thams cad mkhyen pas dbus phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod mi rnams kyi gnas stangs/btsan byol gzhung gi skor bcas zhib phra bka' 'dre gnang bar zhib lan phul/ khong gis thams cad mkhyen pa dang nga rang kha bral nas lo 20 lhag tsam song yang da cha bslu med dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang / yang sgos rang cag bod mi rnams mjal 'dzoms kyi dga' ston dus skabs shig yong rgyur nges zhes dang / yang khong gis bar lam lo ngo bcu phrag ring rang cag kha ba can gyi bstan pa chab srid kyi lo rgyus thog la byung ma myong ba'i gtor bcom dang gnod skyon brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig byung yang /mi bzhi shog khag rtsa gtor btang rjes da yod krung dbyang srid gzhung gi teng phu'u kru'u zhi (teng zha'o pheng ) gis gtsos 'go khrid gsar pa rnams kyis deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs skrun gyi srid byus lag bstar byas yod pa des rgya nag yongs kyi mi dmangs rnams dang / bye brag bod gangs ljongs kyi mi dmangs rnams la dbugs ring zhig gtong rgyu'i dus skabs shig byung yod ces dang / de nas khong gis phyi lo 1952tsam nas khong la nyes pa phog nas lo ngo bcu phrag ring bzang btson lta bu btson khang du bzhugs dgos byung ba ma zad/ sku srog la yang nyen kha 'phrad pa'i skor rob tsam gsungs/ da res khyed rnam pas bod ljongs sa khul du brel tshab med pa'i sgo nas gzigs zhib gang thub ci thub kyis nyams rtogs yag po gnang thub na bod mi dmangs la phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ gzigs skor grub mtshams slar yang pe cing du phyir phebs kyis krung dbyang la gnas tshul sba gsang med pa'i thog zhu thub na dge mtshan chen po yod ces bka' slob mang po gnang / 50

de'i sang nyin nga phod ngag dbang 'jig med mjal 'phrad du 'gro 'char yod kyang / de nyin paṇa chen rin po che'i mjal kha grub rjes phun tshogs dbang rgyal nas phran la kha par btang 'byor byung don ltar nga tsho nyin de'i phyi dro khong sar bskyod nas nga tsho lo mang ring ma 'phrad pa da res glo bur mjal 'dzoms byung bar brjod kyis mi lang pa'i dga' tshor chen po byung /gong du khong gi sngon gyi lo rgyus rob tsam bris yod pa ltar/ 1958 lo nas nye char bar khong pe cing nye 'gram du thos pa tsam gyis 'jigs snang skye dgos pa'i chin khren zhes pa'i btson khang ang dang po'i nang du lo ngo nyi shu tsam ring bzhugs dgos byung 'dug nga tsho khong gi bzhugs yul gyi 'gram du 'byor skabs der khong gi bzhugs khang de thog brtsegs gsum pa'i khang pa gu dog po zhig tu bzhugs 'dug lo 20 la nye ba'i ring 'jigs snang can gyi btson khang de'i nang du khong gis sdug sbyong myangs pa'i rkyen gyis de sngon brjod chags ldan pa'i gzugs stobs de nyams rgud du gyur yod pa ma zad/ zhabs gom 'khyar 'khyor bskyon mkhan gyi mi rgas 'khogs shig tu gyur 'dug de bzhin btson khang nang du su zhig dang yang 'phrad du ma bcug par gcig pur bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis skad cha shod skabs tshig 'gag thebs 'gro gi 'dugade'i dgong dro khong gis nga tshor gsol tshogs gang rgyas shig gra sgrig gnang yod stabs nga tshos gsol tshig zhus pa dang sbrags phan tshun gyi lo rgyus ngo sprod zhu res byas/khong gis nye lam sku gcen rgyal don mchog pe cing du ma phebs gong tsam la khong btson khang nas gzhi nas glod bkrol byung ba de 7gong sa mchog gi thugs rje nyag cig la brten nas byung ba las de min glod bkrol yong rgyu de rmi lam du yang 'khor mi thub pa zhig red ces gsung skabs/ khong gi zhal 'dzum dmul dmul gyi rnam pa 15

bstan pa tsam las bka' mol gnang ma thub pa lta bu kha shas byung song / btson khang nang du khong la ya nga snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg brjod kyi mi lang ba phog yod kyang /dus yun de'i ring ma khe si dang / le nyin ring lugs kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi deb mang po bltas te slob sbyong gting zab mthar phyin byas nas nyams rtogs kyi go skabs thob byung zhes spobs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gis rang la sems gso lta bu gnang bar mngon/skabs der khong gi sras sros nga tsho dang mnyam du bzhugs yod pa de rnams kyis de sngon khong tsho'i yab yum gnyis ka btson khang nang du bcug rjes bu rgan pa phun khams rang lo 12 dang / bu mo rgan pa phun tshogs bde skyid rang lo 10 las slebs med cing / khong gnyis la nyes pa gang yang med bzhin du btson khang du lo shas bcug pa'i skor brjod skabs/ khong tshos ngu 'bod kyi thog nas rgya mi gung khran tang zhes pa de 'gro ba mir gdug 4ba kyi sdug sbyong gtong mkhan srin po srin nag red ces 'khon 'dzin chen po'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug skabs der nga tsho mnyam du yong ba'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi sne len pa re ren can la/ bu phrug tshos nga tsho bod mir sdug po gtong mkhan rgya mi khyod tsho'i gas red ces dngos su skyon 'dzugs byed skabs/ khong gis kha ya de tsam ma byas par snang med du btang ba'i thog sems gso lta bu'i 'grel bshad 'ga' shas byas song /de'i sang nyin phyi dro nga phod mjal 'phrad du bskyod/ nga tsho khong gi bzhugs khang du 'byor skabs rgyal sgo'i phyi nang gnyis su srung bya bcings 'grol dmag 'ga' shas go mtshon rang 'grigs kyis bsdad 'dug pa dang / rgyal sgo'i nang du khong gi sras sros rnams dang lcam bcas kyis nga tshor dga' bsu gnang byung / de nas sgo ra gnyis 152
