pa'i sgo 'gram du yar slebs skabs nga phod khong rang phebs sgug gnang nas bzhugs 'dug nga tsho lo mang zhig ma mjal kyang khong gtan zhal gnyis de tsam gyi rgas 'khogs chags mi 'dugang phod kyi gnas stangs de kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang bsdur na rgya mis nga phod la brtsi mthong chen po yod par mngon gyi 'dug pa de ni rgya mis nga phod de thog mtha' bar gsum du bod mi rnams la drag gnon byed pa'i lag cha lta bur spyod kyi yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin pa gor ma chag1959 lo'i lha sa'i zing 'khrug rjes rgya mi'i dbang 'dzin pa tshos nga phod la krung go rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi spyi khyab gzhon pa dang / bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spyi khyab bsko bzhag byas pa de dus de'i bar gnas 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ khong gis rnam kun rgya me'i bka' gsung ci sgrub zhus yod stabs rgya mi tshos khong la yid ches blos 'gel lta bu byas 'dugakhungs ldan gyi go thos shig la/ 1959 lo'i rjes su nga phod krung go gung khran tang gi rjes snon tang mir zhugs yod pa ltar krung go gung khran tang gi lhag bsam rnam dag gi zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan gyi mi zhig tu gyur yod zer/rgya mi'i zer srol la/ khong ni mes rgyal la sha zhen dang/ krung go gung khran tang gi phul byung gi bu phrug gcig red ces zer ba ltar phyi ngos kyi rnam par lta na don dngos thog nas mtshon thub pa zhig byung 'dug nga tsho mjal 'phrad skabs bar lam phan tshul gyi gnas stangs ngo sprod lta bu zhu res byas/nga tshos khong la phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa mchog gis dbus btsan byol gzhung dmangs kyi gnas stangs 'grel bshad byed skabs khong gis de rnams do snang 53

med pa'i rnam pa bstan kyang / khong gi sras sros rnams nas ha cang do snang chen po'i thog btsan byol gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs gyi gnas stangs dang / sgrig 'dzugs kyi ngo bo bcas re re bzhin dre ba zhib phra bton byung / nga phod khong la sras sros bcu gnyis yod/ tshang mar slob sbyong mtho po byung 'dug nga phod de sngon bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bkrin gyis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 'tsho ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gis khong la thugs blos byings 'gel gnang yul gyi mi zhig yin par brten da cha gzhan dbang gi gnas la 'jigs nas phyi'i rnam 'gyur de 'dra zhig bstan rung / thugs kyi gting du ji bsam su zhig gis rtogs dka' ba zhig yin/de nas nyin shas ring pe cing grong khyer dang de'i nye 'khor bcas kyi gna' shul grags can dang / bzo gra dgon pa/ slob gru bcas par lta skor byas nas ches 17nyin dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog srid blon gzhon pa li shan nyan gyis gtsos pa'i mtho rim gnad yod dpon rigs bcas mi dmangs tshogs khang chen mor tha'i wan gyi mgron khang zhes pa'i khang chen nang mjal 'phrad byas/skabs der nga tshos bod lugs kyi gyon chas gyon yod pa li shan nyan gyis khyed rang tsho phyi rol du bod chas gyon gyi yod dam zhes phran la dris byung ba/ phran gyis nga tsho mi yul du da bar gnas yod kyang rang gi chos dang / rig gzhung / goms gshis bcas la brtsi srung gang thub byed kyi yod ces bshad/ mjal 'phrad sar khong dang mnyam du 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi spyi khyab u lan phu (sogapo) dang mi rigs las khungs kyi spyi khyab yang chin rin bcas dpon rigs bcu tsam yod/ li shan nyan gyis/ da res khyed tsho mes rgyal du phyir log gis nga tsho mnyam du ngo 'phrad byung bar dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ deng sang mes rgyal gyi gnas stangs sngar las yag tu 'gro gi ga54

yod lugs dang / khyed tsho bod sa khul la ring min gzigs skor gnang skabs de sngon gyi gnas stangs dang / deng sang gi gnas stangs gnyis bsdur na shes kyi red/bar lam rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs brdabs rdeg chen po byung yang / deng sang drag tu phyin yod/ mi bzhi shog khag gis bod kyi dgon pa khag gtor bshig phran bu btang yod pa de dngos 'brel gyi gnas tshul red/ chos lugs rtsa gtor nam yang gtong thub kyi ma red/ nga tsho krung go gung khran tang gis chos dad rang mos la srung skyob byed kyi yod/ mi bzhi shog khag gis srid byus ngan pa de dag dang rgyab 'gal byas yod/ 'on kyang mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlags rjes krung dbyang gis bod kyi dgon pa khag nyams gso byed bzhin yod/ tā la'i bla ma dang khyed rnam pa mes rgyal du phyir log phebs na nga tshos dga' bsu yod/ yang na lo shas rjes phebs na yang 'grigs/ tu la'i bla ma pe cing ngam/ yang na bod du bzhugs na yang 'grigs/ gal srid goms gshis ma 'phrod pa yin na slar yang phyi rgyal du phebs na yang nga tshos dga' skyel zhu gi red/ 'on kyang bod de krung go dang kha bral thabs med pa zhig red ces zer/ de nas u lan phu yis rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs bod ljongs su gtor bshig byas pa de dang nang sog la gtor bshig byas pa gnyis bsdur na bod la nang sog nang bzhin gtor bcom byung med/ nang sog la gtor bcom byas pa'i gnas tshul de mi gang 'dra zhig yin rung thos pa tsam gyis skrag snang chen po skyo dgos pa zhig red ces dang /yang khong gis tu la'i bla ma dang khyed tsho su'u len dang 'brel ba byas na bod la dka' ngal chen po 'phrad kyi red/ khyed tshos phyi sog rang btsan rgyal khab cig yin par ngos 'dzin byas yod pa red/ dngos 'brel byas na phyi sog de su'u lan gyi 155

btsan gnon 'og tu sog po'i mi dmangs rnams sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod pa red/bod de mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du zhugs pa des khe phan chen po yod/ khyed tshos nges par du de rtogs pa bya dgos/ su'u len bzo bcos ring lugs kyi bya spyod de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab las sdug gi red/ de'i 'og tu tshud pa'i rgyal khab dang rgyal phran khag gi mi dmangs rnams sdug bsngal brjod kyis mi lang ba myong gi yod pa red ces zer/de ni bar lam 7gong sa mchog phyi sog dang / su'u len gyi shar phyogs sbya rad thu rang skyong khul zhes pa bcas nas gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur gnang ba der rdugs 'grog chen po byed kyi 'dugang tsho rgya gar nas ma thon gong tsam la pe cing gi sku gcen rgyal don mchog brgyud tā la'i bla mas su'u len dang / su'u len dang phyi sog la ma phebs rogs gnang zhes nan tan gyi thog nas bkag 'doms lta bu byas yod kyang / 7gong sa mchog gis gong gsal yul khag de gnyis sngar rabs nas bod dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos phyogs kyi 'brel ba dam zab byung yod par brten da lam 7gong sa mchog gis yul de gnyis kyis mi dmangs kyis skom pa chu 'dod lta bus gdan zhu byas pa las srid don gyi gnas tshul gang yang ma red ces rgya phyogs kyi dgag char gsan 'jog ma gnang bar dus thog tu gong gsal yul khag la chibs bsgyur bskyangs pa de da res u lan phu yis nga tshor dmigs bsal gyis phru gur 'jigs skul lta bu'i skad cha bshad pa zhig red/nga chos pe cing khul gyis byed sgo rnams zin nas bod du thon bskyod bya rgyu'i lam phyogs dang / sa gnas/ nyin grangs bcas kyi skor 'thab phyogs gcig gyur 456

dang / mi rigs las khungs kyi gnad yod las byed mnyam du 'char gzhi bkod de rla 8 ches 31 nyin pe cing nas gnam gru'i thog rgya nag gi nub byang gtso gnas lan kra'u grong khyer brgyud bod kyi shar byang du gnas pa'i mdo smad dam/ a mdo zhes grags pa'i yul gru sogs la 'tshams 'dri lta skor du thon/pe cing nas lan kra'u bar gnam thog chu tshod gsum min tsam 'gor/ dus rabs bdun pa nas bzung lan kra'u yi sa khul de bod kyi 'phrul gyi lha btsan po rim byung gis dus rabs gsum tsam gyi ring dbang sgyur byas/ dus skabs der lan kra'u yi shar rgyud chin hru'u zhes pa dang / byang shar hor lan ri bo phan tshul la bod dang rgya gnyis kyis sa mtshams kyi dbye zhib byas pa'i skor bod rgya gnyis kyi lo rgyus yig rnying khyu'i rgyal rabs thang hru'u gsar rnying / las gsal/skabs der/ nga tsho lan kra'u la nyin gnyis bsdad nas de khul gyi bzo gra dang /nub byang mi rigs slob grwa de bzhin mi dmangs spyi khang / rma chu'i thog gsar bskrun byas pa'i han tsā shar glog khang bcas su lta skor du bskyod de lan kra'u yi lho rgyud bkris 'khyil dgon chen du mo ṭa'i thog nyin sgang bskyod nas lam bar ka chu zhes pa len shu la ngal gso byas nas de nas bkres 'khyil la 'byor skabs sa rub pa'i skabs 'khel kyang / de khul gyi mi dmangs rnams kyis nga tsho yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul thos te snga dro nas dgong dro bar nga tsho ma slebs par bod lugs kyis lam kha'i g.yas g.yon du bsangs gtong ba dang / dkar thig 'then pa/ rta star sgrig pa bcas dga' bsu gus 'dud tshad las 'das pa zhus 'dugaskabs der de khul la gnas sdod bod rgya las byed tshos rnam kun krung dbyang dang zhing chen gyi gnad yod dpon rigs phebs skabs mi dmangs rnams kyis khyug 57

tsam bsdad nas mu mthud ma sgug par kha 'thor du 'gro gi yod kyang / da res khyed rnam pa phebs rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul thos ma thag mi dmangs rnams kyis rnam kun dang mi 'dra ba'i zhogs pa snga po nas dgong dro bar khyed tsho ma phebs bar phebs sgug zhus song zhes zer byung /lan kra'u nas kha lho phyogs su gtad de ri klung chu phran mang po dang/ sa rong /ba pa'i kyag kyog gi lam thog ka chu dang / tor tshang shing sgo sa gnas sogs brgyud rim bzhin mdun du bskyod skabs sa bab mtho ru 'gro ba dang / gnam gshis kyang je grang du gyur nas tshang mar ngal dub chen po byung yang / pha yul bsil ldan ljongs kyi ri klung mdzes sdug can 'dis nga tsho'i sems stobs spel nas bgrod lam gyi ngal ba sel ba'i 'tshor snang zhig byung /shing sgo zhes pa'i tha snyad de gna' dus bod rgya'i sa mtshams su btsugs pa'i sa mtshams rtags kyi tha snyad cig yin/ shing sgo'i g.yas g.yon du gna' rabs kyi mkhar rdzong gi gyang ro da dung lus yod/ shing sgo de gras bod rgya gnyis kyi sa mtshams gnad yod khag mang po zhig la yang / deng sang yul mi rnams kyis tha snyad de 'bod kyi yod pa red ces zer skad 'dugade nyin bkris 'khyil dgon pa'i nye 'gram gyi grong du 'byor skabs sa rub song ba mgron khang gi phyir mi mang po dga' bsur sgug nas bsdad 'dug nyin der lam thag ring por 'grul bskyod bya dgos byung rkyen gyis tshang ma ngal dub shin tu chen po byung ste dgong dro gsol tshigs grub ma thag gnyid skyid po khug byung /nam ma langs tsam la mgron khang gi phyi la skad cor brgyab ste rmi lam skyid po rmi bzhin pa'i gnyid de dkrog nas gnyid las sad/ skabs der skad cor rgyag pa ci 58

yin snyam nas mal khre nas langs te nyal khang phyir thon te mgron khang gi rgyal sgo'i 'gram nas phyir lta skabs bod mi pho mo rgan byis mang po zhig 'tshang kha shig shig gis mgron khang rgyal sgo'i nang du mig hrig hrig lta bzhin 'dug rgan khog 'ga' zhig lag tu phreng ba bzung ste ngag nas smon 'debs byed pa dang / na gzhon rnams kyis phan tshun skad cha shod bzhin par mgron khang du lta gi 'dug pa de rnams nas nged mthong ma thag 'ga' shas kyis lag tu 'khyer ba'i kha btags sog dar sngon po de g.yug g.yug byed pa dang / rgan khog 'ga' zhig gis mgron khang phyir bskor ba rgyag gi 'dugaskabs der sne len byed mkhan bod mi las byed pa zhig nged sar slebs te de rnams nam ma langs gong tsam nas der yong ste khyed rnam pa mjal ched sgug bsdad song zhes zer/ spyan rla de rnams kyi rnam 'gyur thog nas rang re gzhis byes bod mi rnams lo bcu phrag gnyis ring dbang med kha bral byas nas gzhis lus spun rla rnams la rgya dmar gdug rtsub can gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og mnar gcod brjod kyi mi langs pa myangs yod kyang / de rnams kyis gnya' rus mi chag pa'i thog phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i bod kha ba can kyi mgon skyabs 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku che bskal brgyar brtan pa dang / bod mi rnams mi yul gyi dmyal ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal las sgrol ba/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa khong gi gdul zhing bod kha ba can du mgyogs myur zhabs sor 'khod pa shog ces smon lam shugs chen rgyag gyi yod pa de gsal por mtshon gyi 'duganged nyal khang du phyir log skabs sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan gzim khri nas yar bzhengs pa'i ngang zhal 'dzum dmul dmul gyis nged la/ mdang nub gang du phebs pa zhes sku rtsed gnang byung / khong ni thugs rgyud drang ba dang / spro snang chen po/ 59

thugs sems bzang ba bcas kyi bdag nyid can zhig yin pa ma zad/ dus rgyun khong la nga rgyal rang bstod che nyams kyi rnam pa cung zad tsam yang med pa'i thog mchog dman su zhig yin rung mdza' brtse gnang ba dang / lhag par nyam thag rnams la gang thub ci thub kyis byams brtse dang rogs ram gnang mkhan zhig red/ rnam kun khong zhogs pa snga bzhengs kyis phyi la sku 'cham du phebs pa'i goms gshis yod kyang /nyin sngon ma der phebs lam du sku ngal chen po byung skabs zhogs pa der snga bzhengs gnang ma thub pa byung 'dugade nyin zhogs pa sne len khang gis nga tshor a mdo'i yul srol gyi 'o ja dang /rtsam pa/ phyur zhib/ go re (a mdo'i bag leb ) snum bsregs btang ba'i kha zas sna tshogs bcas sgrig gshoms byas 'dug pa tshang ma dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas zhogs ja der tshim par rol/a mdo'i yul srol la ja khu dang 'o ja 'dres pa'i ja dkar yol nang blugs te mar dang / phyur zhib bye ma ka ra/ rtsam pa gang tsam bcas byugs te lag pas g.yos te za srol yod cing / dbus gtsang khul gyi goms gshis la ja bskol nas ja mdong nang du mar dang / tshwa/ ja khu bcas blugs te bsrubs nas 'thung srol yod 'duga'abyor ldan pa rnams kyis srub bya dang mnyam du thud dang rtsam pa za ba dang / 'byor med pa phal ches kyang nyin ltar bsrub ja 'thung gi yod pa red/nga tsho gzab rgyas ro bcud ldan pa'i zhogs ja de longs su spyad rjes de nyin gyi gzigs bskor 'tshams 'dre byed sgo dang po bkris 'khyil dgon chen du mchod mjal la basprod rgyu byas/ bla brang bkris 'khyil dgon chen de ni bod chol gsum nangayongs su grags pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon chen gyi gas shig yin/ zer skad 60

cig la/ de snga rgyal po lha bzang khang dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis lha bzang gis sde srid bgrongs pa de'i snying 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gdan zhus kyis bkris 'khyil dgon pa'i g.yang khang du bzhugs gsol thog rgyun du mchod 'bul zhus par brten bkris 'khyil dgon pa de nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mkhas grub snyan grags can phreng rgyud du byung yod par grags/bkris 'khyil dgon pa'i chos gzhis lha sde dang / mi sde/ mchod sde bcas tshogs khag mang po yod/ bkris 'khyil dgon pa'i ming de rim bzhin yul gyi ming du grags/ bar skabs rgya nag pa tshos bsang chur zha ho zhes pa'i ming btags te dgon pa'i 'gram du srid 'dzin las khungs shig btsugs nas bkris 'khyil khul la rgya'i tha snyad zha ho zhan zhes par ming bsgyur byas 'dugang tsho mgron khang nas dgon par mchod mjal du bskyod skabs lam g.yas g.yon du mi dmangs mang po 'tshang ka shig shig gis sgug bsdad 'dug pa nga tsho sdod pa'i mo ṭa de mi dmangs kyi dkyil du gtong skabs de rnams kyis nga tsho mthong ma thag mi rgan rnams kyis lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te gus 'dud zhu ba dang / 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa skya che bskal brgyar brtan pa dang / mgyogs myur bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams su zhabs sor 'khod par shog ces skad shugs chen po'i thog nas smon lam rgyag gi 'dug lam kha'i g.yas g.yon dang / dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i rtser bsangs btang nas du ba nam mkhar skya thul ler 'phyur bzhin 'dug de ni bod mi rnams kyis bla ma dang / dpon chen rnams phar tshur phebs gnang skabs dga' bsu dga' skyel zhu ba'i goms gshis shig yin/ mgron khang nas dgon pa'i bar rkang bgrod byas na chu tshod skar ma bcu tsam las 'gor gyi mi 'dug kyang / sa 6

gnas sne len las byed tshos bde 'jags kyi ched du mo ṭa gra sgrig byas yod ces bshad de nga tsho mo ṭa'i nang 'khrid byung / sne len las byed rnams kyis nga tsho'i bde 'jags srung skyob yin tshul brjod pa de don dngos thog nga tsho dang gzhis lus spyan zu rnams kyi dbar blo nye'i 'brel ba yong rgyur rdugs te nga tsho'i g.yas g.yon du rnam pa 'dra min sna tshogs kyi sgo nas so nyul mang po btsugs yod pa mngon gsal dod po 'dugang tsho bkris 'khyil dgon par 'byor skabs dge 'dun bcu grangs dang / mi dmangs mang po dga' bsu zhu bar slebs 'dug dge 'dun pa rnams nas gra chas gsar rkyang bzhes 'dug pa de ni nye lam de rnams la gra chas gyon chog pa'i bka' 'khrol thob byung zer/phyi lo 1954 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya nag pe cing du phebs zhor a mdo khul sku 'bum byams pa gleng dang / bkris 'khyil dgon chen gnyis la gnas gzigs chibs bsgyur bskyangs pas skabs de'i dgon pa'i gnas stangs dang da lta'i gnas stangs gnyis bsdur na ha lam hon thor dgos pa lta bu 'dug1958 lo dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs lha khang dang / gra shag bcas par gtor brlag shin tu shugs chen byung 'dug dge 'dun rnams btson khang dang /sa thag ring sar btsan khrid kyis mang che ba ngal rtsol ring la bkres ltogs kyis 'chi skyon byung 'dug ces zer/ da lta lhag bsdad pa'i 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bla brang dang / dgon pa'i 'du khang gang la gang tsam bsdad yod pa'i thog skabs der yul mi rnams kyi thabs shes sna tshogs kyi sgo nas skya gsung thugs rten gang la gang tsam zhig bdag nyar byed thub pa byung 'dug 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bla brang gi gzim chung 62

zhig gi nang du sngon tshud nas gra sgrig byas pa'i skya gsung thugs rten rnams la gnas mjal du khrid pa dang / de nas da yod bla sprul re zung nga tsho lhan du zlos gar 'khyab pa lta bu'i mjal 'phrad go sgrig byas song / de nyin dgon par mchad mjal rjes bkris 'khyil khul gyi slob gru dang / bod lugs sman khang bcas la lta skor 'tshams 'drer bskyod/ de'i sang nyin bkris 'khyil gyi byang shar nye mtshams gan skya zhes pa'i 'brog sder lta skor 'tshams 'drer bskyod cing / nga tsho yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul de nyin shas sngon nas thos yod pa 'dra/ nga tsho der 'byor skabs 'brog pa rnams rang rang so so sdod pa'i gur gyi g.yas g.yon sogs la bsangs btang nas sgug bsdad 'dug 'brog pa'i goms gshis la mi tshang phal cher gur gyi nang du sdod pa ma gtogs khang pa skrun srol med cing / 'brog khul re zung la dgon pa dang / lha khang skrun srol yod/ 'brog pa rnams gur gyi nang du sdod dgos don ni sems can dkar nag ded nas rtsa chu gang bzang gi sar skyas spo yang yang byed dgos pas spo thabs bde ba'i ched du yin/ gan skya grong sne'i marjes sdug can gyi yul ljongs dang /me tog tshon mdog sna tshogs kyi dri zhim 'thul ba bcas kyis nged cag tshang ma'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog ste de lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa'i 'brog khul ni mtho ris kyi dpal la co 'dre ba lta bu 'dug snyam pa byung / gan skya grong sde'i mi mang rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad zhing pa'i sa khul las mtho ba yod zer/nga tsho de khul du phar tshur 'tshams 'drir 'groslabs 'brog pa rnams kyiyul srol ltar rta rgyugs btang nas sprosems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu dang / dga' skyel byas byung /nged tsho gan skyanas bkyis 'khyil du phyir 'ag skabs phan tshun bral miphod pa lta byabyung /bkris 'khyil du lta skor 'tshams 'dre zin rjes kun lho bod rigs rang skyong 63

ljongs zhes pa'i lte gnas gtso che'i sa gnas su bskyod pa yin/ de sngon sa khul de 'brog khul zhig yin 'dug pa bar lam rang skyong sa khul gyi lte gnas der gsar skrun byas nas grong khyer che tsam zhig chags 'dug grong khyer chags yul lung gshongs yin stabs gnam gshis tsha grang snyoms po 'dug grong rdal gsar pa'i nang gi las khungs khag dang / bzo ga slob ga sman khang bcas su mi mang che ba rgya mi yin zhing / mtshon rtags lta bur bod mi re zung mthong rgyu 'dug bzo gra re gnyis btsugs pa de tshor yul gyi thon rdzas 'o ma dang / pags rigs sogs sa gnas gzhung gi btsan bsdus kyis rgya nag tu 'dren gyi yod 'dug pa dang / bod rigs tshor rin pa sde sel tsam rag gi yod/dang thog gi 'char gzhi ltar na/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs yul sprus mdo la 'gro rgyu byas yod kyang / lam kha bde bgrod med lugs zer nas lan kra'u la phyir log byas te mtsho sngon khul du thon/ lan kra'u nas zi ling bar me le 113 lhag tsam las med cing / 'gro lam de tsam legs po med stabs bar lam ka kor gyis rkyen pas nyin gang tsam 'gor song / zi ling grong khyer du 'byor pa'i dgong dro der mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi ang gnyis pa bkris dbang phyug gis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs che khag gis dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams pa dang sbrags srol rgyun ltar mtsho sngon khul gyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas ji song dang / mi mang rnams kyi 'tsho ba gong 'phel ji phyin/ 'grim 'grul gsar skrun ji byas/ slob gso 'phel rgyas ji byung bcas kyi gnas tshul dang / bye brag mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi bod rigs rang skyong sa khul bdun gyi gnas babs bcas kyi skor ngo sprod gsal bshad chu tshod gcig lhag tsam byas par brten gsol 64

tshigs kyang grang mor gyur/bkris dbang phyug ni phyi lo 1913 lor khams dkar mjes su skyes shing /1935 lor mdo stod smad sa khul brgyud rgya nag nub byang phyogs su dmar dmag rgyang bskyod bros 'gro skabs dkar mdzes nas kho pa mgo skor bslu brid kyis 'khrid pa'i gras shig yin/ ri 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs kho pas rgya nag byang shar tung pa'i zhes pa'i sa khul la ri 'gog dmag 'khrug nang du zhugs myong yod pa dang / phyi lo 1947 lor rgya dmar gyis rgya nag nub byang sa khul bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i u yon gyi gras su 'dems bsko byas/ 1949 lo mjug tsam la rgya dmar gyis mtsho sngon sa khul dbang bsgyur rjes bkris dbang phyug mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi dang / mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob spyi/ bod ljongs bcings 'grol mkho sgrub las khungs kyi pu'u krang bcas kyi go ming dang / las 'khur blangs yod/ skabs der ma'o tse tung gis kho par bya dga' yang sprad yod 'dug 1953lor kho pas mgo log sa khul gyi las don tshogs chung gi 'go khrid byas te mgo log sa khul du dus yun gang 'tshams bsdad/1953 lo mtsho sngon zhing chen rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mir 'debs bsko byas/ lo der kho pas mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi spyi khyab thog krung go gung khran tang mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi rgyun las hru'u ci/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs brgyad pa'i 'thus mi/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mi rigs don byed las khungs kyi spyi khyab bcas gcig lcog gi las 'gan khur/1954 lor kho pas bkris 'khyil 'jam dbyangs nag rig sogs dang mnyam du u ru su rgyal khab tu rtogs zhib 'tshams 'drer bskyod nas mtsho sngon du 165

phyir 'khor rjes bod mi grags can bla brang gi a pha a blo dang / rme'u rgyal po dpal mgon 'phrin las rab brtan/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sde dge bya rgod stobs ldan/reb gong nang so bkris rnam rgyal bcas thug 'phrad mnyam 'dzoms sar bkris dbang phyug gis ru su'i rgyal khab nang gi mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul so sos rgyal phran lta bu'i rang skyong rtsa 'dzugs byed stangs kyi gnas lugs rnams khong tshor ngo sprod gsal bshad byas nas rgya nag dbus gzhung la don tshan gnyis 'khod pa'i snyan zhu zhig phul/de'i don tshan dang po/ bod spongs dbus gtsang sa khul la rgya skad du ha'u gtsang zer/ ha'u gtsang zhes pa'i go don ni bod rgyab ma/ zhes pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs dang / de'i rgyal sa lha sa/don tshan gnyis pa/ khams dang a mdo sa khul bcas la chan gtsang / chan gtsang zhes pa'i go don ni bod mdun ma zer/ rang ljongs bod rigs sa khul 'dzugs rgyu/ de'i rgyal sa rnga ba 'bar khams su 'dzugs rgyu bcas kyi 'char gzhi bkod de rgyal srid spyi khyab khang brgyud dbus gzhung la phul nas zu bzhi tsam las ma 'gor bar bka' 'khrol chog mchan thon pa'i thog rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis mtha' mtshams zhing chen gsum gyi las don gra sgrig tshogs pa zhig gsar 'dzugs dgos rgyu'i bka' khyab dang sbrags bkris dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis la gong gsal gra sgrig tshogs pa'i 'gan 'khur ba (spyikhyab) dang / a pha a blo dang /bya rgod stobs ldan/ rme'u rgyal po dpal mgon 'phrin las rab brtan/ reb gong nang so bkris rnam rgyal bcas la thon krang gzhon pa (spyi khyab gzhon pa ) bsko bzhag byas/ de bzhin mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi hru'u ci gzhon pa krang go ching la gra sgrig las 66

don bsgrub phyogs kyi 'gan khur ba bskos pa dang / rtsa 'dzugs las don mtha' dag sgrub mkhan las byed bod mi sha stag bsko rgyu'i thog gyon chas bod chas dang / bod yig gtso bor bed spyod bya rgyu/ dngul sgor bed spyod bya rgyu/ bod mi'i rta dmag thon zhes pa'i dmag sgar zhig gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu bcas lag len bstar mur/1955 rla ba bdun brgyad tsam rjes gong gsal las don glo bur du phyir 'then bya dgos kyi bka' 'byor ba ltar phyir 'then byed dgos byung 'dug 1955lor bkris dbang phyug pe cing du rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen du bskyed nas phyir 'khor rjes dus yun de tsam ma song bar kho pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi spyi khyab dang / tru'u ci bcas kyi go ming gnas dbyungs thog gzhon par bzhag 'dug cing / kho pa ni mi gshis drang po dang / kha ri kha thug yin zhing / rig gnas chu tshad de tsam med na yang / bod rigs kyi zhen khog chen po yod pa'i mi zhig red/ de sngon kho pa dang mnyam du dkar mdzes nas rogs par bskyod mkhan nang blo brtan dga' zhes dmar dmag thon zhes pa'o dmag sgar gyi chab srid u yon gyi las khur byed skabs go min tang gis 'dzin bzung byas par brten nyes pa phog pa dang / phyi lo 1949 lo rgya nag yongs su bcings 'grol btang rjes kho pa mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi phyugs las kyi 'go 'dzin las 'gan bsko bzhag byas 'dug kyang / kho pa bod rigs kyi srol rgyun bag chags shugs rkyen che zhing / gshis rgyud drang po/ blo rtsa brtan pa/kha ri kha thug lhag par du bod rigs kyi sha zhen che bar brten dus gtan du nor 'khrul byung yod na'ang/ re zhig snang med kha ya mi byed par bzhag cing rjes su las gnas nas yongs su gnas dbyung btang bar grags so/de'i sang nyin sku 'bum bums pa gling du mchod mjal dang / de nas stag 167

'cher 'khrungs khang bcas su 'tshams 'dre lta skor du bskyod rgyur 'char bkod ltar rim bzhin bskyod/ zi ling nas skya 'bum byams pa gling bar me le 9 tsam las med stabs mo ṭa dal po'i thog chu tshod phyed ka tsam las 'gor ma song /nga tsho skya 'bum du 'byor skabs sku 'bum bla ma rgya yag rin po che dang / che shos rin po che rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i bla sprul mang po phebs sgug gnang nas bzhugs 'dug rgya yag rin po che paṇa chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin yin la/ skya 'bum dgon gyi bla ma mtho gras shig yin/ khong mtsho sngon po'i nub 'gram sog rigs mi tshang zhig tu 'khrungs pa red/ skabs der dgung lo 70 tsam la phebs 'dug nga tsho khyug tsam ngal gso brgyab ste rje tsong kha pa sku bltams sar yod pa'i gser sdong chen mos gtsos pa'i lha khang gzhan rnams la mchod mjal zhu bar bskyod/ sku 'bum dgon pa dang / bkris 'khyil dgon pa gnyis bsdur na sku 'bum dgon par gtor skyon cung drag pa byung 'dug kyang / lha khang dang / gra shag mang po lo mang bdag gnyer ma byung bar char rlung gis nyams chag chen po byung 'dugang tsho rgyal ba tsong kha pa sku bltams sa'i gser sdong chen mos dbus lha khang sogs la mchod mjal rob tsam zhus te a kya sgar par ngal gso dang sbrags nyin dgung gsol tshigs zhu bar 'gro skabs nged kyi gcung mo che ring sgrol dkar dang /khong gi bza' rla bu phrug bcas zur kya sde grong nas sku 'bum la nged rang 'phrad par phebs 'byor 'dug par phan tshun thug 'phrad skabs brjod kyis mi langs pa'i dga' tshor chen po byung /nged cag ming sring gnyis lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring phan tshun 'chi gson ci mchis kyi gnas tshul tsam yang shes rtogs ma byung bas de ring glo bur du 'phrad 168

skabs yud tsam rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin snyam pa'i tshor ba zhig byung /gcung charshas nged rang 'phrad skabs bka' mol tshig gcig kyang ma gsungs par lam seng 'thams te spyan chab lhung lhung du 'bab pa de ni khong mi lo 30 lhag tsamaring mi yul gyi dmyal ba lta bu myong dgos byung bar brten rang dbang med par yid gdung chen po'i ngang chu tshod gcig tsam ring mu mthud nas spyan chab gzags song / de bzhin du nga rang yang sems gdung lhag par che yang / khong la sems gso'i tshig 'ga' shas zhu bsam pa de yang kha nas ma thon par phan tshun 'thams res kyi dbugs ring gtong bzhin par yud tsam ring mi smra bar gnas/phyi lo 1955 lo gcung mo bza' tsho gnyis lha sa nas pe cing du slob sbyong la bskyod de 1959 rjes khong bza' tsho gnyis la rla shas ring phyugs nad sman pa'i slob sbyong rob tsam sprad de bod kyi na gzhon slob phrug khag gcig dang mnyam du bod gsar pa 'dzugs skrun du 'gro dgos red ces skyal 'ded byas pa'i 'og lha sar btang ste khong bza' tsho gnyis lha sa'i lho phyogs lho kha'i lung khug grong gseb gcig tu btang 'dugarig gnas gsar brje'i dus skabs der gcung mo nyin ltar mi mang gi khrod du khrid de khyed kyi gcen po log spyod pa stag lha phun tshogs bkris tā la'i mnyam du phyi rgyal la bros pa red/ kho pa phye rgyal du ma bros gong las don ga re mngags byung ngam/de dag mi mang gi dkyil du ngos len bya dgos zhes yang yang dre ba blangs pa dang / lo shas ring drag po'i 'thab rtsod dang / nyes brdung thengs mang bzed dgos byung /skabs re che 'dir gcen po khyed mjal thub e yong bsam nas yar klung gtsang por rang srog lcebs dgos bsam pa yang yang byung yang / phru gu gso skyong bya dgos 69

pa'i bsam blo 'khor nas mnar gcod sdug khur byas te lo shas bsdad mthar gong rim la rang yul du phyir log gtong rogs zhes snyan zhu phul bar bka' 'khrol thob ste pha yul du rang gi grong sde'i spyi tshogs su rtsis sprod byas byung yang / pha yul du slebs nas mu mthud nas dka' ngal myong dgos byung zhing / dper na/ phar tshur 'gro skabs mi su la yang mig lta mi chog par gus bkur gyis 'gro dgos pa'i mthong chung dang / brnyas bcos myong dgos byung ba ma zad/ lo shas ring ltogs shi thebs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad byung / de ring gcen po khyed mjal thub pa de dkon cog gi thugs rje yin zhes skad shugs chung ngu'i thog nas brjod bzhin du g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i mi gzhan gyis thos mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag dang / 'jigs snang chen po'i ngang lta gi 'dugang tsho zi ling du ma 'byor gong nyin gsum gyi sngon du mtsho sngon zhing chen dang /rdzong gi las byed pa snga rjes su gcung mo'i sar yong ste bza' chas gro zhib dang / mar/sha bcas bskyal ba'i thog khyed kyi gcen po yong gi yod pa khyed rang gnyis thug 'phrad skabs skad cha gang byung ma byung ma shod/ krung go gung khran tang gi thugs rjes gang ci'i thad yag po 'dug da cha dka' ngal gang yang mi 'dug ces bshad na yag po yod red ces 'jigs skyal lta bus nan tan gyis mngags byung zhes gsungs kyi 'dugaskabs der sku 'bum dgon par nyin shas lhod sdod byed bsam kyang / gzhan dbang stabs bsnun 'og gcung mo dang / khong gi bu mo gnyis bcas mi gsum nged mnyam du zi ling du phyir log nas mnyam 'dzoms kyi go skabs legs po zhig byung / de'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog go'achas khang stag 'cher du 'tshams 'dri5skor du bskyod pa yin/nga tsho stag 'cher la ma slebs tsam la glo bur du gnam gshis la 'gyur ba byung 70

ste khyug tsam ring char rlung drag po'i gnod skyon gyis rkyen pas mo ṭa mdun bskyod ma thub pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyang / stag 'tshor grong du 'byor skabs nam mkha' sprin bral sa gzhi rdul dag pa zhig byung ba de ni yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi cho 'phrul min nam snyam byung /de sngon 7gong sa mchog 'khrungs sa'i gzim khang de ni rgyal yab chen mos lha sa nas mi ched brdzongs gnang ste sngon yod 'khrungs khang de bshigs nas gzim khang gsar pa rgya chen po zhig bskyon yod pa de rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor skyon byung 'dug 'khrungs khang gi zur la khang chung zhig yod pa de'i nang du nged kyi de khul bzhugs pa'i spun mched dang / ngo shes tshang mar 'tshams 'dri zhus rjes stag 'cher nas zi ling du phyir log lam zhor nged rang gi yul cong rtsi grong du yod pa'i spyan mched dang / grong pa khyim mches/ ngo shes bcas la 'tshams 'drir khyug tsam bskyod/ khong rnam pa dang kha bral nas lo mang song ba de ring phan tshun 'phrad skabs khong tsho dga' spro'i mig chu dbang med du shor bzhin par dga' bsu byas byung bas nged rang la dga' skyo'i 'tshor ba brjod mi shes pa zhig byung / de rnams kyis nga tsho dang mnyam du rgya mi'i las byed pa yod stabs krung go gung khran dang / ha kru'u zhi'i (hā go hphang ) bka' dren la brten nas 'tsho ba yag po 'dug ces zer ba dang / rgya mi'i las byed pa med skabs da phan lo mang ring sdug bsngal brjod kyis mi langs pa myangs pa'i skor bshad pa dang sbrags mig chu lhung lhung gtong gi 'dug pa rgya mi'i las byed nga tsho'i sar yong skabs khong tshos mig chu 'phyis nas bcos ma'i 'dzum mdangs ston gyi 'dug mi de rnams kyis rnam 'gyur ston stangs de rigs ni lo mang ring rlabs chen gung khran ring lugs kyi bkrin la brten nas slob sbyong thebs pa'i 47ga

'bras bu zhig yin 'dug pa de ni mi dang mi'i dbar gcig gis gcig la yid ches blo gtad mi thub pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin/nga rang skyes sa'i khyim la khu bo'i bu dang / de'i mna' ma sogs nang mi 'ga' shas 'dug khong rnams kyis nga slebs par dga' tshor chen po byed kyang / tha na zhag po gcig kyang sdod long med par 'gro dgos byung ba des skyo snang ha cang chen po byed kyi 'dug pa ltar nga rang yang sems pa ha cang skyo yang/ bya thabs ma byung bar mi 'dod bzhin du khong rnams dang kha bral dgos byung / skyes khang nas zi ling du phyir log rjes de'i sang nyin nga tsho mtsho sngon lho rgyud kyi rma lho bod rigs rang skyong sa khul gyi lte gnas reb gong du 'tshams 'dre lta skor du bskyod pa yin/ lam bar tsong kha skye ri'i la brgyab pa dang / rma chu brgal zhing / reb gong gi sa zin nas lam bar g.yas g.yon grong sde'i bod mi rnams rang rang so so'i grong sde'i nye 'gram du nga tsho yong ba'i lam gyi g.yas g.yon du me tog sna tshogs dang / dri zhim bdug spos/ kha btags bcas lag tu khyer nas nga tsho sgug bsdad 'dug de rnams kyis nga tsho yong ba mthong ma thag nga tsho'i sar 'tshang ga shig shig gyis yong nas brjod kyis mi langs pa'i dga' spro'i rnam 'gyur gyi thog nas nga tshor dga' bsu gnang byung / skabs re khong tshos nga tsho'i mo ṭa bkag nas mdun bskyod ma thub pa yang byung skabs nga tshos mo ṭa nas babs te khong rnams la 'tshams 'dre zhus pa'i thog rang cag bod mi rnams kyi khog pa'i snying dang / lta ba'i mig lta bu'i 7gong sa mchog gi sku khams dang / mdzad 'phrin bcas kyi skor khong tshor zhu skabs khong tshos sor bcu'i 'dab ma spyi bor bkod de rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku che zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang / bod mi rnams sdug bsngal las myur du grol te bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams 172

su mgon po gang gi thugs rje'i bde skyed nyi ma myur du 'char nas nga tsho bod mi rnams khong gi gser zhal myur du mjal ba shog ces skad gsang mthon po'i thog nas smon lam 'debs kyi 'dug rgan khog 'ga' shas nas mig chu gtong bzhin par nga tsho'i lag pa nas bzung ste dga' skyo bzung 'brel gyis dran med du brgyal ba yang 'ga' shas byung song /rong po'i dgon chen gyi nye 'gram du 'byor skabs lam bar g.yas g.yon du mi ha cang mang po 'joms te dga' bsu zhu gi 'dug pa lo rgyus thog de khul la mi 'bor de 'dra 'dzoms myong med ces zer mkhan 'dug mgron khang du ma slebs bar g.yas g.yon du mi ha cang mang po 'tshang ga shig shig gis bsdad 'dug pas nga tsho sdod sa'i mo ṭa re zhig mdun bskyod byed dka' ba'i gnas su gyar/ pho mo rgan byis mang pos nga tsho'i mo ṭa'i phyir dpral ba gtugs nas byin rlabs zhu gi 'dug pa de ni nga tsho 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku tshab yin stabs khong sku ngo ma mjalab dang khyad med snyam pa'i dag snang gus brtsi shin tu zhu ba'i mtshon rtags shig tu mngon/ — nyin gsum ring reb gong rong po dgon chen dang / g.yas g.yon grong sde/ slob gru bod sman gyi sman khang bcas su 'tshams 'dre lta skor du bskyod skabs mi mang rnams nas nga tshor spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i dga' bsu dang / gus bkur tshad las 'das pa zhu gi 'dug nga tsho sa phyogs gang du bskyod kyang mi mang rnams nga tsho'i g.yas g.yon dang / rjes su yong nas smon lam 'debs pa dang / kha 'don byed kyi 'dug nga tsho de khul du sdod skabs mi mang dang 'bral med lta bu byung / rma lho bod rigs rang skyong sa khul de rma chu lho phyogs kyi sa khul khag yin zhing / rang skyong khul 173

gyi lte gnas de reb gong sa khul gyi rong po'i dgon chen gyi nye 'gram du chags yod/de'i khongs gtogs rdzong khag bzhi yod pa de ni/ reb gong dang / gtsan tsha/ rtsa khogarma lho sog rigs rang skyong rdzong bcas yin/ rang skyong sa khul der sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan rdzong khag rnams bod mi yin/rong po dgon chen de reb gong sa khul dge lugs pa'i dgon che shos yin 'dug dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i rab byung drug pa'i chu pho rta lo phyi lo 1342 lor bla ma bsam gtan rin chen gyis phyag btab rjes shar skal ldan rgya mtshos rgya bskyed gnang 'dug 195 sngon du dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis stong tsam yod zer/ gong gsal lo de nas bzung rkyen ngan rim 'phrad kyis dgon pa de dang / gzhan rnams la gnod skyon chen po byung / lhag par rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul skabs sngar las lhag pa'i gnod 'che brjod kyi mi langs pa byung ste dgon pa'i 'du khang gcig pu ma gtogs lha khang / gra shag gra tshang bcas rtsa gtor btang 'dug nga tsho dgon pa'i 'du khang du lta skor la bskyod skabs 'du khang nang du lug pags dang /bal/ gro sogs bzhag 'dug pa las lha skya dang / gsung rab bcas mthong rgyu mi 'dug rgya mi las byed tshos brjod gsal la/ rong po'i dgon chen de rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs skyon chag chen po byung ba red ces zer yang / gnas tshul dngos 'brel byas na phyi lo 1958 lo nas bzung chos ni mi dmangs la gnod skyon gtong mkhan dug red ces bshad de rim bzhin gnod 'tsho btang yod pa red/gang ltar de sngon srid byus sdug po lag len bstar ba rnams kyang shes/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs mi bzhi shog khag gi mgor g.yog gi yod pa de ni rgya mis rang nyid blo rig ldan pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ldan pa zhig yin par rlom 174

pa'i mtshon rtags shig red/ rong po'i dgon chen g.yas g.yon la zhing chen dang /rang skyong khul gyi las khungs khrag slob snya sman khang / las shag bcas skrun 'dug pa ltar slad dgon pa slar gso bya yul med pa gsal por mthong /reb gong sa khul du snga rabs nas bzung bod mi chags yul zhig yin/ dus rabs 13 pa'i rjes bod kyi byang shar nas snga rjes hor rigs de khul du gnas spo byas yod kyang / de rnams lo ngo brgya phrag ring bod mi'i khrod du 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byas par brten chos dang / rig gzhung / goms gshis/ skad yig bcas bod mi dang gcig mtshungs su gyur 'dug lhag par du reb gong khul gyi mi dmangs rnams kyis chos lugs ris med kyis dad gus zhu ba'i srol bzang dus da lta'i bar gnas yod zer/ de bzhin reb gong sa khul la bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal srung skyob dar spel gyi snying stobs zhum pa med pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ reb gong seng ge gshongs kyi lha bris mdo smad khul snyan grags chen po yod pa ma zad/ dbus gtsang khul gyi sgyu rtsal la yang 'gran thub pa zhig yin/ de mtshungs sa khul de nas bod kyi chos dang / rig gzhung / rgyal rabs bcas lo rgyus thog snyan grags yod pa'i mi sna mang po thon yod cing / lhag par deng rabs 'dzam gling nang snyan grags yod pa'i mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel yang reb gong zho 'phang grong du 'khrungs pa red/rgya mi tshos reb gong gi tha snyad du rgya skad la thung ren zhes 'bod kyi yod pa de ni rgya'i rig gzhung dang rang 'drar sgyur ba'i srid byus kyi cha shas shigayin/nga tsho reb gong du nyin gsum sdod ring de'i g.yas g.yon gyi spyi khang dang / ru khag bcas su 'tshams 'dri lta skor du bskyod skabs bod mi spyan zla rnams kyis tshad las 'das pa'i mdza' brtse'i dga' bsu dang / spro sems 'khol ba'i sne len zhus gtam5

pa des nga tsho tshang ma sems 'gul ha cang chen po thebs byung / nga tshos kyang dka' ngal la ma 'jems par nyin gsum ring de khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams la gang thub ci thub thabs shes sna tshogs kyi thog nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon rin po che mchog sku khams gsal bzhugs thog mdzad pa 'phrin las 'dzam gling yongs su khyab pa'i skor dang / rang cag gzhes byes bod mi rnams kyis re bcol bya yul btsan byol gzhung gi gnas stangs bcas khong rnams la gsal bshad gang thub zhus par brten tshang ma blo bde bag phebs byung song/reb gong khul du nyin gsum ring 'tshams 'dri lta skor grub rjes slar yang zi ling du phyir log rjes mtsho lho dang / skye rgu mdo bcas kyi bod rigs rang skyong khul khag gsum la lta skor du thon 'char byas/skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku tshab rnams mdo smad bla brang bkris 'khyil dang / reb gong sa khul khag bcas la 'tshams 'dri lta skor du phebs 'byor skabs bod mi rnams nas bsam brjod las 'das pa'i mdza' brtse dang / bla na med pa'i gus bkur zhus pa de la rgya phyogs kyi sa gnas las byed dang / nga tsho mnyam du pe cing nas lam rogs su yong mkhan las byed pa bcas ha las te dbus gzhung gong rim gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin snyan zhu byas par dbus gzhung gis gnas tshul de thos rjes 'tshab 'tshub ngang blos kyis ma bzod par lha sararang skyong ljongs la gong gsal a mdo khul gyi gnas tshul ji byung rnams bshad pa'i thog ring min tu la'i bla ma'i sku tshab rnams lha sar btang na 'grigs min dang / gal srid lha sar slebs na bod mi rnams kyi rnam 'gyur ji ltar yong min gyi bsam tshul dres par/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyis lo ngo 30 lhag tsam ring bod ljongs mi dmangs rnams kyi chab srid go rtogs ha cang mtho po yod par brten mtsho sngon dang / kun lho 176

sa khul khag gi bod mi nang bzhin tu la'i bla ma'i sku tshab mi lnga la dga' bsu nam yang byed kyi ma red/ 'on kyang 'di khul mi dmangs rnams kyis tu la'i bla ma'i skya tshab rnams la rnam 'gyur ngan pa ston mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems khral yod stabs de rnams la rnam 'gyur ngan pa ston pa dang / kha lud dbyugs pa/ rdo gzhu ba sogs byas na 'grigs kyi ma red ces slob gso rgyag bzhin yod ces snyan seng zhus rkyen pe cing 'brel yod dpon rigs tshos blo bde por gyur yod lugs nga tsho lha sar 'byor rjes gnas tshul go thos byung /skabs der de dag bden brdzun ji yin ma shes kyang / rjes su pe cing du phyir slebs nas gong gsal gnas tshul de dngos 'brel yin pa shes rtogs byung / nga tsho lha sar ma yong gong bod rang skyong ljongs kyis lha sa dang / gzhis rtse sa khul gyi mi dmangs rnams la gong 'khod gnas tshul bzhin slob gso thengs kha shas byas 'dugang tsho rma lho khul nas zi ling du phyir 'khor rjes zla 9 ches 10 nyin mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lte gnas chab char lta skor dang / 'tshams 'drer bskyod/ zi ling nas chab cha bar me le 93 tsam las med kyang / lam kha de tsam bde po med pas mo ṭa dal po'i ngang gtong dgos byung stabs mjes shing lta na sdug pa'i ri klung yul ljongs rnams zhib mor lta ba'i go skabs thob/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong sa khul de mtsho sngon po'i lho phyogs dang / rma chu'i byang ngos su gnas yod stabs sa rgyu ha cang gshin po yod pa ma zad/ gnam gshis kyang dro grang snyoms po 'dug par brten zhing 'brog gnyis ku'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung gi sa khul zhig red 'dugamatsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul de'i khongs rdzong khag lnga tsam yod/ de ni hri ku sde kha dang / shin ha'e/ thung ste/ ku'e nan/ kung ho bcas yin/ rdzong khag lnga la rgya'i 77

ming 'bod pa las/ bod ming yod kyang 'bod kyi med cing / chab cha grong rdal de yang kung ho rdzong gi khongs su gtogs yod/ rdzong khul der mi 'bor nyung ba'i rkyen gyis sa rgyu gshin pa'i sa cha mang po zhig yod pa la rgya nag nas de khul du rgya mi dang /hu'i rigs mang po zhig gnas spo byas dang / byed bzhin yod/ da dung lo bcu phrag 'ga' shas rjes sa khul der rgya mi dang / hu'e rigs/ kha che sha stag gis khengs rgyu nyag cig red 'dug go thos la de khul du ngal rtsol btson sgar gsum yod pa rnams la btson pa mang che ba rgya nag nas btang ba'i shes yon can red zer/nga tsho chab char nyin gnyis lta skor byed ring chab cha nas me le 13 tsam la lung phrang 'gag gam/ tsa na 'gag ces pa rma chu'i grog rong du glog khang chen po zhig 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin yod pa der lta skor du bskyod pa yin/ glog khang de rma chu 'gag nas las gra gzhi khyon ha cang chen po skrun gyi 'dug pa der las mi khri lhag tsam yod lugs zer ba las mi phal cher rgya mi sha stag yin 'dugang tshos chab char nye 'khor bcas la lta skor byas rjes mgo log dang / yus tru'u bod rigs rang skyong sa khul gnyis la mu mthud lta skor 'tshams 'drir bskyod/sa khul de gnyis kyi sa dbyibs ni mtsho sngon gyi sa khul gzhan las mtho zhing / rgya khyon che bas/ cha snyom rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad ki lo mi ṭar bzhi stong yas mas yod par brten dang shing bsal ba'i mtho grangs sa khul zhes grags/ sa khul de gnyis kyi rgya khyon la gzhigs pa'i mi 'bor 'phel rgyas med pa da dung nyam rgud du gyur mngon/ sa khul de gnyis la 'dzam gling yongs su snyan grags yod pa'i chu chen ma chu dang / 'bri chu gnyis kyi chu mgo dang / de bzhin a myes rma chen gangs ri dang /pā yan ha ra bcas kyi gnas yul yin la/ de ga'i ri klung thang gsum la bcos min rang byung gi rtsa chu phun sum tshogs pa yod pas sems can phyugs dkar nag 78

dang / ri dwags gcan gzan bcas kyi 'byung gnas kyang yin/ de min rin thang che ba'i sman rtsa dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu dang / pe mu'u/ kyi lce/ me tog gangs lha sogs dang / shā ba'i khrag ra/ gla rtsi bcas thon rdzas mang po yod/ de min bal dang /pags rigs bcas kyang 'bor chen thon gyi yod/ de lta nyam dga' zhing / bag phebs pa'i yul de gnyis kyi mi rnams kyang mi gshis bzang la/ las la brtson pa/dpa' ngar che ba bcas kyi snyan grags yod/ nga tshos mgo log dang yus hrus sa khul gnyis kyi lam du skyod skabs ri klung thang gsum bcas la sems can dkar nag gis khengs nas 'dugamago log rang skyong khul gyi lte gnas rta'u smad tshang de drwa thang du chags yod pa dang / mgo log rang skyong khul gyi khongs su gcig sgril dang / rma stod/ rma chen/dga' bde/ pad ma/ dar lag bcas rdzong khag drug yod zer/ nga tshos rta'u smad tshang yas mas kyi 'brog sde dang / shu ba gso skyong ra ba bcas la lta skor dang 'tshams 'dre byas rjes de'i sang nyin pā yan ha ra brgyud yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lte gnas skye rgu mdo'i phyogs su bskyod nas de gar nyin gnyis tsam ring lta skor 'tshams 'dre gang thub byas/ yus hru'u zhes pa 'di bod kyi tha snyad du yul shul zhes 'bod kyi yod kyang / rgya mis bod kyi tha snyad kyi sgra de yus tru'u zhes par bsgyur ba zhig red/ yul shul sa khul gyi lo rgyus dang / rig gzhung bcas snga rabs 'od zer stong ldan byung yod par brten da bar gna' shul grags can du ma zhig gnas yod/ yus hru'u bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khongs su nang chen dang / chu dmar leb/ skye rgu mdo/ khri 'du/ rdza stod/ 'bri stod bcas rdzong khag drug yod/bod pa'i srol rgyun gyi sde shog bgrang 'dren skabs rgya mis bzos pa'i rdzong khag drug po 'di rnams khams nang chen rgyal po'i phyi sde'i khongs su gtogs la/ skye rgu 79

mdo/ khri 'du/ 'bri stod bcas kyi sa khul gyi spyi ming du'ang khams sga pa'am sga khog tu 'bod srol yod/nga tshos skye rgu mdo dang / de'i nye 'khor bcas la nyin gnyis ring lta skor 'tshams 'dri gang thub byas rjes slar yang lam de rang brgyud kyi ming du phyir log gis lan kro'u brgyud gnam thog nas bod ljongs kyi rgyal sa lha sa'i phyogs su thon bskyod byas pa bcas so//180

le tshan so bdun pa/rang re'i rgyal sa lha sa dang / sa gnas gnad khag bcas la lta skor 'tshams 'drir bskyod pa'i 'char snang /༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 1979 zla 9 ches 13 nyin snga dro chu tshod bdun par lan kra'u gnam thang nas lha sa'i phyogs su thon te gnam grus lho nub phyogs su kha bltas nas rim bzhin mkha' dbyings su rje mthor 'phur te bod ljongs kyi sa khams ri klung dang / mtha' yas pa'i drwa thang / mche'u du ma bcas lta na sdug pa'i sa babs yul ljongs la lta bzhin pa'i ngang nas lha sa'i lho ngos nye 'dabs yar klung skyid gshongs gnam thang du 'byor te bod ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur zhes pa'i las khungs kyi rgya mi las byed 'ga' shas dang / sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus bcas bsu len du slebs 'dugasde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus ni de sngon bod gzhung gi chab mdo mnga' khul smar khams sa khul gyi sa srung dmag sgar ang dgu pa ta dang dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon yin zhing / 1950 lor rgya dmar gyi bcings 'grol dmag sa khul der btsan 'dzul du yong skabs khong gis 'go dmag rnams 'khrid nas dgra la phar rgol gyi me mda' gcig kyang ma brgyab par rgya mis bstod bsngags ltar 'os langs 8

sam/ mgo btags zhu mkhan de yin/ sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus nga tsho bsu len byas rjes gnam gru de'i nang rgya nag tu tshogs 'du zhig la 'gro gi yin zhes brjod de thon/skabs der skyid gshongs gnam thang btsugs nas dus yun de tsam phyin med stabs 'grul pa'i ngal gso byed yul med par lam seng lha sa'i phyogs su gtsang chu'i chu shul zam chen brgal nas thon te lam bar chu tshod gnyis tsam 'gor song /dus skabs der lha sa nas skyid gshongs gnam thang bar gyi lam du snum snyigs bting mi 'dug kyang / de sngon las 'grul bzhud bde ru phyin 'dug nga tshos lha sa'i nub 'dabs snye thang lha chen po'i sar 'byor skabs rtse po ta la de gzil rngams ldan pa'i thog sngarabazhin 'gying nger gnas pa ltar mjal/ zhib tu mjal skabs sngon ma'i gzi brjed dang mdzes nyams mchog gyur gyi rnam pa de yal nas kha dog thal mdog zhig gis sgrib g.yogs byed pa lta bu'i gnas stangs de mthong ma thag rang dbang med par yid mug brjod kyi mi langs ba zhig byung /nga tshos pe cing nas lha sar ma yong sngon snye thang khul gyi ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi btson sgar zhig nang du bod rang btsan gyis don du rtsod len tha nan gnang mkhan dpa' bo a mdo stod ma'i shog chung rgan blo bzang dbang phyug la khyag tsam ngo 'phrad bya rgyu khas len byas yod kyang / snye thang sa gnas su slebs nas brtsad gcod byed skabs rgya mi'i las byed tshos 'di nas yar tsam la yod ces kho na bshad nas mgo bskor btang ste mo ṭa'i kha lo pas mo ṭa mgyogs por btang ste skad cig tsam la lha sa'i nye 'gram gyi byang ngos brag ri khug mgron khang ang gsum par 'byor te nga tshos rgan blo bzang dbang phyug lags khyug tsam mjal 'phrad zhu ba'i dus skabs ma byung 82

bar rang bzhin gyi blo pham byung lugs skor rgya mi las byed sku zhabs rin ring la pe cing nas nga tshor bod la mi su thug 'phrad byas na'ang thug chog pa dang / sa gnas ga par blta gi yin na'ang bltas chog gi red/ rgan blo bzang dbang phyug thug 'phrad chog gi red ces khas len gnang ba de da ring lag len ma bstar ba blo pham byung lugs brjod skabs kho pas gad mo zhig dgad nas dgongs dag rjes su thugs 'phrad chog gi red/ dus tshod nges par go sgrig byas chog ces kha snyan po bshad yod kyang /rjes su gnas tshul gzhan dag la bsnyad 'dogs kho na byas nas thug 'phrad byed du ma bcug pa red/de nyin brag ri khug mgron khang du 'byor nas khyug tsam ngal gsos rjes sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan dang / nged gnyis lha sa'i grong khyer de ji lta bur gyur yod dam snyam nas khrom bskor du khyug tsam bskyod de lha sa'i khrom gzhung dang / lam bar du phar tshur 'gro bskyod byas par bod mi rgan pa re zung tsam bod chas gyon pa las mang che bas rgya chas gyon 'dug par brten rgya nag tu slebs pa lta bu'i tshor snang zhig byung / gnas tshul de dag la gzhigs na legs bcos ma thub par da mus bzhin gnas che bod kyi rig gzhung dang / goms gshis bcas ring min rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha chen po mi yong ngam snyam pa byung /nged gnyis khrom gzhung la phar tshur bskor ba rgyag bzhin par sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog gis lam du 'phrad pa'i pho mo rnams la phyag g.yug g.yug gnang ba'i thog nga tsho rgya gar nas khyed rnams la thug 'phrad du slebs yod lta/sang gnangs lhod lhod thug chog ces gsung gsang mthon po'i thog nas gsungs par phar tshur 'gro mi rnams kyis ya mtshan ha las shing / mig hrig hrig gis nga gnyis 83

la bltas pa las su zhig gis kyang nga gnyis sar tshur yong nas ji yin dre brtsad mi byed cing / de bzhin thad kur brda lan byed ma phod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan song yang /snying dbus nas 7gong sa mchog gis gtong gnang mdzad pa'i sku tshab rnams yin pa shes nas dga' 'tshor chen po byung ste bod mi gcig gis gcig la brda sprod byed thub pa byung lugs kyi gnas tshul rjes su go thos byung /rang cag bod mi rnams kyi goms gshis ltar phyogs mthar thon kha dang / tshur 'byor gdong bcas pa dang thog lha sa'i jo shāka rnam gsum mjal rgyu de gtso bor 'dzin gyi yod stabs nga tsho mi lnga yang de'i sang nyin snga dro gtsug lag khang du jo bo shākya mu nis gtsos pa'i sku rten rnams la mchod mjal du bskyod rgyu'i gra sgrigs byas te sang nyin 1979 zla 9 ches 25 nyin snga dro gtsug lag khang du slebs skabs g.yas g.yon la 'grul bzhud dang / mchod mjal du yong mkhan mi de tsam mthong rgyu med pa'i skyo snang chen po byung /skabs der jo bo shākya mu ni gcig pur skyon chag de tsam byung med pa las/ de min sku rten mang che ba rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor skyon chen po byung 'dug par gsar bzhengs byed pa'i skabs red/ nga tsho mchod mjal zhus rjes gtsug lag khang gi rtse thog tu slebs skabs khyams ra'i gzhung sgo'i phyi jo bo dbu skra'i nye bskor thang chen der lha sa'i mi mang ha lam nyi khri lhag tsam zhig 'dzoms te ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun gyi bod mi rnams kyi snying dang 'dra ba'i 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma rin po che mchog nas da ring bod kyi rgyal sar ched brdzong mdzad pa'i sku tshab lnga la dga' bsu zhu bar bcar yod ces skad shugs chen por brjod 'dug par brten nga tshos gtsug lag khang gi rtse thog nas de rnams la lag pa g.yug g.yug gi brda lan (sgo

zhus pa'i thog khong tsho'i sar mar phyin nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog gis nga tsho mi lnga gzhis lus spyan rla rnams la mtshams 'dre zhu bar gtong gnang mdzad pa'i skor dang / lhag par lo ngo nyi shu'i ring nga tsho kha bral nas khyed rnams kyis sdug bsngal tshad las brgal ba myangs par sems gso yod pa dang / de mtshungs 7gong sa mchog gi bla na med pa'i dbu khrid 'og rgya gar sa thog tu yod pa'i bod kyi btsan byol gzhung dang / byes 'byor mi mang rnams kyi gnas stangs bcas kyi skor gsal bshad gang thub byed skabs der mi mang rnams dang / nga tsho'i dbar sngon du ched btsugs lcags dra'i ra ba zhig bskor yod pa dang / ra ba'i dkyil du sgo chung zhig bzos yod pa'i phyi nang gnyis la rgya mi'i zhi drag chas gos gyon pa'i nyen rtogs pa mang po bkag 'doms byed par bzhag yod kyang / mi mang rnams kyi 'tshang kha shugs che brgyabs nas sgo chung de gtor te mi mang rnams nga tsho'i sar rgyugs yong nas nga tsho'i mtha' bskor gyis ngu 'bod kyi sgo nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis gtong gnang mdzad pa'i sku tshab rnam pas skya ngal 'dzems med kyis rang re'i bod ljongs sa khul khag dang / lhag par rgyal sa lha sar phebs te da ring nga tshor mtshams 'dri gnang ba der snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhes mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis skad sgra gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu bsgrags pa dang / mi rgan pa 'ga' shas kyis khyed rnam pas da res gzigs bskor gzab gzab yag po zhig gnang rogs gnang /mi tshang 'di ni g.yo sgyu khram gsum byang chub pa zhig yin/ zhes nan gtan gyis mngags pa dang / yang khag cig gis nga tshor 'thams nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon rin po che mchog gi zhabs 'degs sdig po zhu rogs gnang zer/'ga' zhig gis 7gong sa mchog mgyogs nas myur du lha lhan rgyal khab la ga85

zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / bod ljongs yongs su skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba/ mgon po mchog gi skya che bskal brgyar brtan pa shog ces skad gsang mthon po'i sgo nas sgrogs bzhin pa'i ngang rgya mi'i las byed mang po mi dmangs kyi dkyil nas nga tsho'i sar yong ste rim bzhin nga tsho'i mtha' bskor te nga tsho'i lag pa 'then pa dang / 'bud rgyag brgyabs nas nga tsho mo ṭa'i nang du srung skyob yin lugs kyis bcug byung /dang thog mi mang rnams kyis lcags dra'i ra ba'i sgo chung gtor nas nga tsho'i sar rgyugs yong skabs rgya mi las byed rnams gar song med par bros pa dang / de mtshungs nga tsho srung skyob bam/ so lta byed mkhan nyen rtogs pa rnams kyang mi dmangs kyi khrod du rang mgo ma thon pa'i gnas su gyur 'dugang tsho lha sar ma 'byor gong la rgya mis lha sa'i mi mang rnams skong tshogs byas nas ring min tā la'i bla mas bod ljongs su blta bskor ba mi lnga btang yod pa de rnams bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mi sna'i gras zhe cig red/ de'i nang du khyed rnams nas ngo shes pa yang yod red/ lhag par du tu la'i bla ma'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan dang / khong gi gcen mo'i khyo bo sku srung mda' dpon gnyis yod pa phal cher khyod tshos ngo shes kyi red/ blo bzang bsam gtan de sngon a mi ri kur phyin nas a ri'i mi ser byas yod stabs bod mi'i khongs su gnas yod pa ma red/ mi lnga po de krung dbyang gzhung gis bod ljongs su lta bskor byas 'thus kyi khas len byas nas yong pa yin stabs khyed rang tshos rdo gzhu ba dang / lud pa dbyugs pa/ mig log blta ba bcas kyi rnam 'gyur sdug cag bstan te ngo rgol byas na 'gregs kyi ma red/ de bzhin khyed rang tsho'i nang nas sngon gyi dpon 'bangs sam/ ngo shes kyi 'du shes bzung nas de rnams kyi sar kha btags 'khyer te 'gro dgos kyi ma red/ gal srid 86

de rnams khyed tsho'i sar yong na sne len byed pa las skad cha gang byung mang po ma bshad na dga' gi red/ bshad na sdig po yong gi ma red ces 'jigs bskul nan tan bshad 'dug 'on kyang gnas tshul dngos la rgya mis rnam kun nas 'chang ba'i bsam tshul dang yongs su phyin ci log pa'i gnas tshul de lta bu byung gshis/ rgya mi mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa tsho hang sangs hon 'thor gyis da bar bod ljongs su lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring krung go gung khran rang gis bod mi rnams la zhi drag 'jam rtsub sna tshogs kyi sgo nas slob gso byas pa de la 'grub 'bras ldog phyogs 'di lta bu byung /skabs der nga tsho mnyam du yong mkhan rgya mi'i las byed sku zhabs ku'o ra'i dang / rin ring gnyis phran sar yong nas da ring lha sa'i mi dmangs rnams kyis khyed rang tshor dga' bsu de lta bu zhus par hang sangs byung / ma 'ongs par tu la'i bla ma sku ngo ma bod du phebs na bod mi rnams kyis khong la dga' bsu ji ltar zhu rgyu nga tsho'i blo yul la nam yang 'char mi thub pa yong gi red/ khyed kyi bsam tshul ji 'dra zhig 'dug gam zhes zer ba'i lan du/ bod rgya mi rigs dbar gyi bsam gzhigs byed stangs tha dad yin par ngos 'dzin dang / brtsi 'jog byed thub na bod rgya mi rigs dbar lhags pa'i 'gal zla rnams bde blag tu sel thub kyi red/ tā la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs gnang na dge mtshan chen po yong gi red ces lab par khong gnyis kyis mgo gug gug byas pa las tshig gzhan gang yang ma brjod par phyir log byas song /de nyin lha sa'i mi mang rnams kyis de lta bu'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa dang rgya mis bod mi rnams kyis tā la'i bla mar dad gus 'gyur med kyi sems shugs ma nyams pa ji yod tshod dpag byed ma thub pa dang / lhag par lo ngo nyi shu'i ring rgya mis gso 87

skyong byas pa'i 'byor med gral rim na gzhon yar thon can phal mo ches de nyin lha sa'i mi dmangs khrod du zhuḍa te gdong len gyi 'gan 'khur gtso bor byas par brten rgya mis bod mi byings la de tsam gyi mkhregs po ma byas pa rang babs su bzhag 'dugaches nyer bdun nyin rang mos thog rang rang so so'i ngo shes khag la thug 'phrad du bskyod de da bar lo ngo nyi shu ring de rnams kyis mi yul du dmyal ba las lhag pa'i myong ba'i sdug bsngal ji byung skor brjod gleng byas te yid gdung chen po byung /ches nyer brgyad nyin rtse pho brang la mchod mjal du bskyod/ skabs der rtse po ta la'i yas mas su 1959 lor rgya mis me skyogs kyis gtor skyon byas pa khag la nyams gso byed kyin 'dug nga tshos rtse po ta la bde yangs shar la 'byor skabs pho brang yas mas su nyams gso byed mkhan las mi rnams dang / lha sa'i mi dmangs khag gcig bcas nga tsho'i sar rgyugs yong nas dga' bsu zhus pa dang /las mi 'ga' shas kyis nga tsho la gzigs skor yag po gnang dgos/ rtse pho brang yas mas gzim chung khag dang / rgyal ba rim byon gyi gser sdong / rnam sras gan mdzod kyis gtsos pa'i gan mdzod khag bcas nang gi rin bral gser nor dang / dngos po yongs rdzogs bsngogs 'don byas zin pa der thugs snang gnang dgos lugs gsang brda lta bu btang byung / de nas nga tshos rtse pho brang yas mas lha khang dang / 7rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon gyi gser sdong chen mo khag gzim chung khag bcas su mchod mjal rim zhus la lha skya rnams sngon ma dang mi mthun par bsgrigs bsham byas khul tsam las/ gzil nyams byin chags kyi rnam pa med pa'i thog gang sar thal rdul gyis khengs 'dugalhag par rgyal ba'i gzim chung shar rgyud nang du sngon yod kyi mchod chas dang / 88

'dzin chas ji bzhin med pa'i thog mi 'dra gral sgrig mchod chas 'ga' shas bsgrig bsham byas 'dug pa de rnams tā la'i bla mas dus rgyun du bed spyod byed pa'i dngos po yin zhes bod rgya yi ge shan sbyar gyi shog lte bzhag 'dugade mtshungs gser sdong rnams kyi phyi dbyibs mjal dus sngon bzhin skyon med bzhugs pa ltar snang yang lha sa'i mi mang kun gyis 1959 lo nas da bar lo ngo nyi shu tsam ring rtse pho brang nang du bod mi ma btang bar brten bod gzhung gis lo ngo brgya phrag ring gsogs 'jogs gnang ba'i gser dngul dang / rin thang bral ba'i dngos po rnam sras gan mdzod sogs nang bzhag yod pa rnams rgya mis bsngogs bton gyis stong pa stong rkyang bzos yod pa gdon mi za ba red ces zer/gong gsal bshad tshul la gzhigs na/ lo rabs drug bcu'i nang hong kong dang/ma kha'o sa gnas gnyis la bod kyi sku rten rnying ma dang / sku thang rnying ma mang po de bzhin rin thang bral ba'i dngos nor mang po bcas phyir tshong byas yod/ de ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i nyes skyon gyong gun chen po zhig red snyam skyo snang chen po byung ba'i ngang mgron khang du phyir logade nyin dgong dro bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs zhes pa'i ming thog nas nga tsho mi lnga la dga' bsu'i gsol ston yin zhes mgron 'bod ltar bskyod/gsol chigs ma bsham sngon gong gsal chab gros khongs 'ba' pa blo bzang tshul khrims kyis gtsos pa'i de sngon bod gzhung gi sku drag dang bla ma bcas 'ga' shas mnyam du phan tshun bsam tshul brje len yin tshul gyi zhugs mol tshogs 'du lta bu tshogs/ blo bzang tshul khrims kyis da ring phyi rgyal nas pe cing brgyud khyed rnam pas bod ljongs su gzigs bskor du phebs par nga tshos dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ khyed rnam 89

pas ga re gzigs 'dod yod na'ang gzigs na 'grig gi red/ mi su thug 'dod yod na'ang thug 'phrad byas na 'grig gi red/ khyed tshos mkhyen gsal ltar de sngon bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs gang 'dra yod pa dang / da cha spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gnas stangs ji 'dra zhig gyur yod pa gzigs na mkhyen gyi red/ 'on kyang lo ngo bcu'i ring mi bzhi shog khag gis bod ljongs tsam ma yin par rgyal yongs tshang mar 'gal rkyen gyis gno da 'che phog yod pa red/ 'on kyang mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa nas bzung de sngon gtor skyon byung ba'i dgon pa khag sogs la gang thub kyi nyams gso byed mus red/ de bzhin lo ngo 'ga' shas ring zhing pa rnams kyis nas 'debs ma chog par dgun gro 'debs bcug pa/ de yang bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshis la phyogs 'gal gyi las ka lag len bstar ba red/ gang yin zhu na/ bod rigs rnams kyis rtsam pa za ba las gro zhib de tsam za gi yod ma red/ de yin tsang bod mi rnams la dka' ngal chen po 'phrad song / da cha bod mi rnams kyi goms gshis ltar/ nas 'debs 'jug gi yod lugs bcas 'grel bshad mang po byas/de min der yod chab srid gros tshogs kyi mi rnams nas tshig gcig kyang ma brjod pa'i thog blo bzang tshul khrims kyis gang bshad la rjes su 'brangs pa'i rnam pa ston 'dug de rnams ni rgya mis rgyal gces yar thon can gyi mi sna zhes mthongs chen po byed pa'i tshul gyis bed spyod byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul skabs mi de tshor rdung deg chen po phog yod 'dugablo bzang tshul khrims ni 'ba' pa yin zhing / phyi lo 1949 lo 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal lha sa nas 'ba' yul tu phyir 'khor rjes 'ba' khul du yod pa'i 90

na gzhon gang 'tshams shig gis shar bod dmangs gtso na gzhon rang skyong mna' sbrel tshogs pa zhes pa zhig gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i tshogs mi'i gas yin/1950 lor krung go gung khyan tang bcings 'grol dmag sgar ang 18 khongs su zhugs te 1951 lo mjug lha sar slebs pa'i gas shig yin/ de nas rim bzhin go gnas 'phar te da char krung go bod sdod u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa ang gnyis pa dang / bod ljongs chab srid gros tshogs lhan khang gi kru'u rin bcas kyi go gnas yod pa red/ khong mi gshis drang po dang / bod zhen yod stabs bod mi rnams kyis khong la bstod bsngags byed kyi yod pa red/de nyin gsol ston gyi sbyin bdag gtso bo sangs rgyas ye shes dang / blo bzang tshul khrims gnyis yin zhing / sangs rgyas ye shes ni de sngon phran dang thengs 'ga' shas 'phrad myong yod pa'i grogs po yin/ khong gi rgya mi'i ming la than pa'o zhes zer/khong gi skyes yul mdo smad rgyal rong bstan pa'am rong mi brag mgo nas yin/ phyi lo 1935 lor dmar dmag mdo stod smad shar rgyud dkar mjes sogs sa khul brgyud rgya nag byang phyogs yan an khul du bros bskyod skabs gong gsal bod kyi sa khul khag nas bod mi na gzhon du ma btsan 'khrid byas pa'i gras shig red/ de rjes yan an mi rigs mtho slob nas thon te dmar dmag khongs zhugs te rim bzhin hreng sde tshan gyi chab srid u yon dang / 1949 lo rjes/ rgyal khab mi rigs u yon lhan khang gi u yon/ tshogasami/ shi'i khang (mdostod smad phyogs ) bod rigs rang skyong khyal gyi kru'u zhi bcas byas yod pa red/ lo shas sngon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi tshab tu bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kru'u zhi dang / krung go bod sdod u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gzhon pa'ang yin 'dug/9

gsol ston skabs sangs rgyas ye shes dang phran gnyis rkub stegs gshib gshib yin stabs phan tshun spyir btang bka' mol ma yin pa tshig gnad re zung yang bshad res byung / lhag par gsol ston grol ba'i mtshams sbyin bdag dang sku mgron tshang ma chang gis phran bu bze ba'i skabs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis phran gyi lag pa nas bzung ste rgya dpon gyi bdag skyong 'og bod rigs las byed tshos nus pa bton dka' zhes skad shugs chung chung thog nas bshad byung ba kho pa'i kun slong ji yin ma rtogs pas lam seng lan gang yang sprod thub ma song zhing / rjes su mi 'ga' shas kyi brjod gsal la kho pa gung khran tang mi rgan gras shig yin na'ang bod rigs la sha zhen yod pa'i mi zhig red zer/ches 29 nyin snga dros ngo shes khag la thug 'phrad du sngar bzhin bskyod/ phyi dror bod rang skyong ljongs dmag khul khang thun mong gi gsol ston bshams pa'i rjes bod srol yin tshul gyi rnam pa 'gyur ba'i zlos gar 'khrab ston du mgron 'bod ltar bskyod/de'i sang nyin ni/ 1979 zla 10 ches 1 nyin de krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs byas nas lo ngo sum bcu 'khor ba'i rgyal ston nyin mo 'khel ba yin stabs rgya mi tshos nga tsho mi lnga la sang nyin nor bu gling gar spro skyed gtong bar phebs rogs zer ba ltar de nyin nor gling pho brang yas mas su mchod mjal dang sbrags bskyod skabs lha sa'i mi dmangs kyang gang 'tshams shig nor bu gling gar sngon 'byor gyis gling kha'i gseb tu thar thor byas nas spro skyed gtong ba'i tshul du bsdad 'dugadang thog nga tshos nor gling skal bzang pho brang dang / gzim chung yas mas 92

bcas la mchod mjal dang blta bskor bskyod de skal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung nang / 7rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dus su bzhengs pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa byin can de rtsa gtor gyis gar song mi 'dug cing / de mtshungs gzim chung 'gag gi phyi la rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs pho brang g.yas g.yon gyi lha khang khag dang / lha sa'i nye 'khor gyi dgon pa dang / lha khang khag bcas kyi skya rten gtor skyon byas pa'i sku rten gyi chag ro ri chung zhig ltar spungs nas bzhag yod pa de mthong ma thag snying la gzer brgyab pa lta bu'i tshor snang byung / de sngon pho brang gsar pa'i yas mas rnams su dri zhim 'thul ba'i mjes sdug can gyi me tog sna tshogs kyis gzab mchor spras pa lta bu yod na yang / da cha me tog sna gcig mthong rgyu med pa'i thog ljon shing rnams kyang nyams rgud du gyur yod pa ma zad/ khor yug gi gnas bab sa rgod lta bu chags 'dug pa'i gnas stangs rnams mngon sum du mthong skabs 'jig rten 'di bzhin skad cig re re la yang 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba'i chos nyid dngos 'brel red snyam pas yid la mi rtag rgyud bskul gyi nyams snang zhig kyang byung /pho brang gsar pa'i gzim chung nang rtse pho brang bzhin 'dzin chas rdzun ma 'ga' shas bzhag 'dug pa'i thog 1955 lor rgya gar gzhung gis phul ba'i sgra sdud 'phrul 'khor chen po de gcig pu rang 'jags bzhag 'dug pa de dgos don gyis ched du bzhag pa 'dra snyam/ nor gling pho brang yas mas su mchod mjal dang blta bskor rob tsam byas rjes der 'dzoms pa'i bod mi rnams la mtshams 'dri zhus par mi dmangs khrod du na gzhon 'ga' shas kyis sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog yar bkug nas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku che bskal brgya'i bar brtan pa shog ces dang / bud med zhig gis bod rang btsan myur du thob pa shog 93

ces skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags song /nga tshos lha sar nyin bdun sdod ring blta bskor mtshams 'dri gang lcogs bskyod rjes re zhig byang nag chu dang / gtsang khul bcas la rim bzhin bskyod/1979 zla 10 ches na nyin snga dro lha sa nas 'dam gzhung rgyud nag chu'i lam gzhung la snum snyigs bting ba'i skabs yin stabs nag chu bar nyin gang 'gor zhing / nag chur nyin gcig las sdod rgyu ma byung yang / de'i yas mas su gnas pa'i 'brog sde spyi khang re zung la mtshams 'dro blta bskor byas par 'brog khul mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba ha cang dbul zhing phongs par gnas 'duganag chu mnga' khul de sa mtho grang ngar chen po yin na'ang rtsa kha bzang ba'i 'brog khul sa gnas shig yin pa ma zad/ de sngon tshong las 'khrug po 'khel sa zhig kyang yin/ lhag par du dmag don thog la gnad chen po yod par brten rgya mis bod ljongs yongs su drag shugs kyis kha lo sgyur ba'i gnas sa bya yul du bzos 'dugargya mis bod byang khul mi med lung stong sar me shugs phur mda'i rten gzhi dang /deng rabs can gyi drag chas kyi bang mdzod/ ched las dmag dpung gi dmag sgar bcas bzhag yod pa red/dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ bar lam rgya nag nas pha ran si'i rgyal khab tu btsan byol du yong ba'i rgya mi gsar 'god pa thang rda shan zhes pa de sngon bod du lo shas sdod pa'i ring bod kyi sa khul phal che bar bskyod myong 'dug pas khong bod kyi byang phyogs 'brog khul du gnas tshul 'tshol zhib dang / 'dri brtsad du 'gro skabs nag chu'i byang ngos a mdo'i nye 'dab khul la rdul phran gyi snyigs ro sbas sa zhig yin pa shes 'dug khong sa gnas der ma bskyod sngon khong la rang skyong ljongs 'brel 94

yod las khungs kyi gnad yod las byed zhig gis da bar lo shas ring nub phyogs rgyal khab gcig gi rdul phran mkho med snyigs ro bod kyi byang thang khul du sbed rgyu'i chog mchan dbus gzhung nas sprad pa de'i gla rin rnams dbus gzhung gis blangs yod pa phyin chad bod rang skyong ljongs la sprod dgos pa'i bka' mol zhu bzhin yod/gnas tshul de go nas sa gnas su gnas tshul 'tshol zhib tu bskyod kyang sa gnas de'i nye 'gram la slebs ma thag der yod sa srung dmag gis 'dzin bzung byas nas nag chu bar bskyal ba red ces nged la bshad byung / gong gsal gnas tshul de rnams la gzhigs na bod byang thang sa khul de rnams dmag don thog ha cang gal gnad chen por thug gi yod/ de bzhin mtsho sngon nas lam chen thog nag chu sa khul brgyud bod kyi sa mtshams khag la dmag mkho'i dngos rdzas rnams bde blag tu 'or 'dren thub kyi yod/nga tshos nag chur mtshams 'dre grub rjes mar yong skabs lam de rang brgyud yangs pa can du phyir log ste zhag gcig bsdad/ de'i sang nyin yangs pa can sa khul la gsar bskrun byed bzhin pa'i sa 'og tsha nus glog khang gi las sar khyug tsam blta bskor byas shing / sa 'og tsha nus glog khang 'dzugs bskrun zin rjes lha sa dang /de'i yas mas grong gseb khag bcas la glog shugs 'dang nges yong gi yod pa ma zad/ lha sa'i mi mang rnams kyi nyin re'i 'bar rdzas kyang 'bal 'bal lhag lhag 'dang gi red ces zer/ de ni rnam kun rgya mi'i las byed tshos 'ud shob shod srol yod par snyam yang / slad sa 'og tsha nus glog khang 'thus tshang btsugs zin rjes phan thogs gang 'tshams yong rgyu yin par mngon/de nyin dgong dro bod kyi grong khyer ang gnyis pa gzhis ka rtser 'byor nas nyin 95

bzhi'i ring bkris lhun po dgon par mchod mjal dang / slob grwa dang / 'chems bzo mnyam las khang/ lag shes bzo gra bcas la blta bskor 'tshams 'drir bskyod skabs 'chems bzo mnyam las khang du bzo pa pho mo brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i khrod du rgan mo zhig yod par nged nas rgan mo khyed lo ga tshod slebs yod dam dris par/rgan mos mgo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin pa'i thog nas lo bdun cu don lngar slebs yod ces zer/ bu phrug ga tshod yod dres par/ rgan mos 'khyar re 'khyor re'i ngang nas bu phrug gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang krung go gung khran tang gi bkrin la brten nas 'tsho ba yag po yod ces brjod skabs mid pa 'gag nas mig gnyis nas mchi ma lhug lhag babs 'dug pa/ skabs der de'i g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i las mi gnyis kyi rgas mo de khang chung zhig tu 'khrid song ba rdung rdeg btang mi yong ngam snyam pa'i ya nga snying rje skyes kyang / rogs phan gang yang ma thub/ rgan mo de ni gnod 'che phog mkhan gyi gras yin 'dug pa des nga tshor rnam 'gyur de 'dra bstan stabs khong la 'gyod sems chen po byung /bkris lhun po dgon chen gyi phyi dbyibs su rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs de tsam gtor skyon byung med pa lta bu snang yang paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi mchod sdong rnams gtor skyon 'dugade bzhin bod kyi chab srid kyi lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i gzhis ka rtse rdzong chen de'i stod char gris gtub pa bzhin gtor skyon chen po byung 'dug pa de dag mi su zhig yin rung mthong ba tsam gyis phangs sems chen po dang gtor bcoms kyi srid byus ngan nag der khong khro dbang med skye dgos pa zhig bzos 'dug lhag par bod mi rjes 'jug rnams kyis der 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa yal thabs med pa zhig 'chang rgyu dang / 96

rgya mi rjes 'jug rnams la ngo gnong dgos pa'i nag thig cig phog yod pa lta bur mngon/nga tshos gzhis ka rtse khrom gzhung nang blta bskor du 'gro skabs de khul mi mang rnams kyis thag ring nas nga tshor blta ba las nga tsho'i sar yong ma nus pa dang /gal srid nga tshos de rnams yod sar bskyod skabs mi tshang mas ga byed 'di byed med pa'i ngang 'jigs snang skyes te bros thabs byed kyi 'dug mi 'ga' shas kyis khyim sgo brgyabs nas sgo'i seng nas nga tshor blta ba dang / yang khag gcig gis nga tsho khong tsho'i sar yong ba mthong ma thag nad bdag yong ba lta bu'i brel 'tshab kyis sgo la sgo lcags brgyabs nas gab yib byed kyi 'dug de dag gi yong rkyen ni nye char lha sa'i mi mang rnams kyis tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi ngang nas nga tshor dga' bsu zhus pa'i rkyen gyis rgya mi mtho rim dpon rigs rnams 'jigs nas nga tsho de khul ma slebs sngon gzhis rtse grong khyer mi mang rnams la 'jigs bskul nan po byas yod par brten slad dka' ngal mi yong ched nga tsho dang thug 'phrad mi yong ba'i thabs shes kyis bros thabs dang / gab yib byed kyi yod pa yin 'dugagazhis ka rtser blta bskor zin rjes rgyal rtse khul du thon te nyin gnyis ring rgyal rtse grong rdal 'bring rim slob gra dang / rum thag lag shes bzo las/ glog khang sogs la rim bzhin blta bskor 'tshams 'drer bskyod de rgyal rtse 'bring rim slob grwa de'i gnas stangs ha cang skyo po 'dug skabs der slob grwa ba grangs 'bor gsum brgya skor yod ces zer yang / slob grwa'i sgrig chas khag zhan pas ma tshad/ slob phrug rnams kyi nyal gdan gyi tshab tu gzan pa bed spyod byed kyi 'dug slob phrug mang che ba rgyal rtse mnga' khul zhing 'brog khul nas yong ba red ces dang / 'bring rim slob gru de bzhin rdzong khag rer btsugs yod lugs zer/ de 'brel slob grwar nyin re'i slob 97

sbyong gtso bo rgya yig dang / de min bod yig phran tsam slob kyi yod 'dug gong gsal slob grwa'i gnas tshul de bzhin rgyal rtse rum thag lag shes bzo gra de yang ming tsam du gnas 'dugade sngon bod kyi rum gdan thon khungs gtso bo rgyal rtse yin pa 'dzam gling du snyan grags yod pa red/ da char rjes lus thebs pa'i rgyu rkyen de ni gzhung gis bdag gnyer byed pa de yin 'dug nga tshos rgyal rtse nas sna dkar rtse brgyud lho kha phyogs su blta bskor mtshams 'drer thon te rtsod thang khul la nyin gnyis ring mi dmangs spyi khang dang / slob gru de bzhin dus rabs bdun pa'i sngon la bskrun pa'i snga rabs kyi rjes shul yum bu bla sgang ngam/ yum bu lha mkhar bcas la blta bskor du bskyod/yum bu lha mkhar de sne gdong nye 'dabs kyi ri bo'i rtser gnas yod/ phyi lo ma byung sngon gyi lo brgya phrag gcig tsam sngon du bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su gsar bskrun byas pa'i pho brang dang po de yin zhes bod kyi lo rgyus rgyal rabs chos 'byung rnams su gsal/ bar skabs rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zings skabs gtor skyon byas pa'i gyang ro phran bu las lhag mi 'dugade'i lho nub de tsam thag mi ring bar srong btsan sgam po'i bang sos gtsos pa'i bang so khag bdun tsam yod/ rtsed thang grong rdal de yar klung gtsang po'i lho 'gram du gnas yod tsang de khul gyi spyi ming la yar klung zhes grags/snga rabs bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan nas bzung yar klung sa khul nas rim bzhin bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum gyi rgyal phran rnams gcig gyur mnga' 'og tu 'dus/ yar klung sa khul der gnam gshis lha sa dang gcig mtshungs dro po yod pa ma zad/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi sa rgyu gshin po yod 98

stabs ston 'bras legs po skyes kyi yod pa dang / de mtshungs grong sde khag gi lag shes bzo las la snyan grags yod pa zhig yin/nga tshos rtsed thang khul du blta bskor zin rjes yar klung gtsang chu'i byang 'dabs su gnas pa'i snyan grags can gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la khyug tsam mchod mjal du bskyod rtsis kyi bsam tshul bton kyang / nga tsho mnyam du yong mkhan bod rang skyong ljongs kyi las byed pas deng sang gtsang po'i chu rgyas pa'i skabs yin pa ma zad/ nyin ltar rlung 'tshub chen po rgyag gi 'dug par brten ko gru gtong dka' bas nyen kha chen po yod luḍa kyi dgag cha byed pa'i bsam tshul bshad de 'gro thub ma byung zhing / go thos su bsam yas gtsug lag khang dang de'i g.yas g.yon gyi lha khang rnams rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs gtor skyon chen po byung yod stabs nga tshor 'gro ma bcug pa red ces brjod mkhan byung /bsam yas gtsug lag khang de dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas gsum gyis bzhengs su bcug gtsug lag khang de bod ljongs yongs kyi dgon pa rnying shos shig dang / snyan grags chen po yod pa zhig yin/ bsam yas su 'gro ma thub par brten lha sar phyir log lam zhor du gra nang la yod pa'i smin grol gling dgon par khyug tsam mchod mjal du bskyod/ smin grol gling dgon pa de yang rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang gcig pu las de min lha khang gzhan rnams dang / gra shag khag bcas rtsa gtor gyis gyang ro ma gtogs lhag mi 'dug gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso bo thub dbang gi sku rten chen po de'i dbu la gtor skyon dang / de bzhin thugs kur e khung chen po zhig brus 'dug de min rin 99

bral gsung rab glegs bam rtsa med song 'phros 'khyar ral 'ga' shas sa thog tu dbyugs bzhag 'dugagong gsal gnas stangs la gzhigs na da bar gtsug lag khang de'i nang su zhig slebs myong med par mngon/ smin grol gling dgon pa de rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug phyi lo 1575 lo rnying ma'i bla ma gter bdag gling pas phyag btab pa red/dgon pa'i chags yul de ri'i gyen thur la gnas 'dug dgon pa'i rgyab la ri bo mthon po dang / mdun du yar klung gtsang chu nub nas shar ngos su rgyugs kyi yod/de sngon smin grol gling dgon par nang chos kyis gtsos bod kyi rig gnas sman rtsis sogs dar khyab chen po yod pas bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum nas slob gnyer bya yul gtso bo zhig dang / lhag par du rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi khungs gtugs sa yang red/de nas nga tsho lha sar phyir log skabs nga tshos sdod yul skor sngon du bsam tshul bton pa ltar lha sa'i grong khyer nye 'gram du gra sgrig byas 'dug nyin bcu sdod ring de sngon mtshams 'dri blta bskor ma byung ba khag dang / zhar zhor khungs so sos ngo shes dga' nye'i rigs/ de min ngo shes min la ma ltos pa'i mi mang gang mang bcas gang thub kyis thug 'phrad bya rgyu byas/nga tsho lha sar phyir 'khor skabs nye dus bla 10 ches 1 nyin nga tshos nor gling pho brang la blta bskor bskyod skabs mi mang khrod nas lha sa'i a lcag che ring lha mos bod rang btsan yin pa dang / rtsam pa za mkhan tshos dbye 'byed byed dgos zhes dang / mi mang 'ga' shas kyis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma sku che khri phrag tu brtan par shog ces skad 'bod byas par brten nga tsho phye thon rjes lha sa'i grong khyer khren 2(5)

kon chus zhes pa'i grong khyer nang sa khul rgya mi'i las khungs nas lha sa'i mi mang rnams bskong tshogs byas te khyed tsho'i nang nas da lam rgya gar nas yong ba'i mi lnga'i sar thug 'phrad skabs phan tshun skad cha ji byung skor 'dri brtsad chu tshod gsum tsam ring byas pa'i thog gsar brjer ngo rgol pa che ring lha mor 'thab rtsod gtong dgos lugs bshad ma thag bod mi hur brtson can re zung gis bod rang btsan zer ba de nyin mo'i skar ma red/ rtsam pa za mkhan tsho dbye 'byed dgos lugs bshad pa de log spyod pa'i skad cor brgyab zhig rang red/ 'on kyang ngos len zhus na srid byus gu yangs gtong gi red/ klad rnying mkhregs bzung byas na khrims gcod drag po gtong rgyu red ces ngar ngar gyis 'jigs bskul byas pa'i thog rgya mi las byed 'ga' shas kyis che ring lha mo'i skra nas 'then te gsar brjer ngo rgol pa che ring lha mo bkag nyar byed rgyu'i thag chod pa yin zer nas spyi bde dmag gnyis kyis che ring lha mo'i dpung pa g.yas g.yon nas bzung ste btson khang du 'khrid/ der yod mi mang rnams la khyod tsho tshod zin na dga' gi red/ gal srid che ring lha mo nang bzhin gsar brjer ngo rgol byas na kho mo 'gro sa'i lam der 'gro rgyu yin/ mi lnga po de ni mgyogs po log 'gro gi red/ chu phyin kyang gram pa sdod kyi red/ da dung khyod tshos 'phag 'tshag brgyab na krung go gung khran tang la srid byus med pa ma red ces 'jig bskul dang kha brdung mang dag btang yod lugs thos byung /nga tsho lha sar nyin bcu sdod ring bod mi gang mang thug 'phrad du bskyod cing /nyin gcig gi dgong mo sa rub tsam zhig la sbra nag zhol khul du mi tshang zhig gi nang du 'dzul bar lo na bdun cu tsam la slebs pa'i rgas 'khogs gcig thug 'phrad byung bar 'tshams 'dri zhus nas nang mi ga tshod yod ces dres par khong dang tsha mo gcig 20
