las med ces zer/ spyi tshogs rnying pa dang spyi tshogs gsar pa'i gnas stangs gnyis bsdur na bsam tshul ji yod dre ba byed skabs rgan 'khogs des lan ma slog pa'i ngang sgo'i phyir blta tsam byas nas yar yong / yud tsam kha ma grags pa'i thog dbugs ring zhig btang nas de sngon rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs sdug bsngal 'phrad pa'i lo rgyus bshad byung / rgan 'khogs der bu gnyis yod pa nas rgan pa de lha sa grong khyer nang yod pa'i slob grwa 'bring ba'i bod yig dge rgan zhig yin pa dang / bu chung ba bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs gtogs las khungs shig gi las byed pa yin/ rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs bu chung ba der rgya mis tā la'i ru tshogs kyi nyul ma yin lugs ma nyes zhu nag g.yogs nas gar song cha med gyur pa'i rjes slob gru'i dge rgan yin pa'i bu rgan pa bstan 'dzin zer ba der khyod kyi spyan chung ba des mi ngan su dang 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa dang / rnam kun khyod la ga re shod kyi yod dam/ da lta ga par phyin yod lugs bcas dri ba byas te nyin mang po'i ring drag po'i 'thab rtsod ji snyed btang yang da dung thag ma chod par brten kho pa nang du log nas nam phyed tsam la rang gi bza' zla dang / phrug gu chung ba gnyis dmar gsod btang rjes rang nyid kyang rang srog rang gcod byas song / skabs der pha rgan rang nyid lha sa'i nye 'khor grong gseb zhig tu bskyode nas lha sar bsdad med/ de bzhin bu mo rgan pa zhig yod pa de rgya mi'i las byed gcig gi nang du g.yog mor bsdad yod stabs skyon cha ma byung ba red ces chad chad mthud mthud kyi lo rgyus shod skabs glo bur du nga tsho'i rgyab nas ngu skad chen po zhig brgyab song / su yin nam blta skabs snum gyi zhun mar 'od gsal la ma gsal khrod du bu mo lo nyi shu tsam slebs pa zhig langs nas ngu bzhin bsdad 'dug skabs der rgad pos de nga'i bu rgan pa'i bu 202

mo bde skyid yin zhes ngo sprod byas byung /rjes su go thos zhig la rgan 'khogs de'i bu rgan pa bstan 'dzin la nyes skyon ma phog pa'i sngon rgya mi'i byus bkod 'og bstan 'dzin gyis bod mi mang por 'thab rtsod ji snyed byas yod pas mthar rang nyid la'ang ngan 'bras de lta bu byung ba red zer/ gong gsal gnas tshul de lta bu rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i dus zings skabs bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum la ji snyed byung yod ces thos kyang / nged rang la de nub nang bzhin gyi yid gdung mi bzod pa zhig byung ma myong bas dus da lta yang de skor yid yul du yang yang 'khor gyi 'duganged kyi yid mthun blos 'khel grogs po bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub (bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub ni phyi lo 1951 lor pe cing du bod rgya gnyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags 'god mkhan bod kyi 'thus mi'i gas shig yin ) phyilo 1959lor lha sar bod mi rnams kyis bod rang btsan slar gso'i las 'gul langs pa'i rjes rgya dmar gyi gdug rtsub drag gnon 'og 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas nas dus yun gang mtshams rjes glod bkrol btang yang / khong gis bod kyi bdag po bod mi yin pa las rgya mir thob thang med lugs bcas kyi dgongs tshul dga' nye 'ga' shas la gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis slar yang 'dzin bzung btson 'jug gis ngal rtsol sgyur bkod ces pa'i khrims gcod byas nas dus yun nges med ngal rtsol btson sgar dang po'i nang du bcug yod lugs shes rtogs byung /nga tsho'i sne shan skya zhabs ku'o ra'i dang / rin reng gnyis la nged kyi grogs po bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub lha sa'i btson khang dang po'i nang ngal rtsol byed kyi yod 'dug pa khong khyug tsam thug 'phrad du 'gro 'thus kyi bsam tshul bton pa khong 203

gnyis kyis bod rang skyong ljongs 'brel yod khag la 'brel mol byas rjes chog mchan thob nas ches 24 dgong dro chu tshod gsum pa tsam la sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog dang lhan du lha sa'i btson khang ang dang por bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub thug 'phrad du bskyod/ btson khang de lha sa'i byang ngos gra bzhi'i shar 'gram nye 'dabs su yod/ de sngon sa khul der bye ma dang / gram trug gis khengs pa'i thang chen zhig yin pa der da cha rgya dmar gyis log spyod pa dang / gad snyigs zhes dma' 'bebs byed pa'i bod mi grags can rnams 'jog yul btson khang zhig bskrun 'dug de'i phyir lcags ri phyi nang gnyis dang / btson sgar gi sgo 'gram bcas su srung dmag dam drag dang ldan pa bzhag 'dug nged gnyis btson sgar sgo 'gram du 'byor skabs bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spyi bde las khungs kyi las byed dang / btson srung bcas mi 'ga' shas sgug nas bsdad 'dug par lam seng btson sgar rgyal sgo nang du shar rgyag 'khrid nas sne len khang ngam/ las khungs lta bu khang chung zhig tu slebs/ khyed gnyis khyug tsam sgug rogs/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub 'bod par btang yod lam seng yong gi red ces zer nas yud tsam sgug skabs shar ngos mda' rgyang tsam nas rgya chas sngon po'i gos thung stod thung gyon pa'i rgas 'khogs shig dang / las byed pa zhig mnyam du nga tsho'i phyogs su dal po'i ngang yong gi 'dug pa rgya mi rgas 'khogs shig min nam bsam byung / thag nyer slebs skabs bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub yin pa ngo shes byung ba ltar lam seng khong sar rgyugs phyin nas khong gi phyag nas bzung ste mtshams 'dri zhus par khong yud tsam ring legs nyes kyi chig gang yang ma gsungs par nged gnyis kyi gdong la yud tsam gzigs te rnam pa gnyis ga dus phebs pa/ zhes gsungs te bzhengs bzhugs nas 204

tshig gzhan gang yang ma gsungs par hang sangs pa lta bus dbu gug gug gnang nas dgongs pa bzhes bzhin pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan song /skabs der nged tsho khang chung der slebs/ bod mi las byed cig gis bod ja khog ldir gang dang / dkar yol gsum khyer yong nas nga tsho gsum la ja re blugs byung ba bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub kyis zhim mdog kha pos ja dkar yol gsum tsam mchod song / de nyin ma gtogs khong la ja de 'dra rgyun ring zhig rag med pa 'dra snyam byung /bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub ni 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yab gzhis kyi skya rgyud yin zhing / mi gshis drang po dang / zhal gsang po/lhag par du grogs po bsam pa zol med gnang mkhan mi dam pa zhig red/ nga tshos chu tshod phyed tsam lhan 'dzoms ring phan tshun spyi stangs tsam las de min gnad yod bka' mol tshig zur tsam gleng mol ma byung zhing / gang yin zhe na/ nga tsho yod sar rgya mi'i las byed yod stabs bka' mol zhu bde ma byung / khong lo mang ring dka' sdug chen po myong ba'i rkyen gyis dar ma'i lus stobs de zhan rgud du gyur nas lo na drug cu lhag tsam slebs pa'i rgad po lta bu chags 'dug pa ma zad/ chems ni gcig kyang med pa bud 'dug de nyin nga tsho kha bral nas dus yun de tsam ma song rjes khong la gu yangs thob nas rang khyim du phyir phebs rjes rim bzhin rgya gar du bza' rla bu phrug bcas gnyen 'phrad la phebs thub pa'i go skabs byung ste rgya gar la lo shas bzhugs rgyu byung yang de sngon btson khang du dka' sdug mang dag myangs pa'i rkyen gyis snyun gzhi lci po phog te sman bcos ji ltar gnang yang phan nus ma thon par skya che zin ma song bar blo pham chen po byung / khong rgya gar du bzhugs ring khong rang gi mi che'i lo 205

rgyus rags tsam 'khod pa'i deb cig kyang bris pa gnang song /ches 35 nyin snga dro nga tsho mal khri nas ma langs gong sngar las lhag pas ngo shegapa dang / ngo ma shes pa lha sa'i mi dmangs mang po skyo bskyel du phebs pa'i snang ba zhig byung / nga tsho thon khar phan tshun kha bral mi phod pa'i thog tshang mas mig zhag 'khor bzhin par myur du 'phrad pa'i smon 'dun zhus shing / skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chab gros spyi khyab sku zhabs blo bzang tshul khrims kyis gtsos pa'i glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug dang / lha sa grong khyer spyi khyab mtsho sgo ba/ lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar bcas kyang nga tsho skyel mar phebs byung yang / phan tshun dbar chu klung chen po zhig gis chod pa lta bu'i bag zon byed dgos stabs ga le phebs dang /ga le bzhugs zhes phan tshun lab res byed pa las de min su zhig gis snying gtam shod ma nus pa'i ngang tshang ma mi 'dod bzhin du kha gyes bya dgos byung ngo /sku lha sa nas kong po nying khri brgyud khams phyogs su thon/ nying khrir zhag gnyis sdod ring de khul gyi sa bab lha sa las dma' ba yod stabs gnam gshis dro grang snyom pa ma zad/ sa khul der rgya gar tsha yul gyi shugs rkyen thebs te char chu 'bal po yod stabs ri klung thams cad du nags tshal gyis khyab yod pa red/ 'on kyang de sngon kong po dang / spo yul gyi ri klung thams cad gdod ma'i nags tshal mthug po der da cha rgya mis skra bzhar ba lta bu'i gnod 'che chen po btang 'dug de mtshungs rjes sor nga tshos mi nyag khul nas li thang du bskyod skabs nyag chu kha nas li thang bar gyi ri klung la yod pa'i nags tshal rnams kyang don med du bcad nas bed spyod ma byas par phangs sems med par rang sar dbyugs te skam rul du gyur ste ched mngags 'phrog brlag btang ba mngon sum du mthong rgyu 'dug206

bar lam rgya mis kong po nying khri khul shing tog ku shu dang / li/ kham bu bcas mang po 'debs gso byas 'dug par nga tsho de khul 'byor skabs ku shu smin pa'i dus skabs dang 'khel 'dug pa ku shu spras ka ha cang legs po 'dug lha sa nas kong po nying khri bar me le 188 lhag tsam 'dug pa bgrod lam de tsam bde po med pa'i thog dbur dus ring sa rud kyis rkyen pas lam gzhung yang yang bzo bcos byed dgos kyi yod tshod 'dug nga tsho 'gro ba'i dus skabs de char zhod chad pa'i dus skabs yin par brten lam bar dka' ngal gang yang 'phrad ma byung /1959 lo dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kong po dang / spo bo'i sa khul khag gi ri khug lung khug la bod rgya btson pa mang po bzhag te dmag sgar dang btson sgar bcas gsar bskrun byas yod pa dang / de mtshungs lung khug btsan sa 'ga' shas sar dmigs bsal dmag sgar yang bskrun yod ces zer/ gang yin zhe na spo yul dang / kong po sa khul gnyis rgya gar shar byang sa khul dang sa 'brel yin stabs rgya mi'i dmag mi 'bor chen gsog 'jog byas yod 'dug spo bo spra mog khul btson sgar yod pa de'i nang gi bod mi btson pa mang po thug 'phrad byung / gang yin zhe na dus skabs der bod yongs rdzogs kyi sa khul khag tu yod pa'i btson pa glod bkrol gtong rgyu yin tshul gyis rang dbang phran bu thob kyang ngal rtsol sgyur bkod ces pa'i las mi'i ru khag gi sgrig 'dzugs khongs su bzhag 'dug pa gu yangs phran bu yod stabs nga tsho dang thug 'phrad la de tsam bkag 'doms mi 'dug ces zer/de nas dpa' shod sa khul dang / chab mdo brgyud rim bzhin khams khul sa gnas khag la mtshams 'drir bskyod skabs chab mdo sa khul gyi mang tshogs rnams kyi 'tsho ba ha cang dbul zhing phongs pa'i skor chab mdor yod pa'i rgya'i las byed 207

pas chab mdo'i mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba de sa khul gzhan dag las zhan pa yod ces ngos len byas pa'i thog rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs su mang tshogs kyis 'bru rigs thams cad gzhung gi mdzod du bcug sprang po thams cad 'bri chu'i pha rol bskyod/ ces gzhas tshig de ltar grags yod pa red ces skyid snang gi rnam 'gyur thog nas 'grel bshad byas pa ma zad/ chab mdo'i mi mang rnams la dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i rgyu rkyen de mi bzhi shog khag gis bzos pa red ces bshad pa las/ krung go gung khran tang gi srid byus yang dag pa red ces bshad byung ba/ mi bzhi shog khag krung go gung khran tang min pa lta bur 'gan nyes thams cad pham nyes can la g.yogs kyi 'dug de ni rgya'i gtam dpe la/ rgyal kha thob na rgyal po dang / pham kha byung na jag kun yin zhes zer ba ltar yin no/chab mdo khul nyin gsum sdod ring chab mdo dgon chen dang / slob grwa 'bring ba/ ar 'dam bzo gra bcas su rim bzhin blta bskor mtshams 'dri byas/ chab mdo dgon pa de bzhin bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum gyi dgon pa khag ltar gtor skyon chen po byung 'dug slob grwa 'bring ba de chab mdo khul gyi gnas stangs la gzhigs na gang cir gra 'grigs po yod par mngon/ de'i rgyu rkyen ni slob grwa de'i nang gi slob phrug mang che ba chab mdo mnga' khul gyi rgya mi las byed rnams kyi bu phrug red 'dug gong bzhin lha sas gtsos pa'i sa gnas gnad yod khag tu rgya mi las byed kyi bu phrug gang yod slob grwa chung 'bring la ma ltos pa gnas stangs gang legs yod 'dugaphyi rla 11 ches 3 nyin chab mdo nas sde dge 'jo mda' brgyud sde dge dgon chen du thon te skam thog gru khar 'byor skabs 'bri chu zam chen byang ngos si khron zhing chen gyi mi rigs las khungs kyi spyi khyab gzhon pa 'ba' pa bkris che ring 208

nas sne 'khrid byas pa'i las byed 'ga' shas dang / mo ṭa bcas nga tsho bsu len du phebs phrug gnang 'duga'aba' pa bkris che ring ni de sngon 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi shar bod dmangs gtso na gzhon rang skyong mna' sbrel tshogs pa'i tshogs mi'i gas shig red/mi gshis drang po dang / skad cha de tsam mang po mi shod mkhan/ rang gi mi rigs dang rig gzhung bcas la sha zhen chen po yod mkhan zhig red/ skam thog gru kha'i zam chen de dag 1954 lor 7gong sa tu la'i bla mas rgya nag tu chibs phebs skabs 'phral sel gyi zam pa btsugs 'dug pa da char zam pa spus legs bskrun yod pa red/ skam thog gru kha'i phar kha'i sa khul rnams deng sang si khron zhing chen khongs su dbye 'byed byas 'dug sa khul de rnams mdo stod bod kyi sa khul sha stag red/zam pa'i lho ngos bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mnga' khongs su brtsi gi 'dugade dag gi lo rgyus yong rkyen ni/ 1932 lo zu 5 pa'i nang bod rgya dbar gnasaskabs kyi dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig bzhag don ltar sor gnas byas pa'i dbye 'byed sa mtshams shig yin pa de da bar gnas pa red/1938 lo rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab kyis dar rtse mdo la zhi khang zhing chen zhes ming btags nas rim bzhin 'bri chu'i shar phyogs kyi bod sde yul gru khag tu btsan 'dzul rim par bgyid de srid 'dzin lag len bstar yod kyang / skabs shig tu bod dmag gis sde dge dang / dkar mjes/ nyag rong bcas kyi sa khul rnams dbang sgyur byas shing / de rjes rgya dmag gis gong gsal sa khul rnams la btsan 'dzul byas mthar bod rgya gnyis skam thog gru khar zhi mthun dmag mtshams kyi chings don bzhag pa der skam thog chings yig tu grags/209

1955 lor zhi khang zhing chen zhes pa'i ming de phyir bsdu byas nas gong gsal sa khul rnams si khren zhing chen khongs su bla bsgril byas 'dug 'on kyang / 1959bar sa khul de rnams kyi chos sde khag la bod gzhung dang / grub mtha' ris med kyi bla chen rnams kyi bkod byus 'og gnas kyi yod/ dpe mtshon zhig zhus na/ 1951lo bar dar rgyas dgon par bod gzhung nas bla gnyer gyi go ming yod pa'i rtse drung gcig bsko brdzongs gnang mus yin/nga tsho sde dge dgon chen la nyin gnyis sdod ringabod ljongs yongs su snyan grags yod pa'i sde dge dpar khang la lta skor byas/ sde dge dpar khang de rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya phyi lo 1729 lor sde dge'i chos rgyal bstan pa che ring gi dus su bzhengs/ der bka' bstan 'gyur dang / sa dge bka' rnying gi bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum phal mo che dang / mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dpar shing 'bor chen bzhugs pa'i dpar khang zhig red/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtsang khul snyan grags can gyi snar thang dpar khang gis gtsos pa'i gzhan rnams rtsa med du btang yod kyang / skabs der sde dge dpar khang de srung skyob thub tsam byung 'dug kyang / dpar shing phran bu bor brlag byung yod ces zer/sde dge dgon chen nas bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal 'khrungs yul du skya gnyen thug 'phrad du phebs thon gnang ba dang / nga tsho byings rnams de nas sde dge khro la brgyabs nas yid lhung bla mtsho brgyud dkar mjes khul du bskyod skabs khro la'i la gsham ma ṇi sgang zhes pa'i sar 'byor skabs dkar mdzes rdzong gi chab gros tshogs mi bod mi blo rab dang / spyi bde'i las byed bod mi dpal ldan zhes pa bcas bsu len du sgug 'dug de nas rim bzhin dar rgyas dgon pa'i 210

mdun nas brgyud dkar mjes grong brdal du 'byor nas nyin gnyis ring de khul nye 'dabs lho pa spyi khang dang / grong pa'i khyim 'ga' shas su mtshams 'dri blta bskor byas par de rnams kyi 'tsho ba dka' ngal de tsam med par mngon/lha sa nas dar rtse mdo bar lam 'khel sa khul gyi sa dge bka' rnying dang /bon po bcas pa'i dgon pa che chung la ma ltos pa rnams rtsa med btang shul gyi gyang ro gang sar dngos rjen mthong rgyu 'dug kong po bar la'i shar ngos nas dar rtse mdo bar gyi yul klung rnams mdzes sdug yid 'ong ldan pa ma zad/ zhing 'brog zung 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis phyug pa'i sa khul sha stag yin 'dug pa ma 'ongs par sa khul de rnams la thon sgo 'byed thub pa byung na lha yul gyi dpal la 'gran thub pa zhig yong nges snyam pa byung /dkar mdzes sa khul der 1935 lor dmar dmag rgya nag sa khul nas rim bros kyi mdo stod smad phyogs su bskyod skabs dkar mjes la zu shas sdod ring bod pa srid gzhung zhes pa zhig 'dzugs rgyu byung 'dug kyang / dus yun de tsam ma song bar dkar mdzes byang shar rgyal rong brgyud rgya nag nub byang du bros dgos byung 'dugade nas nga tsho dkar mdzes nas brag 'go dang / rta'u/ mgar mthar bcas rim brgyud kyi nyag chu kha nas li thang du mtshams 'dre blta bskor du bskyod de lam bar nyag chu khar zhag gcig 'khel bas de nyin sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog nas mgron khang gi phyir gzigs bskor dang sbrags zhabs 'chams su phebs skabs de sngon gdan sa 'bras spungs la bzhugs myong yod pa'i dge bshes shig dang mjal te phan tshun zhal tshor byung stabs grong rdal de'i mi dmangs rnams kyis khong 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku mched yin par shes nas mi dmangs pho mo rgan byis sprug

rnams sku gcen gyis gam du bcar nas mtha' bskor te phyag dbang zhus pa ma zad/khong gis bzhes pa'i sku stod de nas byin rlabs ched tshal bu 'then dbral byas nas skya stod de tsab hral du btang 'dug rgya mi'i las byed rnams kyi mi ngan re zung gis ched mngags rnyog khra bzos pa min nam snyam pa'i rdugs pa byung ste brtsad gcod byed kyi yin zhes zer yang / sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog nas de 'dra byed dgos mi 'dug de rnams kyis 7rgyal ba rin po che mchog la dad gus bcos med kyis de ltar byas pa zhig yin pa las/ mi ngan gyis byas pa zhig rtsa ba nas ma red ces bka' nan po gnang song /de'i sang nyin nga tshos li thang dgon chen gyi nye 'dabs grong rdal du 'byor nas de khul mi dmangs rnams la mtshams 'dri gang lcogs zhus/1955 lo nas bzung 'bri chu shar brgyud gyi bod mi rnams nas rgya dmar gyi gdug rtsub mnar gcod ma bzod par rngam brjed ldan pa'i ngo rgol byas par brten rgya mi kha skyengs khro langs kyis gnam sa gnyis thog nas drag gnon tshab chen byas te li thang dgon pa de rtsa gtor btang ba ma zad/ grong sde mang po mer bsregs btang ba bcas bod kyi lo rgyus thog yid skyo zhing go dka' tsam snang 'os pa'i dpe ris mtshar du dngar ba zhig bris yod/ de nas dpa' bo rnams ri khul bros te dgra bo rgya dmar la nges med rgol rdung dmag 'thab rim byas mthar rang yul bral nas dbus phyogs su bskyod de a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis btsugs pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag dpung gi sgrig khungs su zhugs/1959 lor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog rgya gar du phebs rjes rim bzhin khong tsho'i gras gang 'tshams rgya gar du 'byor yod pa'i nang mi rnams la 2 2

ngo 'phrad kyis gnas tshul zhib cing phra ba gang thub zhus te tshang ma dga' skyed blo bde'i thog nas nang mi rnams kyi gnas stangs skor yi ge mang po bskur ba rjes sor nga tshos rgya gar du phyir 'khor ma thag yi ge rnams khungs so sor nges 'phrod zhus te gzhis byes spyan bla phan tshun mtshams sbyor gyi 'brel bar phan thogs chen po byung ngo /rgya mis li thang dgon chen nye 'dabs su bye ma ka ra'i bzo gra spus dag zhig gsar bskrun byas yod kyang / bye ma ka ra bzo ba'i rgyu cha la phug de'i nye 'gram gyi rtsa thang sa khyon gang tsam zhig la 'debs kyi yod par sa khul de bzhin sa bab mthon po yin stabs ston 'bras skye dka' ba yin cing / lo gcig gi la phug ston 'bras bsdus pa de dag gis rla gcig tsam las ldeng gi med par brten de 'phros rla ba bcu gcig tsam ring bzo gra'i 'phrul chas las med bed med du lus pa dang / bzo pa rnams kyang las med du sdod kyi yod kyang / las byed rnams kyi phogs dngul sngar bzhin sprod kyi yod/ de bzhin gong rim tshos bzo gra'i thon 'bab gang leḍa yod pa'i ham rdzun snyan zhu 'dra gang chags 'bul gyi yod pa las/ mi shugs dang / ma dngul bcas chud zos su 'gro bar phangs sems spu tsam byed mkhan med lugs zer/gong gsal gnas tshul dang mtshungs pa bod ljongs sa gnas khag mang por yang ji snyed byung 'dug de ni sa gnas las byed rang nyid la ming gnas byas rjes yong slad kho na las yul gyi gnas bab dngos la bsam blo ma btang ba mun 'thom thal bskyod byas pa zhig yin/ de nas nga tsho li thang nas dar rtse mdo dang / khyen tu'u brgyud pe cing du phyir log byas/ dar rtse mdo de bod kyi shar phyoḍa mtha' mtshams kyi rgyal sgo zhig yin pa ma zad/de sngon bod rgya sa mtshams kyi tshong 'dus sa khul zhig kyang yin zhing / deng sang 243

dkar mjes bod rigs rang skyong sa khul zer ba'i lte gnas kyang der btsugs yod/phyi lo 1950 lo'i zu 13 ches 25 nyin dar rtse mdor shis khang zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong zhes pa btsugs pa de/ 1955 lor dkar mjes bod rigs rang skyong sa khul zhes par bsgyur/ rang skyong sa khul de'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rdzong khag dar rtse mdo dang / brag 'go dkar mdzes/ nyag rong / dpal yul/sde dge ser shul/ gser thar/ lcags zam/ rong brag brgyad zur/ nyag chu kha/rta'u/ li thang / cha phreng / 'dab pa/ 'ba' thang / sde rong bcas rdzong khag bco brgyad yod/ gong gsal rdzong khag bco brgyad yod khongs nas dar rtse mdo'i mnga' khongs su rgya mi mang che ba der gnas chags yod pa las/ de min rdzong khag bcu bdun la skabs de dus bod mi gtso bor gnas yod/dar rtse mdo grong rdal gyi khor yug tu ri bo mtho po yod stabs der grog rong gu dog po chags 'dug de'i shar lho nye 'dabs su rgyal rong rgya mo ngul chu byang nas lho phyogs rgyugs te lu'o ting gtsang chu dang 'dres/nga tshos dar rtse mdor ngal gso dang sbrags de khul yod pa'i dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi chab gros tshogs 'thus sde dge btsun mo 'jam dbyangs dpal mo dang / dkar mjes khang sar ye shes rdo rje sogs ngo 'phrad byung / de rnams nas zlos gar 'khyab pa ltar krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag dbu khrid 'og mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa'i skor dang / dkar mdzes bod rigs khul gyi mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba gong 'phel du 'gro gi yod lugs/ de bzhin mi dmangs kyi chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus lag len bstar gyi yod lugs bcas kyis bstod bsngags gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyi nga tshor skad 'khor lta bu bshad pa 2 4

dang / de mtshungs khong rnams kyis phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i tā la'i bla ma mchog dang /bod rigs spyan zu rnams mgyogs myur du mes rgyal la phyir phebs gnang nas nga tsho lhan du mes rgyal deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun du zhugs dgos/ rgyal gces la snga rjes med/ mi rgas na yul dran/ bya rgas na shing dran zhes brtse dung chen po yin khul gyi bsam tshul ji snyed bshad de nga tsho mdo smad khul dang / dbus gtsang khul blta bskor mtshams 'drir bskyod skabs ji bzhin sa gnas so so'i chab gros tshogs 'thus rnams kyis 'khrab ston byas song / 'on kyang khong rnam pa dang kher rkyang du 'phrad skabs gong du bshad pa'i gnas tshul rnams dang yongs su tha dad red/mang che ba'i bsam tshul gtso cher 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog gis rgya nag gi 'gyur ba'i gnas babs la gzigs nas dgongs bzhes zab nan mdzad de phyir phebs gnang na yag po 'dug ces bcos min snying gtam gcig mtshungs su bshad kyi 'dugachab srid gros tshogs zhes pa de srid 'dzin rim pa'i sa khul du btsugs yod pa dang / dper na bod rang skyong ljongs yongs kyi bla chen khag dang / sku drag spyi tshogs kyi mi sna grags can bcas kyi khongs nas ang rim gsum dbye 'byed byas nas ang rim dang po rgya nag chab srid gros tshogs kyi tshogs mi'i go ming sprad nas pe cing du sdod dgos pa dang / ang rim gnyis pa'i gras bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs kyi tshogs mir bkod nas lha sar sdod dgos pa/ ang rim gsum pa rnams sa gnas rang khongs khul dang / rdzong bcas kyi chab srid gros tshogs ming bkod nas sa gnas der gtan sdod dgos kyi yod pa red/ de rnams kyi las 'gan ni nyin re bzhin dbus gzhung gi srid byus gtan 'bebs ji byung dang / gong rim gnad yod mi sna rnams kyi gtam bshad/ mi dmangs nyin re'i gsar shog 2 5

thog bkod pa'i gleng brjod bcas la slob sbyong bya dgos pa las/ rang mos kyi bsam tshul shod dbang med pa de ni rlung rtsi'i nang du bcug pa'i ne tso dang mtshungs so/nga chos khyen tu'u la 'byor nas nyin gnyis sdod ring bod rgya tshog mdzod brtsams bsgrig gnang mkhan mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan dang / thub bstan nyi ma/ ngam ring ba rdo rje rgyal po sogs bzhugs sar khyug tsam mtshams 'drer bskyod nas phan tshun bgro gleng lhod po byas/khyen tu'u nas gnam thog pe cing du bskyod rjes nyin shas lhod sdod bya ring kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po mchog dang / nga phod/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal rnam gsum dang slar yang mjal 'phrad zhus te da lam nga tshos bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum gyi sa khul rnams la 'tshams 'dre blta bskor bskyod pa'i mthong thos ji byung rnams gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin khong rnam gsum dang gleng mol byung ba ma zad/ rgya gzhung 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang gzhon pa pheng ce hran gyis gtsos pa'i gnad yod dpon rigs 'ga' shas lhan du mi rigs pho brang zhes pa'i khang chen du bzhugs mol tshogs 'du zhes pa'i thog da lam nga tshos bod ljongs sa khul khag la blta bskor 'tshams 'drer bskyod pa'i mthong thos tshor gsum gyi gnas tshul bcas thal lus med par bsam tshul gsal por brjod/skabs der nga tshos bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum sa khul khag bzhi bcu tsam la 'tshams 'dre blta bskor du bskyod par lan kra'u nas dar rtse mdo bar mo ṭa thog khyon bsdoms me le lnga stong lnga brgya tsam bskyod yod pa red/ sa gnas khag la dmigs bsal gnas tshul ji byung rigs skabs bstun hong kong du sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la thag ring kha dpar thog snyan seng zhus pa dang / lhag par lha 216

sa'i khul blta bskor 'tshams 'dre'i byed sgo ji byung snga rjes thengs gnyis tsam kha par phul ba yin/nga tsho pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir thon ma gnang tsam la nyin gcig kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis nga tsho'i sne shan pa rin ring brgyud phyi nyin dgong dro paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs shag tu nga tsho gsol tshigs la yong rogs zhes mgron brda gnang don ltar dus thog bcar ba yin/ paṇa chen rin po che'i yabayum rnam gnyis dang / yongs 'dzin rgya yag rin po che bcas nas nga tshor sne len gnang thog mjal 'phrad khang du sne 'khrid gnang ba ltar nga tshos yar bcar ma thag kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal rnam gnyis nas nga tshor dga' bsu gnang zhing / nga tshos paṇa chen po che mchog la chos phyogs kyi gus bkur phyag dbang zhus nas tshang ma bzhugs gral du 'khod rjes paṇa chen rin po mchog gi zhal 'dzum dmul thog nas do nub khyed rnam par ngas bsu skyel zung sbrel gyi gsol tshigs stabs bde zhig gra sgrig byas yod par grogs po phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags dang / nga phod rnam/ gnyis kyang gdan zhu byas yod/ nga phod da lta rang phebs kyi yin zhes zhal dpar 'byor song zhes bka' gnang byung bar skabs der phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis bzhad mo bzhad bzhin par thugs yid mgu ba'i rnam pa bstan/ de nas gang 'tshams zhig la nga phod kyis kun gzigs rin po che mchog la zhal dpar phul 'byor byung bar khong da ltar bcar rtsis yin kyang glo bur las ka zhig thon song bas gsol tshigs su bcar thub byung ma song zhes zhus par kun gzigs paṇa chen rin pa che mchog cung zad thugs ma spro ba lta bu mngon pa dang /phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags nas nga tshor gzigs tsam gnang nas sngar bzhin 2 7

'dzum ston gnang ba las legs nyes kyi tshig gang yang gsungs ma song /skabs der nged rang gi bsam blor de sngon bka' blon zur khang gis sras sku zhabs khyed rang nga phod la thugs yid chen po ches kyi yod pa red/ nga phod skabs re mi su zhig yid mi ches pa'i rdzun gtam bshad mkhas po zhig red ces gsungs pa de hob ste yid la 'khor byung / de'i nub mo nga phod kyis rjes sor rgya mis khong la rnyog dra bshad mi yong ngam bsam pa'i 'jigs pa dang / yang na rgya mir bskyod chog min gyi bka' 'khrol zhus te bka' ma 'khrol bas de nub gsol tshigs la g.yol thabs byas pa zhig yin pa thag chod pa red snyam mo/de nas nyin shas rjes nga tshos pe cing nas hong kong brgyud rgya gar du phyir thon gyis hong kong du bar lam bod ljongs yul gru khag la blta bskor 'tshams 'dri ji byung skor dang / pe cing la rgya phyogs gnad yod dpon rigs dang mjal mol ji byung bcas kyi skor sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la zhib cha zhus/de nas ldi li brgyud rda sa bzhugs sgar du bcar te 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas bcas la da lam gus tsho pe cing brgyud bod ljongs chol kha gsum gyi sa khul gang tsam zhig dang / lhag par bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa bcas la 'tshams 'dre blta skor bskyod pa'i gnas tshul dzi byung dang / de mtshungs pe cing du rgya gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs li zhan nyan gyis gtsos pa rnams dang mjal mol ji byung / lhag par pe cing la bzhugs pa'i kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'ba' pa phun tshoḍa dbang rgyal rnam gsum gyi gnas stangs bcas kyi skor phra zhing zhib pa snyan seng zhus pa dang /las khungs ma lag bcas pa'i las byed rnams la'ang gsal bshad ngo sprod zhus//2 8

le tshan so brgyad pa/7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs zab mo ltar rang gzhung gi sku tshab snga rjes gnyis pe cing du 'brel mol ched brdzong mdzad pa'i skor/lo de'i sngon du skya'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang / pe cing gzhung gnyis bka' mol byung don bzhin tā la'i bla ma mchog nas da dung khungs so so'i sku tshab tshogs pa gsum tsam bod ljongs khul yongs su 'tshams 'dre blta bskor du gtong gnang mdzad rgyu thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar lta skor thengs gnyis par 1980 lo'i rla 5 ches 1 nyin rang gzhung ni'u yog don gcod bkras mthong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / sud si'i don gcod che ring rdo rje/ nyi hong don gcod padma rgyal po/bod mi btsan byol bod kyi gzhon nu lhan tshogs kyi tshogs gtso blo bzang sbyin pa/dbyin yul du gtan bzhugs phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas na gzhon shes yon can mi lnga pe cing brgyud bod ljongs sa khul khag la 'tshams 'dre dang blta bskor du ched brdzong mdzad pa phyi rla 8 ches 15 nyin rgya gar du phyir 'khor ba dang / de'i mjug tsam la lta skor thengs gsum pa rang gzhung gi slob gso'i las riḍa kyi 'gan 'khur ba rda sa bu khyim dbu 'dzin sku'i gcung mo rje btsun padma mchog dang / ma su ri 2 9

gtan 'jags slob gru'i slob spyi phyag mdzod tshang bsod nams rab brtan lags dang slob dge rdza lha mgon sprul skyas gtsos mi drug kyang gong bzhin bsko brdzong mdzad/gong zhus ltar sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog nas hong kong la bca' sdod rgya mi'i shing ha gsar ca'agyur yan lag khang gi 'gan 'dzin li cus hreng dang 'brel gtugs gnang thog ldi li rang gzhung don gcod las khungs nas ldi li rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang dang 'brel gtugs gnang zhing / skabs re 7gong sa mchog dang bka' shag gi bka' dgongs bzhin kho bo ldi li rgya mi'i gzhung tshab hreng can dang 'brel gtugs byed par gtong gnang ba ltar/ rang gzhung gi sku tshab thengs bzhi pa bla ma dang / dge bshes khag gcig bod du blta bskor 'tshams 'drer bskyod 'thus skor 'brel mol bgyis par rgya phyogs nas thog mar deng sang rgya nag nang khul legs bcos bkod sgrig gi brel zing rkyen pas sne len zhu thub min la/ dus sang rla ba bzhi pa tsam la phebs na legs gnas zhes bshad yod kyang / rjes su bskul 'ded rim bgyis skabs don gnas gzhan du kha bsgyur nas ka kor dus 'gyangs mur/ 1981 zu ba gsum pa'i cher nyer gcig nyin slar yang kho bos ldi lir rgya mi'i gzhung tshab hreng can dang mjal 'phrad skabs khong gis kha sngon sku zhabs rgya lo don grub kyis nga la don tshan 'ga' shas dbus gzhung la snyan seng zhu rgyu mngags pa'i bka' lan 'byor song zhing /don tshan dang po/ tā la'i bla mas bod mi gzhis byes dbar sne 'brel sku tshab cig bod du gsar 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i skor dbus gzhung gis da lta'i dus skabs 'dir sku tshab 'dzugs dgos don med lugs dang /don tshan gnyis pa/ khyed tsho'i na gzhon dge rgan mi grangs lnga bcu skor bod du 220

gtong rgyur dbus gzhung gis dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ 'on kyang gsham gsal don tshan gsum khas len byed dgos/1 rang nyid nas krung go'i spyi 'bangs yin pa ngos len bya dgos/2 bod du slebs rjes sa gnas gzhung gi bka' don gzhi bzung brtsi bkur zhu dgos/3 dus yun ring tsam bod du sdod dgos rgyu bcas bka' phebs lugs zhes zer ba dang /don tshan gzhan gcig khyed tsho'i chos phyogs kyi blta bskor thengs bzhi pa'i skor/dbus gzhung gis da bar khyed tsho'i blta bskor snga rjes thengs gsum gyis bod rang skyong ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ kun su'u/ si khron/ yun nan bcas kyi bod rigs sa khul rnams la blta bskor byas zin pa red/ de bzhin deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs dang / bod rigs sa khul gzhan la'ang legs bcos bkod sgrig gi brel zing la brten sne len zhu thub pa mi 'dug ces chig thag bcad nas bshad pa'i thog khong gi ngo gdong nag log ge ba'i ngang khyed tshos bod du blta bskor skya tshab snga rjes btang ba'i khongs nas mi re zung gis mes rgyal gyi mi rigs mthun bsgril la gnod skyon gyi gtam bshad ji snyed spel yod pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal mi rigs brgyud nas mi 'tshams pa'i dril bsgrags kyang byas yod par brten sa gnas 'ga' zhig la phan tshun gnyis ka mi skyed pa'i gnas tshul yang byung yod ces yud tsam rlung tshub tshub kyi rnam 'gyur bstan/ yang khrel bgod dang bcas nye dus zla ba gsum pa'i ches bcu'i nyin khyed tsho'i gzhon nu dang / bod mi mang po zhig gis nga tsho'i gzhung tshab khang gi sgo 'gram du rngam ston skad cor gyis las 'gul byas pa de yag po ma red ces zer ba'i lan du/22

tu la'i bla mas dus rtag tu bod mi rnams la de gas ma byed ces bka' slob gnang gi yod kyang / rgya gar rang dbang can gyi rgyal khab zhig yin pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i na gzhon rnams rang dbang gi yul nang 'tshar long byung ba dang / de bzhin deng dus kyi slob sbyong thob yod stabs rgyal spyi'i gnas babs ji yin gsal rtogs la brten rang bzhin gyis nyan 'jog byed khag po red ces brjod par hreng can gyis tu la'i bla ma'i bka' la nyan gyi ma red pas ces brjod skabs dgad mo chen po zhig dgad nas spyir btang gi skad char 'gyur song /de'i sngon tsam la 7gong sa mchog gis bod mi rnams kyi thob thang brtson len mdzad thabs ched rgya dmar gyi tru'u ci hu'u ya'o pang phyi rgyal gang rung zhig la 'tshams 'dre gnang ba'i dus dang bsnun nas 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog gis khong dang khyug tsam mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu'i thugs dgongs ltar/ 1980 lo rla ba bcu gnyis pa'i ches bco brgyad nyin kho bos ldi li rgya mi'i gzhung tshab hreng can dang mjal 'phrad thog gong gsal bsam tshul gleng par hreng can gyis dbus gzhung la lam seng snyan seng zhu gi yin/'on kyang da lta'i dus la blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang phyi rgyal 'tshams 'drer phebs rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod pa ma red bsam gyi 'dug de las tā la'i bla mas mes rgyal du gzigs bskor la phebs thub na dbus gzhung gis dga' bsu zhu gi red/ de bzhin blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang dang rgyal khab kyi dbu 'khrid khag dang mjal mol gnang na khong tshos dga' po byed kyi red ces zer ba'i lan du/ tā la'i bla ma gnas skabs ring phebs thub kyi ma red/ rim pas dgongs pa bzhes kyi red bcas brjod/1983 lor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis rang cag gi bod don skor rgya mi dang mes 'chig mer gtugs kyi 'brel ba byed dgos par brten pe cing 222

du gros mol sku tshab zhig gtong rgyur thugs gtan 'khel te mi 'gro kho bo bde srung bka' blon stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / chos shes bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal/ bod mi mang spyi 'thus tshogs gtso rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan bcas gsum la bsko bzhag brdzong brda mdzad don bzhin ldi li rgya mi'i gzhung tshab dang 'brel ba byas te phran gsum ldi li nas tong kong brgyud pe cing la rla bzhi pa'i ches nyer gsum nyin thon gtan 'khel ba ltar sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la 'brel thabs zhus kyang / khong gi hong kong gi zhal byang ma thob stabs zhu thabs bral/ches nyer drug nyin nga tsho hong kong gi gnam thang du 'byor skabs rgya mi shin hā gsar 'gyur khang gi 'go 'dzin li cus hreng dang las byed 'ga' shas bcas bsu len du 'byor 'dug de'i dgong dro li cus hring gis dga' bsu'i gsol tshigs su khong gis nga tshos zla ba gsum lhag tsam ring sku zhabs rgya lo don grub dang thug 'phrad ma byung stabs 'tshol thabs byas kyang brtsad chod thub ma song zhes gsungs/nga tsho hong kong la nyin gnyis bsdad ring pe cing du rgya bod ngo shes mi sna rnams la lag rtags phran bu nyo sgrub byas te ches 25 nyin dgong dro chu tshod 13 thog hong gong nas pe cing du thon te pe cing gnam thang la 'byor skabs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang gzhon pa cang pheng dang / mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin gzhon pa zhu'u can hwa gsham 'og las byed 'ga' shas bcas nga tsho bsu len du 'byor 'dug par gnam thang phyi mgron sne len khang (712) du khyug tsam ring ngal gsos thog gsol ja'i sne len bgyis te cang pheng gis khyed rnam gsum phebs par dga' bsu yod tshul/ da ring slar yang mjal bar dga' po byung tshul bcas brjod cing / cang pheng ni de sngon dbyang chen rin gyi drung yig gi las ka lo mang byas yod 223

stabs bar lam dbyang chin rin mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin las gnas thog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang gcig lcogs kyi las 'gan gnas 'phar la brten blos 'khel yul cang pheng khong gi las rogs su yar 'then pa zhig red/ de ni dbang cha gcig sdud ring lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i srol rgyun zhig yin 'dugacang pheng ni gzugs tshad 'bring gras dang / rtsom bris mkhas pa/ rgyun du 'dzum bag ston mkhan/ kha 'jam gting gnag gi gshis ka ldan pa zhig red ces zer/de nas nga tsho pe cing grong khyer gyi nub byang mdza' grogs mgron khang du gra sgrig byas pa ltar bsdad/ mgron khang der sdod mkhan phyi sdod rgya rigs sha stag yin pa las phyi rgyal mi rigs sdod mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug cing / nga tsho mnyam du sngar bzhin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi sne shan sku zhabs rin ring gtsos pa'i las byed gsum tsam bcas bsdad/ de'i dgong dro sne shan pa rin ring gis sang nyin dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la dbus gzhung gi dbu 'khrid lha'u lan phu'u dang / dbyang chen rin rnam gnyis kyis khyed rnam pa gsum la mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu byas yod ces zer/ skabs der phran gsum nang gros byas nas sngon du kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal rnam gsum mjal 'phrad zhus nas rim bzhin ༷'u lan phu dang / dbyang chin rin rnam pa bcas la mjal 'phrad zhus 'thus zhes bsam tshul bton par de rang 'grigs kyi red ces lan gsal byung ste paṇa chen rin po che mchog la sne shan pa brgyud 'brel ba zhus kyang / nyin shas dus khom mi 'dug ces lan gsal 'byor/ches na7 nyen phye dro chu tshod gsum pa'i thog nga phod kyi bzhugs yul du mjal 'phrad du bskyod de dang thog kho bos 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi 224

bka' yig phul ba dang sbrags de sngon ting sha'o pheng dang / li zhan nyan gnyis nas bod rang btsan dang / kha bral min na de min phan tshun bka' mol ji byed 'grig gi red ces gsungs yod pa ltar da res 7skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma mchog gis phran gsum pe cing du ched brdzongs kyis rgya phyogs mtho rim dpon rigs dang lhan du ma 'ongs bod kyi rtsa don skor gros mol zhu bar yong ba yin lugs bcas brjod par skabs der nga phod nas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' yig blangs nas snang med kyis lcog rtse'i steng du kha ma dbye bar bzhag nas bar lam khong rang bod du phyin te bod rang skyong ljongs mtho rim las byed rnams la bod skad dang / bod yig bed spyod mi byed pa'i skyon gnad mthong gi yod lugs sogs kyi bsam tshul gsungs lugs skor brjod pa las/ nga tsho'i bsam tshul bshad pa der yang do snang de tsam mi byed pa bcas mi de dmar po'i ring lugs kyi lta ba sems su zug pa lta bu chags pa ga la srid snyam pa byung zhing / dus yun gang tsam zhig nas nga tshos slar yang khong la da lam nga tsho rgya phyogs dpon rigs dang bod don skor bka' mol zhu bar yong ba yin/ khyed kyi dgongs 'char ji yod dres par/ khong gis phan tshun gnyis ku'i rtsa don thag chod gtsang ma gtan 'khel byung yod pa yin tsang bka' mol ga re gsungs na'ang chog gi red ces pa las de min dgongs tshul gsal po gang yang gsungs ma byung / nga tshos kyang khong la slar yang gsal po zhu bde ma byung gshis/ nga tshos nga phod sar dus yun chu tshod gcig tsam 'gor nas 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal bzhugs yul du bskyod de nga tsho khong gi bzhugs khang sgo'i phyir 'byor skabs khong dang khong gi gcung po de sngon dga' ldan gyi gra pa yin pa chos 'phel mnyam du sgo'i 'gram du phebs sgug gnang nas bzhugs 'dug225

de sngon 1979 lor nga chos bod ljongs su blta bskor du bskyod skabs khong gi bzhugs khang gu dog po dang / bzhugs yul sa babs kyang zhan po 'dug da lta'i bzhugs khang ni mtho rim las byed gas kyi khang pa thog brtsegs drug pa mdo sbyag can cha tshang spus legs zhig gi nang du spo bzhugs gnang 'dugang tsho khong gi bzhugs khang nang du slobs nas bzhugs gral du 'khod rjes kho bos 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' yig khong la phul ma thag lam seng zhal phye nas do snang chen pos ljags klog gnang song / de rjes nga tshos da res yong don skor khong la rob bsdus tsam brjod skabs khong gis rgya lo lags deng sang gang du bzhugs yod dam ces dres byung ba'i lan du hong kong du bzhugs yod pa 'dra/bar lam mjal 'phrad ma byung zhes zhus/ yang phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis da res khyed tshos hu'u ya'o pang gis don tshan lnga sprad pa de'i ched du phebs pa yin nam zhes dres byung ba'i lan du ma red ces brjod/ da dung khong gis go brda ma 'phrod pa'i rnam pa lta bu 'dug cing / skabs der nga tshos don tshan lnga zhes pa ji yin khong la dres par/ khong nas de sngon rgya lo lags pe cing du phebs kyi yin lugs gsungs par phebs sgug zhus kyang khong phebs ma byung stabs nga bod du 'gro dgos byung / bod la ma 'gro sngon hu'u ya'o pang thengs gnyis tsam mjal 'phrad byung ste phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod mi'i skor byed phyogs gsal po dgos lugs zhus par hu'u ya'o pang gis phan tshun drang po drang bzhag byed rgyu yin zhes yang nas yang du nan tan gsungs byung /hu'u ya'o pang gi dgongs bzhes skor rgya lo lags pe cing du phebs skabs phran dang mjal ma thub par rang bzhin gyis go skabs shor ba red/ ha cang phangs po byung song zhes 'gyod sems chen po byung ba'i rnam pa mngon pa'i mur hu'u ya'o pang dang rgya lo 226

lags mjal 'phrad thog hu'u ya'o pang gis rgya lo lags la chig tho don tshan lnga zhes pa de gnang yod pa red/ don tshan lnga'i ngo bshus paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod/ nga la'ang sprad byung /don tshan dang por/ rgyal khab kyi spyi yongs gnas stangs bris 'dugadon tshan gnyis par/ tā la'i bla ma'i mtshan gnas de sngon ma ltar rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi u yon krang gzhon pa dang / chab srid gros tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas kyi mtshan gnas rang 'jags yod/don tshan gsum par/ tu la'i bla ma pe cing du bzhugs dgos pa las bod du phebs dgos kyi ma red/ deng sang bod la las byed lo gzhon pa tshos las ka yag ripo byed thub kyi yod pa red/don tshan bzhi par/ tshur phebs skabs tong kong brgyud ri li nas phebs na sa mtshams su pu'u krang zhig phebs bsur bcar rgyu dang / gnam thog nas phebs na pe cing gnam thang la phebs bsu gra rgyas shig bya rgyu/don tshan lnga par/ tshur phebs khar thugs 'dod ltar gsal bsgrags shig gnang na 'grigs rgyu bcas 'khod 'dug ces gsungs/ nga tshos khong la de skor dgongs 'char ji yod dres par khong gis nga phod kyis ga re gsung gi 'dug ces nga tshor dres byung bar nga phod kyis gsal po gsungs ma byung zhes lan btab par khong gis nga yang lan sprod khag po red ces gsungs/ de nas nga tshos khong la slar yang rang cag bod mi rnams kyi rtsa don de rgya che'i gzhis lus bod mi rnams kyi ched du yin pa las 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i sku sger dang / phyi rgyal du yod pa'i sku 'khor rnams kyi ched du ma red/ gzhis byes bod mi rnams kyis bod rang dbang 227

rang btsan gtsang ma zhig bsam pa dang / de dag thag gcod gtsang ma zhig ma byung bar 7gong sa mchog bod du phyir phebs ma gnang rogs gnang / rgya mir yid ches dus nam yang med ces bod mi rnams kyis bsam tshul ji snyed zhu mus red/ 'on kyang 7gong sa mchog gis bden pa bden thog gi sgo nas dgongs bzhes rgya chen po gnang ste da lta'i rgya nag gi dbu khrid tshos dngos yod rgyu mtshan la dgongs bzhes gnang ba'i thugs re mdzad de da res nga tsho gsum pe cing du rgya phyogs dang 'brel mol du yong ba yin zhes brjod par khong gis gnas tshul las sla po ma red/ bka' mol thengs gcig gnyis kyis thag chod thub kyi ma red/ dus yun ring po dang/ kyag ge gyog ge mang po byas te don dag 'grub dgos/ khyed rnam pa'i dgongs 'char de gsungs pa la skyon mi 'dug don dag lam seng 'grub rgyu khag po red ces yang nas yang du gsung ba red/nga tsho phun tshogs dbang rgyal sar yod skabs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas zhal dpar zhig phebs par khong gis nga tshor dga' bsu yod pa dang / ring min mjal yong zhes bka' phebs/ gong zhus ltar dang thog paṇa chen rin po mdzad brel kyis nyin shas ring khom min zhes sne shan brgyud bka' phebs byung yang / ches nyer dgu nyin snga dro chu tshod dgu pa'i thog paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun la bcar 'thus kyi bka' phebs pa ltar dus thog bcar te nga tsho gsum nas sngar bzhin chos phyogs kyi srol bzang ltar sku phyag phul rjes rgya gar nas thub dbang gi sku zhig gdan zhu byas yod pa de dang / 'bul mtshon skad 'khor spus legs dang mjal dar bcas phul rjes kho bos 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' yig paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tu phul ma thag phyag gnyis kyis bzung nas khong gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin 228

rlabs zhus rjes zhal phye nas thugs jib legs grub zin nas khyed rnams pe cing du phebs pa yag po byung / thams cad mkhyen pa sku dkyil gsal bzhugs yod dam zhes bka' gnang bar bka' lan zhus pa dang sbrags snga lo teng sha'o pheng dang / li zhan nyan gnyis kyis bod rang btsan dang / kha bral min na tā la'i bla mas bka' mol ga re gnang gi yod na'ang 'grigs kyi red ces gsungs don gzhir bzung gis da res 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas phran gsum rgya phyogs dang gros mol du ched brdzongs gnang ba sogs kyi skor phra zhib snyan seng zhus par paṇa chen rin po ches da res khyed rnams hu'u ya'o pang nas rgya lo lags su gnang ba'i don tshan lnga'i skor phebs pa red dam zhes bka' gnang bar de ma red ces zhus pa dang /da res 7gong sa mchog gis nga tsho gsum rgya phyogs dang / bka' mol zhu rgyu'i bka' mngags gnang ba ltar de sngon teng zha'o pheng nas rang btsan brjod thabs med pa dang / de min bka' mol ga re gnang na'ang 'grig zhes gsungs pa dang / de rjes li zhan nyan gyis kha bral byed thabs med pa las de min tu la'i bla mas bka' mol ga re gnang na yang mi 'greg pa med ces gsungs yod par brten bod mi mang rnams kyi bka' sdug bde rtsa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam/ ched du bka' mol zhu rgyu las 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog gi sku sger dang / byes bzhugs sku 'khor rnams kyi ched du bka' mol zhu rtsis ma yin zhes zhus par paṇa chen rin po mchog gis de dag bka' mol zhus na 'grigs kyi 'dug da lta phan tshun gyi bsam tshul rgyangs khyad chen po yod pa red/ khyed tshos re 'dun gyi bsam tshul gsal po zhus na ma gtogs bsam tshul ma rtogs na mi 'grigs pa chags kyi red/ rang btsan skor da lta phar bzhag de min tshad mtho'i rang skyong 'di dang 'di bzhin yong thabs 229

bya dgos shing / bar lam bod du yag po byung ba'i skor ngos len byed dgos/ tshang ma ma 'grigs ma 'thus pa sha stag ma shod/ bka' mol gnang skabs 'tshab 'tshub ma byed/ zhed snang byed ma dgos/ yang mkhregs po dang tshig rtsub kyang ma shod/phugs bsam ring po gtong dgos/ 'brel ba ma chad pa bya dgos/ tha'i wan la don tshan dgu sprad pa'i skor shod chog pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig red/ da lta'i char de lhag yong thabs med la gnas skabs ring de las lhag pa bya thabs bral zhes bka' slob sbas gsang med pa shin tu rtsa che gnang byung ba dang / yang paṇa chen rin po ches mnyam sbrel rgyal phran zhes pa'i tshig don zhor 'phros su bsam tshul gleng pa las/ rtsa don thog la dngos su brjod na khong tsho dogs 'drog byed kyi red/ ham pa che drags na mi 'grigs/ bod mi rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par dad mos chen po dang / gus brtse tshad mtho po yod lugs shugs chen po shod dgos/ de bod mi rnams kyi rtsa don red/ snga lo skya tshab blta bskor dang po bod du phebs pa ha cang phan thogs byung 'dug nga rang yang bod rigs sa khul la bskyod 'dod yod/ phran bu phan thogs yong gi red/ da res khyed rnam pas bka' mol lam seng don gnad thag chod thub kyi ma red/ 'on kyang / mu mthud 'brel mol byas na yag po 'dug ces dang / na ning rgya lo don grub nga'i sar phebs te da ngas las ka byed kyi min/ phar phyogs tshur phyogs gnyis ku'i rgyang khyad chen po red/de'i bar nga la ming chad yong bzo 'dug ces gsung byung / nged kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs don dang / bod mi dmangs/ kyi las don la phan gyi yod na ming chad dang /dka' ngal 'dzems med gnang dgos lugs zhu rgyu byung zhes bka' slob gnang byung /de nyin snga dro paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar rjes phyi dro chu tshod bzhi 230

pa'i thog nga tsho dbyang chin rin gyi gtsos pa'i gnad yod dpon rigs khag rnams mi dmangs tshogs khang du mjal 'phrad du bskyod/ tshogs khang de'i khongs gtogs pe cing tshoms chen du sne shan pas sne 'khrid de nga tsho mjal 'phrad khang du yar slebs skabs dbyang chin rin gyis gtsos pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang gzhon pa li ku'i dang / cang phing / mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin gzhon pa zhu'u can hwa bcas nas nga tshor bsu len gyis phan tshun 'tshams 'dri zhu res dang sbraḍa sngon tshud nas rkub stegs kha sprod du sgrigs bzhag 'dug par bcas nas nga tshor sne len byas/sne shan pas nga tsho gsum g.yon phyogs dang / khong rnams g.yas phyogs kyi rkub stegs thog la gral 'khod rjes kho bos 7gong sa mchog nas khyed rnam par 'tshams 'dre yod ces gsungs lugs zhus shing / de nas phan tshun bka' mol 'go 'dzugs kyis bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal gyis da res skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog nas snga lo teng sha'o pheng dang / li zhan nyan rnam gnyis kyis bod rang btsan dang / kha bral min pa'i bka' mol gzhan ji 'dra zhig kyang gnang chog gi red ces gsungs pa gzhi bzung ltar nga tsho gsum pe cing du ched brdzongs gnang ste khyed rnam pa lhan du ma 'ongs bod kyi rtsa don skor la bka' mol zhu bar yong ba yin zhes gsungs par/ dbyang chin rin gyis blo mthun teng zha'o pheng dang / li zhan nyan rnam gnyis kyis gsungs pa dang / de rjes blo ma thun hu'u ya'o pang gis rgya lo don grub dang mjal 'phrad skabs gsungs pa bcas gcig gyur red/ blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang gis rgya lo don grub la tshig tho zhig phul yod/ de yang dag pa red ces zer/ bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal gyis deng rabs rgyal spyi'i nang gi rgyal khab khag gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas tshang ma mthun 23ga

phyogs kyi nus pa mnyam bskyed byed pa'i dus skabs shig yin stabs nga tsho bod mi sa ya drug zur du bsdad pa las rgya nag mi 'bor sa ya stong phrag gcig dang mnyam du bsdad na der gzi brjid che ba yod bsam gyi yod/ 'on kyang gcig 'og gcig sdod ma yin pa 'dra mnyam thog bod rigs yongs kyi sa khul rnams kha bral ma yin par phyogs gcig tu gnas pa'i thog bod me rnams la rang thag rang gcod chog pa'i thob thang ming don mtshungs pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang 'os pa zhig red/ nye char krung dbyang nas tha'i wan la don tshan dgu thag gcod gsal bsgrags gnang 'dug par bod la de las lhag pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang 'os pa zhig red/ dper na/ tha'i wan la yod pa'i mi rigs phal cher rgya nag skam sa chen po nas snga rjes su bskyod pa'i rgya mi rigs yin pa ma zad/ rgya nag gi zhing chen gyi gras shig kyang red/ bod kyi lo rgyus de tha'i wan dang 'dra gi ma red/ bod mi rigs 'di mi rigs su dang 'dres lhad med pa'i mi rigs khe gtsang zhig red/ lhag par du bod du chab srid dang / chos/ rig gzhung / goms gshis/ skad yig bcas logs su yod pa red/slad bod mi dmangs la thob thang yag po byung na rgyal spyi'i thog krung go rgyal khab kyi mtshan don la gzi brjid dang / phan thogs chen po yong gi red snyam gyi 'dug ces gsungs par/ dbyang chin rin gyis bod dang tha'i wan gnyis kyi gnas stangs 'dra gi ma red/ bod ni bcings 'grol btang nas lo sum cu so gnyis phyin pa ma zad/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zin nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam du zhugs zin par brten spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam du phyir log brgyab na 'grig gi ma red la/ bod mi dmangs rnams dang / las byed rnams kyis khas len byed kyi ma red/ krung go mi dmangs dung phyur bcu nas kyang khas len byed kyi ma red/ nga tshos tshong rgyag gi ma 232

red/ tha'i wan ni bcings 'grol gtong rgyur bsdad yod/ da lta'i tha'i wan gyi gnas stangs de dmigs bsal can gyi sa khul zhig yin zhes 'khod yod/ de nga'i sger gyi bsam tshul yin/ khyed tshos bsam tshul bton pa rnams dbus gzhung la snyan seng zhu gi yin zer ba'i lan du/ tha'i wan dang bod gnyis kyi gnas stangs mi 'dra ba red ces gsungs pa de khyed rnam pa'i gzigs tshul zhig red/ 'on kyang tha'i wan la dgongs pa bzhes pa de las lhag pa'i dgongs pa bod la bzhes ma 'os pa ma red/da lta gsungs don bzhin bod 'di spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam du phyir log rgyag gi red snyam pa'i thugs khral gnang ma dgos/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla mas rgyun du bod mi rnams la nga tshos spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta ba dang / gsar brje/ rgya mi rigs bcas la ngo rgol byed kyi med/ nga chos gtso bor bod mi rnams kyi drang bden gyi thob thang ched du yin zhes bka' slob yang yang gnang gi yod pa red ces dang /de nas kho bos dbyang chin rin pu'u krang gis bod 'di slar yang spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs su phyir log rgyag rtsis yin lugs gsungs pa de nga tsho'i blo yul la yang med/ 'ju chen thub bstan gyis gsungs pa ltar tā la'i bla mas dus rgyun du gtso bor bod mi rnams kyi bde skyid kho nar dgongs pa bzhes pa'i thog ma 'ongs par bod 'di bde skyed dang ldan pa'i spyi tshogs shig yong thabs la dgongs bzhes gnang bzhin yod pa red/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs su nam yang phyir log rgyag gi ma red/ tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs bzhes gnang stangs de khyed rnam pas lam tsam rtogs thub kyi red bsam gyi yod/ gang ltar bod mi rnams la mi rigs 'dra mnyam thog rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang dgongs bzhes gnang dgos kyi 'dugagang yin zhu na bod kyi 'das pa'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus gang ci'i thog nas rang skyong sa 233

khul gzhan dag rnams dang 'dra gi ma red/ bod la ming don mtshungs pa'i thob thang dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ de mtshungs bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs dum bu mang por bgos yod pa 'di dag phyogs gcig tu gnas thub pa'i thog bod mi rang nyid kyi las 'gan 'khur du 'jug dgos/ tu la'i bla ma phyir phebs ma phebs skor khong gis bod mi rnams kyi bde skyed 'dod blo khengs pa byung mtshams ngas ga dus yin rung phyir log byas chog chog red ces yang yang gsung gi yod/ khong gi mtshan gnas dang / khe phan bcas la gal chen por dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod pa ma red ces zhus/de rjes bod btsan byol gzhung gi spyi 'thus tshogs gtso rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis khyed rnam pas dgongs pa rgya chen po bzhes dgos/ hob ste gzigs na nga tsho bod mi rigs gcig pu'i khe phan ched du bshad pa lta bu gzigs kyi yod 'gro/thag ring po dang zhib tshags pos gzigs na krung go rgyal khab kyi gzi brjid dang / khe phan yang red bsam gyi yod/ nga tshos gang zhus pa de mar le ring lugs kyi mi rigs ring lugs thog 'dzin pa'i srid byus dang mthun pa zhig red/ de ltar lag len 'khel thub che ma/ra le ring lugs kyi lta ba'i rgyal kha thob pa zhig kyang red/ gong du gsungs pa ltar bod don thog dgongs pa yag po bzhes thub na krung go rgyal khab la dga' zhen dang / yid ches blos 'khel zhu gi red/ tha'i wan dang bod kyi gnas tshul tha dad red ces gsungs par blo pham byung / tha'i wan ni krung go'i cha shas red bsam gyi yod/ yin na'ang khyed rnam pas g.yas par spyan dang / g.yon par mig zer ba ltar ma yin par drang po dang 'os shing 'tshams pa'i dgongs pa zhig bzhes dgos/ dgongs 'char lhug po gsungs pa dga' po byung zhes gsungs pa'i rjes dbyang chen rin gyis slar yang gong gsal skyar chos lan 'debs byas/234

de nyin nga tsho gsum gyis dbyang chen rin la dgag lan re rgyag skabs khong khro rab tu 'bar te rkub bkug steng nas yar langs thog phar tshur gom pa re zung spos/tha mag shugs chen 'then te yud tsam bsam blo btang nas slar yang rkub bkyag steng rang 'jags su bsdad de ngo gdong dmar por 'gyur gyi 'dug skabs re khong khro'i rnam pa tshod 'dzin lta bus zhi dul ngag 'jam du 'gyur gyi 'dugadabyang chin rin ni skyes yul rgya nag nub byang lan kra'u khul hu'i rigs shig yin zhing / na gzhon skabs gung khran tang la zhugs te/ phyi lo 1949 lo'i sngon kun su'u zhing chen khul gsang ba'i las 'gul byas yod pa dang / de rjes rgya nag yongs su dmar po'i ring lugs su 'gyur rjes pe cing du gnas spos ste mi rigs las khungs kyi las byed theg pa rim 'dzigs kyis mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u rin dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang bcas gcig lcogs kyi las 'gan dang /nga tsho pe cing nas rgya gar du thon rjes re zhig rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon gzhon pa'ang gcig lcogs su bsko bzhag byas 'dug kyang dus yun de tsam gnas mi 'dugang tsho pe cing du yod pa'i dus skabs der dbyang chin rin rlung rta dar ba'i dus skabs yin stabs de sngon khong gi gong rim ༷'u lan phu'u la yang de tsam brtsi bkur mi byed par mngon/gong smros ltar/ 1981 lo zla ba bdun pa'i nang sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog pe cing du phebs te rgya dmar gyi spyo khyab hru'u ci hu'u ya'o pang dang mjal 'phrad gnang skabs hu'u ya'o pang gis brjod don ji mchis tshig tho don tshan lnga bkod nas rgya don la sprod pa las rgya lo don grub kyi gsung gleng tshig zur tsam yang tshig tho de'i nang bkod yod pa ma red/ hu'u ya'o pang gi tshig tho ni 'di ltar yin/235

1981 zla ba bdun pa'i ches nyer bdun nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod gsum par mi dmangs tshogs chen du rgya lo don grub la mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i gros don tshig tho gsham gsal/ blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang gis nga tshos lhag bsam zol med thog nas gros mol don tshan de 'dra 'ga' zhig gcig thag chod pa red/1 nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi chab srid rgyun ring brtan gnas yod pa dang / dpal 'byor yang rgyun ma chad pa'i 'phel rgyas su 'gro gi yod/ mi rigs kyi mthun bsgril sngar las lhag pa'i thog phan tshun rogs ram gyi dus rabs gsar pa zhig chags yod pa red/ tu la'i bla ma dang / khong gi rjes 'brangs rnams blo rigs gsal ba sha stag la brten don tshan 'di la nges par du yid ches gnang gi red/ gal srid yid ches ma gnang che lo shas gzigs na 'grig gi red/na tā la'i bla ma dang / khong gis nga tsho dang 'brel gtugs ched btang gnang ba'i mi snas nges par lhag bsam zol med byed pa las gab res yib res ma byed/nyo tshong gi byed stangs ma byed/ 'das pa'i rnyog 'dzings kyi lo rgyus de'ang skyar du ma shod 1959 lo'i lo rgyus de tshang mas brjed rgyu dang / rtsis med btang rgyu/3 nga tshos lhag bsam rnam dag gi thog nas tu la'i bla ma dang / khong gi rjes 'brangs rnams phyir log phebs pa'i dmigs yul ni khong gis nga tsho rgyal khab gcig gyur rgyun 'khyongs dang bod mi rigs dang / mi rigs khag yongs rdzogs kyi mthun bsgril gong 'phel thog deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs bskrun ched du legs skyes gnang bar dga' bsu zhu gi yod/4 tu la'i bla mas phyir phebs gtan bzhugs rjes su chab srid kyi thob thang dang / 'tsho ba'i thob thang de/ 1959 lo sngon thob thang der 'gyur ba med/ tang 236

krung dbyang gis rgyal yongs mi mang tshogs chen la bsam 'char bton nas rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshogs chen gyi u yon krang gzhon pa gnang rgyu dang / de mtshungs gros mol byas nas chab srid gros tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'ang gnang rgyu/ 'tsho ba'i thog sngar gyi thob thang rgyun 'khyongs der 'gyur ba med/ 'on kyang bod du phyir phebs gnang dgos ma red/ deng sang bod la na gzhon gas yar slebs yod pa rnams kyi las ka yag po byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang skabs re bod du gzigs bskor du phebs chog gi red/ nga tshos khong gi rjes 'brangs rnams la'ang 'os shing 'tshams pa'i bkod sgrig byed kyi red/ las ku'i nang du zhugs stangs dang / 'tsho ba bcas la sems khral byed dgos ma red/ de sngon las yag tu gtong gi red/ gang yin zhe na nga tsho'i rgyal khab 'di yar rgyas phyin yod pa red/5 tu la'i bla mas ga dus phyir phebs gnang rgyu thugs gtan 'khel mtshams phyi rol la gsal bsgrags thung tsam zhig gnang rgyu/ gsal bsgrags nang du khong gi thugs 'dod ltar gnang rgyu/ khong nas lo dang rla ches bcas gtan 'khel mtshams nga tshor lan zhig gnang rogs/ gal srid hong kong brgyud skam sar phebs che nga tsho'i pu'u krang gi gnas rim yod pa zhig gis blo mthun 'ga' shas bcas 'khrid nas sa mtshams su dga' bsu zhu rgyu/ gal srid gnam thog nas phebs che nga tshos rtsa 'dzugs gzhi khyon nges can gyi dga' bsu zhu rgyu dang / gnas tshul zhig kyang gsal bsgrags bya rgyu zhes 'khod 'dugagong gsal don tshan lnga po de la hob ste blta skabs 'dra chags lhad med kyi brtse gdung yod mdog lta bur mngon yang / don snying la zhib tu dpyad skabs mgo bskor bslu brid kyi dong rnyi'i nang du 'khrid pa'i ngan byus shig red/ lhag par du don 237

tshan bzhi pa'i nang tā la'i bla mas phyir phebs gtan bzhugs gnang rjes chab srid kyi thob thang dang / 'tsho ba'i thob thang de sngon gyi thob thang ltar 'gyur ba med ces dang / pe cing du bzhugs rgyu las bod du phyir phebs chog gi ma red ces pa de snga tshig phyi 'gal ma zad tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la 'tsho ba khungs ma 'khyol bar phebs kyi yod pa lta bu dang / lhag par du phyir phebs rjes pe cing du gtan bzhugs gnang rgyu las/ bod du phyir phebs mi chog pa zer ba de'i nang don ji yin la klog pa po rnams kyis gzigs dang / bod mi rnams kyi rna bar 'gro gi red pas/ de ni byis par bslu brid byed pa lta bu'i gtam zhig kyang ma red dam/de nyin phan tshun chu tshod gnyis tsam ring rtsod gleng rno ngar dang ldan pa byung yang /mthar mdza' brtse'i rnam pa'i thog nas nyin shas rjes slar yang mjal 'dzoms kyi gros gleng bya rgyur tshang mas mos mthun byas/ gsol ston du phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang khongs gtogs chos don cus las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa 'ba' pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes pa yang phebs 'duganyin gcig nga tsho'i sne shan pa rin ring gis dbus gzhung gi dbu khrid rnams zla gcig ring las brel che bas mjal khom med lugs zer ba ltar nga tshos pe cing nye 'dab kyi bzo gra dang / gna' shul mjes ljongs khag bcas la blta bskor rim byas thog pe cing nub byang hran zhi zhing chen gyi lte gnas tha'i yon nye 'gram du snyan grags can gyi nang chos kyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga zhes par mjal du bskyod de mtshan gnyis bsdad/ri bo rtse lnga de 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gnas ri zhig yin zer/ sa gnas der ri rtse lnga yod pas ri bo rtse lngar grags/ ri rtse bzhi'i dkyil la gnas pa'i ri de'i g.yas g.yon du dgon pa dang / mchod rten chen po zhig yod/ de ni dus rabs gsum pa'i 238

yas mas su rgya gar nas phebs pa'i slob dpon zhig gis bzhengs pa red ces zer srol 'dug ri de mtho po yod stabs gnam gshis grang mo dang/ skabs re gangs ma char yang 'bab kyi yod 'dug de sngon bod dang sog po gnyis kyi gnas bskor ba dang / rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa nyams len bya yul zhig yin zer/ de sngon ri bo rtse lnga'i g.yas g.yon ri rtse khag la lha khang dang / mtshams khang bcas mang po yod kyang nyi hong dmag 'khrugs skabs gtor skyon chen po byung ba red zer/ 'on kyang da yod lha khang mang che ba de tsam skyon chags byung med par mngon/ lha khang nang du rgya mi'i grwa pa sum cu bzhi cu lhag tsam bzhugs 'dugang tsho ri bo rtse lngar bsdad pa'i nyin mtha' ma'i dgong mor nga tsho'i sne shan pa rin ring phran sar yong ste sanganyin nga tsho pe cing du log dgos/ rgyal khab kyi dbu 'khrid tshos khyed rnam gsum la mjal 'phrad gnang gi red/ nye char khyed rnam pa dang / dbyang chin rin pu'u krang bka' mol gnang ba de tsam gsal po byung med stabs de rjes blo mthun zhu'u can ha khyed rang tsho dang bka' mol gnang yod pa red/hu'u ya'o pang gis sku zhabs rgya lo don grub la don tshan lnga sprad pa'i skor tā la'i bla mas dgongs bzhes gnang ma bde ba byung ba yin nam der rdugs pa gnang dgos ma red/ khyed tsho'i dgongs 'char ji yod gsal po gsung thub na yag po yod pa red/dgongs 'char de krung dbyang nas shes thub na dge mtshan yod/ dper na/ 1979lor nga tsho mnyam du bod rigs sa khul khag la blta bskor du bskyod nas pe cing du phyir log rjes khyed rnams kyi gzigs tshul ji byung rnams krung dbyang la dgongs 'char zhus pa ltar nga dang ku'o ra'o gnyis kyi mthong tshul yig thog shugs che bkod de krung dbyang la phul bar brten tang krung dbyang gis thugs snang chen po gnang ste tang 239

krung dbyang rgyun las chab srid cus tshogs gros thog bod don la legs bsgrigs bya rgyu thag gcod byung ste blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang dang / wan li bcas bod du ched phebs gnang nas legs sgriḍa gnang ba ma zad/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tru ci blo mthun ran rong bod nas phyir 'then byas pa dang / bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos yong thabs su dbul bcos phyug 'gyur gyi srid byus rtsa don brgyad dang / don chen drug ces lag len don 'khyol gnang ba red/ skabs der bod la yod pa'i blo mthun mang pos nga dang ku'o ra'e gnyis la mi dga' ba chen po byung yod pa red ces zer bar/kho bos snga lo nga tsho mnyam du bod kyi sa khul gang tsam zhig la blta bskor bskyod pa'i mthong tshul rnams ku'o ra'i dang / khyed rnam gnyis kyis yig thog dbus gzhung la phul te 1980 lor spyi khyab hru'u ci hu'u ya'o pang bod du ched phebs gnang ste de sngon lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring rgyal khab phyi nang la bod ljongs gsar pa yarargyas chen po byung tshul skor 'ud sgrog ma yin yin tshul gyi khyab bsgrags byas pa de hu'u ya'o pang gis gsal po gzigs nas da bar bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba ha cang thabs skyo por gnas yod lugs gsungs pa'i thog slad bod mi rnams la dbul bcos phyug 'gyur gyi srid byus lag len bstar ba red/ der tā la'i bla ma thugs mnyes gnang ba'i thog phyi nang mi sna khag la bsngags brjod kyang gnang gi yod/ tu la'i bla mas phyir phebs skor kha sngon nga tshos dbyang chin rin pu'u krang la gsal po zhus yod/tā lam bla ma dus rgyun du bod mi rnams kyi gnas stangs thugs blo khengs pa byung mtshams khong bod du nges par phyir phebs gnang gi red/ khong skya sger gyi chab srid thob thang la dgongs pa bzhes kyi ma red/ dbus gzhung gi mtho rim tshos tu la'i bla ma'i dgongs bzhes rnams yag yo mkhyen dgos kyi 'dug ces brjod par rin ring 240

gis tu la'i bla mas phyi rgyal gsar shog thog la gsung gleng gnang ba rnams krung dbyang dbu 'khrid pa rnams kyis mkhyen gyi yod pa ma zad/ tu la'i bla mas chab srid kyi thob thang la dgongs bzhes ma gnang ba de ha cang gzi brjod chen po red ces bsngags brjod dang / gus brtsi zhu yi yod pa red/ 'on kyang krung dbyang dbu 'khrid rnams kyis tu la'i bla mas mes rgyal du ga dus phebs kyang khong la chab srid kyi thob thang de teng phu'u kru'u zhis snga lo rgya lo don grub mjal 'phrad skabs bka' gnang yod pa red/ skabs der nga yang brjed tho bri bar bcar yod/ nye dus blo mthun dbyang chin rin gyis khyed rnams la yang bka' mol gsal po gnang ba don gcig pa red/tu la'i bla ma dang khyed tsho'i dgongs tshul ji yod bton thub na yag po 'dug ces zer bar/phran gyis tu la'i bla ma dang nga tsho'i bsam tshul rnams dbyang chin rin la gong zhus ltar gsal po bton yod/ de las gsal ba bton sdig med/ yin na'ang nga'i sger gyi bsam tshul gcig gnyis bshad kyi yin/dang po/ snga lo tu la'i bla ma'i phyag bris shig rgya lo don grub gdong teng zha'o pheng la phul yod par 'byor lan tsam ma gnang ba nga tsho blo pham byung zhing / dper na/ tā la'i bla ma de sngon bod du bzhugs ring ma'o kru'u zhi dang / phan tshun phyag bris kyi thog nas 'brel ba gnang skabs ma'o kru'u zhi rang gi lag bris yig lan yang yang gnang gi yod/gnyis par/ nga tsho bod ljongs 'di bzhin 'dar pa'i dus rabs kyi chab srid gnas stangs dang / chos rig dpal 'byor/ mi rigs kyi skad yig goms gshis bcas gang ci'i thog nas mi rigs gzhan rnams dang bsdur thabs med pa zhig red/24

man ju'i dus rabs shugs che ba'i skabs su yang chab srid dang / dmag don/dpal 'byor bcas kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum mtha' dag bod gzhung rang gis rang thag rang gcod kyi dbang cha cha tshang lag len bstar yod pa red/lhag par du/ 1911 lo nas 1951 lo bar lo ngo bzhi bcu'i ring bod rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab lta bur gnas yod/de bzhin 1951 lo gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun pa'i gleng brjod du bod de mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du phyir log byed dgos ces gsal ba des bar skabs bod de krung go dang logs su rgyal khab zhig yin pa ngos len byas par mngon/de mtshungs bod rgya'i dbar gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun de yig thog tu bzhag dgos byung ba red/ shin cang dang / nang sog bcas la de 'dra'i gnas tshul byung yod pa ma red bcas brjod par sne shan rin ring gis da lta khyed rang gis bsam tshul gsungs pa de 'dra zhig de sngon padma rgyal po nas kyang nga la shod myong / khyed rang gi bsam tshul de gong rim la snyan seng zhu gi yin zhes zer/ sne shan rin ring ni 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi mtho rim rnams blos 'khel ba'i las byed gnad yod zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod rigs sde tshan khru'u gyi khru'u krang gi las 'gan 'khur mkhan zhig kyang yin 'dug par brten bod don che chung la ma ltos pa khong brgyud nas ma gtogs 'gro yul med ces zer/nga tshos ri bo rtse lnga nas pe cing du phyir 'khor rjes rla 5 ches 19 nyin de sngon bod du phran gyi ngo shes grogs po zhu'i than lu'u zhes pa kho bo thug 'phrad du slebs te bar lam lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring phan tshun gnas tshul ji 'phrad skor gleng mol byung ba dang / khong gis da res khyed tshos gnad yod dpon rigs dang bka' mol 242

byung ba'i skor phun tshogs dbang rgyal sa nas shes byung / khyed tshos chos don skor la bka' mol gang yang gleng mol ma byung ba yin pa 'dra/ don gnas de nges par bka' mol gnang dgos/ lhag par du slad tu la'i bla ma'i yang srid skor bsam blo sngon tshud nas gtong dgos/ de ni khyed tsho bod rigs rnams la don gnad ha cang gal chen po yod pa red ces dang / yang khong gis nub phyogs pa'i na gzhon mang pos tu lo'i bla mar dad gus chen po zhu gi yod lugs thos byung ba de ha cang yag po red/ krung dbyang gis tā la'i bla mas dbus pa'i sku 'khor rnams mes rgyal la phyir phebs gnang thabs kyi re 'dun gnang gi yod pa dang / phyir phebs gnang nas pe cing du gtan bzhugs gnang rgyu'i gnas tshul 'dug pa de la khyed rang gi bsam tshul ji yod ces 'dre 'dug par/ nga'i sger gyi bsam tshul byas na mos mthun rtsa ba nas med/ tā la'i bla mas phyir phebs dang ma phebs thad bod mi dmangs rnams kyi gnas stangs la rag las yod/ slad bod mi dmangs rnams la bde skyid kyi gnas stangs thugs blo khengs pa zhig byung mtshams tā la'i bla ma nges par bod du phyir phebs gnang gi red/ 'on kyang tā la'i bla ma'i bzhugs yul bod rang la ma gtogs pe cing la bzhugs kyi ma red/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma pe cing du bzhugs 'jug pa yin na bod mi rnams kyis mos mthun nam yang zhu gi ma red/ pe cing du bzhugs pa las da mus bzhin rgya gar du bzhugs pa de yag gi red ces brjod par/ yang khong gis krung dbyang dang bka' mol gang mkhas gnang dgos pa las mkhregs po gnang rgyu mi 'dug zer/ de rjes khong nas nga dang bka' mol ji byung skor don tshan gnyis yig thog tu bkod skede 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su sprad yod par/243

don tshan dang po/ tu la'i bla ma phyir phebs gnang na bod du bzhugs rgyu las krung dbyang gis tā la'i bla ma pe cing du gtan bzhugs bya rgyu'i dgongs gzhi der 'dod mos byed kyi med lugs/don tshan gnyis par slad bod riḍa sa khul yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgril ba'i thog chab srid kyi thob thang yang tshad mtho po zhig dgos rgyu bcas kyi bsam tshul chen po 'dug ces chig tho zhig phul yod lugs khungs ldan zhig gi sa nas go thos byung /nga tsho pe cing du phyir 'khor nas zla 5 ches 39 nyin phyi dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog mi mang tshogs chen nang gi pe cing tshoms chen mgron khang du krung gung dbus rgyun las chab srid cus kyi drung che gzhon pa zhi krung zhun gyi gtsos pa'i gnad yod dpon rigs rnams dang mjal 'phrad bya rgyu'i brda lan 'byor ba ltar dus thog tu bskyod/nga tsho pe cing tshoms chen mgron khang gi sgo 'gram du slebs skabs zhi krung zhun dang / wu'u lan phu/ dbyang chin rin rnam gsum gtsos pa'i cang pheng dang / zhu'o can ha bcas sngon du phebs nas nga tsho sgug bzhugs 'dugakhong rnams kyis nga tsho mthong ma thag mdun bsus thog zhi krung zhun gyis 'dzum mdang dang bcas khyed tsho tu la'i bla mas krung dbyang dang 'brel ba gnang bar ched brdzong gnang ba de nga tshos dga' bsu yod/ khyed rnam pas gsungs pa'i dgongs 'char rnams krung dbyang gis tshang ma shes rtogs byung / krung dbyang nas tha'i lhan la don tshan dgu bton pa'i byed phyogs de dag las rgya che ba zhig bod la dgos kyi 'dug ces pa'i bsam tshul 'dug bod de tha'i lhan dang ga 'dra se sdur gyi red/bod de 1951 lor zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob pa ma zad/ bod rang skyong yang btsugs zin nas mi rigs rang skyong gi khe dbang thob yod/ 1951 lor don tshan 244

bcu bdun bzhag rjes lo ngo sum cu'i ring spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun yang byas yod/ da lta tha'i wan de mes rgyal gyi pang du phyir log byas yod pa ma red/sngar bzhin gnas yod/ a mi ri kus khug nas bzung ste 'khrid kyi yod/ phyi bun mang po sprod dgos kyi yod pa red/ dka' ngal chen po 'phrad kyi yod/ bod dang tha'i wan gnyis kyi ngo bo dang gnas stangs mi 'dra ba red/ gnad don de 'don mkhan mi de spyir btang gi shes yon med pa zhig red/ nga tshos shes gsal la a mi ri kus krung go gcig dang / tha'i wan gcig bzo rgyu'i 'char gzhi gcig dang / de bzhin mi 'ga' shas kyi bod gcig dang / krung go gcig bzo rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod par de dag nga tshos khas len byed kyi ma red/ khyed tshos bod chen po rang skyong tshad mtho po zhig gi bsam tshul 'don gyi yod pa de dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun gyi ma red/yin na'ang bod rigs rnams la khyad chos shig yod pa red/ bod rang skyong sa khul la bod rigs rkyang pa red/ sa khul gzhan rnams la bod rigs rkyang rkyang ma red/yun nan zhing chen gcig pur mi rigs khag nyi shu rtsa gsum yod/ nga tshos bod ljongs sa khul la bod rang skyong ljongs zhes pa btsugs yod/ si khron dang / yun nan/mtsho sngon/ kun su'u bcas bod rigs 'dus sdod sa khul la bod rigs rang skyong sa khul dang / rang skyong shan bcas btsugs yod pa de dag rnams la dngos 'brel mi rigs rang skyong lag len bstar yod/ de ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs khyad du 'phags pa'i rang bzhin zhig red/ bod ljongs de bcings 'grol ma btang gong zhing bran lam lugs yin zhing / da cha rtsa ba nas 'dra gi ma red/ 'on kyang lo ngo bcu'i ring zang zing gi rkyen pas bod de yang god chags las nyen g.yol ma thub pa red/ gal srid dmigs bsal can gyi gnas tshul de byung med na/ deng sang bod 245

kyi rnam pa de 'dra zhig ma red/ grub 'bras chen po zhig thob kyi red ces dang / yang khong gis tā la'i bla mas su'u len du 'tshams 'drer phebs pa de yag po ma red/de tsho'i mgo bskor bslu brid 'og tu 'tshud kyi red/ thugs snang chen po gnang dgos bcas gsungs/chig don mgo mjug rnams 'gal rla yod pa dang / bod ljongs sa khul gyi dngos yod gnas stangs ji bzhin ma rtogs pa'i dbang shugs kyi skad cha mang dag zhig bshad par/de nas nga chos/ nga tsho'i 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi thog la dgongs pa bzhes dgos kyi red/ bod 'di nang sog dang / shin cang gnyis dang 'dra gi ma red/dper na/ de sngon bod kyi chab srid kyi gnas stangs dang / chos rig dpal 'byor/dmag don/ mi rigs kyi goms gshis/ skad yig de bzhin bod mi'i khyad chos bcas dmigs bsal can zhig red/ lhag par du bod mi rnams gnas yul bod kyi sa khul du 'brel mthud kyis gnas yod pa dang / sa khul de rnams su gnas pa'i mi rnams bod mi rkyang rkyang yin par brten 'os shing 'tshams pa'i dgongs pa bzhes 'os pa zhig red ces brjod par/zhi krung zhun gyis de lo rgyus shig red/ ma 'ongs par bod mi rigs rnams kyis bsam gzhigs byed dgos red ces bshad pa'i tshig mtshams su dbyang chin rin gyis gnas tshul de'i thad rgya lo don grub nas blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang la bsam tshul de bton par hu'u ya'o pang gis da lta krung dbyang gis gnad don der bsam blo btang med/ 'on kyang gnad don der bod nang gi bod mi rnams kyi bsam gzhigs gtong rgyu las khyed tshos bsam tshul bton na 'tshams po ma red ces sngar bzhin ngo gdong nag po'i ngang nas nan po brjod par/246

kho bos/ kha sngon dbyang chin rin pu'u krang khyed rang la zhus don bzhin bod mi rnams kyi gnas stangs de bod mi gzhis byes thun mong gi bsam tshul gcig mthun zhig yin par brten bod mi tshang ma'i 'os 'gan zhig yin bsam gyi yod/ dper na/ phyi rgyal khag tu yod pa'i rgya mi rnams kyis rgya nag gi gnas babs ji byung rnams la de bzhin du bsam gzhigs dang / sems 'khur byas pa dang / gcig gyur yin par bsam gyi yod ces brjod/ de mtshams tshogs gtso rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis da lta hru'u ci zhi krun zhun gyis tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal mi chos bed spyod 'og ma 'tshud pa dgos rgyu zhes gsungs pa/ tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam bzhugs ring phyi rgyal mi su zhig gi bed spyod 'og tu dbu 'khor ba'i gnas tshul byung yog ma red/ khong gis gang ci'i thad la dgongs bzhes mkhyen rlabs ldan pa zhig gnang yod/ thugs khral gnang dgos med/ tā la'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dbu 'khrid red/ khong gis chos kyi 'brel mol kho na yin par brten thugs rdugs gnang dgos ma red ces gsungs/yang kho bos/ gong zhus ltar bod rigs sa khul rnams nges par du gcig la bsgril nas gnas dgos pa gal che zhig red/ de sngon gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag rjes tsam la bod kyi skya tshab gtso bo nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis bod rigs sa khul rnams gcig tu bsgril dgos rgyu'i tshig tho zhig rlis khri han brgyud dbus gzhung la phul ba ltar srid blon kra'u en lan kyis ngag thog nas da lta bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs gcig tu rla bsgril bya rgyu'i dus skabs la slebs med pa dang / bod zhi ba'i bcings bkrol de gzhi nas lag len bstar rgyu red/ bod rigs sa khul gzhan rnams bcings 'grol sngon du btang zin yod stabs sa khul de rnams kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor sogs gom pa sngon du spos yod tsang mos 247

mthun byed kyi ma red/ rjes su rla bsgril chog gi red ces gsungs yod ces brjod pa'i skabs u lan phu mgo bo lcog lcog gis ngos len lta bu'i rnam 'gyur bstan song /de nyin chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam ring phan tshun gnyis kus zol med kyi bsam tshul brjod res dang / rtsod gleng byung stabs phan tshun ma spro ba'i rnam 'gyur mngon yang / mtha' mar mdza' brtse'i rnam pa'i thog nas rjes su 'brel mol bya rgyur tshang mas mos mthun gyis tshogs 'du grol/ gsol ston rgyas pa zhig bshams song /de nyin nga tsho'i bsam tshul shugs che brjod skabs zhi krung zhun gyis dgad mo'i rnam pa las khong khro nga rgyal gyi rnam 'gyur ma mngon yang / skabs rer gsal bshad byed skabs zur za khyad gsod lta bu'i tshig ngan ji snyed cig bed spyod byas song / de ni rgya mi dmar po'i mi rnams kyi nga rgyal rang che'i srol rgyun zhig red/gsol ston grol rjes zhi krung zhun gyis da ring nga tsho phan tshun rno ngar ldan pa'i bsam tshul kha ri kha thug tu bton pa yag po byung / rjes su da mus bzhin 'brel gtuḍa byed phyoḍa ldi li dang / hong kong gnyis gang rung la 'brel ba bya rgyu bcas brjod/de'i sang nyin nga tsho gsum rgya gar du phyir log gi gra sgrig byas shing / pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir log thon khar paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ de min pe cing khul du gnas pa'i bod mi ngo shes rnams la gyes 'tshams zhu bar bskyod de paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis da res khyed tshos dbus gzhung dang bka' mol gsal po yag po byung 'dug don dag lam seng 'grub rgyu khag po red/ sems shugs nam yang chag mi rung / 'brel ba mu mthud byed rgyu byas pa de yag po red/ 'brel ba mu mthud byed rgyu byung ba de yag po red/ lan dgu chad mthud kyi dpe ltar 'bad brtson byed dgos zhes bka' slob gnang byung /de nas rgya gar du phyir log thog phran gsum nas pe cing du gros mol ji byung 248

skor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas bcas la zhib cing phra ba snyan seng zhus par 7gong sa mchog gis da res lam seng grub 'bras don son ma byung yang / phan tshun nas bsam tshul gsal po bshad res byung ba yag po byung 'dug slad da mus bzhin 'brel gtugs bya rgyu byung ba de gal chen po zhig red ces bka' phebs//zhi dul sems dpa' chen po'i thugs skyed kyi chu 'dzin//zhi mol bod rgya gnyis dge'i mkha' dbyings su 'khrigs kyang //zhi 'jam rgyud la med pa'i gung khran gyi than ltas//zhi bar mi nus dngos po'i gshis lugs la gzigs dang //24bye

rdzo le tshan so dgu pa/phyi lo 1984 lor bod gzhung gi skya tshab mi gsum pe cing du gros mol thengs gnyis par bskyod pa/༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 1983 rla ba bcu pa tsam nas bzung kho bo lo na'i babs kyisagazugs khams zhan 'gyur la brten 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog la bka' blon las 'khur dgongs zhu snyan zhu rim phul ltar/ 1983 rla 3 ches 11 nyin dgongs zhu bka' 'khrol thugs rje bla med du che yang slad skabs rer ldi li bca' sdod rgya nag gzhung sku tshab dang 'brel gtugs sngar bzhin bya dgos rgyu dang / rgya'i deb rnying khag tu bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba ji byung rnams bod yig tu phab sgyur zhu dgos bka' phebs pa ltar sri zhu gang thub 'bad brtson zhus/1984 lo dpyid dbyar dus ring lus khams je zhan du gyur te ldi ler sman bcos dang sbrags rgya gar lho phyogs bod mi sdod sgar du 'tshams 'dri ngal gso chabs cig tu bskyed nas ldi lir phyir 'byor skabs bka' blon 'ju chen ngo 'phrad byung bar lho phyogs gzhis chags khag nang rang gzhung sku tshab cig rgya nag tu gtong 'char yod lugs shod kyi 'dug par de dag dngos 'brel yin nam dres par/dngos 'brel yin/ sku ngo khyed rang yang nga tsho mnyam du phebs rgyu gtan 'khel song 25
