gsungs shing / nyin shas rjes bzhugs sgar du phyir 'khor skabs 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis bka' blon bgres pa 'ju chen dang / kho bo/ phyi dril drung che las 'phar rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan bcas pe cing du gros mol thengs gnyis pa'i sku tshab la bsko gzhag mdzad 'dug par skabs der kho bo'i lus khams ha cang zhan stabs dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu zhig phul na bsams kyang / 7gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du bcar skabs zhu nus bral te lo de'i rla 10 ches 19 nyin ldi li nas sngar bzhin hong kong brgyud pe cing du gnam thog nas thon te pe cing du 'byor ba'i phyi nyin ches 21 nyin paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du 'byor mjal zhus thog da res phran gsum pe cing du yong don skor zhib phra snyan seng zhus rjes paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis da res khyed rnam gsum pe cing du phebs pa de yag po byung 'dug da mus bzhin 'brel ba byed rgyu de yag po red/ bar lam khyed rang tshos phyi rol la krung dbyang la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul byed pa de yag po ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ rgya mi'i 'go 'khrid kyi nang du tā la'i bla ma dang 'brel ba byas nas yag po yod par ngos 'dzin mkhan khag cig dang / 'brel ba mi byed mkhan khag gcig yod/ de 'dra yin tsang khyed rang tshos phyi rol nas krung dbyang gi sku tshab la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul byas rkyen tā la'i bla ma dang 'brel ba byed mkhan tsho la pham nyes byung ba dang / 'brel ba mi byed zer mkhan rnams la rgyal kha 'thob kyi yod pa red/ gnad don de khyed rang tshos bsam bloyag po gtong dgos pa gal chen po red ces bka' slob gnang /yang khong gis na ning lha sar mi mang po 'dzin bzung byas pa'i skor dang / lhag par dga' ldan la drag gnon byas pa bcas kyi skor ngas dbus gzhung la 'dri brtsad byas pa yin/ de dag sa gnas rang nas lag len bltar ba zhig las dbus gzhung 252

gis shes kyi yod pa ma red/ khyed tshos de skor bka' 'dre gnang na yag po 'dugade ni sa gnas g.yon lhung phyogs khag gis tshab byas pa zhig yin 'dug ces bka' gnang byung /de'i phyir nyin nga tshos nga phod dang / phun tshogs dbang rgyal rnam gnyis sar mjal 'phrad du bskyod de da res slar yang pe cing du yong don skor paṇa chen rin po che mchog la snyan seng zhus don bzhin khong gnyis la'ang gsal po zhus par nga phod kyis na ning bod du mi mang po 'dzin bzung byas pa'i skor dbus gzhung nas bka' btang ba zhig ma red/ de ni bod rang skyong ljongs kyis byas pa'i las rnyog cig red/las ka de nor 'khrul red ces dang / yang khong gis da res khyed rnam pa krung dbyang dang 'brel ba legs su gtong bar phebs pa yag po 'dug ces gsungs/ de bzhin phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags nas kyang paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod gnyis dang 'dra mtshungs gsungs pa las dmigs bsal gyi dgongs 'char mi 'dra ba gang yang 84zugachis/rla 10 ches 24 nyin phyi dro chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la 'thab phyogs gcog gyur las khungs su bskyod de pu'u krang gzhon pa cang phen gyi gtsos dpon rigs 'ga' shas mjal 'phrad zhus te nga tsho gsum pe cing du khyed rnam pa dang lhan du 'brel ba legs bcos ched yong lugs dang sbrags 1982 lor nga tsho'i phyogs nas re 'dun zhus pa'i don tshan khag la zhabs bskul zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin na ning 1983 lor lha sa khul dang / dga' ldan dgon pa bcas la bod mi ji snyed cig 'dzin bzung thog nyes don nyes can zhes pa'i ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis rdung rdeg btang ste bkag nyar 'dre gcod drag po byas pa'i skor dang / gzhan yang bar lam 253

bod du rgya mi ha cang mang po yong dang yong bzhin la brten bod mi dmangs rnams kyi las ka shor gyi yod stabs bod mi tshang ma sems khral chen po yod lugs/ snga lo dga' ldan dgon pa'i don rkyen la drag po'i thog lag len bstar ba de dbus gzhung gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus 'dzin pa de dang phyogs 'gal yin lugs tu la'i bla mas go skabs bzang po zhig dang bstun nas 1985 lor bod du gzigs skor la chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes yod pa nga tsho'i ngo shes phyi rgyal gsar 'god pa 'ga' shas kyang lhan du 'khrid rgyu yin lugs bcas bsam tshul brjod par/cang phen gyis da ring nga chos khyed rnam pa'i dgongs 'char nyan gyi yin/ nyin shas rjes nga tsho slar yang 'dzoms nas krung dbyang gi bsam tshul khyed rnam par shod kyi yin zhes brjod de ches 38 nyin 'tshogs rgyur gtan 'khel byas nas tshogs 'du grol/1984 che 10 ches 28 nyin dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog sngar bzhin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su lhan 'dzoms kyis cang phen gyi lag tu yi ge shog lhi nyi shu skor 'khyer te brjod don/ khyed tshos pe cing la phebs nas krung dbyang dang 'brel ba thengs 'ga' shas gnang ste nga tsho phan tshun gyi bsam tshul sba gsang med par bgro gleng byas yod pa red/ ches 24 nyin khyed tsho'i dgongs 'char nyan pa yin/ de ring nga tsho krung dbyang gi bsam tshul don gnad 'ga' shas khyod tshor shod rgyu yin zhes zer te khong gi lag tu yod pa'i shog nyi'i nang du 'khod pa'i don tshan gyi tshig don re re bzhin klog pa'i skabs ngo gdong nag po bstan pa'i thog skabs re khyad gsod khrel dgod dang spobs nyams khengs dregs ldan pa'i sgo nas nga tsho la bka' bcad gtong ba ltar ngar ngar phad phad kyis ngang nas 'grel bshad byas song /254

don tshan dang po/ lo shas ring bod mi gzhis byes rnams phan tshun 'gro 'ong byas tshul skor dang /don tshan gnyis pa/ tā la'i bla ma 1985 lor bod du gzigs bskor phebs rgyur dga' bsu yod lugs dang / 'on kyang hu'u ya'o pang gi tshog tho don tshan lnga'i nang du 'khod pa'i don tshan khag khas len byed dgos lugs khong gi thugs 'dod ltar sa phyogs gang du gzigs bskor 'tshams 'drir phebs kyang chog pa dang /khong gi skya phyu'i srung cha'i 'gan len gtsang ma zhus chog khong lhan du phyi rgyal gsar 'god pa 'khrid dgos don med lugs bcas gsal/don tshan gsum pa/ 1981 lo hu'u ya'o rma nga gi tshig tho don tshan lnga po sgyur zhes skyar zlos byas pa'i thogadon tshan bzhi pa/ bod rang btsan zer ba'i gnad don skor la/ khyed tshos krung dbyang dang 'brel ba legs su gtong rgyu des bod ljongs ni krung go rgyal khab kyi cha shas shig yin pa ngos 'dzin byed dgos lugs dang / khyed tshos bod rang btsan byed bsam pa dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs ro langs rgyag rgyu'i bsams pa de ni nam yang 'grub thabs med lugs sogs rgya phyogs kyis 'char can bod rgya dbar gyi lo rgyus rdzun bzo 'khyog bshad kyi gtam gleng sngar bas rgyas pa zhig bshad/don tshan lnga pa/ 1981 lor hu'u ya'o pang gis rgya lo don grub la de ni rgya che'i bod mi dmangs rnams nas mno bsam gtong dgos pa las tā la'i bla mas dbus pa'i phye rgyal la yod pa'i bodami rnams nas bsam tshul de bton pa yin na 'tshams po med ces bshad pa dang /255

yang kho pas 1983 lo blo mthun zhi krung zhun gyis khyed rnams dang mjal 'phrad skabs bod ljongs de rgyal khab gcig tu bzos na mi 'grigs/ rang skyong tshad mthon po zer ba byas na'ang mi 'grigs zhes gsungs yod ces bshad pa'i thog kho pas khyed tshor bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs rang skyong chen po zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i dgongs 'char bton pa de ni/ don dngos dang mi mthun la/ 'tshams po yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod rigs 'dus sdod sa khul phan tshun 'brel nas yod kyang lo rgyus thog nas dus yun ha cang ring po'i sdebs gcig tu gcig gyur byung med pa dang/sa gnas so so'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi 'phel tshul ha cang do mi mnyam pa/ bod rigs kyi sa khul yangs shing rgya che bas rang skyong sa gnas gcig tu bzos na dpal 'byor dang rig gnas gong du spel bar phan thogs med lugs bcas bshad/ de ni byis par bslu brid byas pa ltar mthong rgya ha cang chung ba mongs pa'i ham gtam sha stag bshad pa zhig yin/don tshan drug pa/ nyes don nyes bsags spyod ngan la rdung rdeg gtong ba'i skor gyi gnad don zer ba'i thad brjod don/ na ning nga tshos rgyal yongs khyon du nyes bsags spyod ngan la dung rdeg btang ba yin/ rdung rdeg gtong yul gtso bo ni nyes khrims las 'gal tshabs ches cher bzo mkhan te mi gsod mkhan dang / me rgyag mkhan/ btsan g.yem byed mkhan/ 'phrog bcom byed mkhan/ 'bar gtor mkhan bcas kyi nyes can red/ bod ljongs su de ltar byas pa smos ci zer ba dang / 'on kyang nyes don nyes bsags spyod ngan la rdung rdeg gtong 'go tshugs tsam gyi dus su bkag nyar 'dre gcod byed mi 'os pa'i mi kha shas bzung nas bkag nyar 'dre gcod byas rigs kyang byung yod/ dper na dga' ldan nas khrims 'gal bya spyod phran bu 256

yod pa'i phyogs mi dang / gnas skor ba/ ar po ba bcas 'ga' zhig bzung nas bkag nyar 'dre gcod byas yod kyang nga tshos gnas tshul ngo ma gsal rtogs byung 'phral de dag glod grol btang ba yin/ der brten chab srid kyi lta tshul mi 'dra ba 'dzin mkhan la dung rdeg btang ba zer ba'i gnad don gtan nas med ces bshad de mngon sum la bston nas don dngos khas mi len pa dang / da dung khos pas chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel bar yang nges par du rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims kyi mtshams tshad las mi brgal ba byed dgos zhes brjod byung ba de ni khrims lugs kyi btsan shugs ngom nas mi dmangs kyi mgo bo gnon pa'i kho pa tsho'i rang gshes phyir mngon pa zhig red/don tshan bdun pa/ bod ljongs las don skor gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i snying don dang / deng dus bod ljongs kyi gnas tshul skor ngo sprod byed rgyu zhes pa'i nang du/ 1952 lo nas 1983 bar krung dbyang nas bod la nor srid kyi rogs skyor sgor dung phyur bdun cu don gnyis dang khri gsum stong sprad yod ces bshad gopa de dngos 'brel yin pa'i dbang du btang rung / 1980 lor hu'u ya'o pang bod du bskyod skabs rang skyong ljongs kyi bod rgya las rigs khag gi las byed rnams la da bar krung dbyang gis bod la rogs dngul btang ba rnams yar klung gtsang po'i nang du g.yugs 'dug ces ngos len dang skyon brjod chabs cig bshad yod pas u tshugs brgyab pa ni ha cang glen rtags kyi bya ba zhig red/yang kho pas/ bod ljongs ni rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas gzhan rnams dang 'dra ba'i thun mong gi rang bzhin yod la/ rang gi dmigs bsal gyi rang bzhin yang yod pa'i mi rigs rang skyong sa gnas shig yin zhes dang / bod ljongs kyi sa khams 257

yul babs dang / rang byung gi cha rkyen/ dpal 'byor grub gzhi/ spyi tshogs 'phel tshul/ mi rigs kyi gnas stangs sogs kyi thad dmigs bsal gyi rang bzhin yang ha cang chen po yod/ yin na'ang khyed rnam pas dmigs bsal gyi rang bzhin ma gtogs thun mong gi rang bzhin khas blangs pa'am lhag par du bod ljongs rang btsan yang byas chog snyam pa de nor 'khrul yin pa dang / thun mong gi rang bzhin khas ma len pa ma gtogs dmigs bsal gyi rang bzhin ma mthong na'ang mi 'grigs zhes brjod byung / de ni ma le ring lugs gzhir bzung mi rigs kyi grub cha khungs byas pa zhig yin rung / ngas bltas na de ni bod rgya tha dad yin pa'i gsal bshad yag po zhig red snyam/ lhag par kho pas dmigs bsal gyi rang bzhin bshad pa tsam las/don du thun mong gi rang bzhin nan brjod byed pa'i rnam 'gyur de ni don dngos khas len mi phod pa'i 'u thug gi g.yol thabs 'ba' zhig red/don tshan brgyad pa/ rgyal nang gi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin shod dgos zhes pa'i skor cang pheng gis da bar khyed tshos phyi rgyal nas rgyal nang du blta bskor la yong nas phyir log rjes rgyal nang gi gnas tshul dang mi 'tshams pa'i gtam ji snyed dril bsgrags byas yod pa dang / lhag par du khyod tsho'i las khungs che ge mo zhig gis kyang krung gos bod kha lo bsgyur ba'i lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ring la dmag 'khrug nang bsad pa dang / rang shi brgyab pa/ ltog shi thebs pa/ mnar gcod 'og tu shi ba bcas khyon bsdoms mi khri brgya tsam shi 'dug ces zer ba de dag bden pa rtsa ba nas ma red ces bshad de kho pas bod ljongs yongs su gdug rtsub can gyi srid dbang 'og dngos 'brel ji byung gi nyes spyod la g.yo 'gebs rdzun bzo dang 'khyog bshad byas pa red/mtha' don kho pas tā la'i bla mas krung dbyang dang 'brel ba legs su gtong rgyu'i 258

'dun pa gnang bar brtsi bkur zhu ba dang / krung dbyang gi ngos nas khyed tshos 'brel gtugs byed pa dang / rgyus mnga' je zab tu yong ba byed pa'i rnam 'gyur la dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin la sgo phye phye ba yin zhes rngam rngam rdzog rdzig bshad nas tshogs 'du grol te rgya nag lho phyogs khul du blta bskor du bskyod/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las khungs kyi 'char gzhi lta ra nga tsho gsum than cin grong khyer dang / rgya nag lho phyogs hrang had kyis gtsos pa'i grong khyer khag nang chos kyi dgon pa khag bcas khag la blta bskor du bskyod nas bdun gsum tsam 'gor zhing / hrang had du 'byor ba'i phyi nyin sne shan rin ring gis nye dus blo mthun cang pheng nas khyed rnam par don tshan brgyad gsungs pa'i skor dgongs 'char ji yod/ de ring snga dro nga tsho lhan du bsam tshul brje len byas na bsam gyi 'dug ces bshad par/ snga dro'i ring phyir blta bskor du ma bskyod par mgron khang nang du bgro gleng byed skabs rin ring gis cang phing nas bton pa'i don tshan brgyad kyi nang don la dgongs 'char ji yod sba gsang med pa'i thog nas gsung rogs zhes zer/ nga tshos kha sngon bsam tshul ji bton la dgongs bzhes ma gnang ba'i thog ma 'ongs bod kyi thob thang gi bsam tshul bton pa de 'tsham gyi mi 'dug ces dgag lan gnang ba der ha cang blo pham byung tshul brjod par/ rin ring gis krung dbyang gi dgongs tshul de ni/ da lta khyed tsho phyi rgyal du bzhugs yod pa red/ da bar lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring khyed tshos phyi rgyal du bod rang btsan gyi las 'gul byas yod pa dang / da lta yang bod rang btsan gyi tshig don de 'bod skul byed bzhin yod par brten dgongs tshul de dag bton na 'tsham gyi mi 'dug ces gsungs pa zhig red/rjes sor khyed rnams bod du phyir phebs rjes dgongs tshul de bton na 'os shing 259

'tsham po yod ces zer ba'i lan du/sngon zhus ltar bod mi rnams la rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang dgos kyi 'dug ces bsam tshul bton pa de ma 'os pa min zhing / nga tsho yang bod mi zhig yin tsang ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi gnas stangs la 'khur 'gan yod ces shod skabs rin ring gis sngon du khyed rang tshos rang thag rang gcod kyi tshig don de bed spyod byas yod pa dang / de ring yang tshig don de dag yang bskyar gsung gi 'dug pa rang thag rang gcod kyi tshig don de dang / sa gnas mi rigs rang skyong gi tshig don dang don gnas bcas mtshungs kyi yod pa ma red ces 'grel bshad byas pa'i lan du/ de sngon krung go gung bran tang gis rgya nag yongs su gsar brje'i las 'gul lag len bstar skabs gung khran tang gi rtsa khrims khyab bsgrags kyi nang la ma 'ongs par rgya nag yongs la bcings bkrol btang zin rjes bod dang / shin cang / sog yul bcas kyi rang mos ltar krung hwa su'u khri e spyi mthun rgyal khab dang mnyam du rgyal phran mnyam sbrel lam/ yang na krung go dang kha bral nas logs su rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs bya rgyur mos mthun dang rgyab skyor yod ces gsal bsgrags byas yod pa de dag nga tshos gzhir bzung nas gong gsal bsam tshul bton pa zhig red ces brjod par rin ring gis lo rgyus thog byung ba'i gnas tshul de dngos 'brel yin zhing / de sngon krung go gung khran tang gis su'u lan rgyal khab kyi dpe ston thog nas srid byus lag len bstar ba zhig red/ gang yin zhe na/ su'u lan rgyal khab la rgyal phran bcu drug tsam yod pa de dag rnams la su'u khri es rgyal khab ces 'bod pa ltar rgyal phran so sos rang thag rang gcod kyi srid byus lag len bstar gyi yod pa red/ krung go gung khran tang gis rgya nag rgyal yongs su bcings 'grol gyi rgyal kha ma thob sngon gyi gsar brje'i 260

'thab 'khrug gi dus skabs der byis pas gog bgrod byed pa lta bu yin pa dang / lhag par du rgya nag yongs kyi mi rigs grangs nyung rnams kyi gdung sems mnyam bskyed dang / rgyab skyor yong thabs kyi srid byus shig lag len bstar ba red/ phyi lo 1949 lor rgya nag rgyal yongs su bcings 'grol btang zin rjes/ 1957 lor ching ta'o grong khyer du slad krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mi rigs grangs nyung rnams kyi don gnad lag len bstar rgyu'i tshogs 'du'i thog srid blon kra'o en le nas mi rigs sa gnas rang skyong lag len bstar rgyu'i thag gcod gtsang ma zhig gnang ba red/ dus de nas bzung rgyal phran mnyam sbrel lam/ mnyam sbrel zhes pa'i gleng phyogs dang bsam tshul de mtshams 'jog byas te sa gnas mi rigs rang skyong gi srid byus lag len bstar rgyu gtan gtsang ma 'khel ba red ces snang ba gang dran dang / ci yin cha mi 'tshal ba'i 'grel bshad cig byas byung /nga tsho hrang had dang / cang su'u/ kro cang zhing chen khag gnyis kyi mnga' khul gyi grong khyer khag dang / nang chos kyi dgon sde du ma/ gna' shul mdzes ljongs bcas la blta bskor du bskyod skabs de khul rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs gong gsal lha khang sogs la gtor skyon gang yang ma byung bar sngar bzhin gnas 'dugargya nag lho phyogs la blta bskor bskyod rjes slar yang pe cing du phyir 'khor nas zla 11 ches 37 nyin phyi dro 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang dbyang cing thug 'phrad du bskyod de 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi mjal 'phrad khang la yar 'dzul skabs nga tsho'i mdun du glog 'od 'khyug 'khyug byas pa'i thog glog brnyan dang / brnyan 'phrin gyis dpar bcas rgyag mkhan mi mang po'i khrod du/ dbyang cin rin gyis gtsos 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dang / mi rigs las khungs kyi gnas yod 26

dpon rigs lnga drug tsam nga tsho'i mdun du 'dzum dmul dmul gyis gom stabs dal po'i ngang nas tshur yong te dga' bsu'i lag pa gtong res kyis bzhugs gral du 'khod pa'i bar glog brnyan par mu mthud nas brgyab song / yol dkar mdun du 'khrab ston byed pa'i le'u de rgyal spyi'i thog mgo bskor bslu khrid byed ched dril bsgrags bya rgyu yin pa gdon mi za ba red/de nyin nga tsho'i thog nas bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan gyis/ da res nga tsho 'di khul yong don skor nye dus cang pheng pu'u krang gzhon par bsam tshul ji yod zhus yod la de ring khyed la yang phra zhib pa zhig zhu gi yin zhes thal lus med pa gsungs par/ dbyang chen rin gyis khyed tsho pe cing du tā la'i bla ma'i thugs dgongs su krung dbyang dang mu mthud 'bre'/ ba bya rgyur nga tshos dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin/ krung dbyang nas tā la'i bla ma dang / phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs rnams kyi gnas babs la sems 'khur yid 'jog byed mus yin zhes dang / kha sngon cang phing gis don tshan brgyad bshad pa'i chig don dang / hu'u ya'o pang gi tshig tho don tshan lnga bcas la bskyar ldeb yang ldab kyis 'grel bshad rgyun ring zhig byas pa'i rjes nga tshos gnad don re rer sngar bzhin lan 'debs chim lus med pa byas pa'i thog snga lo bton pa'i gnad don rnams yang bskyar bton pa dang / de bzhin 1983 lo lha sa dang / dga' ldan dgon pa bcas la bod mi ser skya mang po 'dzin bzung gis nyes don nyes bsags kyi spyod ngan zer ba'i ming btags nas ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis bkag nyar 'dre gcod drag pos rdung rdeg btang yod pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na lha sa khul gyi mi 'bor nyung shas de dag nang dus gcig tu rkun ma dang /spyod ngan byed mkhan mang po de 'dra zhig ga la yong srid dam/ lhag par krung go gung 262

khran tang gi srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og de 'dra yong mi shes pa zhig red/dper na/ rgan blo bzang dbang phyug ces pa ni dus rgyun du rang gi mi rigs dang / chos dang rig gzhung bcas la srung brtsi zhu mkhan gra pa rgas 'khogs shig yin pa de la yang nyes don nyes bsags kyi ming btags nas bkag nyar thog 'dri gcod drag po byas yod pa red ces brjod skabs/ dbyang chin rin gyis de skor brtsad gcod byed kyi yin zhes pa las rjes sor go thos la brtsad gcod gang yang ma byung ba'i mur rgan blo bzang dbang phyug mchog rgya dmar gdug /ba can gyi btson khang nang du mnar gcod 'og sku che ma zin pa'i gnas tshul byung 'dugade nyin chu tshod gnyis tsam bgro gleng byas rjes sngar bzhin gra sgrig byas 'dug pa ltar gsol tshigs skabs kho bos/ dbyang chin rin la bar lam rgya nag nas bod du dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du rgya mi 'bor chen btang 'byor la brten bod mi rnams kyi las ka shor te 'tsho ba dka' ngal chen po 'phrad lugs dang / de bzhin gzhung 'brel ma yin pa'i rgya mi mang po zhig kyang bod du 'byor yod pa de rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i thabs len du rgya gzhung nas ma dngul sprod kyi yod lugs zer 'dug par brten rgya rigs mang po bod la gzhis chags bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi med dam snyam nas bod mi rnams kyis sems khral chen po byed kyi yod lugs zhes brjod par dbyang cin rin gyis rgyal nang nas bod la dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du zhing chen khag mang pos mi rgyu gnyis thog nas rogs ram byed kyi yod pa red/'dzugs skrun zin rjes bod la sdod kyi ma red/ gzhung 'brel min pa'i bod la slebs pa'i mi rnams la gzhung gis rogs dngul sprod kyi yod pa ma red/ bod rigs rnams la 'tsho ba'i thabs len gyi ched du rogs dngul sprod kyi yod/ bod sa mtho 263

po yin stabs rlung 'deng min gyis rkyen pas rgya rigs gtan sdod dka' ba red ces bshad byung ba de ni nam mkhar mi shong ba'i rdzun gtam zhig yin pa bsam blor 'khor kyang/ bskur du lan 'debs bya rgyu ma byung ba'i ngang gsol ston grol nas mgron khang du phyir log skabs brnyan 'phrin nang gong du nga tsho dang dbyang cin rin sogs mjal 'phrad byed skabs glog brnyan par brgyab pa'i brnyan 'phrin de ston pa'i sgang red/ der brten nga tshos sne shan pa rin ring la da gin glog brnyan brgyab pa de da lta brnyan 'phrin nang bstan song ba de skor nga tshor sngon tshud nas tshig zur tsam yang ma brjod par lam seng khyab bsgrags gnang ba de yag po ma red/ dngos 'brel lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin na nga tshor skad cha 'dri tsam zhig byed dgos lugs gleng rtsod mang po byas par rin ring gis blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang gi tshig tho don tshan lnga po de la phyi nang gi mi tshang mas do snang dang / shes rtogs byed kyi yod 'dug par brten 'dzam gling la gsal bsgrags byed dgos byung ba red/ 'on kyang khyed rnams kyi dgongs 'char ngas lam seng gong rim la snyan seng zhu gi yin zhes zer/ches 30 nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod drug gi thog zhi krung zhun gyi mgron 'bod ltar bskyod de gsol ston ma bshams gong / bar lam pe cing khul la 'byor nas 'brel yod 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang bcas lhan du gros mol byung skor dang / lhag par snga lo nga tshos bton pa'i bsam tshul la bskyar du 'grel brjod byas rjes zhi krung zhun gyis/ da res khyed rnam pa gsum tu la'i bla mas krung dbyang dang 'brel ba legs su gtong bar pe cing du phebs nas snga rjes nga tshos 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi 'gan 'khur blo mthun rnams dang bgro gleng byung ba'i skor nga tsho tshang mas shes byung / krung dbyang gi dgongs tshul ji yin snga phyi bar gsum du khyed 264

tshor gsal po zhus yod/ bod rang btsan dang / tshad mtho'i rang skyong chen po mi 'grigs/ bod rigs sa khul phan tshun sa 'brel yod kyang / lo rgyus kyi thog dus yun ha cang ring por kha bral nas gnas yod pa las krung go gung khran tang gis bzos pa zhig ma yin zhes zer ba'i lan du/ lo rgyus dus yun ring po phyin pa'i dbang gis bod rigs sa khul rnams phyogs gcig tu rla sgril mi chog pa yong mi shes/mi rigs gzhan gyi sa khul 'ga' shas la zla sgril gyi thob thang gnang yod pa red/dpe mtshon zhig zhus na nang sog rang skyong ljongs de snga rjes gnyis ring zu sgril byas yod pa ma zad/ bar lam nying zhu hu'i rigs rang skyong ljongs khul du yod pa'i a la shar sog rigs sa khul de dag nang sog rang skyong mnga' khul du rla sgril byas yod pa'i gnas tshul go thos byung bar brten nga tshos snga phyi bar gsum du bsam tshul bton pa rnams ma 'os ma 'tshams pa med stabs de dag la dgongs pa nges par bzhes dgos kyi 'dug ces brjod par/ zhi krung zhun gyis 'dzum dmul skyi rnam 'gyur bstan te de skor lan thad kur ma brgyab par tshig don gzhan du khrid de nye char rgya gar gsar shog gcig tu/ pe cing gzhung gis tu la'i bla ma pe cing nye 'gram chin khyen btson khang du 'jog rtsis yod 'dug ces 'khod 'dug pa khyed rnams kyis gnas tshul de bden pa min pa'i skor tā la'i bla mar zhal par thog 7snyan seng 'phral du 'bul thub na yag po 'dug zer yang / nga tshos rda ram sa lar zhal par 'bul thabs khag po yod ces lan 'debs byas/ nga tsho'i bsam tshul la 'di ga'i shin hwa gsar 'gyur thog nas gsal bsgrags shig byas na yag po 'dug ces bsam tshul bton par khong gis mos mthun byas shing / de nas nga tsho gsol tshigs grub rjes zhi krung zhun gyis/ da res nga tsho phan tshun sngar bzhin bka' mol rno ngar 265

ldan pa byung yod kyang slad mu mthud 'brel ba bya dgos zhes gsungs nas gyes 'tshams zhu res byas te phyi nyin snga dro shin ha gsar 'gyur khang gi gsar 'god pa brgyud tā la'i bla mas bod mi dmangs kyi bde skyid kyi don du dgongs bzhes kho na gnang ba las khong sku sger gyi don du dgongs bzhes spu tsam gnang gi yod pa ma red/slad dus skabs 'os 'tshams shig la bod du gzigs bskor du phebs rtsis yod kyang / 1985 lor phebs thub kyi med lugs 'khod pa'i gsal bsgrags byas/ pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir thon ma byas gong ches 25 nyin paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar nga tsho thon mjal du bcar te kha sa kha nyin zhi krung zhun dang / dbyang chen rin gnyis snga rjes su mjal mol byung ba'i skor snyan seng zhib phra zhus rjes bka' slob phyir phebs su/ krung dbyang dang 'brel ba da mus bzhin gnang rgyu de ha cang yag po 'dug 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa thengs gcig gzigs bskor la phebs thub na yag po 'dug phan tshun gyi 'brel ba yag tu gtong ba las/ sdug tu mi 'gro ba'i dgongs pa bzhes dgos shing / krung dbyang la phog thug gi bka' mol gnang rgyu mi 'dug khyed tshos phyag las kyi 'gan yag po bsnam dgos pa las/ don med kyi gtam drag po ma gsung / skad cha rdzig po shod pa'i skabs spro snang chen po yod 'gro don dngos thog phan thogs yod pa ma red/ lhag par du khyed tshos 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi bkur yag po zhu dgos/ de bzhin nang khul mthun po yag po byed dgos/ de gal chen po red/ nga yang sngar bzhin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / rang cag bod kha ba can gyi mi dmangs rnams kyi don du 'khur len 'bad brtson zhu bzhin yod ces bka' slob bla na med pa bstsal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi dus da lta'i bar rang gi snying dbus su gnas yod//266
/ka shu ka la gser dngul dpyad pa bzhin/kha zhe mi mtshungs rgya mi'i g.yo ham de//ga 'dra byas kyang 'dzam gling kun gyis rtogs//nga tsho'i bden mtha' gsal la thag mi ring //267

le tshan bzhi bcu pa/phran sger gyi ming thog nas pe cing du 'brel thug tu bskyod pa/༄༅༅/ /pe cing nas rgya gar tu phyir log zhor rgya nag lho phyogs kong tung zhing chen mnga' khongs kru'u ha'e dang / hren ṭin sa gnas gnyis la blta bskor du bskyod nas hong kong brgyud rgya gar du phyir log ste da lam pe cing du gros mol ji byas skor 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas la zhib phra snyan seng zhus/de rjes rang gzhung nas slar yang bod du blta bskor tshogs pa thengs bzhi pa gtong rgyu thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar rang gzhung ldi li don gcod khang nas ldi lir bca' sdod rgya gzhung sku tshab las khungs dang 'brel mol gyis rang gzhung sku tshab bka' zur kun bde gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis dbus mi ngo 1985 7 5ches 15 nyin sngar bzhin ldi li nas hong tong brgyud bod du phebs rgyu byas kyang / rgya phyogs nas blta bskor ba rnams bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mnga' khongs min pa'i sa khul khag la ma gtogs phebs na 'grigs min ka kor brjod pa ltar khong rnams pe cing nas mdo smad khul du phebs te rgya gar du phyir phebs/lo rjes ma slar yang bod ljongs sa khul du sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub kyis dbus blta bskor thengs lnga pa phebs rgyur sngar bzhin ldi ler bca' sdod rgya me'i gzhung tshab brgyud re 'dun bka' mol rim pa byung mthar rgya phyogs nas bar lam 269

phyi sdod rang mi'i lag 'khyer sprod phyogs thad tong kong du las khungs sheg gsar 'dzuḍa byas yod stabs las khungs de nas phyir sdod rang mi spyi mtshungs lag 'khyer len dgos yin pa las sngar bzhin sprod thabs med pa'i srid byus gtan 'bebs byung yod lugs kyi rkyen pas sku tshab thengs lnga pa phebs rgyur 'gog rkyen 'phrad/gong gsal gnas tshul de ltar gnas pa'i mur/ phyi lo 1985 zla 3 ches 25 nyin bka' shag gi bka' 'brel ltar kho bos ldi lir bca' sdod rgya mi'i gzhung tshab pa li chen nan mjal 'phrad du bskyod de 1984 lo nga tsho pe cing nas thon khar zhi krung zhun gyis rgya lo don grub la bod ljongs su gzigs bskor du phebs 'dod yod na dga' bsu yod ces gsungs pa gzhir bzung de snga nga tsho'i ldi li don gcod nas rgya lo don grub kyis dbus pa'i mi bdun bod du gzigs bskor la phebs 'thus skor bka' mol rim par zhus kyang / lag 'khyer sngar bzhin ma gnang ba'i rkyen gyis phebs thub pa byung ma song ba blo pham gyi rang bzhin du gyur lugs bcas brjod par/ khong gis krung dbyang nas srid byus gtan gtsang ma 'khel yod stabs byed thabs bral zhes brjod pa dang / yang khong gis nye char khyed tsho bod mi pho mo mang pos nga tsho'i gzhung tshab khang gi rgyal sgo'i phyir rngam ston ngo rgol sngar las lhag pa byung 'dug de yag po ma red/ krung dbyang dang tā la'i bla ma'i dbar 'brel gtugs la gnod skyon chen po chags kyi red ces brjod par/phran gyis nga tsho phan tshun gyi 'brel ba legs su phyin na de dag du ba ltar yal gyi red ces brjod par/ gzhung tshab kyis de 'dra byung na yag po red ces brjod pa dang / yang khong gis rgya lo don grub ldi lir phebs skabs mjal 'dod yod pas khyed nas khong la lan zhig sprod rogs zhes dang / yang khong gis snga lo khyed rang gis 270

tun tong du blta bskor phebs 'dod yod lugs zhes gzhung tshab rnying pa hren cang dang bka' mol byung don bzhin khyed rang ga dus phebs na yang / krung dbyang nas dga' bsu yod ces bka' 'byor yod pa khyed rang ga dus phebs rgyu yin min lan gsal sprod rogs zhes brjod byung bar/ phran gyis tun hong du bskyod 'dod yod kyang nga tsho'i mdun lam du glog bzhu dmar po zhig spar yod stabs 'gro bskyod dka' ba red ces ku re dang sbrags nas brjod par/ khong gis gad mo zhig bgad nas khyed rang gi mdun la glog bzhu ljang khu ma gtogs dmar po spar yod ma red ces zer/phran gyis da lta lus khams bde min gyis rkyen pas lam seng 'gro thub dka' ba dang / gal srid 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel che sngar bzhin lag 'khyer ma sprad na 'gro rgyu khag po red ces brjod de/ khong gis de skor krung dbyang la snyan seng zhus nas bka' 'byor ma thag khyed tsho'i ldi li don gcod brgyud nas lan gsal sprad 'thus zhes gleng mol byung zhing / de rjes rgya mi'i gzhung tshab nas ldi li don gcod brgyud kho bo ldi lir 'khyug tsam yong rogs zhes lan 'byor yang / skabs der phran gyi lus khams zhan rkyen lam seng 'gro thub med/lo de'i zla 9 pa'i ches shar tsam la ldi lir sman bcos dang sbrags bskyod de ches 12 nyen rgya mi'i gzhung tshab li chen nan mjal 'phrad du bskyod skabs khong gis khyed rang pe cing du phebs rgyu'i lag 'khyer khyed rang gi re 'dun ltar sprod 'thus kyi lan 'byor byung / ga dus phebs 'dod yod na'ang phebs dus dang lam phyogs bcas khyed rang dang go bsdur byas nas krung dbyang la snyan seng zhu gi yin zhes brjod par/ skabs der phran gyis gnas skabs gzugs gzhi bde min gyi rkyen pas thon 27ga

ches zhu dka' yang ring min drag skyed byung mtshams lan gsal phul 'thus zhes brjod pa dang sbrags slar yang nga tsho blta bskor tshogs pa thengs lnga pa bskyod rgyu'i skor dris par khong gis sngon zhus ltar krung dbyang nas gtan 'khel ba'i srid byus der 'gyur ba byed thabs dka' yang / ring min khyed rang pe cing du phebs nas khyed rang gi ngo shes grogs po tshor bka' mol zhus na yag gi red ces zer/de nas ldi li nas phyir log gis 7gong sa mchog dang bka' shag lhan rgyas la snyan seng zhus mthar kho bo pe cing du 'gro rgyu gtan lam tsam 'khel te rogs pa dang sbrags yig 'bri las byed gcig 'khrid 'thus bka' 'grol bzhin rogs pa bde legs sman khang gi las drung che dbang phun tshogs dang mnyam du 1985 zla 13ches 29 nyin ldi li nas hong kong dang/ de nas gnam thog pe cing du thon te pe cing du 'byor skabs rgya nag pe cing mtho rim slob grwas gtsos pa'i slob phrug chos rngam ston khrom bskor byas pa'i rkyen gyis hu'u ya'o pang krung go gung khran tang gi 'go 'khrid las 'gan dgongs pa zhu dgos pa'i skabs dang 'khel zhing / pe cing du 'byor ba'i nyin gnyis pa'i dgong dro 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang gzhon pa hu'i rigs yin pa lhun lan mis dga' bsu'i gsol ston du mgron 'bod byas pa ltar bskyod/skabs der 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang dbyang chin rin dang / las rogs cang phing gnyis rgan yol du 'phos zin pa ltar/ dbyang chin rin gyis tshab la yan ming phu bsko gzhag byas 'dug skabs der yan ming phu gzugs khams bde min gyis sman khang du sman bcos byed kyi yod lugs zer/ gsol tshigs grub nas 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi chos don dang / mi rigs sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin gzhon 272

pa li tso min dang / bod rigs sde tshan gyi khru'u krang ren rin gnyis phran sdod yul mgron khang du thug 'phrad du slebs te nga chos chu tshod gnyis tsam ring phan tshun bsam tshul shod res byas/ skabs der phran gyis snga lo nga tsho'i sku tshab tshogasapa thengs lnga pa 'gro ma thub pa'i skor brjod par/ li tso min gyis de sngon ldi li gzhung tshab nas brjod pa'i tshig don gcig gyur bshad par/ phran gyis nga tsho'i shes rig lhan khang gis 'di lo rla gsum pa'i nang rda ram sa lar bod kyi skad yig dang / rig gzhung bcas 'phel rgyas yong thabs su phyi rgyal khag la yod pa'i bod mi mkhas pa gang 'tshams mgron 'bod zhus yod pa bzhin/ bod sa khul nas mkhas dbang dung dkar sprul sku blo bzang 'phrin las dang / rdo rje rgyal po/ sprul sku thub bstan nyi ma/dmu dge bsam gtan/ dor zhi sprul sku/ zu ba dpal ldan bcas mi drug la gdan zhu'i mgron shog phran gyis mnyam 'khyer yod pa khyed gnyis brgyud nas khong rnams la gnang rogs ma zad/ khong rnams la rgya gar du bskyod 'thus kyi bka' 'khrol gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang / khyed gnyis nas shes gsal ltar phran nyin shas rjes pe cing nas tun hong (tung hong sa khul zhes pa de mtsho sngon byang dang / rgya nag kun su'u zhing chen gyi nub ngos zhin cang gi shar la gnas/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs lo ngo brgya tsam ring bod kyi dbang gyur byas yod pa dang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i stod tsam sa khul der bod yig dang / rgya yig yu gur sogs kyi gter yig 'bor chen thon yod pa ma zad/ dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu pa'i bar bod kyi rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ khrims yig gso rig bcas kyi yig rnying mang po'ang thon yod par brten 'dzam gling du snyan grags can kyi sa khul zhig red ) du 'khyug tsam blta bskor du bskyod rgyu'i byed phyogs kyi bkod sgrig gnang rogs zhes bsam tshul bton par li tso min gyis/ kha sngon nga tshos khyed rang snga tsam phebs na snyam yang / bar lam khyed rang sku gzugs bde min gyis rkyen pas phebs 'gyangs 273

su gyur stabs deng sang tun hong khul la gnam gshis ha cang grang ngar chen po yod pa ma zad/ dgun dus ring sa khul de'i mthun rkyen ha cang zhan stabs da res ma phebs na yag po 'dug de las khyed rang pe cing du lhod bzhugs kyis sku gzugs sman bcos brtag dpyad yag po gnang na legs/ yang khong gis/ 1979 lo nas bzung khyed rang tsho'i blta bskor tshogs pa snga rjes bzhi dang / pe cing du bka' mol gnang ched sku tshab thengs gnyis bcas phebs yod pa/ de tshun rgya lo don grub dang /stag 'tshor thub bstan nor bu nang mi bcas kyang mes rgyal du phebs nas nga tshos sne len gra sgrig zab rgyas zhus yod/ da bar lo ngo brgyad ring nga tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba yar rgyas 'gro rgyu'i tshab tu phyir shig brgyab ste sdug tu phyin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas krung dbyang gi ngos nas blo pham yod lugs dang / de bzhin khyed tshos da bar rgya mi'i btsan dbang 'og bod mi khri brgya lhag tsam srog skyon byung lugs dang / dgon sde stong phrag drug lhag tsam rtsa gtor btang lugs gsal bsgrags byas 'dug pa nga tshos tshan rig gi thog nas bod kyi mi 'bor grangs bsher byas te khri brgya dang nyi shu lhag tsam las med/ deng sang khri nyis brgya lhag tsam la slebs yod/ gal srid khri brgya lhag tsam bsad yod na deng sang khri brgya lhag tsam las bsdad med ces zer/phran gyis nga tsho'i phyogs nas bod chol kha gsum yongs rdzogs la ngos 'dzin byed pa ma gtogs bod rang skyong ljongs gcig pu la zer gyi med ces brjod par/ li tso min gyis/ khyed rang gi zer srol ltar byas nas bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs brtsis na yang / bod mi khri bzhi brgya lhag tsam las lon gyi yod pa ma red/ gzhi rtsa bod de krung go'i cha shas yin pa de la thug yod/ bod de krung go dang logs su yin pa'i bsam tshul bton na nga tsho'i dbar 'brel ba yong gzhi dka'/ de min gnas 274

tshul la bka' mol gnang na ma 'grigs pa med ces brjod par/phran gyis de sngon 1983 dang 1984 lo nga tsho mi gsum pe cing du yong skabs bsam tshul gsal po zhus yod/ gang ltar bod mi rnams la drang bden gyi thog nas rang thag rang gcod byed chog pa'i thob thang gi dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu las rgya mis bod mi'i steng du bsdad na 'grigs thabs med/ gang yin zhe na/ de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus gnas stangs ji byung skor khyed rang gnyis nas gsal po mkhyen gyi yod shagad lta bod kyi chab srid kyi gnas stangs de rang skyong gzhan dag dang gcig mtshungs gnas yod pa de drang po ma red/ dper na/ de sngon lo rgyus thog bod 'di rgya gar dang krung go'i dbar bar chod rgyal khab lta bur gnas yod/ slad kyang bod 'di rgyal khab chen po gnyis kyi dbar zhi bde'i sa khul zhig tu gyur na phan tshun rgyal khab che ba gnyis kur phan thogs chen po yong rgyu dang / bod mi rnams nas kyang rgya mi la ji srid bar dga' zhen dang / brtsi mthong chen po byed kyi red/ snga lo mkhas dbang li yi'u g.yi rda ram sa lar phebs skabs tā la'i bla mas khong la/ mi tshang gcig la spyan rgan gzhon gnyis yod na rgan pas gzhon par byams skyong ma byas par dbang gnon byas na gzhon pas rgan par mi dga' ba dang mtha' mjug logs su 'gro rgyu las gzhan bya thabs med ces bka' gnang yod/ der brten rgya mis nas dgongs pa nges par bzhes dgos kyi red ces brjod par/ li tso min gyis de snga rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs bod rigs spun rla rnams la dka' tshogs byung yod kyang / khyed kyis brjod don ltar rgya mi rigs kyis bod mi'i steng bsdad zer ba'i bka' mol de ngos len bya thabs med/ mdor bsdus zhus na/ 1951 lo nas bzung rgya mi rigs kyis bod mi rigs la slob grwa dang / sman khang / lam kha sogs gsar skrun gyi rogs 275

ram gang thub byas yod/ lhag par du deng sang bod kyi gnas stangs sngar las lhag pa'i yar rgyas yong thabs kyi 'dzugs bskrun rogs ram byed bzhin yod/ deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tru'u ci u cing ha pe cing du phebs yod pas khyed rang dang bka' mol gnang na yag po 'dug khyed rang bod du khyug tsam phebs rgyu'i skor khong la'ang bka' mol gnang na khong gis thag chod pa'i lan sprod thub kyi red ces zer/de'i phyi nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog kho bo dang / che dbang phun tshogs gnyis kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi sku mdun du mjal khar bcar te 7gong sa mchog gi phyag bris dang / phyag rtags bcas phyag tu phul ba'i thog da res phran pe cing du yong don skor zhib phra snyan seng zhus par paṇa chen rin poche mchog gis da res khyed 'di khul phebs thub pa gang legs byung 'dug phan tshun dbar 'brel ba ma chad par mu mthud gnas rgyu de shin tu gal chen po yin/ sngon du brjod pa ltar/ don dag lam seng 'grub rgyu khag po yod kyang / 'brel lam yag po chags na grub 'bras gang 'tshams thon gyi red/ gal che shos ni ngang rgyud ring ba'i bsam blo gtong dgos/ lhag par du nga tsho gzhis byes dbar rdog rtsa gcig bsgril bya rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ phyi rgyal du yod pa'i gzhon skyes tsho'i shes yon yar rgyas gtong thabs dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun te lag bstar bya rgyu gal che/ gal srid dngos yod kyi dgos mkho dang bstun pa'i lag bstar ma thub che skad cha stong pa chags kyi red ces bka' gnang / kho bos kun gzigs rin po che bar lam bal yul du zhabs sor 'khod skabs gzhan dbang stabs bstun gyis rkyen pas bal yul du gnas pa'i bod mi btsan byol ba rnams kyis kun gzigs paṇa chen rin poche mchog la zhabs 'degs 'dod blo khengs pa zhu ma thub par tshang mar rang bzhin gyi 276

blo pham byung yod kyang 7gong sa mchog gis bka' blon phyag rogs a lags 'jigs med ched brdzong gis mtshams zhur phebs pa ltar rin po che mchog nas bka' slob zab rgyas gnang bar 7gong sa mchog nas dgyes mnyes chen po gnang gi 'dug ces zhus par kun gzigs rin po che mchog nas/ ngos rang bal yul rgyal po'i sku mgron du bal yul du bskyod skabs thams cad mkhyen pa 'khyug tsam mjal rgyu'i re ba chen po byung yang / srid don gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas mjal thub pa byung ma song yang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' yig bstsal ba shin tu dga' po byung / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku che yun ring brtan pa'i smon lam zhu bzhin yod/ bar lam ngos khams khyal dang / dbus gtsang / a mdo bcas khul du bskyod skabs nga tsho'i bod rigs rnams rdog rtsa chig bsgril dgos lugs skor dang / gzhon skyes rnams shes yon la do snang dgos rgyu'i bsam tshul shod rgyu byung / de ni ngos rang gi 'os 'gan zhig yin/ lhag par du bod mi tshos so so'i rkang pa'i steng so so langs thub pa'i 'bad rtson dgos gal skor thengs mang po brjod rgyu byung / bod mi rnams la 'jon thang med na mi gzhan gyi g.yog tu 'gyur gyi red/ der brten shes yon yar rgyas gtong rgyu gal chen po red/ gal srid rgya rigs kyis nga tshor thob thang sprad pa yin na bod mi tshor 'jon thang med na slar yang gzhan gyi dbang sgyur 'og 'gro rgyu yin par mngon/ gang ltar snga sa nas gra sgrig dgos gal che/ rgya gar nang yod pa'i gzhon skyes tsho nas kyang las khungs 'dzin skyong tsam ma yin par spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong phyogs bcas kyi lag rtsal slob sbyong bya rgyu gal chen po red ces gsungs pa'i thog yang khong gis bod rgya mi rigs dbar 'dra mnyam med na mi rigs mthun sgril yong thabs dka' ba'i skor rgya phyogs dpon 277

rigs khag la yang nas yang du gsung rgyu byung zhes gsungs par kho bos/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po mchog nas slad phyi rgyal khag la 'tshams 'dre gzigs bskor yang yang gnang thub na dge mtshan chen po yod lugs/ de yang chos phyogs kyi bka' slob mang tsam gnang thub na phan thogs chen po yod pa dang / bod rgya khongs yin lugs kyi bka' mol gnang ma dgos pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang gal zhes zhus pa'i thog da res zhu mkhan de a mdo'i mi zhig yin tsang rin po che dgongs 'gal mi yong ba zhes zhal shob dang sbrags nas zhus par/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches bzhad mo bzhad de/ khyed tsho 'di 'dra bsam gyi yod dam zhes bka' 'dre gnang ba dang chabs cig nga la tshig za gang yang med/ gal che shos 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs gzhi ma 'khrug pa bya rgyu dang / nga tsho gzhis byes gnyis kyi sri zhu ba tshang ma bsam blo gcig mthun dgos gal che/ 'on kyang / da lta gzhis byes gnyis kyi gnas stangs mi 'dra ba yin na yang / gcig gyur gyi bsam blo nges par gtong dgos pa yin/ da lta bka' mol byung ba de phyir rgyar ma gsungs na dga'/ gsung nas phan thogs med/ ma 'ongs par thams cad mkhyen pa dang /krung dbyang gi gnad yod cig dang mjal 'phrad gnang thub na dge mtshan chen po yod ces bka' gnang bar/kho bos/ da res rgya phyogs la don tshan gcig zhu rgyu de ni gus pa sger gyi bsam tshul la/ 1987 zla 10 nang 7gong sa mchog nyi tong na ri ta'i dgon pas gdan zhus ltar chibs sgyur thugs gtan 'khel song ba tshur lam tong kong la rgya phyogs kyi dbu khrid cig mjal 'phrad byung na snyam pa'i bsam tshul de bton na dge skyon ci mchis zhes zhus par/ kun gzigs rin po che mchog nas khyed kyi bsam tshul hong 278

kong du mjal phrad gnang rgyu de krung dbyang nas phal cher khas len mi yong ngam bsam 'dug kyang / de las rgya nag gi mtha' mtshams grong khyer kong gre'o lta bur mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu byung na nges par khas len zhu gi red/ thams cad mkhyen par rgya mi'i gnas yod dpon rigs su mjal 'phrad gnang 'dod yod dam/ snga sa nas ming bton thub na khong tshos go sgrig zhu gi red ces gsungs par kho bos/ byung na hu chi li 'am/ zhus krung zhun gnyis mjal 'phrad thub na yag po 'dug zhus/gang ltar thad kur bka' mol byung na dge mtshan chen po yod/ ring min khyed rang rgya gar la phyir phebs ma gnang gong thengs gcig thug gi yin zhes gsungs rjes gsol tshigs go sgrig gnang 'dug yab yum rnam gnyis dang / 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur gyi ren ring bcas mgron 'bod gnang 'dugade rjes kho bo bod ljongs su 'gro rgyur 'gal rkyen 'phrad pa'i mur pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir log bya khar kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du thon mjal khyug tsam bcar rtsis byas kyang / mdzad brel gyis khom min la da res 'phrad thabs dka' ba yin lugs dang bcas sku bcar zhabs zhu ba zhig phran sar 7skyabs mgon rin po che mchog la 'bul rgyu'i phyag bris dang / kho bor phyag rtags bcas skyel bar gtong gnang byung ba nyin de nas bzung khong gi dpa' stobs zhum med kyi thugs brtse'i bka' slob zhu ba'i go skabs dang bral song /de'i sang nyin nga phod dang / phun tshogs dbang rgyal gnyis la mjal 'phrad zhu bsams kyang skabs der pe cing khul gnam gshis grang ngar che ba'i dus skabs yin stabs nga phod nang mi rnams lho phyogs su grang g.yol du phebs 'dugade nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal mjal 'phrad du bskyod de phun tshogs dbang rgyal 279

gyis 7gong sa mchog pe cing du 'khyug tsam phebs thub na dge mtshan yod luḍa dang /da res khyed rang hu chi li dang than ci yun su rung zhig mjal phrad thub na yag po yod lugs/ mjal 'phrad zhu phyogs skor 'thab phyogs gcig gyur 'brel yod mi sna li tso min la bka' mol gnang na khong mi yag po red ces dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang yan ming phu/ de ring snga dro nga sman khang du bskyod skabs 'phrad byung / khyed rang 'di khul 'byor yod pa'i skor khong gis nga la gsungs byung / khong da lta sman bcos byed bzhin pa red/ bdun gcig gi rjes sman khang nas phyir thon rjes khyed rang dang thug 'phrad byed kyi yin zhes gsungs byung / khong mi yag po zhig red/bod don thog la yang bsam tshul yag po yod/ khong lo na chung yang 'jon thang dang nyams myong yang sdig po yod/ nga gnyis btson khang nang mnyam du sdod myong / khyed dang nga gnyis bcings 'grol ma btang sngon nas ngo shes yin lugs skor khong la zhus yod/ ring min khong mjal skabs bka' mol lhod lhod gnang thub na dge mtshan chen po yod/ de bzhin u cing hwa bod nas pe cing du 'byor yod/ khong dang mjal 'phrad gnang thub na yag po 'dug nye char khong yang nga'i nang la phebs nas bar lam bod kyi skor bka' mol mang po byung / khong gis bod don thog la bsam blo yag po khyer nas lag bstar byas yod/ gang yin zhe na/ khong ni grangs nyung mi rigs shig yin tsang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dka' ngal gsal po shes pa'i thog bod la phan thogs byed kyi red ces gsungs byung /de'i sang nyin rla 1 ches 5 nyin snga dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su u cing ha dang mjal 'phrad skabs khong gis bar lam bod kyi gnas tshul ji byung skor bkal mol ji snyed byung zhing / dang thog u cing ha 280

yis snga lo krung dbyang gis nga la bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tru'u ci bsko gzhag gnang ste bod du 'gro dgos red ces bka' khyab gnang skabs ngas las ka byed thub kyi ma red ces dgongs pa zhus pa yin/ gal te bod la 'gro dgos byung na las ka byed bde po zhig dgos kyi 'dug ces zhus pa yin/ gcig ni/ bod rigs rgya che'i mi mang rnams kyis chos dang / rig gzhung / goms gshis bcas la brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa gal chen po red ces zhus pa yin/ krung dbyang gis nga'i bsam tshul la rgyab skyor dang/ khas len gnang yod stabs bod la 'byor nas 'gyur ba mang po zhig btang ba yin/ bod rigs na gzhon 'jon thang yod pa'i las byed rnams la dbang cha dang / gnas rim/ las 'gan bcas sprad yod/ de bzhin bod mi rnams la chos dad rang mos thog la yang sngar las lhag pa'i rang dbang sprad yod pa ma zad/snga lo lha sa smon lam tshogs bcug pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che gdan 'dren zhus pa/ dgon pa mang po nyams gso byed bcug pa bcas la mi rnams shin tu dga' po byung song / da dung yang rim bzhin legs su gtong rgyu'i bsam blo yod/ de mtshungs zhing 'grog sa khul la yang thon skyed yar rgyas phyin yod lugs/ lhag par du yul bskor spro 'cham nas 'di lo gcig pur sgor khri stong phrag lhag tsam gyi khe bzang byung yod/ krung dbyang nas kyang bod la 'dzugs skrun ched rogs dngul 'bor chen gnang yod lugs bcas brjod mthar/ khong gis bar lam phyi rgyal nas bod du so myul mang po btang ste nga tshor dka' rnyog bzo rtsis byas yod /'i gnas tshul zhig byung 'dug pa de yag po ma red ces shod skabs khong gis snang med lta bur brjod pa las khong khro zhe sdang go rnam 'gyur med pa'i thog khyed rang rgya gar du phyir log rjes de skor khyed tsho'i bka' shag dang 'brel yod khag la zhu rogs zhes brjod par/28

kho bos nga'i bsam par/ de ni rgya mi'i gtam dper/ krang gi zhwa mo de li yi mgo la g.yog pa lta bu yin gyi red/ de dag go min tang gis btang ba'i so nyul yin pa las nga tshos de 'dra byed kyi ma red/ gang yin zhe na/ tā la'i bla mas dus rtag tu 'che med kyi lam nas las 'gul bya rgyu las/ de min 'khon 'dzin gyi thog nas las 'gul byed mi rung zhes yang yang bka' slob phebs bzhin yod/ ces brjod par/ khong gis de skor slar yang gleng slong ma byas pa'i sgo nas khyed rang lha sar blta bskor du bskyod 'thus skor li tso min dang bka' mol byung zhing / da lta gnam gshis ha cang grang mo yod pa ma zad khyed rang dgung na mtho po slebs yod stabs dka' ngal 'phrad kyi red/ de las che ba kha shas rjes phebs na yag gi red/ khyed kyis mkhyen gsal ltar/ nam dus yag shos ni rla bdun pa dang brgyad pa dgu pa bcas kyi nang red/ de skabs lha sar phebs na yag po 'dug deng sang nga tsho las byed mang che ba sa cha dma' sar yong gi yod pa red/ de las khyed rang sku gzugs la brtag dpyad sman bcos gnang nas dbyar dus phebs na yag gi red ces brjod byung /zla 1 ches 7 nyin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las byed li tso min dang /ren ring gnyis slar yang phran gyi sdod gnas su slebs nas sngar bzhin bod kyi gnas babs skor bgro gleng byas shing / li tso min gyis/ kha sa nga dang ren ring gnyis kyis khyed dang bka' mol byung don ltar krung dbyang gi bod don skor srid byus 'gyur ba zhig phyin yod/ 'on kyang tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal la phyir phebs gnang rgyu'i re 'dun da mus bzhin zhu gi yod/ de sngon tā la'i bla mas krung dbyang gi dbu khrid rnams la bstod bsngags byung gnang yod pa ma zad/ mes rgyal gyi las don skor la'ang ngo rgol gyis bka' mol de tsam gnang med/ 'on kyang bar lam nas bzung tā la'i bla mas 282

phyi rgyal mi sna dang / gsar 'god par krung dbyang la ngo rgol gyi bka' mol mang po zhig gsungs yod/ de yag po ma red/ tā la'i bla ma 'dzam gling nang snyan grags chen po yod pa'i mi sna zhig red/ khong chos srid gnyis kyi sku yon bla na med pa/mkhas mdzangs dang ldan pa zhig kyang yin/ deng sang krung go'i rgyal khab de man ju'i dus rabs kyi gnas stangs dang 'dra gi ma red/ de bzhin go min tang srid gzhung rul pa'i dus dang 'dra gi ma red/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab nyin re bzhin stobs shugs che ru 'gro gi yod/ phye rgyal su yin na'ang krung go'i rgyal khab la kha gtad gcog rgyu dka'/ bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba de dus rabs bdun pa nas byung ba de dngos 'brel yin zhing / de nas bzung bod de rgya nag gi khongs gtogs yin tshul mang dag cig bshad par/ kho bos/ bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba de dus rabs bdun pa nas byung ba de dngos 'brel yin zhing / 'on kyang / rgyal khab gnyis 'brel mthun byung ba tsam gyis gcig gi 'og tu gcig tshud mi thub/ dus rabs bdun pa nas da bar gyi 'brel ba'i bskyod lam mi 'dra ba khag drug tsam byung yod/dang po/ dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs/ bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po nas bzung dus rabs gsum tsam ring bod rgya rgyal khab gnyis skabs re 'thab 'khrurnga dang / skabs re zhi mthun du gnas yod kyang rgyal khab gnyis tha dad yin zhing /gnyis pa/ dus rabs bcu pa'i dkyil nas dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dkyil bar bod rgya gnyis 'brel ba phra mo tsam yang byung med/gsum pa/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dkyil nas bod kyi bla ma sa skya pa dang /jing ge se han gyi rjes 'jug dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba zhig byung yod/ dus skabs der sog pos rgya nag sung lho ma'i rgyal khab dbang sgyur bya rgyu yin par brten 283

sog po'i rgyal pos krung go'i rgyal khab kyi tshab byed mi thub/ lhag par du dus skabs der sog po'i drag shugs kyis e shi ya'i dkyil gyi yul gru khag dang / yo rob shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab khag e rang rgyal khyab bcas la dbang sgyur byas yod/ de bzhin krung go'i khyim mches rgyal khab ko ri ya dang / khri ti nam/ 'bar ma bcas la bod las lhag pa'i dbang sgyur byas yod/bzhi pa/ dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dkyil nas dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dkyil bar rgya nag ming rgyal khab kyi dus rabs smad bar lo ngo sum brgya tsam ring bod dang ming gi dus rabs dbar chos phyogs kho na'i 'brel ba byung yod pa las/chab srid thog 'brel ba byung yod pa ma red/lnga pa/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dkyil du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang man ju rgyal khab 'brel ba byung / de nas lo shas rjes man ju rgyal khab kyis gzhi nas rgya nag dbang sgyur byas te/ 1553 lor man ju rgyal po shun rtsi dang tu la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i dbar phan tshun mchod yon gyi 'brel ba'i thog nas pe cing du gdan zhu byas pa zhig yin/ tu la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes man ju gzhung gis mchod yon gyi 'brel ba de rim bzhin chab srid kyi thog la bsgyur nas srid phyogs la the byus byas pa nas bzung / 1911 lo bod gzhung dmangs rnams kyis man ju'i nus shugs bod nas mthar skrod byas pa red/drug pa/ 1911 lo nas 1951 bar bod 'di rang dbang rang gyi btsan rgyal khab gcig mtshon par gnas yod/ 1951 lor bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan 17 bzhag pa nas bzung bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs su tshud pa zhig byung yod/ 'on kyang / nga tsho bod kyi rgyal rabs 'phel 284

rgyas rim byung la phyi mig tsam bltas na lo rgyus kyi 'gyur ldog mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung ba de bzhin du bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba yang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig byung yod ces brjod par/li tso min gyis khyed rang gi bsam tshul der ngas mos mthun byed kyi med/'on kyang / dgongs 'char gang yang gsungs na yag po 'dug lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul de gsal po red/ man ju chan lung gi dus rabs la bod de krung go'i mnga' khongs su gtogs yod/ de dag rgya bod gnyis kyi yig cha'i thog gsal po yod/ lhag par du/ don tshan 17 bzhag pa nas bzung bod de slar yang mes rgyal khyim tshang gi pang du phyir log byung yod/ kha sa khyed rang gi dgongs 'char gsungs pa zhig gi nang bod mi yongs rdzogs sam/ khyed rang tsho'i zer srol la/ bod chol kha gsum yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgril te rang thag rang gcod dang / yang na rang skyong chen po zhig btsugs te krung go dang / hin du rgyal khab gnyis dbar zhi bde'i sa khul zhig tu gnas thub pa'i re 'dun bton pa de nam yang yong thabs med pa zhig red/ 'das pa'i rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus dang/ da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul bcas la bltas na bod kyi dngos yod kyi gnas stangs der 'gyur ba gtong thub kyi ma red/ lo rgyus kyi thog la gtan 'khel zin pa zhig red ces dang /yang khong gis 1955 lo nga tsho'i srid blon kra'u en les hin rdu rgyal khab tu 'tshams 'drer phebs skabs su tā la'i bla mar khyed rang lha khang gi lha red/ khyed rangalha khang nang gi lha de phyir phebs na/ lha'i nus pa chung du 'gro gi red/ khyed rang gi lha khang de bod la red/ der brten tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du bzhugs na sku ngal chen po 'phrad kyi red ces gsungs yod pa ltar khyed rang tsho bod rang btsan rgyal khab de 285

bod nang du 'dzugs thub kyi ma red/ gal srid khyed tshos phyi rgyal du btsugs pa'i dbang du btang na nga tshor gnod skyon gang yang gtong thub kyi ma red ces dang /yang khong gis tu la'i bla ma dgung lo 52 la phebs yod/ dgung lo chung chung ma red/ ngas khyed rang la bka' mol 'di zhus pa chig snyan po med kyang zhu dgos pa chags song / mi che 'dir nges gtan med/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma dgongs pa rdzogs pa yin na khyed rang tsho gcig byas na rgya gar nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i yang srid cig gdan 'dren zhu mdog kha po red/ gcig byas na yang srid khag gnyis la 'khrungs mdog kha po red/ khyed rang tshos rgya gar du yang srid cig gdan 'dren zhu mdog kha po red/ nga tshos kyang bod nang nas yang srid gcig 'tshol mdog kha po red ces brjod par/phran gyis tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid skor nga chos rtsod pa rgyag dgos don mi 'dug tu la'i bla mas dus rgyun du ma 'ongs par tu la'i bla ma gnas dang ma gnas de bod mi dmangs kyi dgos 'dun la rag las pa zhig red ces gsungs yod ces brjod skabs/ ren ren gyis krung dbyang nas bla ma'i yang srid skor srid byus gsar pa zhig lag len bstar rgyur gtan 'khel yod/ da lta'i dus skabs 'dir bod rigs mi mang rnams la dgos mkho zhig chags kyi yod/ gang yin zhe na/ bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang la bla ma med na ma 'grigs pa'i dus skabs shig red/ dper na/dgon pa zhig la bla ma zhig med na/ 'grigs kyi yod pa ma red/ dgon pa nyams gso byed pa dang mnyam du bla ma yang dgos kyi yod/ 'on kyang bla ma'i yang srid de rgyal khab nang khul la brtsad gcod dang / ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu ma gtogs phyi rgyal nas yang srid gdan zhu byas na krung dbyang nas ngos 'dzin byed kyi ma red/ khyed rang tshos 286

phyi rgyal nas yang sring ngos 'dzin byas pa de rgyal nang du yong na nga tshos mi dmangs spyi mtshungs las bla ma'i gral du 'jog mi thub/ rtsa ba'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed phyogs skor nyams zhib byed mus yin zhes zer bar/kho bos/ gal srid phyi rgyal mas bla ma'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byas pa de bod du rtsa log byas na khong gi sngon yod kyi dgon pa dang / thob thang bcas rang 'jags sprod rgyu yin nam zhes dres par/ li tso min gyis 'di skor nga tsho nyams zhib byed mus yin/ de skor paṇa chen rin po che nas thugs 'gan chen po bzhes gnang gi yod ces dang / yang khong gis tu la'i bla ma rgyal spyi'i nang mtshan snyan grags chen po yod pa de gal srid mes rgyal la phyir log ma phebs na rim bzhin bod mi rnams kyis khong la dad pa chung du 'gro rgyu dang / tā la'i bla ma med na bod mi rnams la ma 'grigs pa yong gi ma red/ dper na/ ma'o kru'u zhi 'das rjes krung go'i rgyal khab de sngar las yar rgyas phyin yod pa las sdug tu phyin yod pa ma red ces brjod par/kho bos/ tā la'i bla ma dang bod mi rnams kha bral thabs yod pa ma red/ dus yun ring thung la ma ltos par bod du nges par phebs kyi red/ 'gag rtsa de gtso bo hu'u ya'o pang gi tshig tho don tshan lnga'i nang du/ tā la'i bla ma pe cing du bzhugs rgyu las bod du bzhugs dgos ma red ces 'khod yod/ gal te tā la'i bla ma bod du bzhugs ma bcug na bod mi tshang mar bsam tshul gang 'dra zhig yong gi red/ de sngon kho bos bsam tshul zhig bton yod/ de skor khyed rang gnyis kyis gsal po mkhyen gyi yod ces lab par/ li tso min gyis/ krung dbyang gis tu la'i bla ma bod du phebs mi chog zhus med/ bod la ga dus phebs na'ang chog gi red/ 'on kyang /bod kyi phyag las gnang dgos ma red ces tshig tho'i nang gsal yod ces dang /287

yang khong gis bar lam tā la'i bla ma'i gsung gleng nang khyed tsho'i gzhon nu'i lta bar rgyab skyor gnang bar mngon/ krung dbyang gis da lta tu la'i bla ma'i gsung gleng la dgag lan byas med/ bzod pa chen po sgom gyi yod/ tā la'i bla mas dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos zhes brjod par/ kho bos/ khyed tshos tu la'i bla ma'i dgongs pa bzhes stangs yag po rtogs kyi mi 'dug nga tsho'i gzhon nu khag cig gis pa le si than zhes pa'i mi tsho'i las 'gul bzhin spel dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul bton pa byung yod/ de rnams kyis mi chos las ka byed thub pa de nga tsho bod mi tshos byed mi thub pa med snyam pa'i bsam tshul yod pa der tā la'i bla mas de ltar lag len bltar na nam yang 'grigs kyi ma red ces bka' slob nan tan gnang yod pa red ces brjod nas phan tshun rtsod gleng mtshams 'jog byas/li tso min ni rgya nag kun su'u zhing chen khul gyi rgya mi zhig yin/ 1948 lo yas mas la gung khran tang du zhugs pa'i na gzhon shes yon can zhig red/ 1949lo tsam la bod kyi byang shar a mdo bkres 'khyil dang / mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul du las ka byed skabs bod skad dang / bod yig bcas sbyong brdar legs po byas nas 1953 lo lha sar 'byor te krung go gung khran tang bod sdod u yon lhan khang khongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi kho'o krang gi 'gan 'khur dang / de bzhin bod sdod rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u yis gtsos pa'i gnas yod rnams 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag mjal 'phrad zhu skabs gsung bsgyur du bcar gyi yod pa dang /1955 lor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po rgya gar gzhung gis gdan zhus ltar phebs skabs rgya phyogs kyi so blta lta bur 7gong sa mchog gi chibs zhabs su btang yod pa red/ de rjes las 'gan gnas 'phar byung yang rig gnas gsar brje'i 288

skabs nyes chad phog nas kong po sa khul la lo mang ring ngal rtsol sgyur bkod du btang 'dug de rjes ngal rtsol btson sgar nas phyir slog rang yul du btang nas re zhig las med du bsdad/ de nas pe cing du mi rigs spyi tshogs khang du bod rigs sde tshan gyi las ka lo shas byed ring bod du snga rjes thengs 'ga' brtag dpyad du btang yod pa red/ches 13 nyin dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i rjes tsam la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su mi rigs dang chos don sde tshan gyi tsu'u krang krang hreng tsu zhes pa dang mnyam du 'phrad mol byung zhing / skabs der khong mnyam du li tso min dang /ren rin gnyis kyang yod/ krang hreng tsu yis nye lam nga'i las rogs blo mthun li tso min dang / blo mthun rin rin gnyis kyis sku zhabs phun tshogs bkris khyed la krung dbyang gi dgongs tshul gsungs yod pa ma zad/ khyed rang gi dgongs 'char yang gsungs pa de gong rim la snyan seng zhus yod cing / tā la'i bla ma dang / khyed rang gi dgongs tshul nang du/ han mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs bod la lag len bstar gyi 'dug ces gsungs pa de ni drang bden ma red/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi srid byus rtsa don ni mi rigs mthun sgril dang / rgyal khab 'phel rgyas/ mi mang gi 'tsho ba phyug po bzo rgyu bcas yin pa bzhin rgyun du srid byus de dag lag len bstar gyi yod/ han mi rigs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs la rogs ram byed pa las gnya' gnon byed kyi med lugs skor chu tshod gcig tsam ring 'grel bshad mang dag cig brgyab nas khong gis yang bskyar/ khyed tshos bod rigs sa khul khag la blta bskor thengs bzhi dang /pe cing du krung dbyang dang bka' mol gnang bar thengs gnyis phebs yod/ 'on kyang phan tshun dbar gyi 'brel ba yag tu 'gro rgyu'i tshab tu rgyang ring du phyin par phangs 289

sems chen po yod khul gyi rnam pa bstan nas bshad byung /skabs der li tso min gis nye char khyed rang nas nga la sprad pa'i khyed tsho'i shes rig sde tshan nas bod kyi skad yig tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu'i nang rgyal nang nas mkhas pa gdan zhu bya rgyu'i skor nga chos khas len zhu stabs bde min dang / de bzhin khyed tshos snga rjes su re 'dun zhus don ltar sku tshab thengs lnga pa bod du blta bskor bya rgyu'i skor krung dbyang dang mu mthud 'brel ba bya rgyu de rnams lag 'khyer thad de sngon khyed rang la gsal bshad byas yod/ krung dbyang nas thag gcod zin pa'i sgrig gzhi der 'gyur ba gtong thabs med ces zer bar kho bos/ kha sa sku tshab thengs lnga pa'i lag 'khyer sngar bzhin gnang rogs zhes zhus yod/ da dung yang re 'dun de zhu gi yod/ gang yin zhe na/ de ltar byung na nga tsho phan tshun gnyis kyi 'brel ba sngar las lhag pa'i mdun du bskyod thub kyi red ces brjod par/ li tso min gyis yang bskyar de sngon bshad pa'i skad cha de rang dus yun ring po zhig gi ring bshad pa'i thog nga tsho'i mjal 'phrad mtshams 'jog byas/ches 15 nyin dgong dro/ mi rigs las khungs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa a mdo khri kha nas yin pa 'brug rgyal gyis bzhugs shag tu mgron 'bod ltar bcar te 'brug rgyal nas 7rgyal dbang rin po che thengs gcig pe cing du phebs thub na bod mi tshang mar phan thogs yong rgyu/ da lta dus skabs 'dir bod rigs gcig tu bsgril rgyu khag po red/ de lo rgyus ring po'i thog nas chags yod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang / rim pas bsam blo gtong dgos zhes gsungs par/kho bos/ bod chol kha gsum kha bral ba'i lo rgyus thog mi 'dra ba chags yod kyang gcig tu sgril thabs skor bod rigs tshang mas bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig 290

red/ de skor ngas zhi krung zhun dang / u lan phu/ dbyang chin rin bcas la zhu myong /de bzhin khong tsho la mi rigs gzhan pa tshor med pa de yod pa zhig bzos yod/ nga tsho bod mir yod pa de med pa bzos pa red/ dper na/ de sngon lo rgyus yun ring gang tsam zhig nang / nang sog rang skyong ljongs de rgya nag byang brgyud zhing chen mang po'i nang khag bgos byas yod kyang / rgya nag bcings 'grol btang rjes nang sog rang skyong ljongs zhes pa de btsugs yod ces brjod par/'brug rgyal gyis de tsho'i skor krung dbyang dang bka' mol mu mthud gnang na don dag thob kyi red/ phyi la skad log ma brgyab na yag po 'dug khyed kyis shes kyi red/nga tsho mtsho sngon zhing chen la rang skyong sa khul khag drug bzos yod/ de sngon lo rgyus thog a mdo rnga pa dang bla brang bkris 'khyil bcas a mdo gcig gyur gyi sa khul zhig yin rung / man ju'i dus rabs kyi dkyil tsam la rnga pa de zi khron khongs su bgos pa red/ de bzhin 1938 lo tsam la bla brang bkris 'khyil de kun su'u zhing chen khongs su bgos pa red/ bar lam a mdo khag gcig gis gong gsal a mdo'i sa khul rnams gcig sgril gyi bod shar ma rang skyong zhig 'dzugs 'dod yod kyang /gcig gis gcig bsam tshul ma mthun par da mus bzhin gnas yod pa red/ de la gnad 'gag mthong gi mi 'dug dper na/ nang sog rang skyong ljongs lta bu zhing chen gzhan la yod pa'i sog rigs tsho'i rig gzhung dang / skad yig bcas 'phel rgyas yong thabs su nang sog rang skyong ljongs nas lta rtog dang / the byus bcas kyi 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa dper na/ mtsho sngon khul sog rigs sa gnas khag gnyis nang gnas yod pa de rnams kyi skad yig bod yig dang / bod skad/ bod kyi goms gshis bcas ma gtoḍa sog skad shes kyi med kyang deng sang nang sog rang skyong ljongs 29ga

nas gong gsal sa khul gnyis nang yod pa'i sog rigs byis pa rnams la bu bcol khang gsar 'dzugs thog sog skad ma gtogs bod skad rgyag bcug gi yod pa ma red/ma 'ongs par bod rang skyong ljongs kyis bod rigs sa khul rnams gcig tu ma sgril ba'i sngon la nang sog rang skyong ljongs kyi srid byus de la dpe bltas nas lag len bstar na rim bzhin gcig gyur gyi bsam blo thag nye ru 'gro gi red bcas gsungs/'brug rgyal ni/ skyes yul mtsho lho khri kha nas yin pa'i bod mi zhig red/ khong mi gshis drang bden dang / g.yo zol med pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ gung khran tang mi yin yang chos dad chen po yod pa zhig mngon/ khong rnam kun bka' mol de tsam mang po mi gnang mkhan zhig dang / de sngon mtsho sngon khul bod rigs rang skyong sa khul re zung gi tang srid gnyis kyi 'gan 'khur gnang myong mkhan zhig red/ bar lam pe cing du gnas spos kyis rgyal khab mi rigs don byed las khungs kyi spyi khyab gzhon pa'i go gnas yod kyang khong gi bzhugs khang la gzhigs na rgya mi spyir btang las byed cig dang mtshungs pa zhig 'duganyin shas rjes rla 1 ches 29 nyin dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang yan ming phu dang mjal 'phrad skabs khong gi las rogs lhu lan ling dang / slob ston pa cang pheng bcas lhan du yod/ de nyin yan ming phu yis kha sngon khyed rang pe cing du phebs ma thag thug 'phrad byed 'dod byung yang bar lam gzugs po bde min gyis nyin shas ring sman bcos su sdod dgos byung zhing / de ring khyed rang pe cing du phebs par dga' bsu dang sbrags dpyid dus lo gsar skabs 'khel gyi dga' ston gsol chigs stabs bde zhig gra sgrig byas yod/ da ring gsol tshigs su phebs mkhan tshang ma khyed rang gi grogs po rnying pa sha stag red/292

nged gnyis de ring thug pa thog ma yin yang / grogs po rnying pa zhig tu brtsi gi yod/nye char khyed kyis dgongs 'char bton pa rnams nga tshos mthong byung / dgongs 'char ji yod gsungs na yag po red/ de ring nged gnyis gzhung 'brel ma yin par grogs po 'dzoms pa'i 'du shes thog phan tshun bsam tshul brje len byas na yag po 'dug ces gsungs par/kho bos/ de ring khyed mjal bas dga' po byung / bar lam kho bo pe cing du 'byor nas khyed rang gi las khungs kyi mi sna bcas dang lhan du nga'i sger gyi bsam tshul snga rjes thengs bzhi tsam zhus pa'i thog khong rnams kyi dgongs 'char yang nga la mang po gsungs byung / da res khyed mjal ba dang chabs cig nga'i bsam tshul re gnyis zhu gi yin/dang po/ nga tsho'i blta bskor tshogs pa thengs lnga pa bod du bskyod 'thus kyi lag 'khyer thog 'gal rkyen 'phrad pa de khong rnams la zhib phra zhus yod/gnyis pa/ nga sger gyi bsam tshul 'di lo rla 10 nang nyi tong chos tshogs shig nas tā la'i bla ma gdan zhu phul yod pa ltar chibs sgyur gnang gtan 'khel yod stabs nyi hong nas rgya gar du phyir phebs lam zhor hong kong sa khul la hru'u ci zhi'i krung shun dang / hu chi li rnam gnyis 'khyug tsam mjal 'phrad yong ba'i re 'dun zhu gi yod/gsum pa/ tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du chos don gyi thog chibs sgyur gnang skabs 'di phyogs nas gdan zhu byed mkhan rgyal khab de dang chos tshogs khag la ngo rgol mi yong ba'i dgongs bzhes gnang rogs ces brjod par/ yan ming phu nas rtsa ba'i krung dbyang dang tā la'i bla ma'i dbar gyi 'brel ba yag tu gtong rgyu de gal chen po red/ 'on kyang / 1979 lo nas bzung khyed tshos bod rigs sa khul la blta bskor 293

sku tshab thengs bzhi dang / pe cing du bsam tshul gros mol thengs gnyis tsam phebs yod lugs sogs kyi skor tshig 'jam po'i sgo nas skyon 'dzugs byed pa dang / yang khong gis/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma phyir phebs gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes yod na nga tshos dus rtag tu dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ 'on kyang / bar lam nas bzung tu la'i bla mas phyi rgyal gsar 'god pa sogs la bka' mol gnang ba de tu la'i bla ma'i rang nyid kyi dgongs bzhes e yin snyam pa'i rdugs pa yod/ gang yin zhe na/ de sngon bka' mol gnang ba dang / bar lam bka' mol gnang ba gnyis dbar 'gyur ba chen po phyin yod/ tā la'i bla mas dgongs pa yag po bzhes te thag gcod bya rgyu'i dus tshod gal chen po zhig tu slebs yod/ krung go dang rgyal spyi'i gnas stangs skor dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos/ phyogs mtshungs bod kyi dngos yod gnas stangs thog la yang dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ mi su dang su yin rung bsam blo dang dngos yod gnas tshul gnyis dbar 'gal rla yod/ dper na/ 1950 lor a ri nas khyed tshor rogs ram phran bu byas yod/ 1970 lo'i nang krung go dang a ri'i dbar 'brel ba byas pa nas bzung khyed tshor 'brel ba bcad yod/ de nas bzung a ri dang krung go gnyis lag sbrel gyis u ru su la kha gtad gcag pa red/ 1950 nas 1980 bar krung go dang su'u le na dbar gyi 'brel ba sdug tu phyin pa red/ deng skabs su'u lan dang krung go 'brel lam yar rgyas byung nas ru sus phyi sog nang la yod pa'i dmag tshang ma phyir 'then byed 'go tshugs yod/yang khong gis tha'i wan thog srid byus lag len byed stangs skor gleng mol thog slad lo rgyun ring po ma song bar tha'i wan gyi gnad don de thag gcod thub kyi red ces gdeng 'khel po'i thog nas gsungs byung ba dang / yang khong gis bod rang btsan ni nam yang yong mi thub/ gang lags she na/ rgyal spyi'i gnas babs dang / krung go'i 294

gnas babs/ bod kyi gnas babs bcas tshang mar blta dgos shing / rgyal spyi'i gnas stangs thog bshad na/ bod rang btsan thog la rogs ram byed mkhan rgyal khab su yang med/ lhag par du rgyal khab su 'dra zhig yin rung rgyal khab rang nyid kyi khe phan yod na ma gtogs snying rje byas te rogs ram byed kyi ma red/ a ri dang /ru su/ rgya gar bcas tshang ma de bzhin red/ da lta rgya gar gzhung gis khyed tshor rogs ram phran bu byed kyi yod pa de sa mtshams kyi rtsod rnyog thad khyed tsho tag se rtsed pa lta bur bed spyod byed kyi yod/ krung go dang / hin rdu gnyis dbar 'brel ba yag tu phyin rjes khyed tshor rgya gar sa thog tu srid don gyi las ka byed bcug gi ma red/ dngos yod kyi gnas stangs de gzigs dgos kyi red/ gang ltar srid don de las rgyu 'bras med pa zhig red/ khyed tshos nges par dgongs pa brtan po bzhes dgos kyi red ces bshad skabs der khong gi las rogs lhan lan ling nas/ tā la'i bla ma khyag tsam gzigs bskor la phebs thub na dge mtshan chen po 'dug ces bshad pa'i rjes/ yan ming phu nas nye lam blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang gi las ka yag po gnang ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis khong hru'u ci dgongs pa zhu dgos chags pa red ces dang / mtha' don khong gis tā la'i bla ma dang / gzhan dag bcas la nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi srid byus la 'gyur ba med pa dang / tshig tho don tshan lnga sngar bzhin lag len bstar rgyu yin pa las 'gyur ba gtong rgyu min zhes zer te bgro gleng mjug bsdoms byas/nyin gnyis kyi rjes/ 1987 zla 2 ches 1 nyen phyi dro chu tshod lnga pa'i thog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs su krung gung krung dbyang chab srid cus kyi tru'u ci zhi krung zhun dang lhan du grogs po dang mdza' brtse'i rnam pa'i thog nas mjal 'phrad byung zhing / dang thog khong gis tu la'i bla ma sku khams bzang po yin nam/ khyed rang da 295

res pe cing du phebs par dga' bsu yod lugs bcas gsungs par/ kho bos/ tā la'i bla ma mchog sku khams bzang po dang / khong gis khyed la 'tshams 'dri gnang gi yod lugs dang / da res ngas 'di khul sger gyi ming thog nas yong don gtso bo snga lo mkhas dbang li yi'u yi rda ram sa la nas pe cing du phyir phebs rjes khyed rang dang bka' mol ji byung gi gnas tshul skor phran la gnas bris zhig 'byor ba'i nang /phan tshun 'brel ba ma chad pa dgos gal skor khyed rang gis nga la 'phrin lan bskur gnang ba'i skor 'khod 'dug pa ltar da res bcar ba zhig yin/ kha sa yan ming phu pu'u krang dang gnas tshul zhib phra bka' mol byung lugs skor brjod par/ zhi krung zhun gyis tā la'i bla ma'i sku yon khong gi mtshan dang mtshungs kyi yod pa de ni rgya mtsho lta bu red/ dus rgyun du ngas khong la gus brtsi chen po zhu gi yod/ khong rang chos phyogs kyi sku yon chen po yod pa ma zad/ chab srid thog la yang nyams myong chen po chags yod/ khong mes rgyal du phyir phebs gnang thub na khong gi sku yon de mes rgyal mi rigs gcig gyur gyi mthun sgril dang / deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun bcas la legs skyes chen po gnang thub pa ma zad/ bod mi mang gi dpal 'byor yar rgyas dang / chos dang rig gzhung bcas gong 'phel slad phan nus chen po yong gi red/ tu la'i bla mas dus rgyun du bod mi mang gi bde skyid la dgongs bzhes gnang mus ltar phyag son thub kyi red bsam gyi 'dug ces bstod bsngags lta bu zhus rjes yang khong gis/ bar lam tā la'i bla mas mes rgyal la skyon brjod dang / gnod skyon yong rgyu'i bka' mol 'ga' shas gsungs yod pa de nga tshos khong rang sger gyi dgongs tshul ma red bsam gyi 'dug bsam tshul de tsho ni khong gi khor yug tu yod pa'i gzhon nu'i bsam tshul gyi shugs rkyen red bsam gyi 'dug krung go'i gzhung dang /bod gzhung zhes pa'i langs phyogs 'dzin stangs de nga tsho'i dbar 'brel lam 296

'grigs thabs med/ 'dzam gling gi chab srid 'pho 'gyur 'gro stangs de rgyal khab gcig gis 'dzam gling gi chab srid la kha lo bsgyur mi thub/ tu la'i bla ma sku yon chen po yod na yang / dngos yod gnas tshul dang ma bstun na 'dzam gling chab srid kyi kha lo sgyur mi thub/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du ga dus phebs na'ang nga tshos dga' bsu zhu gi yod/ khyed kyi bsam tshul bton pa bzhin nga tsho dang tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal sa thog la mjal 'phrad gnang rgyu de yong rgyu khag po red/ gang yin zhe na/ hong kong lta bur cha mtshon na/ ma 'ongs par mes rgyal khongs su slebs rgyu yin rung / da lta dbyin ji'i sa thog red/ de mtshungs gsang rgya yang byed mi thub/ sa cha de srung skyob thog nyen kha chen po zhig kyang yod pa red/ gal te tā la'i bla mas nga tsho thug 'phrad gnang 'dod yod na krung go'i sa thog mtsho kha 'os 'tshams shig la gsang thabs kyis phebs na nga tshos dga' bsu zhu rgyu ma zad/ gang ci'i thad go sgrig kyang legs po zhu thub kyi red/ de bzhin gsang rgya yang zhu thub kyi red gsungs pa dang/ yang khong gis da cha tu la'i bla ma dgung lo 53 la phebs yod pa red/ mi yul du yun ring bzhugs na phyi mi tshos mthong rlung dang khyad gsod byed kyi red/ de ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid red/ da lta hin rdu'i gzhung gis tu la'i bla mar gus brtsi chen po zhu gi yod kyang / de ni khyed tshor bed spyod byed ched yin pa de khyed tshos shes dgos/ krung go dang / hin rdu rgyal khab gnyis dbar sa mtshams rtsod rnyog lhing 'jags ma byung bar tu la'i bla mar tag se rtsed pa lta bur bed spyod byed kyi red/ gnad don de tu la'i bla mas gsal po mkhyen gyi red/ khyed tshos hin rdu gzhung gi srid byus der nges par rdugs zon byed dgos/ gal srid rdugs zon ma byas na rjes su dka' ngal mang po 'phrad kyi red ces pa'i brjod tshig de hob ste nyan skabs lhag bsam zol med kyi slob ston lta bur snang yang / don dngos thog 'gal ba'i g.yo chig yin pa 297

gsal por mngon/skabs der kho bos/ tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal sa thog tu phebs nas lo 30 lhag tsam bzhugs yun ring phyi rgyal su zhig gi bed spyod 'og tshud med la/ ma 'ongs par yang tshud kyi ma red brjod par/ zhi krung zhun gyis de 'dra yin na yag po red/ ces dang / yang khong gis/ de sngon nga tsho'i hru'u ci zur pa hu'u ya'o pang nub 'jar man la 'tshams 'dre gzigs bskor du phebs skabs nub 'jar man gyis gyi rin paraḍi nas bod don skor gleng slong byas yod lugs dang / yang khong gis khyed tsho'i blta bskor tshogs pa thengs lnga pa bod du yong rgyu'i thad krung dbyang gi thag gcod zin par gyur ba gtong thub kyi ma red/ phyogs mtshungs khyed chos rgya nag gzhung dang bod gzhung zhes pa gsal bsgrags byas yod pa de yag po ma red/ gal te bsam tshul yod na phyi la gsal bsgrags ma byas pa'i thog nga tshor nang don gros mol byas na yag gi red ces gsungs pa'i thog yang khong gis rgya lo don grub nye char nga tsho'i ldi lir bca' sdod gzhung tshab dang mjal 'phrad du phebs te khyed rang nang bzhin khong sger gyi ming thog nas khong gi sras gnyis dang de min tā la'i bla ma'i yid ches yod pa dang /skad cha shod mkhas pa'i mi drug bdun tsam khrid de bod ljongs sa khul khag la bskyod 'dod yod ces gsungs pa dang / de dag tā la'i bla mas mos mthun gnang byung zhes gsungs 'dug de skor khyed kyis shes kyi yod dam zhes dris byung bar/kho bos/ de skor shes kyi med/ 'on kyang / khong gis gsungs pa bzhin tu la'i bla mas mos mthun gnang yod par yid ches yod ces lan btab par/ zhi krung zhun gyis bar lam nga tsho dang rgya lo don grub dbar 'brel ba chad nas dus yun lo shas phyin pa red/ nye char nga tsho 'brel ba gnang ba'i rtags mtshan lta bu zhig bstan pa red/ rgya lo don grub nas nga tsho'i blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang las 'khur bzhag rjes 298

bsam tshul bton pa de dzi yin mi shes zhes bshad mtshams/ yud tsam ring bsam blo btang nas yang bskyar/ phal cher nga tsho'i srid byus la 'gyur ba mi yong ngam bsams pa yong srid/ nga tsho'i srid byus gtan 'bebs byas pa der 'gyur ba gtong gi ma red/ tā la'i bla ma dang / krung dbyang dbar 'brel ba bzo mkhan rgya lo don grub yin stabs khong rang 'di phyogs ga dus phebs 'dod yod na yang nga tshos dga' bsu zhu gi red/ 'on kyang / khong rang mnyam du phebs mkhan gzhan rnams kyi lag 'khyer nga chos gtan 'bebs byas pa'i lag 'khyer ma gtogs sngar bzhin 'bul thub kyi ma red/ nye char khyed kyis bod nang tan mi rigs mang po slebs yod pa'i skor bsam tshul bton pa de la sems khral byed mi dgos/ tan mi rigs mang po slebs pa de gnas skabs ring bod yar rgyas yong ba'i 'dzugs skrun ched du yin/de ni 1980 lor blo mthun hu'u ya'o pang bod du gzigs bskor phebs nas srid byus gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar bod la tshong las dang / 'dzugs skrun sogs krung dbyang nas rogs ram byed rgyu las/ rgya mi rigs rnams bod du gtan sdod bya rtsis med ces dang /yang khong gis/ khyed tsho'i bsam blo gtong stangs khyad mtshar po 'dug nye lam khyed tsho'i shes bya gsar shog nang du mekha ma hon sa thig de ngos 'dzin byas 'dugadangos yod gnas tshul byas na/ de sngon bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis skabs der ngos len byas med/ las ka de 'dra byas na bod mi rnams kyis khyed tshor dga' po byed kyi ma red ces dang / yang khong gis/ tā la'i bla mas phyi rgyal du chos phyogs kyi bslabs bya'i snying don du/ chos lugs tshang ma mthun bsgril dang / gcig gyur dgos gal skor gsungs pa de rlabs chen gyi dgong bzhes shig red/ de nas khong gis yar bzhengs nas da nga tshos gsol tshigs gra sgrig byas yod pas gsol ston du 299

phebs zhes brjod pa dang / bka' mol mtshams bzhag nas gsol tshigs su bskyod/ gsol chigs grub mtshams/ zhi krung zhun gyis kho bo'i lag nas bzung ste tā la'i bla ma khyug tsam mes rgyal la phebs nas khong gi grogs po rnying pa rnams thug 'phrad thog khong gis mes rgyal dang kha bral ma yin pa'i dgongs 'char ji 'dra zhig gsungs na yang dge mtshan chen po yong gi red/ gnas tshul de ngas tā la'i bla mar zhu lugs khyed kyi brgyud zhu gnang rogs zhes zer/ de nyen zhi krung zhun mnyam du 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang yan ming phu dang / cang phen bcas lhan du yod/zu na ches 8 nyin kho bo pe cing nas rgya gar du phyir thon khar li tso min dang / ren ring gnyis phran sar slebs nas li tso min gyis khyed tsho'i blta bskor sku tshab kyi lag 'khyer ni khyed tsho'i rnam 'gyur la rag las pa zhig red ces brjod par/kho bos gal srid nga tsho'i phyogs nas ngo rgol gyis las 'gul lag len ma bstar na lag 'khyer sngar bzhin sprod rgyu yin pa'i go don red dam zhes brjod skabs/ kho pas gad mo zhig bgad nas tshig lan gang yang ma byas shing / skabs der ren ring gyis/da regangs tshig mdor bsdus dang / gsang po zhig zhus na/ khyed tshor de sngon bzhag pa'i gros mthun don tshan 17 nang 'khod pa'i thob thang las lhag pa rag thabs med/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du 'khyag tsam phebs te rgyal khyab kyi dbu khrid rnams dang / mjal thub na dge mtshan chen po yod/ don dag son min gyi gnas tshul tha dad red/ dper na/ dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs go min tang dang / gung khyan tang gnyis mthun bsgril yong slad ma'o kru'u zhi khrung ching du bskyod skabs go min tang dang /cang ce hre sogs la bstod bsngags kyi tshig mang po gsungs yod kyang khrung ching nas yan an du phyir 'khor 'phral go min tang la phar rgol gyi las 'gul shugs che ru btang yod/ de mtshungs a ri dang / su'u lan gnyis chu dang me thug pa bzhin yin 300
