yang srid don gyi khe phan slad phyogs gnyis kyi rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid tsho mjal 'phrad yong rgyu'i 'bad brtson byed mus red/ de bzhin deng skabs rgyal spyi'i nang rgyal khab khag gcig phan tshun rtsod gleng rno ngar dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'thab 'khrugs byed kyi yod kyang zhi ba'i lam nas thag gcod yong thabs kyi 'brel gtugs kyi srid byus lag len bstar gyi yod pa red/ gal srid tā la'i bla ma 'khyug tsam phebs na khyed tsho'i phyogs la gnod kyi ma red/ khyed tsho'i langs phyogs de 'gyur ba gtong dang mi gtong khyed tsho'i 'dod pa red ces bcas brjod byung /kho bo pe cing du sdod ring de'i sngon tsam la ldi lir bca' sdod rgya mi'i gzhung tshab rnying pa hren can bza' 'tsho gnyis nas mi rigs pho brang du nyin dgung gsol tshigs shig la mgron 'bod ltar bskyod par hren can gyis/ tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du phebs na yag po yong lugs dang / mi gzhan gyi rgyal khab nang yun ring bzhugs rgyu mi 'dug ces zhi'i krung zhun gyi brjod tshig dang gcig gyur bshad byung / de bzhin de sngon bod rang skyong ljongs zhes pa'i kru'u zhi zur pa rdo rje tsho brtan lags kyis kho bo thug 'phrad du phebs te 7rgyal ba rin po che bod du phyir phebs gnang na yag po 'dugagal srid gtan bzhugs ma thub na yang bod ljongs yongs su gzigs skor zhig tu 'khyag tsam phebs na dge mtshan chen po yong gi red/ bod mi rnams kyis khong mjal 'dod kyis phebs sgug zhu bzhin yod/ khong rang gzhan dag dang 'dra gi ma red/ bod mi rnams nas dad gus chen po zhu gi yod/ lhag par gzhon skyes rnams kyis 7rgyal ba rin po che la dad gus dang re ba chen pozhu gi yod pa red/ bod rigs gzhon skyes rnams kyis paṇa chen rin po che la de tsam gyi dad gus byed kyi mi 'dug gang lags she na/ sdom pa med pa dang / rgyas spros chen po dang / rgyu nor la mnyes po gnang mkhan zhig tu mthong gi yod/ 7rgyal ba rin po che pe cing du khyug 30

tsam phebs thub pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang dgos kyi 'dug ma phebs na yag po yod pa ma red/ srid don gyi las ka de khyad mtshar po zhig red ces dang /yang khong gis 7rgyal ba rin po che skya phywa'i thog gzab gzab gnang dgos/ ngas zhu dgos don med/ khyed tshos gsal po shes kyi red/ bar lam nga pe cing du slebs nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung skor nyams zhib kyi lte gnas shig gsar 'dzugs byed kyi yod/ de sngon rgyal spyi'i nang bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung la do snang nyams zhib dang / bgro gleng yang yang byas dang byed bzhin yod pa red/ 'on kyang / rgyal nang du de tsam do snang byas med stabs slad bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi lte gnas kyis 'gan 'khur nas nyams zhib dang / skabs re rgyal spyi'i mi sna rnams gdan zhus kyis gros gleng tshogs 'du bya rgyu'i gra sgrig bya rtsis yin/ krung dbyang nas lo rer 'gro gron sgor khri nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam bka' 'khrol gnang yod ces dang / yang khong 'gro khar/ slar yang 7rgyal ba rin po che'i skya phyu'i thog gzab gzab byed dgos zhes nan tan thog nas brjod byung /pe cing nas ldi lir sdod gnas su 'byor skabs sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog gis kho bo 'byor ma thag khong la kha dpar zhig lam seng gtong dgos zhes ljags lan 'jog gnang yod pa ltar lam seng kha par thog da lam pe cing du 'brel ba ji byung skor phra zhing zhib pa snyan seng zhus pa dang / de nas rda sa bzhugs sgar du phyir 'khor rjes 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas bcas la da lam kho bos pe cing du krung dbyang chab srid cus kyi tru'u ci zhi krung zhun dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang yan ming phu gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i gnad yod dpon rigs rnams dang mnyam du snga rjes thengs lnga tsam thug 'phrad thog phan tshun bsam tshul ji byung skor 7snyan seng thal lus med pa zhus pa yin//302

le tshan zhe gcig pa/btsan byol du 'byor khongs de snga rang dbang rang btsan skabs kyi bod gzhung dmag sgar khag gi 'go dmag yongs nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul zhus pa/༄༅༅/ /phyi lo 1959 lor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i chibs zhabs sku srung du bcar ba ka dang sku srung mda' dpon phran stag lha dang / ru dpon bsod nams bkris/ brgya dpon blo bzang bkris/ lding dpon 4 me jar 1 bcu dmag grangs 135 kha dang gra bzhi mda' dpon bkris dpal ra rdo rje tshe brtan dang / dang ru bsod nams rdo rje/ bzhi ru dbang ldan bkris/ sdod dang brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul/ sdod gsum brgya dpon bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang / phun tshogs rdo rje/ sdod bzhi brgya dpon rdo rje/ lding dpon 12 me jar 4 bcu dmag grangs 34༷ nga dang rgyal rtse mda' dpon mdo mkhar sras bsod nams stobs rgyal/ lding dpon 2 me jar 1 bcu dmag grangs 75 cha dang (pu li si)mda' dpon 'jun pa ngag dbang dpal mo dang / ru dpon rig 'dzin dpal 'byor spyodang ni 1959 lha sa'i dmag 'thab la skad grags bzhag pa'i byas can gyi dpa' bo zhig red )lding dpon 1 bcu dmag 33 ga dang gzhis rtse lding dpon o rgyan rdo rje dang /dmag 1 bcas 'brug dang mon brgyud rgya gar nang snga rjes 'byor thub pa dang / de 303

bzhin bal yul shar khum bu dang wa lung brgyud ca dang ding ri dmag sgar gyi lding dpon 4 dang / bcu dmag grangs 100 skor bcas khyon bsdoms 'go dmag 713 lhag tsam rim 'byor thub pa rnams nas gzhon skyes phal cher glo dmag sgar/dang slob sogs zhi drag gsang gsum sgrig khongs su bzhugs nas rang yul dgra lag nas bskyar len zhu rgyur sems shugs cher bskyed kyi rgyal gces lhag bsam g.yo med du gnas yod/ 'on kyang dus kyi chos nyid kyis lo re bzhin nyung du 'gro bar brten lhag bsdad rnams nas bod dmag gi mi rabs kyi mjug ma rdzogs gong bod bstan srid mi rigs dang bcas pa'i bde rtsa 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i sku phyu mdzad 'phrin kho nar rag lus yod pas bod gzhung dmangs kyi bka' drin cha shas tsam gzhal phyir dang / phyin chad kyang tshe rabs rjes 'dzin yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhu slad 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por de snga'i bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dmag sgar khag gi 'go dmangs gzhis byes ngo yod rnams nas brtan bzhugs 7zhabs brtan zhig bstar 'bul zhu rgyur gros mthun te de don phran sku srung mda' dpon nas 7snyan seng zhu dgos brjod byung /phran nas skya sger yig tshang brgyud 7snyan seng zhus par bka'i phyir phebs su de dang chabs cig gsung chos khag gcig stsal rgyu'i bka' bzhes thob cing / sa sprul zla 1 tshes 17 phyi lo 1989 zla 2 tshes 33 nas bzung spyod 'jug chen mo dang bslab btus kyi bka' khrid dang 'brel spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' dbang sta gon dngos gzhi bcas nyin ltar chags su stsal ba dang / bod zla 3 tshes 1 res gza' lhag pa'i nyin rnam grwa mkhan slob gsung zhabs bcas nas tshe sgrub gnad smin sngon song gis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs mgon du spyan drangs nas tshe sbyin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas brtan 304

bzhugs gzab rgyas bstar 'bul zhus/de rjes pho brang du 'go dmangs yongs la dgyes brtse'i mjal kha dang bka' slob stsal ba bcas tshang ma skal bzang dga' bde'i dpal la longs spyad/ mjug tu dmar nag gnyis kyi rten mkhar mdun bsangs gsol gzab rgyas dang / rgyal sa lha sar bod rang btsan ched rgya rgol zhi ba'i rngam ston gnang mkhan dpa' bo pho mo 'das gson rnams kyi ched theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar dang 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen bkur zhus te thugs smon zhal 'don gnad smin rgya che gnang / 'phros lhag hin sgor na0934 yod pa bstan srid sku pa'i zhabs rim dang / ma ṇi dung sgrub/ smon lam chen mo bcas kyi thebs rtsa'i khongs su 'bul lam zhus pa bcas so/gong gsal rang nyid kyi mi che'i byung ba brjod pa 'di lo ngo bzhi'i ring ngal ba khur du blang nas da phan rang thog dngos myong mthong thos kyi gnas tshul gal che ba blo nges gang dran yig thog zhib mo'i lam nas 'khod pa'i 'bad brtson gang yong byas pa yin/ 'on kyang rang nyid shes pa mongs la shes yon gnas tshad kyang zhan khar lo na yang rgas pas gnas tshul mang po zhig brjed nges kyi kun pos khyer nas dran ma gsos pa dang / 'ga' zhig dran gsos kyang lo zla dus ches ma nges pa/ lhag par sems nas bsams kyang yig thog ji bzhin 'god mi thub pa sogs kyi gnas tshul mgo yod la/ mjug med pa dang / cha mi tshang ba/ brjod 'don dag gsum skyon bral zhig bcas yong gi mi 'dug rung / thog ma'i dam bca' snying la brtan por bzungs nas sdug rus kyi dus kyi gron pa btang te bris pa klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du bstar ba 'di yin/ 'on kyang lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul bcos med rang mdangs 'cher ba zhig 'bri dgos dus rang bzhin brtse ldan gnyen nye dang / grogs 305

po 'ga' zhig la thugs phog kyang yong srid pas/ gal te de rigs mchis na kho bos lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas bzod gsol zhu rgyu dang / yang lhag bsam rnam dkar gyi cha shas phran bu mchis che de dag phyag na padmo'i thugs bzhed grub pa'i ched bsngo smon zhu rgyu bcas lags so//mi thog 'di la skyed gsum sdug gsum bzhin//mi yul gnas kyang rang yul ma brjed par//mi che'i byung ba brjod pa'i lo rgyus 'di//mi rabs rjes ma'i dran rten tshul du bris///ma bcos rang bzhin gtam gyi mdel rtse 'di//langs phyogs bden pa'i 'ben la bsnun na yang //ma rtogs log rtogs thugs la 'phog srid na//ma bsam thog tu babs pas thol lo bshags//306
